definitions.en: s. at some distance from the shore
definitions.zh: adv. 向海面

examples.en: The wind is blowing offshore today.
examples.zh: 今天风从陆地吹向海面。

examples.en: They work on an offshore oil platform.
examples.zh: 他们在近海石油平台上工作。

definitions.en: n. a graded change in the magnitude of some physical quantity or dimension
definitions.zh: n. 倾斜度, 梯度, 坡度, 斜率

definitions.en: n. the property possessed by a line or surface that departs from the horizontal
definitions.zh: a. 渐升的, 渐降的, 步行的

examples.en: The road has a steep gradient.
examples.zh: 这条路有一个陡峭的坡度。

examples.en: We measured the gradient of the hill.
examples.zh: 我们测量了山的倾斜度。

definitions.en: n. traveler who moves from one region or country to another
definitions.zh: n. 候鸟, 移居者

definitions.en: s. habitually moving from place to place especially in search of seasonal work
definitions.zh: [法] 移居者

examples.en: Migrant workers travel for jobs.
examples.zh: 移居工人为了工作而旅行。

examples.en: The migrant birds fly south in winter.
examples.zh: 候鸟在冬天飞往南方。

definitions.en: a. used of high or hilly country
definitions.zh: n. 山地, 高地, 高原
a. 高地的, 山地的

examples.en: They live in the upland region.
examples.zh: 他们住在高地地区。

examples.en: Upland farms grow different crops.
examples.zh: 高地农场种植不同的作物。

definitions.en: n. a doctrine that advocates equal rights for women
definitions.zh: n. 女权主义, 男女平等主义
[医] 男子女性

examples.en: She studies feminism at university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习女权主义。

examples.en: Feminism advocates for equal rights.
examples.zh: 女权主义倡导平等权利。

definitions.en: a. relating to cells
definitions.zh: a. 细胞的

definitions.en: a. characterized by or divided into or containing cells or compartments (the smallest organizational or structural unit of an organism or organization)
definitions.zh: [医] 细胞的

examples.en: Cellular biology studies living cells.
examples.zh: 细胞生物学研究活细胞。

examples.en: He uses a cellular phone for work.
examples.zh: 他使用手机工作。

definitions.en: s producing new life or offspring
definitions.zh: a. 生殖的, 再生的, 复制的
[医] 生殖的, 复现的

examples.en: The reproductive system is essential for life.
examples.zh: 生殖系统对生命至关重要。

examples.en: Birds have unique reproductive habits.
examples.zh: 鸟类有独特的繁殖习性。

definitions.en: n. a speech sound made with the vocal tract open
definitions.zh: n. 元音

definitions.en: n. a letter of the alphabet standing for a spoken vowel
definitions.zh: a. 元音的

examples.en: The letter 'a' is a vowel.
examples.zh: 字母'a'是一个元音。

examples.en: She learned the five vowel sounds.
examples.zh: 她学会了五个元音发音。

definitions.en: n. (law) the hearing and determination of a dispute by an impartial referee agreed to by both parties (often used to settle disputes between labor and management)
definitions.zh: n. 仲裁, 公断

definitions.en: n. the act of deciding as an arbiter; giving authoritative judgment
definitions.zh: [计] 仲裁

examples.en: They settled the dispute through arbitration.
examples.zh: 他们通过仲裁解决了争端。

examples.en: Arbitration is faster than going to court.
examples.zh: 仲裁比上法庭更快。

definitions.en: n. a regulated daily food allowance
definitions.zh: a. 饮食的

definitions.en: a. of or relating to the diet
definitions.zh: n. 规定食物

examples.en: She follows a strict dietary plan.
examples.zh: 她遵循严格的饮食计划。

examples.en: Dietary habits affect your health.
examples.zh: 饮食习惯影响你的健康。

definitions.en: n. any substance (such as a chemical element or inorganic compound) that can be taken in by a green plant and used in organic synthesis
definitions.zh: a. 营养的, 滋养的
n. 营养物, 滋养物

examples.en: Fruits provide important nutrients.
examples.zh: 水果提供重要的营养物。

examples.en: This soil is rich in nutrients.
examples.zh: 这种土壤富含营养物。

definitions.en: s most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied
definitions.zh: a. 最佳的, 最理想的
[化] 最优的

examples.en: We need the optimal solution.
examples.zh: 我们需要最佳的解决方案。

examples.en: This is the optimal time to plant.
examples.zh: 这是种植的最佳时间。

definitions.en: n. Australian tree grown especially for ornament and its fine-grained wood and bearing edible nuts
definitions.zh: n. 榛子, 榛树, 淡褐色

definitions.en: n. the fine-grained wood of a hazelnut tree (genus Corylus) and the hazel tree (Australian genus Pomaderris)
definitions.zh: a. 榛树的, 淡褐色的

examples.en: She has beautiful hazel eyes.
examples.zh: 她有一双美丽的淡褐色眼睛。

examples.en: The hazel tree grows in the forest.
examples.zh: 榛树生长在森林里。

definitions.en: n. the social science that studies the origins and social relationships of human beings
definitions.zh: n. 人类学
[医] 人类学

examples.en: She studies anthropology at the university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习人类学。

examples.en: Anthropology helps us understand different cultures.
examples.zh: 人类学帮助我们理解不同的文化。

definitions.en: n. the immature free-living form of most invertebrates and amphibians and fish which at hatching from the egg is fundamentally unlike its parent and must metamorphose
definitions.zh: n. 幼虫
[医] 幼虫(昆虫), 蚴(蠕虫)

examples.en: The butterfly larva eats leaves all day.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶幼虫整天吃叶子。

examples.en: A larva will soon become a pupa.
examples.zh: 幼虫很快就会变成蛹。

definitions.en: n. something that acts like a tentacle in its ability to grasp and hold
definitions.zh: n. 触须, 触手, 触角

definitions.en: n. any of various elongated tactile or prehensile flexible organs that occur on the head or near the mouth in many animals; used for feeling or grasping or locomotion
definitions.zh: [医] 触角, 触须

examples.en: The octopus has eight long tentacles.
examples.zh: 章鱼有八条长触手。

examples.en: A tentacle reached out from the dark water.
examples.zh: 一条触手从黑暗的水中伸出来。

definitions.en: n. hormone secreted by the isles of Langerhans in the pancreas; regulates storage of glycogen in the liver and accelerates oxidation of sugar in cells
definitions.zh: n. 胰岛素
[化] 胰岛素

examples.en: She takes insulin every day for her diabetes.
examples.zh: 她每天注射胰岛素治疗糖尿病。

examples.en: Insulin helps control blood sugar levels.
examples.zh: 胰岛素有助于控制血糖水平。

definitions.en: s grossly offensive to decency or morality; causing horror
definitions.zh: a. 暴虐的, 极无礼的, 可恶的

examples.en: His behavior was completely outrageous at the party.
examples.zh: 他在派对上的行为完全令人无法容忍。

examples.en: The price of that dress is outrageous.
examples.zh: 那条裙子的价格高得离谱。

definitions.en: s. discouraging by hindering
definitions.zh: a. 令人沮丧的

examples.en: The traffic jam was very frustrating.
examples.zh: 交通堵塞非常令人沮丧。

examples.en: It is frustrating to lose your keys.
examples.zh: 丢了钥匙很令人沮丧。

definitions.en: v dispose or incline or entice to
definitions.zh: a. 诱惑人的, 吸引人的

examples.en: The cake looks very tempting.
examples.zh: 蛋糕看起来非常诱人。

examples.en: It is tempting to stay in bed.
examples.zh: 赖在床上很诱人。

definitions.en: n. something recalled to the mind
definitions.zh: n. 记忆, 回想, 回忆

examples.en: I have a clear recollection of that day.
examples.zh: 我对那天有清晰的记忆。

examples.en: His recollection of the event is vague.
examples.zh: 他对那件事的记忆很模糊。

definitions.en: s. influenced or controlled by a powerful force such as a strong emotion
definitions.zh: a. 着迷的；无法摆脱的

examples.en: She is obsessed with learning new languages.
examples.zh: 她痴迷于学习新语言。

examples.en: He became obsessed with video games.
examples.zh: 他沉迷于电子游戏。

definitions.en: n. an endorsed policy in the platform of a political party
definitions.zh: n. 厚木板, 支架, 木板制品, 冲浪板, 救急物, 政纲条目

definitions.en: v. cover with planks
definitions.zh: vt. 在...上铺板, 撂下, 立即付款

examples.en: He walked across a narrow wooden plank.
examples.zh: 他走过一块狭窄的木板。

examples.en: The party's main plank is tax reform.
examples.zh: 该党的主要政纲是税制改革。

definitions.en: n. lack of attention and due care
definitions.zh: n. 忽视, 漠视

definitions.en: n. willful lack of care and attention
definitions.zh: vt. 忽视, 不顾

examples.en: Please disregard that old message.
examples.zh: 请忽视那条旧消息。

examples.en: He showed disregard for the rules.
examples.zh: 他表现出对规则的漠视。

definitions.en: n a small part or portion that remains after the main part no longer exists
definitions.zh: n. 剩余, 零料, 遗迹

definitions.en: n a piece of cloth that is left over after the rest has been used or sold
definitions.zh: a. 剩余的, 残余的

examples.en: Only a remnant of the wall remains.
examples.zh: 只剩下墙的遗迹。

examples.en: She used a remnant of fabric for the project.
examples.zh: 她用了一块零料布料做这个项目。

definitions.en: v. cause to become detached or separated; take off
definitions.zh: vt. 使分离, 分遣

definitions.en: v. separate (a small unit) from a larger, especially for a special assignment
definitions.zh: [机] 摘下, 分离, 卸下

examples.en: Please detach the form from the page.
examples.zh: 请把表格从页面上分离下来。

examples.en: He tried to detach the sticker carefully.
examples.zh: 他试图小心地分离贴纸。

definitions.en: v be a hindrance or obstacle to
definitions.zh: a. 后面的

definitions.en: v hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
definitions.zh: v. 阻碍, 打扰

examples.en: The rain may hinder our progress.
examples.zh: 雨可能会阻碍我们的进展。

examples.en: Don't let fear hinder your dreams.
examples.zh: 不要让恐惧阻碍你的梦想。

definitions.en: v. fall apart
definitions.zh: v. (使)粉碎, (使)成为碎屑, 瓦解, 崩溃, 败落

examples.en: The old wall began to crumble.
examples.zh: 旧墙开始崩塌。

examples.en: She watched the cookie crumble in her hand.
examples.zh: 她看着饼干在手中碎裂。

definitions.en: s. complete or extreme
definitions.zh: a. 僵硬的, 完全的, 刻板的, 明显的, 荒凉的, 结实的

definitions.en: r. completely
definitions.zh: adv. 突出地, 简直, 全然

examples.en: The landscape was stark and beautiful.
examples.zh: 风景荒凉而美丽。

examples.en: He gave a stark warning about the danger.
examples.zh: 他给出了关于危险的明确警告。

definitions.en: v. make sharp or sharper
definitions.zh: vt. 使尖锐, 使敏捷, 加重, 削尖

definitions.en: v. make crisp or more crisp and precise
definitions.zh: vi. 尖锐化, 变锋利

examples.en: Please sharpen this pencil for me.
examples.zh: 请帮我削尖这支铅笔。

examples.en: He sharpened his knife before cooking.
examples.zh: 他在做饭前磨快了刀。

definitions.en: a. fully developed or matured and ready to be eaten or used
definitions.zh: a. 成熟的, 熟练的, 成年的

definitions.en: s. fully prepared or eager
definitions.zh: [医] 成熟的

examples.en: The apples are ripe and ready to eat.
examples.zh: 苹果熟了，可以吃了。

examples.en: The time is ripe for a change.
examples.zh: 改变的时机成熟了。

definitions.en: n. the act of one who pleases
definitions.zh: a. 令人喜爱的, 愉快的, 舒适的

examples.en: The music has a pleasing melody.
examples.zh: 这首音乐有令人愉快的旋律。

examples.en: Her smile is very pleasing to see.
examples.zh: 她的微笑看起来很令人愉快。

definitions.en: s. showing no care or concern in attitude or action
definitions.zh: a. 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的

definitions.en: s. fairly poor to not very good
definitions.zh: [医] 中性的, 无作用的, 无亲和力的, 淡漠的

examples.en: She seemed indifferent to the news.
examples.zh: 她似乎对这个消息漠不关心。

examples.en: He was indifferent about which movie to watch.
examples.zh: 他对看哪部电影无所谓。

definitions.en: s. being or feeling set or kept apart from others
definitions.zh: a. 超然的, 分离的, 冷淡的

definitions.en: s. no longer connected or joined
definitions.zh: [法] 分遣的, 派遣的, 分离的

examples.en: He remained detached from the argument.
examples.zh: 他对争论保持超然态度。

examples.en: The house has a detached garage.
examples.zh: 房子有一个独立车库。

definitions.en: r. to a great depth psychologically
definitions.zh: adv. 深深地, 深切地

examples.en: She was profoundly moved by the story.
examples.zh: 她被这个故事深深地打动了。

examples.en: The experience changed him profoundly.
examples.zh: 这次经历深刻地改变了他。

definitions.en: s under terms not final or fully worked out or agreed upon
definitions.zh: n. 试验

definitions.en: s unsettled in mind or opinion
definitions.zh: a. 试验性的, 暂时的

examples.en: We made a tentative plan for the trip.
examples.zh: 我们为旅行做了一个暂时的计划。

examples.en: Her answer was tentative and unsure.
examples.zh: 她的回答是试验性的，不确定的。

definitions.en: v hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of
definitions.zh: vt. 挫败, 击败, 破坏

definitions.en: v treat cruelly
definitions.zh: a. 无益的, 挫败的, 挫折的

examples.en: The delay frustrated our plans.
examples.zh: 延误挫败了我们的计划。

examples.en: It frustrates me when I can't solve the problem.
examples.zh: 当我无法解决问题时，我感到沮丧。

definitions.en: v. be hungry; go without food
definitions.zh: v. (使)饿死, (使)挨饿

examples.en: Many people starve in times of famine.
examples.zh: 许多人在饥荒时期挨饿。

examples.en: Don't starve yourself; eat something.
examples.zh: 别饿着自己，吃点东西。

definitions.en: v surprise greatly; knock someone's socks off
definitions.zh: a. 令人震惊的, 极坏的, 不正当的

examples.en: The news was truly shocking.
examples.zh: 这个消息确实令人震惊。

examples.en: He had a shocking accident on the road.
examples.zh: 他在路上发生了一起令人震惊的事故。

definitions.en: n. originality by virtue of being new and surprising
definitions.zh: n. 新奇, 新鲜, 新奇的事物

examples.en: The novelty of the toy soon wore off.
examples.zh: 玩具的新奇感很快就消失了。

examples.en: He enjoys the novelty of new experiences.
examples.zh: 他享受新体验的新鲜感。

definitions.en: r. in a relaxed manner; not rigid
definitions.zh: adv. 松弛地, 宽松地, 不紧

examples.en: She wore her hair loosely tied back.
examples.zh: 她松散地把头发扎在后面。

examples.en: The term is used loosely here.
examples.zh: 这个术语在这里使用得很宽松。

definitions.en: a. occurring without interruption; chiefly restricted to what recurs regularly or frequently in a prolonged and closely spaced series
definitions.zh: a. 持续不断的, 继续的

definitions.en: s. `continual' (meaning seemingly uninterrupted) is often used interchangeably with `continuous' (meaning without interruption)
definitions.zh: [建] 连续的

examples.en: There was continual noise from the street.
examples.zh: 街上持续不断的噪音。

examples.en: She faced continual challenges at work.
examples.zh: 她在工作中面临持续的挑战。

definitions.en: v summon into action or bring into existence, often as if by magic
definitions.zh: vt. 念咒文召唤, 变戏法, 想象

definitions.en: v ask for or request earnestly
definitions.zh: vi. 变戏法, 施魔法

examples.en: The magician can conjure a rabbit from a hat.
examples.zh: 魔术师能从帽子里变出兔子。

examples.en: She tried to conjure up a happy memory.
examples.zh: 她试图唤起快乐的回忆。

definitions.en: s. pressed together or compressed
definitions.zh: a. 充满...的, 满座的, 挤得满满的, 压坚实的, 塞满了...的, 挤满了人的, 拥挤的
[计] 压缩的, 装配的

examples.en: The bus was packed with passengers.
examples.zh: 公共汽车挤满了乘客。

examples.en: She packed her suitcase for the trip.
examples.zh: 她为旅行收拾好了行李箱。

definitions.en: n. sewing that repairs a worn or torn hole (especially in a garment)
definitions.zh: n. 改进, 修补, 好转

definitions.en: v. heal or recover
definitions.zh: vt. 修改, 改进, 加快, 修理
vi. 好转, 改善

examples.en: He needs to mend the broken chair.
examples.zh: 他需要修理坏掉的椅子。

examples.en: The wound will mend in a few days.
examples.zh: 伤口几天内会愈合。

definitions.en: v. arouse or elicit a feeling
definitions.zh: vt. 刺激, 使兴奋, 激励

examples.en: The good news excited everyone.
examples.zh: 好消息使每个人兴奋。

examples.en: Don't excite the dog too much.
examples.zh: 别让狗太兴奋。

definitions.en: n. a periodical that summarizes the news
definitions.zh: n. 文摘

definitions.en: v. convert food into absorbable substances
definitions.zh: vi. 消化

definitions.en: v. arrange and integrate in the mind
definitions.zh: vt. 消化, 理解

examples.en: It takes time to digest food.
examples.zh: 消化食物需要时间。

examples.en: She reads a news digest every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上读一份新闻文摘。

definitions.en: v. open to the view
definitions.zh: vt. 展开, 打开, 披露, 开展, 挑明

definitions.en: v. extend or stretch out to a greater or the full length
definitions.zh: vi. 伸展, 开花, 呈现

examples.en: Please unfold the map on the table.
examples.zh: 请把地图在桌子上展开。

examples.en: The story will unfold slowly.
examples.zh: 故事会慢慢展开。

definitions.en: s. preceding all others in spatial position
definitions.zh: a. 最初的, 最重要的

definitions.en: s. situated closest to the bow
definitions.zh: adv. 在最前

examples.en: He is the foremost expert in his field.
examples.zh: 他是他领域里最重要的专家。

examples.en: Safety is foremost in our minds.
examples.zh: 安全是我们心中最重要的。

definitions.en: v. originate (in)
definitions.zh: vi. 居住, 居住(于), 存在(于)

examples.en: They dwell in a small village.
examples.zh: 他们居住在一个小村庄。

examples.en: Don't dwell on past mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要总是想着过去的错误。

definitions.en: v. put something somewhere so that the space is completely filled
definitions.zh: vt. 塞满, 填满, 猛吃

definitions.en: v. study intensively, as before an exam
definitions.zh: vi. 贪吃

definitions.en: v. prepare (students) hastily for an impending exam
definitions.zh: n. 极度拥挤, 死记硬背

examples.en: She had to cram for the final exam.
examples.zh: 她不得不为期末考试临时抱佛脚。

examples.en: Don't cram too many clothes into the bag.
examples.zh: 不要把太多衣服塞进包里。

definitions.en: n. a surrounding or nearby region
definitions.zh: n. 附近, 邻近, 附近地区, 近处
[法] 附近, 邻近, 附近地区

examples.en: There is a park in the vicinity.
examples.zh: 附近有一个公园。

examples.en: They live in the vicinity of the school.
examples.zh: 他们住在学校附近。

definitions.en: n. something that is a source of danger
definitions.zh: n. 威胁, 胁迫

definitions.en: n. a threat or the act of threatening
definitions.zh: v. 威吓, 胁迫

examples.en: The storm was a menace to the town.
examples.zh: 暴风雨对小镇是一个威胁。

examples.en: He spoke with menace in his voice.
examples.zh: 他说话时声音中带着胁迫。

definitions.en: v. overcome by conquest
definitions.zh: vt. 克服, 征服, 战胜
vi. 得胜

examples.en: They hoped to conquer the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们希望征服这座山。

examples.en: She conquered her fear of public speaking.
examples.zh: 她克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

definitions.en: s. (usually followed by `to') naturally disposed toward
definitions.zh: a. 有...倾向的, 易于的, 恰当的, 聪明的

definitions.en: s. at risk of or subject to experiencing something usually unpleasant
definitions.zh: [计] 自动数控语言, 自动图象传输, 自动程序控制, 自动程序设计工具

examples.en: She is apt to learn new languages.
examples.zh: 她易于学习新语言。

examples.en: That is an apt description of the problem.
examples.zh: 那是对问题的一个恰当描述。

definitions.en: v. clap one's hands or shout after performances to indicate approval
definitions.zh: v. 拍手喝彩, 称赞, 赞同

examples.en: The audience stood up to applaud the singer.

definitions.zh: n. 不可缺少之物

definitions.en: s. unavoidable
definitions.zh: a. 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的

examples.en: Water is indispensable for human life.
examples.zh: 水对人类生命是不可或缺的。

examples.en: A good dictionary is indispensable for learning.
examples.zh: 一本好词典对学习是必不可少的。

definitions.en: n. a notable achievement
definitions.zh: n. 壮举, 功绩, 技艺表演
a. 灵巧的, 合适的, 整洁的

examples.en: Climbing the mountain was an amazing feat.
examples.zh: 攀登那座山是一项了不起的壮举。

examples.en: The acrobat performed a dangerous feat.
examples.zh: 杂技演员表演了一个危险的技艺。

definitions.en: s. deserving of the highest esteem or admiration
definitions.zh: a. 可钦佩的, 极好的, 令人惊奇的

examples.en: Her courage is truly admirable.
examples.zh: 她的勇气确实令人钦佩。

examples.en: That was an admirable effort by the team.
examples.zh: 那是团队一次令人钦佩的努力。

definitions.en: n. a plane curve traced by a point circling about the center but at increasing distances from the center
definitions.zh: n. 螺旋形之物, 螺线

definitions.en: n. a continuously accelerating change in the economy
definitions.zh: a. 螺旋形的, 盘旋的

definitions.en: n. ornament consisting of a curve on a plane that winds around a center with an increasing distance from the center
definitions.zh: vi. 螺旋形下降, 螺旋形上升, 螺旋形行进

examples.en: The smoke rose in a spiral from the chimney.
examples.zh: 烟从烟囱螺旋上升。

examples.en: The costs began to spiral out of control.
examples.zh: 成本开始螺旋上升，失去控制。

definitions.en: a. careful and sensible; marked by sound judgment
definitions.zh: a. 审慎的, 三思而后行的, 精明的, 节俭的

examples.en: It is prudent to save money for emergencies.
examples.zh: 为紧急情况存钱是审慎的。

examples.en: She made a prudent decision to invest carefully.
examples.zh: 她做了审慎的决定，谨慎投资。

definitions.en: n. qualities that attract by seeming to promise some kind of reward
definitions.zh: n. 饵, 诱惑
vt. 引诱, 诱惑

examples.en: The promise of gold lured many people west.
examples.zh: 黄金的承诺引诱许多人去了西部。

examples.en: He used a worm as a lure to catch fish.
examples.zh: 他用一条虫子作诱饵来钓鱼。

definitions.en: v. praise somewhat dishonestly
definitions.zh: vt. 奉承, 阿谀, 使高兴
[机] 平面锤

examples.en: He tried to flatter his boss for a promotion.
examples.zh: 他试图奉承老板以求升职。

examples.en: She flattered me by saying I look young.
examples.zh: 她说我看起来年轻，让我高兴。

definitions.en: s. marked by sudden changes in subject and sharp transitions
definitions.zh: a. 突然的, 唐突的, 陡峭的, 不连贯的

examples.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
examples.zh: 会议突然结束了。

examples.en: His abrupt manner made others uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他唐突的态度让别人不舒服。

definitions.en: n. quality or fact or degree of being visible; perceptible by the eye or obvious to the eye
definitions.zh: n. 可见性, 能见度, 能见距离

definitions.en: n. degree of exposure to public notice
definitions.zh: [计] 可见性

examples.en: The fog reduced visibility on the road.
examples.zh: 雾降低了道路上的能见度。

examples.en: Good visibility is important for safe driving.
examples.zh: 良好的可见性对安全驾驶很重要。

definitions.en: s displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses
definitions.zh: a. 豪华的, 奢侈的, 放纵的

examples.en: They stayed in a luxurious hotel by the beach.
examples.zh: 他们住在海边一家豪华的酒店。

examples.en: She enjoys a luxurious lifestyle.
examples.zh: 她享受奢侈的生活方式。

definitions.en: n. a district of a city marked by poverty and inferior living conditions
definitions.zh: n. 贫民窟

definitions.en: v. spend time at a lower socio-economic level than one's own, motivated by curiosity or desire for adventure; usage considered condescending and insensitive
definitions.zh: vi. 访问贫民区

examples.en: They live in a poor slum area.
examples.zh: 他们住在一个贫穷的贫民窟地区。

examples.en: He went to slum it for a day.
examples.zh: 他去贫民区体验了一天生活。

definitions.en: n. copy that is not the original; something that has been copied
definitions.zh: n. 复制品
[计] 目录分区复制

examples.en: She bought a replica of the famous statue.
examples.zh: 她买了一个著名雕像的复制品。

examples.en: The museum displayed a replica of the ancient ship.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了一艘古船的复制品。

definitions.en: v kill in large numbers
definitions.zh: vt. 根除, 扑灭, 根绝, 消灭

examples.en: We must eradicate poverty in our city.
examples.zh: 我们必须根除城市的贫困。

examples.en: The disease was finally eradicated worldwide.
examples.zh: 这种疾病最终在全球被根绝。

definitions.en: n. (law) the act of condemning (as land forfeited for public use) or judging to be unfit for use (as a food product or an unsafe building)
definitions.zh: n. 非难, 宣告有罪, 非难的理由

examples.en: The building received a condemnation order.
examples.zh: 这栋建筑收到了宣告有罪的命令。

examples.en: His actions drew strong condemnation from the public.
examples.zh: 他的行为引起了公众的强烈非难。

definitions.en: s. lacking a visible order or organization
definitions.zh: a. 混乱的, 无秩序的

definitions.en: s. completely unordered and unpredictable and confusing
definitions.zh: [法] 混乱的, 混沌的

examples.en: The room was chaotic after the party.
examples.zh: 派对后房间混乱不堪。

examples.en: Traffic was chaotic during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间交通无秩序。

definitions.en: s marked by defiant disregard for danger or consequences
definitions.zh: a. 不介意的, 大意的, 鲁莽的, 不顾后果的

definitions.en: s characterized by careless unconcern
definitions.zh: [法] 不注意的, 粗心大意的, 鲁莽的

examples.en: His reckless driving caused a serious accident.
examples.zh: 他鲁莽的驾驶导致了严重事故。

examples.en: She made a reckless decision without thinking.
examples.zh: 她没思考就做了不顾后果的决定。

definitions.en: v. join the military
definitions.zh: vt. 征募, 参与, 谋取

definitions.en: v. engage somebody to enter the army
definitions.zh: vi. 从军, 应募, 赞助

examples.en: He decided to enlist in the army.
examples.zh: 他决定参军。

examples.en: She enlisted the help of her friends.
examples.zh: 她争取到了朋友们的帮助。

definitions.en: v move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
definitions.zh: v. 漫游, 闲逛, 徜徉
n. 漫步, 漫游

examples.en: The children roam freely in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在公园里自由闲逛。

examples.en: He likes to roam through the forest alone.
examples.zh: 他喜欢独自在森林里漫游。

definitions.en: s. wanting to eat or drink more than one can reasonably consume
definitions.zh: a. 贪婪的, 贪得的, 贪吃的

examples.en: The greedy boy ate all the cake.
examples.zh: 那个贪吃的男孩吃光了所有蛋糕。

examples.en: She is greedy for more money.
examples.zh: 她对更多的钱很贪婪。

definitions.en: v. strive to equal or match, especially by imitating
definitions.zh: vt. 效法, 尽力赶上, 同...竞争

definitions.en: v. imitate the function of (another system), as by modifying the hardware or the software
definitions.zh: [计] 仿真

examples.en: Young athletes often emulate their heroes.
examples.zh: 年轻运动员常常效仿他们的偶像。

examples.en: The software can emulate a different operating system.
examples.zh: 这个软件可以仿真不同的操作系统。

definitions.en: v. expel from a community or group
definitions.zh: vt. 驱逐, 消除

definitions.en: v. ban from a place of residence, as for punishment
definitions.zh: [法] 驱逐, 流放

examples.en: The king decided to banish the traitor.
examples.zh: 国王决定流放那个叛徒。

examples.en: She tried to banish all negative thoughts.
examples.zh: 她试图消除所有消极的想法。

definitions.en: v. enlarge or increase
definitions.zh: v. 增加, 增长

definitions.en: v. grow or intensify
definitions.zh: [计] 增加; 增量; 添加

examples.en: He took a second job to augment his income.
examples.zh: 他做第二份工作来增加收入。

examples.en: The new data augments our understanding.
examples.zh: 新数据增长了我们理解。

definitions.en: v. make withdrawn or isolated or emotionally dissociated
definitions.zh: vt. 使疏远, 离间, 转让
[法] 转让, 让与, 疏远

examples.en: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。

examples.en: The policy may alienate some voters.
examples.zh: 这项政策可能会疏远一些选民。

definitions.en: n. the act of giving something up
definitions.zh: n. 放弃, 抛弃, 放纵

definitions.en: n. the voluntary surrender of property (or a right to property) without attempting to reclaim it or give it away
definitions.zh: [经] 委付, 废弃, 放弃(采矿权)

examples.en: The abandonment of the project surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 放弃这个项目让所有人惊讶。

examples.en: The old house showed signs of abandonment.
examples.zh: 老房子显示出被抛弃的迹象。

definitions.en: s. substantially made or constructed
definitions.zh: a. 强健的, 健全的
[医] 羊晕倒病, 羊蹒跚病

examples.en: The table is made of sturdy wood.
examples.zh: 这张桌子由强健的木头制成。

examples.en: He is a sturdy and reliable worker.
examples.zh: 他是一个强健可靠的工人。

definitions.en: n. a state of extreme hunger resulting from lack of essential nutrients over a prolonged period
definitions.zh: n. 饥饿, 饿死

definitions.en: n. the act of depriving of food or subjecting to famine
definitions.zh: [医] 绝食, 饥锇(指长时期的)

examples.en: Many animals die of starvation in winter.
examples.zh: 许多动物在冬天死于饥饿。

examples.en: Starvation is a serious problem in some countries.
examples.zh: 饥饿在一些国家是一个严重的问题。

definitions.en: s dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises
definitions.zh: a. 严肃的, 郑重的, 庄严的

examples.en: The ceremony was very solemn and quiet.
examples.zh: 仪式非常庄严而安静。

examples.en: He made a solemn promise to help.
examples.zh: 他做出了一个庄严的承诺去帮忙。

definitions.en: s. given to or marked by sentiment or sentimentality
definitions.zh: a. 感伤的, 感情用事的

examples.en: She kept the old photo for sentimental reasons.
examples.zh: 她出于感伤的原因保留了旧照片。

examples.en: The movie made him feel very sentimental.
examples.zh: 这部电影让他感到非常感情用事。

definitions.en: v make steady progress; be at the high point in one's career or reach a high point in historical significance or importance
definitions.zh: vi. 繁荣, 兴隆, 成功
vt. 使成功, 使昌盛

examples.en: The small business began to prosper quickly.
examples.zh: 这家小企业开始迅速繁荣。

examples.en: Hard work helps people prosper in life.
examples.zh: 努力工作帮助人们在生活中成功。

definitions.en: a. providing or conveying information
definitions.zh: a. 提供消息的, 见闻广博的

examples.en: The lecture was very informative and helpful.
examples.zh: 这个讲座信息量很大，很有帮助。

examples.en: She gave an informative presentation on history.
examples.zh: 她做了一个关于历史的提供信息的演讲。

definitions.en: v give qualities or abilities to
definitions.zh: a. 有天才的

examples.en: She is a gifted musician and singer.
examples.zh: 她是一位有天才的音乐家和歌手。

examples.en: The gifted student solved the problem quickly.
examples.zh: 有天才的学生很快解决了问题。

definitions.en: n. scenery hung at back of stage
definitions.zh: n. 背景幕, 背景

examples.en: The mountains formed a beautiful backdrop for the photo.
examples.zh: 山脉构成了照片的美丽背景。

examples.en: The red curtain served as a simple backdrop.
examples.zh: 红色窗帘用作简单的背景幕。

definitions.en: v. fill with terror; frighten greatly
definitions.zh: vt. 使恐惧, 恐吓

examples.en: The loud noise terrified the little girl.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音使小女孩恐惧。

examples.en: He was terrified by the horror movie.
examples.zh: 他被恐怖电影吓坏了。

definitions.en: n. a lamp that produces a strong beam of light to illuminate a restricted area; used to focus attention of a stage performer
definitions.zh: n. 照明灯, 反光灯, 聚光灯

examples.en: The spotlight shone on the singer.
examples.zh: 聚光灯照在歌手身上。

examples.en: He enjoys being in the spotlight.
examples.zh: 他喜欢成为关注的焦点。

definitions.en: n something of sentimental value
definitions.zh: n. 纪念品

examples.en: I bought a souvenir from my trip to Paris.
examples.zh: 我从巴黎旅行买了一个纪念品。

examples.en: This shell is a souvenir of our beach vacation.
examples.zh: 这个贝壳是我们海滩度假的纪念品。

definitions.en: v. math: determine the length of
definitions.zh: vt. 订正, 矫正, 改正, 调正, 校正, 精馏, 整流

definitions.en: v. set straight or right
definitions.zh: [化] 精馏

examples.en: We need to rectify the mistake immediately.
examples.zh: 我们需要立即改正错误。

examples.en: The engineer rectified the problem with the machine.
examples.zh: 工程师矫正了机器的问题。

definitions.en: v. watch and direct
definitions.zh: vt. 向下看, 了望, 监督, 偷看到
[法] 监察, 监督, 俯瞰

examples.en: The manager will oversee the entire project.
examples.zh: 经理将监督整个项目。

examples.en: She oversees the team's daily work.
examples.zh: 她监督团队的日常工作。

definitions.en: s. so small as to be meaningless; insignificant
definitions.zh: a. 可以忽略的, 不足取的, 无用的

definitions.en: s. not worth considering
definitions.zh: [医] 可不计的, 可忽视的

examples.en: The difference in price is negligible.
examples.zh: 价格差异可以忽略。

examples.en: The risk of infection is negligible.
examples.zh: 感染的风险微不足道。

definitions.en: n. someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission
definitions.zh: n. 侵入者, 干扰者, 妨碍者
[计] 入侵者

examples.en: The security system detected an intruder at night.
examples.zh: 安全系统在夜间检测到一名侵入者。

examples.en: An intruder tried to enter the house.
examples.zh: 一名入侵者试图进入房子。

definitions.en: n. a device (generally used by carpenters) that holds things firmly together
definitions.zh: n. 夹钳

definitions.en: v. fasten or fix with a clamp
definitions.zh: vt. 夹紧, 强加

examples.en: He used a clamp to hold the wood steady.
examples.zh: 他用夹钳固定木头。

examples.en: Clamp the pipe tightly to prevent leaks.
examples.zh: 夹紧管道以防泄漏。

definitions.en: n. a man who has never been married
definitions.zh: n. 单身汉, 学士

definitions.en: v. lead a bachelor's existence
definitions.zh: [法] 学士, 单身汉

examples.en: He is a bachelor living alone.
examples.zh: 他是一个独自生活的单身汉。

examples.en: She earned a bachelor's degree last year.
examples.zh: 她去年获得了学士学位。

definitions.en: n. overbearing pride evidenced by a superior manner toward inferiors
definitions.zh: n. 傲慢态度, 自大

examples.en: His arrogance made him unpopular at work.
examples.zh: 他的傲慢使他在工作中不受欢迎。

examples.en: Arrogance often hides a lack of confidence.
examples.zh: 傲慢常常隐藏着缺乏自信。

definitions.en: a. causing intense interest, curiosity, or emotion
definitions.zh: a. 使人感动的, 非常好的

examples.en: The news report was very sensational.
examples.zh: 这篇新闻报道非常使人感动。

examples.en: Her performance was absolutely sensational.
examples.zh: 她的表演绝对非常好。

definitions.en: a. characterized by repetition
definitions.zh: a. 重复的, 反复性的

examples.en: The work became boring and repetitive.
examples.zh: 这项工作变得无聊且重复。

examples.en: He found the song too repetitive to enjoy.
examples.zh: 他觉得这首歌太反复性而无法欣赏。

definitions.en: n. a line enclosing a plane areas
definitions.zh: n. 周长, 周界, 边缘
[医] 周, 周边, 周界线; 周长; 视野计

examples.en: The soldiers guarded the perimeter of the camp.
examples.zh: 士兵守卫着营地的周界。

examples.en: We walked around the perimeter of the field.
examples.zh: 我们绕着田地的边缘走。

definitions.en: v. become brisk
definitions.zh: a. 强烈的, 寒冷而干燥的, 活泼的

definitions.en: s. very active
definitions.zh: vt. 使活泼
vi. 活跃起来

examples.en: We took a brisk walk in the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园里快步走了一会儿。

examples.en: The brisk wind made us feel cold.
examples.zh: 寒冷而干燥的风让我们感到冷。

definitions.en: n. a biography of yourself
definitions.zh: n. 自传

examples.en: She wrote her autobiography last year.
examples.zh: 她去年写了她的自传。

examples.en: His autobiography tells his life story.
examples.zh: 他的自传讲述了他的人生故事。

definitions.en: s. caused by infection or capable of causing infection
definitions.zh: a. 有传染性的, 易传染的

definitions.en: a. easily spread; children catch it from their elders"- Bertrand Russell
definitions.zh: [医] 传染性的

examples.en: The flu is highly infectious.
examples.zh: 流感有很强的传染性。

examples.en: Her laughter was infectious and made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 她的笑声有感染力，让每个人都笑了。

definitions.en: a. worthy of being recommended or suggested; prudent or wise
definitions.zh: a. 适当的, 明智的

examples.en: It is advisable to bring an umbrella.
examples.zh: 带伞是明智的。

examples.en: Studying hard is advisable for good grades.
examples.zh: 努力学习对好成绩是明智的。

definitions.en: v lie adjacent to another or share a boundary
definitions.zh: a. 邻接的, 毗连的

definitions.en: v be in direct physical contact with; make contact
definitions.zh: [机] 联接

examples.en: We stayed in adjoining hotel rooms.
examples.zh: 我们住在毗连的酒店房间里。

examples.en: The garden is adjoining the main house.
examples.zh: 花园邻接着主屋。

definitions.en: s. standing above others in quality or position
definitions.zh: a. 显赫的, 杰出的, 有名的

examples.en: She is an eminent scientist in her field.
examples.zh: 她是她领域内一位杰出的科学家。

examples.en: The eminent professor gave a famous lecture.
examples.zh: 那位显赫的教授做了一场著名的讲座。

definitions.en: s. designed to incite to indecency or lust
definitions.zh: a. 淫秽的, 猥亵的, 讨人厌的, 可憎的
[法] 猥亵的, 海洋的, 污秽的

examples.en: The movie was banned for obscene content.
examples.zh: 这部电影因淫秽内容被禁。

examples.en: He made an obscene gesture at the driver.
examples.zh: 他对司机做了猥亵的手势。

definitions.en: n. an artful or simulated semblance
definitions.zh: n. 相似, 外观, 伪装
v. 穿戴, 伪装

examples.en: He came to the party under a false guise.
examples.zh: 他以虚假的伪装来到派对。

examples.en: The spy entered the building in a new guise.
examples.zh: 间谍以新的外观进入了大楼。

definitions.en: n. an event or situation that happens at the same time as or in connection with another
definitions.zh: n. 伴随物, 附加物, 伴奏

examples.en: The piano provided a beautiful accompaniment.
examples.zh: 钢琴提供了优美的伴奏。

examples.en: Wine is a perfect accompaniment to cheese.
examples.zh: 酒是奶酪的完美伴随物。

definitions.en: n. an energetic style
definitions.zh: n. 活力, 生命力
[医] 生机, 活力, 生活

examples.en: The young puppy was full of vitality.
examples.zh: 这只小狗充满活力。

examples.en: Exercise helps maintain your body's vitality.
examples.zh: 锻炼有助于保持身体的生机。

definitions.en: a. causing or tending to cause things to slip or slide
definitions.zh: a. 滑的, 光滑的, 靠不住的, 圆滑的, 不稳固的

definitions.en: s. not to be trusted
definitions.zh: [法] 狡猾的, 不可靠的, 不安定的

examples.en: The wet floor is very slippery.
examples.zh: 湿地板很滑。

examples.en: Be careful of the slippery road.
examples.zh: 小心滑的路。

definitions.en: v. be abundant or plentiful; exist in large quantities
definitions.zh: vi. 大量存在, 富于, 充满

examples.en: Fish abound in this clear river.
examples.zh: 鱼在这条清澈的河里大量存在。

examples.en: Opportunities abound for hardworking students.

definitions.zh: a. 一丝不苟的, 精确的, 过细的

examples.en: She is meticulous about her work.
examples.zh: 她对工作一丝不苟。

examples.en: He gave a meticulous description of the event.
examples.zh: 他对事件做了精确的描述。

definitions.en: a. attractive and tempting
definitions.zh: a. 引人动心的, 有魅力的
[法] 诱惑人的, 动人心的

examples.en: The warm fire made the room look inviting.
examples.zh: 温暖的炉火让房间看起来诱人。

examples.en: She gave him an inviting smile.
examples.zh: 她给了他一个诱人的微笑。

definitions.en: v. pay close attention to; give heed to
definitions.zh: n. 注意, 留心
v. 注意, 留心

examples.en: You should heed the warning signs.
examples.zh: 你应该注意警告标志。

examples.en: She paid no heed to his advice.
examples.zh: 她没有注意他的建议。

definitions.en: v gather, as of natural products
definitions.zh: v. 拾落穗, 收集

examples.en: Farmers glean leftover grain from the fields.
examples.zh: 农民从田地里拾取剩余的谷物。

examples.en: She gleaned useful information from the book.
examples.zh: 她从书中收集了有用的信息。

definitions.en: s. difficult to handle or use especially because of size or weight
definitions.zh: a. 笨重的, 麻烦的, 累赘的

examples.en: This old suitcase is very cumbersome to carry.
examples.zh: 这个旧手提箱携带起来很笨重。

examples.en: The process felt cumbersome and slow.
examples.zh: 这个过程感觉麻烦又缓慢。

definitions.en: a. marked by continuous or uninterrupted extension in space or time or sequence
definitions.zh: a. 未破损的, 未被征服的, 未打垮的, 不屈服的, 不涣散的, 整齐的, 未中断的

definitions.en: s. not subdued or trained for service or use
definitions.zh: [法] 未被阻断的, 未破损的, 完好的

examples.en: The horse remained unbroken after many attempts.
examples.zh: 多次尝试后，这匹马仍未驯服。

examples.en: The record has stayed unbroken for years.
examples.zh: 这个记录多年来一直未被打破。

definitions.en: v. overthrow by argument, evidence, or proof
definitions.zh: vt. 反驳, 驳斥；驳倒

examples.en: He tried to refute the false accusation.
examples.zh: 他试图驳斥虚假的指控。

examples.en: The scientist will refute the old theory.
examples.zh: 科学家将反驳旧理论。

definitions.en: n. a large indefinite number
definitions.zh: n. 无数, 无数的人(或物)
a. 无数的, 种种的

examples.en: There are myriad stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中有无数颗星星。

examples.en: She faced myriad challenges in her new job.
examples.zh: 她在新工作中面临无数挑战。

definitions.en: n. a stifling cloud of smoke
definitions.zh: vt. 使喘不过气, 使窒息, 闷熄, 忍住, 抑制, 覆盖

definitions.en: v. envelop completely
definitions.zh: vi. 窒息, 被抑制

definitions.en: v. deprive of oxygen and prevent from breathing
definitions.zh: n. 浓烟, 窒息状态, 杂乱无章

examples.en: The thick smoke began to smother the room.
examples.zh: 浓烟开始使房间窒息。

examples.en: She tried to smother her laughter during class.
examples.zh: 她试图在课堂上忍住笑声。

definitions.en: r. in a striking manner
definitions.zh: adv. 显著地, 惊人地, 引人注目地

examples.en: She is strikingly beautiful in that dress.
examples.zh: 她穿那条裙子美得惊人。

examples.en: The two paintings are strikingly similar.
examples.zh: 这两幅画惊人地相似。

definitions.en: s not hurried or forced
definitions.zh: a. 悠闲的, 从容的

definitions.en: r in an unhurried way or at one's convenience
definitions.zh: adv. 从容地, 悠闲地

examples.en: They took a leisurely walk in the park.
examples.zh: 他们在公园里悠闲地散步。

examples.en: He ate his breakfast at a leisurely pace.
examples.zh: 他以悠闲的速度吃早餐。

definitions.en: n. the point on the celestial sphere toward which the sun and solar system appear to be moving relative to the fixed stars
definitions.zh: n. 顶, 尖端, 最高潮
[医] 尖, 尖端

examples.en: The mountain's apex was covered in snow.
examples.zh: 山顶被雪覆盖。

examples.en: He reached the apex of his career.
examples.zh: 他达到了职业生涯的顶峰。

definitions.en: v. become smaller or lose substance
definitions.zh: vi. 减少, 缩小, 衰落
vt. 使缩小

examples.en: The food supply began to dwindle quickly.
examples.zh: 食物供应开始迅速减少。

examples.en: Her savings dwindled after she lost her job.
examples.zh: 她失业后储蓄减少了。

definitions.en: s. moving slowly
definitions.zh: a. 偷懒的, 懒惰的, 迟钝的
[经] 萧条的, 呆滞的

examples.en: The economy is sluggish this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度经济萧条。

examples.en: He felt sluggish after eating a big meal.
examples.zh: 吃了一顿大餐后他感到迟钝。

definitions.en: v. cause to move back by force or influence
definitions.zh: vt. 逐退, 抵制, 使厌恶, 抗御

definitions.en: v. be repellent to; cause aversion in
definitions.zh: vi. 使厌恶, 相互排斥

examples.en: The smell can repel many insects.
examples.zh: 这种气味能驱赶许多昆虫。

examples.en: His rude behavior will repel others.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的行为会让人反感。

definitions.en: n. doubt about someone's honesty
definitions.zh: n. 疑虑, 不安, 害怕, 担扰, 疑惧

examples.en: She had a misgiving about the plan.
examples.zh: 她对计划有疑虑。

examples.en: His misgiving grew as the deadline approached.
examples.zh: 随着截止日期临近，他的不安增加了。

definitions.en: v. increase in size, volume or significance
definitions.zh: vt. 放大, 扩大, 赞美, 夸大
vi. 有放大能力

examples.en: A microscope can magnify tiny objects.
examples.zh: 显微镜能放大微小的物体。

examples.en: Do not magnify your problems too much.
examples.zh: 不要过分夸大你的问题。

definitions.en: s. marked by extreme and violent energy
definitions.zh: a. 残忍的, 凶猛的, 可怕的

examples.en: The ferocious lion roared loudly in the zoo.
examples.zh: 凶猛的狮子在动物园里大声咆哮。

examples.en: A ferocious storm hit the coastal town.
examples.zh: 一场可怕的暴风雨袭击了沿海小镇。

definitions.en: n. (astronomy) a heavenly body's highest celestial point above an observer's horizon
definitions.zh: n. 顶点, 高潮, 最高点

examples.en: The festival was the culmination of months of work.
examples.zh: 这个节日是几个月工作的顶点。

examples.en: Winning the award was the culmination of his efforts.
examples.zh: 获奖是他努力的高潮。

definitions.en: n. a collection containing a variety of sorts of things
definitions.zh: n. 分类, 各种各样
[医] [遗传]配列

examples.en: The store has a wide assortment of candies.
examples.zh: 这家商店有各种各样的糖果。

examples.en: She bought an assortment of fresh fruits.
examples.zh: 她买了各种各样的新鲜水果。

definitions.en: n. a place that is scoured (especially by running water)
definitions.zh: vt. 擦亮, 洗涤, 清洗, 冲刷成, 急速穿过

definitions.en: v. examine minutely
definitions.zh: vi. 擦, 洗, 冲刷, 腹泻, 急速穿行

definitions.en: v. rub hard or scrub
definitions.zh: n. 擦, 洗, 腹泻, 洗涤剂

examples.en: She scoured the pan with a brush.
examples.zh: 她用刷子擦洗了锅。

examples.en: The police scoured the area for clues.
examples.zh: 警察仔细搜索了该地区寻找线索。

definitions.en: n. language or behavior intended to mock or humiliate
definitions.zh: n. 嘲笑, 愚弄, 笑柄

definitions.en: v. subject to laughter or ridicule
definitions.zh: vt. 嘲笑, 嘲弄, 愚弄

examples.en: They ridicule his old-fashioned clothes.
examples.zh: 他们嘲笑他过时的衣服。

examples.en: He faced ridicule for his strange idea.
examples.zh: 他因奇怪的想法而遭到嘲笑。

definitions.en: n. a copy that corresponds to an original exactly
definitions.zh: n. 副本, 复本, 复制品

definitions.en: v. make or do or perform again
definitions.zh: a. 复制的, 二重的

definitions.en: v. make a duplicate or duplicates of
definitions.zh: vt. 复制, 使加倍

examples.en: Please make a duplicate of this key.
examples.zh: 请复制一把这把钥匙。

examples.en: He tried to duplicate the experiment results.
examples.zh: 他试图重复实验的结果。

definitions.en: n. needy people collectively
definitions.zh: a. 贫穷的, 贫困的, 生活艰苦的

examples.en: The charity helps needy families in the city.
examples.zh: 慈善机构帮助城市里的贫困家庭。

examples.en: We should donate food to the needy.
examples.zh: 我们应该向贫困者捐赠食物。

definitions.en: n. someone who enters by force in order to conquer
definitions.zh: n. 侵略者
[化] 侵入物

examples.en: The army fought against the invader bravely.
examples.zh: 军队勇敢地对抗侵略者。

examples.en: An invader tried to enter the castle.
examples.zh: 一个侵略者试图进入城堡。

definitions.en: n. a comedy characterized by broad satire and improbable situations
definitions.zh: n. 闹剧, 滑稽剧, 胡闹

examples.en: The meeting turned into a complete farce.
examples.zh: 会议变成了一场彻底的闹剧。

examples.en: The play was a hilarious farce about family life.
examples.zh: 这部剧是关于家庭生活的滑稽闹剧。

definitions.en: v. have a craving, appetite, or great desire for
definitions.zh: v. 渴望, 热望, 恳求

examples.en: I crave a piece of chocolate cake.
examples.zh: 我渴望一块巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: She craves attention from her friends.
examples.zh: 她渴望得到朋友的关注。

definitions.en: s. marked by pomp or ceremony or formality
definitions.zh: n. 仪式
a. 正式的

examples.en: The king wore a ceremonial robe.
examples.zh: 国王穿了一件仪式长袍。

examples.en: They held a ceremonial dance for the festival.
examples.zh: 他们为节日举行了仪式舞蹈。

definitions.en: v. put out or expel from a place
definitions.zh: vt. 逐放, 放逐, 喷射

definitions.en: v. leave an aircraft rapidly, using an ejection seat or capsule
definitions.zh: [化] 排出

examples.en: The pilot had to eject from the plane.
examples.zh: 飞行员不得不从飞机上弹射出来。

examples.en: The machine will eject the finished product.
examples.zh: 机器会弹出成品。

definitions.en: n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work
definitions.zh: vt. 交换, 折偿, 减轻

definitions.en: v. exchange positions without a change in value
definitions.zh: vi. 代偿, 经常乘车来往

examples.en: She commutes to work by train every day.
examples.zh: 她每天乘火车通勤上班。

examples.en: His commute takes about an hour.
examples.zh: 他的通勤时间大约一小时。

definitions.en: a. conveying or resembling a compliment
definitions.zh: a. 问候的, 称赞的, 夸奖的

examples.en: She gave me a complimentary smile.
examples.zh: 她给了我一个称赞的微笑。

examples.en: The hotel offers complimentary breakfast.
examples.zh: 酒店提供免费的早餐。

definitions.en: n. a distinctive characteristic or attribute
definitions.zh: n. 纯度检验证明, 品质证明
vt. 加盖纯度检验证明

examples.en: Honesty is the hallmark of a good friend.
examples.zh: 诚实是好朋友的标志。

examples.en: The ring has a hallmark on the inside.
examples.zh: 戒指内侧有纯度检验证明。

definitions.en: a. marked by imagination, initiative, and readiness to undertake new projects
definitions.zh: a. 有魄力的, 有进取心的, 有事业心的

examples.en: He is an enterprising young businessman.
examples.zh: 他是一个有进取心的年轻商人。

examples.en: Her enterprising spirit led to success.
examples.zh: 她的进取精神带来了成功。

definitions.en: v. reduce the amplitude (of oscillations or waves)
definitions.zh: vt. 弄湿, 使沮丧

definitions.en: v. make vague or obscure or make (an image) less visible
definitions.zh: vi. 变湿, 丧气

examples.en: The rain will dampen the dry ground.
examples.zh: 雨水会弄湿干燥的地面。

examples.en: Bad news can dampen your spirits quickly.
examples.zh: 坏消息会很快使你的情绪沮丧。

definitions.en: s no longer in use
definitions.zh: a. 荒废的, 成废物的, 陈旧的, 老式的
n. 废词, 废物

examples.en: This old computer is now completely obsolete.
examples.zh: 这台旧电脑现在完全过时了。

examples.en: Many technologies become obsolete very quickly.
examples.zh: 许多技术很快就变得陈旧。

definitions.en: v find repugnant
definitions.zh: vt. 厌恶, 憎恶

examples.en: I loathe getting up early in the morning.
examples.zh: 我厌恶早上早起。

examples.en: She loathes the taste of bitter medicine.
examples.zh: 她厌恶苦药的味道。

definitions.en: s. not capable of sin
definitions.zh: a. 无懈可击的, 勿容置疑的, 无瑕疵的, 不会做坏事的

examples.en: Her manners are always impeccable at dinner.
examples.zh: 她的举止在晚餐时总是无懈可击。

examples.en: He has an impeccable record of honesty.
examples.zh: 他有无可挑剔的诚实记录。

definitions.en: s. spoken with emphasis
definitions.zh: a. 语调强的, 着重的, 强调了的

examples.en: She gave an emphatic no to the proposal.
examples.zh: 她对提议给出了一个强调的“不”。

examples.en: His emphatic speech convinced everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他着重的演讲说服了房间里的每个人。

definitions.en: v take away a part from; diminish
definitions.zh: vi. 减去, 贬低
vt. 转移, 分散

examples.en: His rude comments detract from the discussion.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的评论贬低了讨论。

examples.en: Small mistakes should not detract from your success.
examples.zh: 小错误不应该减损你的成功。

definitions.en: r. in a superficial manner
definitions.zh: adv. 表面, 表面性, 浅层, 不深, 表皮, (贬)肤浅, 一知半解, 浅薄, 平方, 浮面

examples.en: Superficially, the two paintings look alike.
examples.zh: 表面上，这两幅画看起来很相似。

examples.en: He only understands the topic superficially.
examples.zh: 他对这个话题只有肤浅的理解。

definitions.en: a. mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
definitions.zh: a. 神智健全的, 稳健的, 没病的, 合理的
[医] 精神健全的

examples.en: He remained sane despite all the stress.
examples.zh: 尽管压力很大，他仍保持神智健全。

examples.en: It's a sane decision to take a break.
examples.zh: 休息一下是个合理的决定。

definitions.en: n. the quality of a color as determined by its dominant wavelength
definitions.zh: n. 样子, 色度, 色彩, 叫声, 色调

definitions.en: v. take on color or become colored
definitions.zh: [计] 色调

examples.en: The sky turned a beautiful orange hue.
examples.zh: 天空变成了美丽的橙色色调。

examples.en: She painted the room in a soft blue hue.
examples.zh: 她把房间漆成了柔和的蓝色色调。

definitions.en: s. in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation
definitions.zh: a. 睡眠状态的, 静止的

definitions.en: a. (of e.g. volcanos) not erupting and not extinct
definitions.zh: [医] 休眠的, 不活动的, 休止的

examples.en: The volcano has been dormant for years.
examples.zh: 这座火山休眠多年了。

examples.en: Seeds remain dormant until spring arrives.
examples.zh: 种子在春天到来之前一直处于休眠状态。

definitions.en: n. an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining
definitions.zh: n. 病痛, 疾病
[医] 疾病

examples.en: He suffers from a common stomach ailment.
examples.zh: 他患有常见的胃病。

examples.en: The doctor treated her minor skin ailment.
examples.zh: 医生治疗了她轻微的皮肤疾病。

definitions.en: n. intense anger (usually on an epic scale)
definitions.zh: n. 愤怒, 激怒, 愤怒的举动, (自然现象等)严酷

examples.en: He feared the king's wrath.
examples.zh: 他害怕国王的愤怒。

examples.en: Her wrath was clear from her face.
examples.zh: 她的愤怒从脸上就能看出来。

definitions.en: v. make disconnected, disjoin or unfasten
definitions.zh: vt. 使分离, 使不相连, 拆开
vi. 断开
[计] 断开

examples.en: Please disconnect the cable from the computer.
examples.zh: 请把电缆从电脑上断开。

examples.en: He decided to disconnect from social media.
examples.zh: 他决定断开与社交媒体的联系。

definitions.en: n. a request to be present
definitions.zh: n. 命令, 邀请, 出价
[经] 投标, 招标

examples.en: She did his bidding without question.
examples.zh: 她毫无疑问地服从他的命令。

examples.en: The bidding at the auction was intense.
examples.zh: 拍卖会上的出价很激烈。

definitions.en: n. the act of passing something along from one person or group to another
definitions.zh: n. 驿马, 替班, 中继, 接力

definitions.en: n. a crew of workers who relieve another crew
definitions.zh: vt. 分程传递, 转播, 使接替

definitions.en: n. a fresh team to relieve weary draft animals
definitions.zh: vi. 接力传送, 转播

examples.en: They relay the message to the team.
examples.zh: 他们把消息传达给团队。

examples.en: She ran in the relay race yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天参加了接力赛跑。

definitions.en: a. recurring in scattered and irregular or unpredictable instances
definitions.zh: a. 偶尔发生的, 零星发生的, 分散的
[医] 散在的, 散发的

examples.en: There were sporadic showers throughout the day.
examples.zh: 全天有零星阵雨。

examples.en: His attendance at class was sporadic this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期他上课出勤是零星的。

definitions.en: s. stopping and starting at irregular intervals
definitions.zh: a. 间歇的, 断断续续的
[化] 间歇的; 间断的

examples.en: The rain was intermittent all day.
examples.zh: 雨断断续续地下了一整天。

examples.en: He suffers from intermittent back pain.
examples.zh: 他患有间歇性背痛。

definitions.en: s. untroubled by interference or disturbance
definitions.zh: a. 未被扰乱的, 安静的, 镇定的

examples.en: The cat slept undisturbed on the sofa.
examples.zh: 猫在沙发上安静地睡觉。

examples.en: He left the room undisturbed for hours.
examples.zh: 他让房间几个小时保持安静。

definitions.en: v. solidify, firm, or strengthen
definitions.zh: vt. 使实体化, 证实
[经] 确证

examples.en: Can you substantiate your claim with facts?
examples.zh: 你能用事实证实你的主张吗？

examples.en: The report failed to substantiate the allegations.
examples.zh: 报告未能证实这些指控。

definitions.en: v. make (to feel) fresh
definitions.zh: vt. 使清新, 使恢复, 使生气蓬勃

definitions.en: v. make fresh again
definitions.zh: vi. 提起精神, 恢复精神, 吃点心, 喝饮料
vt. 刷新, 重新整理

examples.en: A cold drink will refresh you quickly.
examples.zh: 一杯冷饮会让你迅速恢复精神。

examples.en: Let me refresh the page to see updates.
examples.zh: 让我刷新页面看看更新。

definitions.en: v. spread or diffuse through
definitions.zh: vt. 弥漫, 渗透, 充满, 影响, 感染
vi. 透入, 散布

examples.en: The smell of coffee permeated the room.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味弥漫了整个房间。

examples.en: Water can permeate through the soil.
examples.zh: 水能渗透土壤。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to perception
definitions.zh: a. 知觉的, 有知觉力的, 感知的

definitions.en: a. having the ability to perceive or understand; keen in discernment
definitions.zh: [医] 知觉的

examples.en: She is a very perceptive teacher.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常有洞察力的老师。

examples.en: His perceptive comments helped us understand.
examples.zh: 他敏锐的评论帮助我们理解。

definitions.en: s being or having the character of a miracle
definitions.zh: a. 奇迹的, 不可思议的

examples.en: Her recovery was truly miraculous.
examples.zh: 她的康复真是奇迹般的。

examples.en: The rescue team made a miraculous save.
examples.zh: 救援队完成了一次不可思议的救援。

definitions.en: n. a sudden short attack
definitions.zh: vi. 侵略, 劫掠, 袭击

definitions.en: n. an initial attempt (especially outside your usual areas of competence)
definitions.zh: n. 侵掠, 侵略, 攻击

examples.en: He made a foray into the forest.
examples.zh: 他闯入森林进行了一次突袭。

examples.en: Her first foray into cooking was successful.
examples.zh: 她第一次尝试烹饪很成功。

definitions.en: v. reduce the level of land, as by erosion

examples.zh: 污染会降低环境质量。

examples.zh: 不要通过说谎来贬低自己。

definitions.en: n a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable especially in sexual behavior

definitions.en: v grow worse

definitions.zh: vt. 使变质, 使退化

examples.en: His health began to degenerate rapidly.
examples.zh: 他的健康状况开始迅速恶化。

examples.en: The debate degenerated into a shouting match.
examples.zh: 辩论退化成了一场争吵。

definitions.en: a. expressing much in few words

examples.en: Her speech was clear and concise.
examples.zh: 她的演讲清晰而简洁。

examples.en: Please give a concise answer to the question.
examples.zh: 请对问题给出简洁的回答。

definitions.en: a. musically pleasing
definitions.zh: a. 和睦的, 调和的, 和谐的, 协调的

examples.en: They live in a harmonious community.
examples.zh: 他们生活在一个和谐的社区里。

examples.en: The colors in the painting are harmonious.
examples.zh: 画中的色彩很和谐。

definitions.en: n a person who goes before or announces the coming of another
definitions.zh: n. 先驱, 前兆

examples.en: This invention was a forerunner of modern computers.
examples.zh: 这项发明是现代计算机的先驱。

examples.en: Dark clouds are a forerunner of rain.
examples.zh: 乌云是下雨的前兆。

definitions.en: n. a courteous expression (by word or deed) of esteem or regard
definitions.zh: n. 顺从, 尊重

examples.zh: 他对长辈表示尊重。

examples.en: In deference to her wishes, we stayed home.
examples.zh: 出于对她的意愿的尊重，我们待在家里。

definitions.en: n. the sound of heavy treading or stomping

definitions.en: v. injure by trampling or as if by trampling

examples.zh: 不要践踏花朵。

examples.zh: 人群把草踩平了。

definitions.en: a. having the nature of or resulting from malice
definitions.zh: a. 怀恶意的, 恶毒的

examples.zh: 他对她做了恶意的评论。

examples.en: That was a malicious rumor spread online.
examples.zh: 那是在网上传播的恶毒谣言。

definitions.en: n. the face or front of a building

examples.zh: 这座建筑有漂亮的正面。

examples.en: Behind his calm facade, he was nervous.
examples.zh: 在他平静的外表下，他很紧张。

definitions.en: n. a small waterfall or series of small waterfalls

definitions.en: n. a succession of stages or operations or processes or units

examples.zh: 水像瀑布一样从岩石上流下。

examples.zh: 这个消息引发了一连串的反应。

definitions.en: n. a state of extreme happiness
definitions.zh: n. 福佑, 天赐的福

examples.zh: 他们生活在幸福之中。

examples.en: The couple enjoyed marital bliss.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇享受着婚姻的幸福。

definitions.en: v. attach or add
definitions.zh: v. 邻接, 毗连

examples.zh: 厨房毗邻餐厅。

examples.en: Our garden adjoins the park.
examples.zh: 我们的花园与公园相邻。

definitions.en: n. a crafty and involved plot to achieve your (usually sinister) ends

definitions.en: n. a clandestine love affair

definitions.en: v. cause to be interested or curious

examples.zh: 这本神秘小说充满了阴谋。

examples.en: Her story intrigued me very much.
examples.zh: 她的故事让我非常感兴趣。

definitions.en: a. perceptible by the senses or intellect

definitions.en: s. capable of being perceived clearly

examples.zh: 他的情绪有可察觉的变化。

examples.zh: 轮廓在黑暗中几乎看不清。

definitions.en: n. a violently fast stream of water (or other liquid)
definitions.zh: n. 奔流, 倾盆大雨, 倾注, 迸发

examples.zh: 一股奔流淹没了街道。

examples.zh: 他面临一连串愤怒的质问。

definitions.en: s totally unlikely

examples.zh: 他撒谎是难以想象的。

examples.zh: 时间旅行的想法似乎不可思议。

definitions.en: s. expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
definitions.zh: a. 雄辩的, 有口才的, 有说服力的

examples.zh: 她在典礼上发表了雄辩的演讲。

examples.en: His eyes were eloquent with emotion.
examples.zh: 他的眼睛充满情感，富有表现力。

definitions.en: n. a person (such as an author) of enduring fame

definitions.en: a. not subject to death

examples.zh: 古代的神被认为是不朽的。

examples.en: Shakespeare's works are immortal.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚的作品是不朽的。

definitions.en: n. a large mass of ice floating at sea; usually broken off of a polar glacier
definitions.zh: n. 冰山, 冷冰冰的人

examples.zh: 船在海洋中撞上了一座冰山。

examples.zh: 只有冰山的尖端可见。

definitions.en: n state of violent mental agitation

examples.zh: 人群陷入一阵狂热的兴奋。

examples.en: He worked himself into a frenzy.
examples.zh: 他让自己陷入疯狂状态。

definitions.en: v. travel up, "We ascended the mountain"

definitions.en: v. go back in order of genealogical succession
definitions.zh: vt. 攀登

examples.zh: 他们一大早就登山了。

examples.en: The balloon began to ascend into the sky.
examples.zh: 气球开始升上天空。

definitions.en: n. the relation between opposing principles or forces or factors

definitions.zh: [化] 拮抗作用; 消效作用

examples.zh: 两个群体之间公开敌对。

examples.en: His words were filled with antagonism.
examples.zh: 他的话充满了敌意。

definitions.en: v. make a more or less disguised reference to
definitions.zh: vi. 暗指, 提及

examples.zh: 她暗指了这个问题，但没有点名。

examples.en: He alluded to his past in the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中提及了他的过去。

definitions.en: r. directly and without evasion; not roundabout

examples.zh: 他直视我的眼睛。

examples.zh: 她把书正好放在桌子上。

definitions.en: s. highly skilled

examples.zh: 她是一位有造诣的钢琴家。

examples.en: He felt accomplished after finishing the project.
examples.zh: 完成项目后，他感到很有成就感。

examples.zh: 雷声在远处隆隆作响。

examples.en: His stomach rumbled with hunger.
examples.zh: 他的肚子饿得咕咕叫。

definitions.en: n. a damage or loss

examples.zh: 吸烟对健康有害。

examples.en: He worked hard to the detriment of his sleep.
examples.zh: 他努力工作，却损害了睡眠。

definitions.zh: vi. 被解散

examples.zh: 巡演结束后，这个团体决定解散。

examples.en: The army was disbanded after the war.
examples.zh: 战争结束后军队被解散。

definitions.zh: vi. 变小, 亏缺, 衰落, 消逝, 退潮

examples.zh: 满月之后月亮开始亏缺。

examples.zh: 他对这个项目的兴趣开始减弱。

definitions.en: s. having won

examples.zh: 胜利的队伍庆祝了他们的胜利。

examples.en: She felt victorious after passing the exam.
examples.zh: 通过考试后她感到胜利了。

definitions.en: n. place or situation affording some advantage (especially a comprehensive view or commanding perspective)

examples.zh: 从这个有利位置，你可以看到整个城市。

definitions.en: n. the state of being held in high esteem and honor

examples.zh: 他给妻子写了一封深情的信。

examples.zh: 她在决定上没有动摇。

examples.zh: 这个国家被内乱撕裂。

examples.en: Family strife can cause a lot of pain.
examples.zh: 家庭冲突会造成很多痛苦。

definitions.en: n. a sharp protuberance

examples.zh: 我们的计划遇到了一个障碍。

examples.en: He snagged a great deal on the car.
examples.zh: 他抢到了这辆车的好价钱。

definitions.en: v shout louder than

definitions.zh: vt. 叫得比...响

examples.zh: 公众对新法律强烈抗议。

examples.zh: 这个决定引起了家长的强烈抗议。

examples.zh: 一个洞穴居民住在山里。

examples.zh: 她在舞台上表演得令人惊叹。

examples.zh: 公交车是城市中常见的交通工具。

examples.en: The conveyance of goods by train is efficient.
examples.zh: 通过火车运输货物很高效。

definitions.en: n. a mixture of soluble salts found in arid soils and some bodies of water; detrimental to agriculture
definitions.zh: n. 碱
a. 碱性的

examples.en: Soap is made from alkali and fat.
examples.zh: 肥皂是由碱和脂肪制成的。

examples.en: The soil is too alkali for most plants.
examples.zh: 土壤碱性太强，不适合大多数植物。

definitions.en: n. a tone that is a component of a complex sound
definitions.zh: a. 和谐的, 音乐般的, 和声的

definitions.en: n. any of a series of musical tones whose frequencies are integral multiples of the frequency of a fundamental
definitions.zh: n. 泛音, 谐波

examples.en: The music had a beautiful harmonic sound.
examples.zh: 音乐有美妙的和声。

examples.en: Harmonic frequencies add richness to music.
examples.zh: 谐波频率为音乐增添丰富性。

definitions.en: n. coins collectively
definitions.zh: n. 造币
[经] 造币, 货币制度

examples.en: The country introduced new coinage last year.
examples.zh: 该国去年推出了新铸币。

examples.en: Old coinage is often collected by enthusiasts.
examples.zh: 旧铸币常被爱好者收藏。

definitions.en: s. subject to or caused by an earthquake or earth vibration
definitions.zh: a. 地震的

examples.en: The seismic activity caused a small earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震活动引发了一次小地震。

examples.en: Scientists study seismic waves to learn about Earth.
examples.zh: 科学家研究地震波以了解地球。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to melody
definitions.zh: a. 有旋律的, 旋律美妙的

examples.en: The song has a very melodic tune.
examples.zh: 这首歌的曲调非常优美。

examples.en: She played a melodic piece on the piano.
examples.zh: 她在钢琴上弹奏了一首旋律优美的曲子。

definitions.en: v face and withstand with courage
definitions.zh: n. 泻水坡, 风化

definitions.en: v cause to slope
definitions.zh: [化] 天然时效

examples.en: The stone shows signs of weathering.
examples.zh: 这块石头显示出风化的迹象。

examples.en: Weathering changes the shape of rocks.
examples.zh: 风化作用改变了岩石的形状。

definitions.en: n. a system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical environment
definitions.zh: n. 生态系统
[医] 生态系

examples.en: The forest is a complex ecosystem.
examples.zh: 森林是一个复杂的生态系统。

examples.en: Pollution harms the ecosystem.
examples.zh: 污染危害生态系统。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to the class Mammalia
definitions.zh: n. 哺乳动物
a. 哺乳动物的

examples.en: Humans are mammalian creatures.
examples.zh: 人类是哺乳动物。

examples.en: Mammalian mothers feed their babies milk.
examples.zh: 哺乳动物的母亲用乳汁喂养婴儿。

definitions.en: n. the act of adding a seasoning to food
definitions.zh: n. 调味品, 作料, 佐料, 锻练
[化] 天然时效

examples.en: Add some seasoning to the soup for flavor.
examples.zh: 加些调味品到汤里提味。

examples.en: Salt and pepper are common seasonings.
examples.zh: 盐和胡椒是常见的调味品。

definitions.en: n. a Protestant in England who is not a member of the Church of England
definitions.zh: n. 不相信英国国教的人, 不符合通常准则的人, 不落俗套的人

definitions.en: n. someone who refuses to conform to established standards of conduct
definitions.zh: a. 违反准则的, 不落俗套的, 违反规范的

examples.en: He is a nonconformist who dresses differently.
examples.zh: 他是个不落俗套的人，穿着与众不同。

examples.en: Nonconformists often challenge traditional ideas.
examples.zh: 不墨守成规的人常常挑战传统观念。

definitions.en: n. someone who creates new dances
definitions.zh: n. 舞蹈指导

examples.en: The choreographer created a beautiful dance.
examples.zh: 舞蹈指导创作了一支优美的舞蹈。

examples.en: She works as a choreographer for the show.
examples.zh: 她为这场演出担任舞蹈指导。

definitions.en: n. an oily organic compound insoluble in water but soluble in organic solvents; essential structural component of living cells (along with proteins and carbohydrates)
definitions.zh: n. 脂类, 类脂物, 脂质
[化] 类脂; 脂质; 脂类

examples.en: Lipids are important for cell structure.
examples.zh: 脂质对细胞结构很重要。

examples.en: This food contains a lot of lipids.
examples.zh: 这种食物含有大量脂质。

definitions.en: n. a saying that is widely accepted on its own merits
definitions.zh: n. 格言, 座右铭

definitions.en: n. English inventor (born in the United States) who invented the Maxim gun that was used in World War I (1840-1916)
definitions.zh: [法] 格言, 准则, 原则

examples.en: “Honesty is the best policy” is a famous maxim.
examples.zh: “诚实为上策”是一句著名的格言。

examples.en: She lives by the maxim “never give up.”
examples.zh: 她遵循“永不放弃”的格言生活。

definitions.en: v. play around with or alter or falsify, usually secretively or dishonestly
definitions.zh: vi. 干预, 拨弄, 贿赂, 损害, 篡改
vt. 篡改
n. 捣棒, 打夯机, 填塞者

examples.en: Do not tamper with the smoke detector.
examples.zh: 不要擅自乱动烟雾探测器。

examples.en: Someone tried to tamper with the evidence.
examples.zh: 有人试图篡改证据。

definitions.en: n. a gradual decline (in size or strength or power or number)
definitions.zh: n. 退潮, 衰退

definitions.en: n. the outward flow of the tide
definitions.zh: vi. 潮退, 衰退

examples.en: The tide began to ebb in the evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚潮水开始退去。

examples.en: His energy started to ebb after the long run.
examples.zh: 长跑后他的精力开始衰退。

definitions.en: v. make understand
definitions.zh: vt. 教育, 启发, 启蒙, 开导, 教导

examples.en: The teacher helped enlighten the students.
examples.zh: 老师帮助启发学生。

examples.en: Reading can enlighten your mind.
examples.zh: 阅读可以启发你的思想。

definitions.en: r. with intention; in an intentional manner
definitions.zh: adv. 故意地, 有意地

examples.en: He intentionally broke the window.
examples.zh: 他故意打破了窗户。

examples.en: She intentionally ignored my question.
examples.zh: 她故意忽略了我的问题。

definitions.en: n freeing from false belief or illusions
definitions.zh: n. 觉醒, 幻灭

definitions.en: v free from enchantment
definitions.zh: vt. 使醒悟, 使幻想破灭

examples.en: The experience led to his disillusion.
examples.zh: 这次经历导致了他的幻灭。

examples.en: She didn't want to disillusion him.
examples.zh: 她不想让他幻想破灭。

definitions.en: v collect or gather
definitions.zh: vt. 积聚, 堆积

examples.en: He managed to amass a large fortune.
examples.zh: 他设法积聚了一大笔财富。

examples.en: She amassed a collection of rare books.
examples.zh: 她收集了大量珍本图书。

definitions.en: s unproductive of success
definitions.zh: a. 不结果的, 不长果实的, 无子的

examples.en: The search for treasure was fruitless.
examples.zh: 寻找宝藏的努力毫无结果。

examples.en: All our efforts proved fruitless.
examples.zh: 我们所有的努力都证明是徒劳的。

definitions.en: s. marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
definitions.zh: a. 敏锐的, 狡猾的

examples.en: The astute investor made a lot of money.
examples.zh: 精明的投资者赚了很多钱。

examples.en: She is an astute observer of human behavior.
examples.zh: 她是一位对人类行为敏锐的观察者。

definitions.en: v. leave (a job, post, or position) voluntarily
definitions.zh: vt.vi. 使空出, 搬出, 腾出, 不再使用/居住, 解除(职位), 撤离(阵地), 辞职, 退位

definitions.en: v. leave behind empty; move out of
definitions.zh: vt. 取消, 使作废

examples.en: Please vacate the room by noon.
examples.zh: 请在中午前腾出房间。

examples.en: They had to vacate the building.
examples.zh: 他们不得不搬出大楼。

definitions.en: s serving no useful purpose; having no excuse for being
definitions.zh: a. 多余的, 过剩的

examples.en: These extra details are superfluous.
examples.zh: 这些额外的细节是多余的。

examples.en: Remove any superfluous words from the essay.
examples.zh: 从文章中删除任何多余的词语。

definitions.en: n. one of the strands twisted together to make yarn or rope or thread; often used in combination
definitions.zh: n. 厚度, 板层

definitions.en: n. (usually in combinations) one of several layers of cloth or paper or wood as in plywood
definitions.zh: vt. 使用, 使劲挥舞, 从事, 折, 弯

definitions.en: v. apply oneself diligently
definitions.zh: vi. 辛勤工作, 定期航行

examples.en: This rope is made of three plies.
examples.zh: 这根绳子由三股捻成。

examples.en: He plies his trade as a carpenter.
examples.zh: 他从事木匠这一行。

definitions.en: s. indulging in or influenced by fancy
definitions.zh: a. 奇怪的, 稀奇的, 想像的

examples.en: She has a fanciful imagination.
examples.zh: 她有着奇特的想象力。

examples.en: The story is too fanciful to believe.
examples.zh: 这个故事太离奇，难以相信。

definitions.en: v. move (people) forcibly from their homeland into a new and foreign environment
definitions.zh: vt. 连根拔起, 根除

examples.en: The storm uprooted many trees.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把许多树连根拔起。

examples.en: They had to uproot their family and move.
examples.zh: 他们不得不举家搬迁。

definitions.en: s. having thin consistency
definitions.zh: a. 稀薄的, 微细的, 纤细的, 脆弱的

definitions.en: s. very thin in gauge or diameter
definitions.zh: [医] 细薄的, 纤细的

examples.en: The connection between the two ideas is tenuous.
examples.zh: 这两个想法之间的联系很微弱。

examples.en: He held a tenuous grip on the rope.
examples.zh: 他勉强抓住绳子。

definitions.en: s. producing exhaustion
definitions.zh: a. 使耗尽的, 使人筋疲力尽的
[计] 经验, 技巧, 穷举, 耗尽, 排气

examples.en: The hike was very exhausting.
examples.zh: 这次徒步旅行非常累人。

examples.en: Working all day is exhausting.
examples.zh: 整天工作令人筋疲力尽。

definitions.en: v. advance beyond the usual limit
definitions.zh: vi. 侵犯, 侵蚀, 蚕食
[法] 侵犯, 侵入, 侵占

examples.en: The building encroaches on the park land.
examples.zh: 这座建筑侵占了公园用地。

examples.en: Do not let work encroach on your family time.
examples.zh: 不要让工作侵占你的家庭时间。

definitions.en: s. characterized by effort to the point of exhaustion; especially physical effort
definitions.zh: a. 费力的, 努力的, 险峻的

examples.en: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task.
examples.zh: 爬山是一项费力的任务。

examples.en: She completed the arduous journey safely.
examples.zh: 她安全完成了这段费力的旅程。

definitions.en: s based on or told of in traditional stories; lacking factual basis or historical validity
definitions.zh: a. 神话的, 存在于神话中的, 神话式的, 不真实的, 虚构的, 幻想出来的

examples.en: Dragons are mythical creatures.
examples.zh: 龙是神话中的生物。

examples.en: The story is based on a mythical hero.
examples.zh: 这个故事基于一位神话英雄。

definitions.en: a. characteristic of or devoted to the temporal world as opposed to the spiritual world
definitions.zh: a. 世间的, 世俗的, 世上的

examples.en: He has a lot of worldly experience.
examples.zh: 他有很多世俗经验。

examples.en: She gave up her worldly possessions.
examples.zh: 她放弃了她的世俗财产。

definitions.en: n. loss of the ability to move a body part
definitions.zh: n. 麻痹, 停顿, 瘫痪
[医] 麻痹, 瘫痪

examples.en: The accident caused paralysis in his legs.
examples.zh: 事故导致他双腿瘫痪。

examples.en: The strike led to a paralysis of the city.
examples.zh: 罢工导致城市瘫痪。

definitions.en: v compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
definitions.zh: vi. 争, 竞争, 争胜
vt. 提出...来竞争, 以...作较量

examples.en: Many companies vie for the top talent.
examples.zh: 许多公司竞争顶尖人才。

examples.en: The two athletes vie for the gold medal.
examples.zh: 两名运动员争夺金牌。

definitions.en: r. in an alternating sequence or position
definitions.zh: adv. 交替地, 间隔地

examples.en: The lights flash alternately.
examples.zh: 灯光交替闪烁。

examples.en: We worked alternately on the project.
examples.zh: 我们交替进行这个项目。

definitions.en: a. without scruples or principles
definitions.zh: a. 无道德原则的, 不审慎的, 肆无忌惮的

examples.en: An unscrupulous salesman tricked the old lady.
examples.zh: 一个肆无忌惮的销售员欺骗了老妇人。

examples.en: Unscrupulous people often break the rules.
examples.zh: 无道德原则的人经常违反规则。

definitions.en: v. cause (a chemical compound, vapour, solution, magnetic material) to unite with the greatest possible amount of another substance
definitions.zh: vt. 使渗透, 浸透, 使充满, 使饱和
a. 浸透的, 饱和度高的, 深颜色的
n. 饱和化合物, 饱和脂肪酸

examples.en: The rain will saturate the ground.
examples.zh: 雨水会浸透地面。

examples.en: Don't saturate the sponge with water.
examples.zh: 不要让海绵吸饱水。

definitions.en: s tediously repetitious or lacking in variety; all work and no play"
definitions.zh: a. 单调的, 无变化的

examples.en: The monotonous lecture made students sleepy.
examples.zh: 单调的讲座让学生们犯困。

examples.en: His monotonous voice put me to sleep.
examples.zh: 他单调的声音让我睡着了。

definitions.en: v. surround so as to force to give up
definitions.zh: vt. 围攻, 包围

examples.en: The army besieged the castle for weeks.
examples.zh: 军队围攻城堡数周。

examples.en: Fans besieged the singer for autographs.
examples.zh: 粉丝们包围歌手索要签名。

definitions.en: n. the action of accomplishing something
definitions.zh: n. 成就, 完成

examples.en: Graduation was a great accomplishment.
examples.zh: 毕业是一项巨大的成就。

examples.en: She felt proud of her accomplishment.
examples.zh: 她为自己的成就感到自豪。

definitions.en: v. make into a puddle
definitions.zh: vt. 混合, 使微醉, 使咬字不清晰
vi. 胡乱对付
n. 困惑, 混浊状态

examples.en: The instructions were a complete muddle.
examples.zh: 说明完全是一团混乱。

examples.en: Don't muddle the two different ideas.
examples.zh: 不要混淆这两个不同的想法。

definitions.en: v. be persistent, refuse to stop
definitions.zh: vi. 坚持, 孜孜不倦, 不屈不挠, (辩论中)固执己见

examples.en: You must persevere to achieve your goals.
examples.zh: 你必须坚持才能实现目标。

examples.en: She persevered through difficult times.
examples.zh: 她在困难时期坚持不懈。

definitions.en: s. causing one to believe what is not true or fail to believe what is true
definitions.zh: a. 迷惑的, 虚伪的, 欺诈的

examples.en: The advertisement was deceptive.
examples.zh: 这个广告是欺骗性的。

examples.en: Appearances can be deceptive.
examples.zh: 外表可能具有欺骗性。

definitions.en: s. resisting control or authority
definitions.zh: a. 造反的, 反抗的

definitions.en: s. participating in organized resistance to a constituted government
definitions.zh: [法] 造反的, 反抗的, 反判的

examples.en: The rebellious teenager often broke the rules.
examples.zh: 这个叛逆的青少年经常违反规则。

examples.en: Rebellious soldiers refused to follow orders.
examples.zh: 反抗的士兵拒绝服从命令。

definitions.en: n. any of various thin shiny (savory or sweet) coatings applied to foods
definitions.zh: n. 釉, 上光, 光滑面

definitions.en: n. a glossy finish on a fabric
definitions.zh: vt. 装以玻璃, 上釉于

definitions.en: n. a coating for ceramics, metal, etc.
definitions.zh: vi. 变得光滑, (目光)变呆滞

examples.en: The potter applied a shiny glaze to the vase.
examples.zh: 陶工给花瓶涂上闪亮的釉。

examples.en: His eyes began to glaze over with boredom.
examples.zh: 他的眼睛因无聊而开始变得呆滞。

definitions.en: n. providence by virtue of planning prudently for the future
definitions.zh: n. 远见, 深谋远虑
[法] 先见, 预见, 预见的能力

examples.en: She had the foresight to save money.
examples.zh: 她有存钱的远见。

examples.en: His foresight prevented a major disaster.
examples.zh: 他的远见防止了一场大灾难。

definitions.en: n. untidiness (especially of clothing and appearance)
definitions.zh: vt. 弄乱, 使混乱, 使脱去衣服
n. 无秩序, 杂乱, 不整齐的衣着

examples.en: The room was in complete disarray.
examples.zh: 房间完全杂乱无章。

examples.en: The company fell into financial disarray.
examples.zh: 公司陷入财务混乱。

definitions.en: s characterized by extreme care and great effort
definitions.zh: n. 辛苦, 苦心, 工夫
a. 辛苦的, 勤勉的, 小心的

examples.en: The artist did painstaking work on the details.
examples.zh: 艺术家在细节上做了辛苦的工作。

examples.en: Painstaking research led to the discovery.
examples.zh: 辛苦的研究导致了这一发现。

definitions.en: v. become less in amount or intensity
definitions.zh: vt. 减少, 减轻, 减弱, 废除, 打折扣
vi. 减轻, 减弱, 减少, 失效, 被废除

examples.en: The storm finally began to abate.
examples.zh: 暴风雨终于开始减弱。

examples.en: The pain in his leg started to abate.
examples.zh: 他腿上的疼痛开始减轻。

definitions.en: a. capable of being borne or endured
definitions.zh: a. 可容忍的, 可以的

examples.en: The pain is tolerable with medicine.
examples.zh: 疼痛在服药后是可容忍的。

examples.en: The weather was tolerable for a walk.
examples.zh: 天气还可以，适合散步。

definitions.en: s. not growing or changing; without force or vitality
definitions.zh: a. 不流动的, 停滞的, 不景气的, 萧条的, 污浊的, 迟钝的
[经] 萧条的

examples.en: The water in the pond is stagnant.
examples.zh: 池塘里的水是停滞的。

examples.en: The economy has been stagnant for years.
examples.zh: 经济多年来一直停滞不前。

definitions.en: r. in accordance with moral or social standards
definitions.zh: adv. 公正地, 理由充分地, 正当地

examples.en: The judge decided justly.
examples.zh: 法官公正地做出了裁决。

examples.en: He was justly rewarded for his work.
examples.zh: 他因工作得到了公正的奖励。

definitions.en: a. incapable of change
definitions.zh: a. 不屈曲的, 不屈挠的, 顽固的

examples.en: The rules are inflexible.
examples.zh: 这些规则是不灵活的。

examples.en: He has an inflexible attitude.
examples.zh: 他态度顽固。

definitions.en: s filled or abounding with fog or mist
definitions.zh: a. 朦胧的, 模糊的, 烟雾弥漫的

examples.en: The view was hazy today.
examples.zh: 今天的景色很朦胧。

examples.en: I have a hazy memory of that event.
examples.zh: 我对那件事只有模糊的记忆。

definitions.en: n. loss of air pressure in a tire when a hole is made by some sharp object
definitions.zh: n. 刺痕, 穿刺

definitions.en: n. a small hole made by a sharp object
definitions.zh: vt. 刺穿, 刺, 揭穿

definitions.en: n. the act of puncturing or perforating
definitions.zh: vi. 被刺穿

examples.en: A nail caused a puncture in the tire.
examples.zh: 一颗钉子导致轮胎被刺穿。

examples.en: The doctor used a needle to puncture the blister.
examples.zh: 医生用针穿刺水泡。

definitions.en: s. so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe
definitions.zh: a. 巨大的, 巨像似的

examples.en: The building was a colossal structure.
examples.zh: 这座建筑是一个巨大的结构。

examples.en: They made a colossal mistake in the plan.
examples.zh: 他们在计划中犯了一个巨大的错误。

definitions.en: s noisy and lacking in restraint or discipline
definitions.zh: a. 难控制的, 无法无天的, 任性的

examples.en: The children were unruly in class.
examples.zh: 孩子们在课堂上不守规矩。

examples.en: His unruly hair needed a comb.
