examples.zh: 他被称为“飞毛腿”很恰当。

examples.en: She aptly described the situation.
examples.zh: 她恰当地描述了情况。

definitions.en: n an indication that something has been present
definitions.zh: n. 遗迹, 痕迹, 残余, 丝毫, 退化的器官
[医] 遗迹, 剩件, 剩余

examples.en: There is no vestige of the old building.
examples.zh: 旧建筑没有留下任何痕迹。

examples.en: A vestige of hope remained in her heart.
examples.zh: 她心中残留着一丝希望。

definitions.en: n. stinginess resulting from a concern for your own welfare and a disregard of others
definitions.zh: n. 自我中心, 利己主义, 任性

examples.en: Selfishness can hurt relationships.
examples.zh: 自私会伤害人际关系。

examples.en: His selfishness annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他的自私让所有人恼火。

definitions.en: v. overcome or allay
definitions.zh: vt. 压制, 平息, 减轻

examples.en: The police quelled the riot quickly.
examples.zh: 警察迅速平息了骚乱。

examples.en: She quelled her fears with deep breaths.
examples.zh: 她深呼吸平息了恐惧。

definitions.en: s. extremely hot
definitions.zh: a. 热的, 炎热的, 热心的

examples.en: She is a fervent supporter of the team.
examples.zh: 她是球队的热心支持者。

examples.en: His fervent speech moved the audience.
examples.zh: 他热心的演讲感动了观众。

definitions.en: v. cut open or cut apart
definitions.zh: v. 解剖, 切开

examples.en: The students will dissect a frog.
examples.zh: 学生们将解剖一只青蛙。

examples.en: Let us dissect this argument carefully.
examples.zh: 让我们仔细分析这个论点。

definitions.en: s. deeply religious
definitions.zh: a. 虔诚的, 虔敬的, 诚恳的

examples.en: She is a devout follower of her faith.
examples.zh: 她是她信仰的虔诚追随者。

examples.en: He gave a devout prayer.
examples.zh: 他做了虔诚的祈祷。

definitions.en: s. informal or natural; especially caught off guard or unprepared
definitions.zh: a. 坦白的, 率直的, 公正的

examples.en: She gave a candid opinion.
examples.zh: 她给出了坦率的意见。

examples.en: The photo was candid and natural.
examples.zh: 照片是抓拍的，很自然。

definitions.en: s. speeded up, as of an academic course
definitions.zh: a. 加快的
[医] 加速的

examples.en: The car accelerated quickly.
examples.zh: 汽车加速很快。

examples.en: She took an accelerated course.
examples.zh: 她参加了一个速成课程。

definitions.en: n. a feeling of ill will arousing active hostility
definitions.zh: n. 仇恨, 憎恶, 敌意

examples.en: There is animosity between the two groups.
examples.zh: 两组之间有敌意。

examples.en: He felt no animosity toward her.
examples.zh: 他对她没有敌意。

definitions.en: s. having made preparations
definitions.zh: a. 愿意, 倾向于

examples.en: She is disposed to help others.
examples.zh: 她愿意帮助别人。

examples.en: He felt disposed to agree.
examples.zh: 他倾向于同意。

definitions.en: v make psychologically or physically used (to something)
definitions.zh: vt. 使习惯于

examples.en: You need to accustom yourself to the new schedule.
examples.zh: 你需要让自己习惯新的时间表。

examples.en: She will accustom to the cold weather soon.
examples.zh: 她很快就会习惯寒冷的天气。

definitions.en: v. avoid and stay away from deliberately; stay clear of
definitions.zh: vt. 避开, 规避, 避免

examples.en: He shuns public attention.
examples.zh: 他避开公众注意。

examples.en: They shun unhealthy food.
examples.zh: 他们避免不健康的食物。

definitions.en: s. strange in an interesting or pleasing way
definitions.zh: a. 古雅的, 离奇有趣的, 奇怪的

examples.en: The village has quaint old houses.
examples.zh: 村庄有古雅的老房子。

examples.en: She wore a quaint hat.
examples.zh: 她戴了一顶奇特的帽子。

definitions.en: n. all future generations
definitions.zh: n. 子孙, 后裔
[法] 子嗣, 后代, 后裔

examples.en: We must protect nature for posterity.
examples.zh: 我们必须为后代保护自然。

examples.en: These records will be kept for posterity.
examples.zh: 这些记录将留给后代。

definitions.en: n doubt about someone's honesty
definitions.zh: n. 不信任, 疑惑

definitions.en: n the trait of not trusting others
definitions.zh: v. 不信任, 疑惑

examples.en: There is a lot of mistrust between them.
examples.zh: 他们之间有很多不信任。

examples.en: I mistrust his intentions.
examples.zh: 我怀疑他的意图。

definitions.en: n. any of numerous extinct elephants widely distributed in the Pleistocene; extremely large with hairy coats and long upcurved tusks
definitions.zh: n. 猛犸, 庞然大物
a. 猛犸似的, 巨大的

examples.en: The museum has a mammoth skeleton.
examples.zh: 博物馆有猛犸象骨架。

examples.en: It was a mammoth task.
examples.zh: 那是一项巨大的任务。

definitions.en: n. the condition of bearing fruit
definitions.zh: n. 成就, 实现, 结果实

examples.en: His plans came to fruition.
examples.zh: 他的计划实现了。

examples.en: The project reached fruition.
examples.zh: 项目取得了成果。

definitions.en: s like down or as soft as down
definitions.zh: a. 毛绒绒的, 蓬松的, 空洞的, 无内容的, 不明确的
[医] 绒毛状的

examples.en: The kitten is soft and fluffy.
examples.zh: 小猫柔软毛绒。

examples.en: She wore a fluffy sweater.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件蓬松的毛衣。

definitions.en: v add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing
definitions.zh: v. 详细说明, 解释

examples.en: He expounded his theory clearly.
examples.zh: 他详细解释了他的理论。

examples.en: She expounded on the topic.
examples.zh: 她详细说明了这个主题。

definitions.en: s. that cripples or disables or incapacitates
definitions.zh: (往复)曲折, 断裂, 临界的, 极限的

examples.en: The accident had a crippling effect on him.
examples.zh: 事故对他造成了致残的影响。

examples.en: The debt became a crippling burden.
examples.zh: 债务成了沉重的负担。

definitions.en: s suggesting the operation of supernatural influences
definitions.zh: a. 怪诞的, 可怕的, 离奇的, 神秘的

examples.en: He has an uncanny ability to predict.
examples.zh: 他有离奇的预测能力。

examples.en: The silence was uncanny.
examples.zh: 寂静得可怕。

definitions.en: n a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts
definitions.zh: n. 大都市, 重要中心, 首府

definitions.en: n people living in a large densely populated municipality
definitions.zh: [医] 产地, 生地

examples.en: New York is a busy metropolis.
examples.zh: 纽约是一个繁忙的大都市。

examples.en: She moved to the metropolis for work.
examples.zh: 她为了工作搬到了大都市。

definitions.en: s marked by excessive enthusiasm for and intense devotion to a cause or idea
definitions.zh: a. 狂热的, 盲信的

examples.en: He is a fanatical supporter of the team.
examples.zh: 他是该队的狂热支持者。

examples.en: Her fanatical devotion worried her friends.
examples.zh: 她狂热的忠诚让朋友们担心。

definitions.en: a. capable of being comprehended or understood
definitions.zh: a. 可理解的

examples.en: The teacher made the lesson comprehensible.
examples.zh: 老师让这节课变得可理解。

examples.en: Her explanation was clear and comprehensible.
examples.zh: 她的解释清晰且可理解。

definitions.en: v. compare critically; of texts
definitions.zh: vt. 校对, 校勘

definitions.en: v. to assemble in proper sequence
definitions.zh: [计] 整理

examples.en: Please collate these two documents.
examples.zh: 请校对这两份文件。

examples.en: We need to collate the data first.
examples.zh: 我们需要先整理数据。

definitions.en: n. inherited properties shared with others of your bloodline
definitions.zh: n. 祖先, 世系, 名门出身

examples.en: She is proud of her Irish ancestry.
examples.zh: 她为自己的爱尔兰血统感到自豪。

examples.en: His ancestry includes many famous people.
examples.zh: 他的祖先包括许多名人。

definitions.en: n. a slight depression in the smoothness of a surface
definitions.zh: n. 皱纹, 妙计, 方法, 技巧

definitions.en: n. a minor difficulty
definitions.zh: vi. 起皱

definitions.en: n. a clever method of doing something (especially something new and different)
definitions.zh: vt. 使起皱纹

examples.en: She has a wrinkle on her forehead.
examples.zh: 她额头上有一条皱纹。

examples.en: The fabric will wrinkle if you sit on it.
examples.zh: 如果你坐在上面，布料会起皱。

definitions.en: s rich and superior in quality
definitions.zh: a. 奢侈的, 华丽的

examples.en: They had a sumptuous feast last night.
examples.zh: 他们昨晚吃了一顿奢侈的盛宴。

examples.en: The palace was decorated in sumptuous style.
examples.zh: 宫殿以华丽的风格装饰。

definitions.en: v. enclose by or as if by a fortification
definitions.zh: vt. 设要塞于, 加强, 使坚强, 增加

definitions.en: v. add nutrients to
definitions.zh: vi. 筑防御工事

examples.en: They fortified the castle with high walls.
examples.zh: 他们用高墙加固了城堡。

examples.en: The cereal is fortified with vitamins.
examples.zh: 这种麦片添加了维生素。

definitions.en: a. injurious to physical or mental health
definitions.zh: a. 有害的, 有毒的, 使道德败坏的
[医] 有害的, 有毒的

examples.en: The factory released noxious fumes.
examples.zh: 工厂排放了有毒气体。

examples.en: Avoid breathing in noxious chemicals.
examples.zh: 避免吸入有害化学物质。

definitions.en: v. happen simultaneously
definitions.zh: vi. 同意, 一致, 同时发生
[法] 同时发生, 并发, 同意

examples.en: I concur with your opinion on this.
examples.zh: 我同意你对此事的意见。

examples.en: The events concurred on the same day.
examples.zh: 这些事件在同一天同时发生。

definitions.en: a. not convincing
definitions.zh: a. 不足以令人相信的

examples.en: His excuse was unconvincing to everyone.
examples.zh: 他的借口对每个人来说都不足以令人相信。

examples.en: The actor gave an unconvincing performance.
examples.zh: 演员的表演不足以令人相信。

definitions.en: v. fill something that had previously been emptied
definitions.zh: vt. 把...重新补足, 把...再装满
vi. 被再装满, 充满

examples.en: Please replenish the water in the tank.
examples.zh: 请把水箱里的水重新加满。

examples.en: We need to replenish our food supplies.
examples.zh: 我们需要补充食物储备。

definitions.en: v. be exposed
definitions.zh: vi. 晒太阳, 感到舒适

examples.en: The cat likes to bask in the sun.
examples.zh: 猫喜欢晒太阳。

examples.en: She basked in the glory of her success.
examples.zh: 她沉浸在成功的荣耀中。

definitions.en: n. a feeling of intense dislike
definitions.zh: n. 厌恶, 反感

definitions.en: n. the object of a feeling of intense aversion; something to be avoided
definitions.zh: [医] 反感, 厌恶; 相克疗法

examples.en: She felt antipathy towards the rude man.
examples.zh: 她对那个粗鲁的男人感到反感。

examples.en: His antipathy to change is well known.
examples.zh: 他对变化的厌恶是众所周知的。

definitions.en: n. an appraisal that is too high
definitions.zh: vt. 评价过高, 过高估价

definitions.en: n. a calculation that results in an estimate that is too high
definitions.zh: n. 估计过高, 评价过高

examples.en: Don't overestimate your abilities.
examples.zh: 不要高估你的能力。

examples.en: The cost was an overestimate by far.
examples.zh: 成本被远远过高估计了。

definitions.en: v. prove negative; show to be false
definitions.zh: vt. 否定, 否认, 取消
[计] 非

examples.en: This evidence will negate his claim.
examples.zh: 这个证据将否定他的说法。

examples.en: The new law negates the old one.
examples.zh: 新法律取消了旧法律。

definitions.en: n. a period of calm weather
definitions.zh: n. 暂停, 间歇, 稍息, 使人安静的东西

definitions.en: v. calm by deception
definitions.zh: vt. 使平静, 哄骗, 使安静

definitions.en: v. become quiet or less intensive
definitions.zh: vi. 变平静

examples.en: The storm had a brief lull.
examples.zh: 风暴有一个短暂的间歇。

examples.en: She sang a song to lull the baby.
examples.zh: 她唱了一首歌来哄婴儿安静。

definitions.en: s. marked by the exercise of good judgment or common sense in practical matters
definitions.zh: a. 头脑精明的, 贤明的, 判断正确的

examples.en: A judicious choice can save money.
examples.zh: 明智的选择可以省钱。

examples.en: He made a judicious decision about the investment.
examples.zh: 他对投资做出了明智的决定。

definitions.en: s. marked by ostentation but often tasteless
definitions.zh: a. 火焰似的, 辉耀的, 华丽的

examples.en: She wore a flamboyant red dress.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件华丽的红色连衣裙。

examples.en: His flamboyant style attracts attention.
examples.zh: 他华丽的风格引人注目。

definitions.en: s. having momentous consequences; of decisive importance
definitions.zh: a. 宿命的, 重大的, 决定性的

examples.en: That was a fateful decision.
examples.zh: 那是一个决定性的决定。

examples.en: They met on a fateful day.
examples.zh: 他们在命运攸关的一天相遇。

definitions.en: n a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place
definitions.zh: n. 大厦, 大建筑物

examples.en: The ancient edifice still stands tall.
examples.zh: 这座古老的大厦依然高耸。

examples.en: They built a grand edifice in the city.
examples.zh: 他们在城里建了一座宏伟的大厦。

definitions.en: n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
definitions.zh: n. 蔑视

definitions.en: n a communication that indicates lack of respect by patronizing the recipient
definitions.zh: vt. 蔑视, 鄙弃

examples.en: She looked at him with disdain.
examples.zh: 她轻蔑地看着他。

examples.en: He disdained their offer of help.
examples.zh: 他鄙视他们提供的帮助。

definitions.en: s. open to doubt or debate
definitions.zh: a. 可争论的, 成问题的, 未决定的

examples.en: The point is debatable.
examples.zh: 这一点有争议。

examples.en: Whether it is true is debatable.
examples.zh: 它是否真实还有待商榷。

definitions.en: v. come together, usually for a purpose
definitions.zh: v. (使)集合, (使)聚集
a. 集合在一起的, 集体的

examples.en: People congregate in the town square.
examples.zh: 人们聚集在城镇广场。

examples.en: The students congregate after class.
examples.zh: 学生们下课后聚集在一起。

definitions.en: n the visual percept of a region
definitions.zh: n. 远景, 展望, 回想

examples.en: The mountain vista was breathtaking.
examples.zh: 山景令人叹为观止。

examples.en: From the hill, you get a beautiful vista.
examples.zh: 从山上，你可以看到美丽的远景。

definitions.en: v spend thoughtlessly; throw away
definitions.zh: vt. 浪费, 使分散

definitions.en: v spend extravagantly
definitions.zh: vi. 浪费, 漂泊, 四散

examples.en: Don't squander your money on games.
examples.zh: 不要把钱浪费在游戏上。

examples.en: He squandered his inheritance quickly.
examples.zh: 他很快就挥霍掉了遗产。

definitions.en: n. an odd or unusual characteristic
definitions.zh: n. 特质, 特性, 怪癖

examples.en: His peculiarity is wearing mismatched socks.
examples.zh: 他的怪癖是穿不配对的袜子。

examples.en: The region has a peculiarity in its dialect.
examples.zh: 这个地区的方言有一种特性。

definitions.en: s characterized by effort to the point of exhaustion; especially physical effort
definitions.zh: a. 艰苦的, 费劲的, 勤劳的

examples.en: Cleaning the attic was a laborious task.
examples.zh: 打扫阁楼是一项艰苦的任务。

examples.en: He finished the laborious work by noon.
examples.zh: 他在中午前完成了费劲的工作。

definitions.en: n. an inability (usually of the male animal) to copulate
definitions.zh: n. 无力, 虚弱, 无效, 阳萎
[医] 阳萎, 无能力

examples.en: He felt a sense of impotence.
examples.zh: 他感到一种无力感。

examples.en: The disease caused impotence.
examples.zh: 这种疾病导致了阳萎。

definitions.en: n something immaterial that interferes with or delays action or progress
definitions.zh: n. 妨碍, 障碍, 阻止, 口吃

definitions.en: n any structure that makes progress difficult
definitions.zh: [经] 对履行义务的阻碍

examples.en: Lack of money is a big impediment.
examples.zh: 缺钱是一个大障碍。

examples.en: His speech impediment made him shy.
examples.zh: 他的口吃让他害羞。

definitions.en: a. not to your liking
definitions.zh: a. 令人不快的, 厌恶的, 不合意的

examples.en: The weather today is very disagreeable.
examples.zh: 今天的天气非常令人不快。

examples.en: He has a disagreeable personality.
examples.zh: 他有一个令人不快的性格。

definitions.en: v surround so as to force to give up
definitions.zh: vt. 绕行, 陷害, 包围, 智取

examples.en: We can circumvent the traffic jam.
examples.zh: 我们可以绕行避开交通堵塞。

examples.en: He tried to circumvent the rules.
examples.zh: 他试图智取规则。

definitions.en: v. make insensitive or callous; deaden feelings or morals
definitions.zh: a. 麻木的, 无情的, 坚硬的, 硬皮的, 起老茧的

definitions.en: s. emotionally hardened
definitions.zh: vt. 使生茧, 使变硬

examples.en: His callous hands showed hard work.
examples.zh: 他起老茧的手显示了辛苦劳作。

examples.en: She was callous to his feelings.
examples.zh: 她对她的感受麻木不仁。

definitions.en: v. move or swing back and forth
definitions.zh: vt. 挥, 挥舞

definitions.en: v. exhibit aggressively
definitions.zh: n. 挥舞

examples.en: He brandished a sword in the air.
examples.zh: 他在空中挥舞着一把剑。

examples.en: The angry man brandished his fist.
examples.zh: 愤怒的男人挥舞着拳头。

definitions.en: s. capable of arousing and holding the attention
definitions.zh: a. 吸引人的, 非常有趣的
[机] 吸收的

examples.en: The book is very absorbing.
examples.zh: 这本书非常引人入胜。

examples.en: She found the lecture absorbing.
examples.zh: 她觉得这场讲座很吸引人。

definitions.en: n. a coat of stucco applied to a masonry wall
definitions.zh: n. 翻译, 表现, 描写, 表演, 打底, 透视图

examples.en: The rendering of the song was beautiful.
examples.zh: 这首歌的表演很美丽。

examples.en: He gave a clear rendering of the text.
examples.zh: 他对文本做了清晰的翻译。

definitions.en: n use of physical or mental energy; hard work
definitions.zh: n. 努力, 发挥, 运用
[医] 劳力, 用力

examples.en: Physical exertion makes you feel tired.
examples.zh: 体力消耗让你感到疲倦。

examples.en: Mental exertion can be just as draining.
examples.zh: 脑力消耗同样会让人筋疲力尽。

definitions.en: a. satisfied or showing satisfaction with things as they are
definitions.zh: a. 满足的, 心安的

examples.en: The cat looked contented in the sun.
examples.zh: 猫在阳光下看起来很满足。

examples.en: She felt contented with her simple life.
examples.zh: 她对简单的生活感到心满意足。

definitions.en: n. an intervening period or episode
definitions.zh: n. 幕间, 幕间时间, 插曲, 穿插, 过场

definitions.en: n. a brief show (music or dance etc) inserted between the sections of a longer performance
definitions.zh: [计] 插算; 中间程序

examples.en: There was a musical interlude between acts.
examples.zh: 幕间有一段音乐插曲。

examples.en: We enjoyed a peaceful interlude in the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园享受了一段平静的插曲。

definitions.en: n. strange and unconventional behavior
definitions.zh: n. 古怪, 古怪行为, 怪癖

definitions.en: n. (geometry) a ratio describing the shape of a conic section; the ratio of the distance between the foci to the length of the major axis
definitions.zh: [化] 偏心度; 偏心距; 偏心率

examples.en: Her eccentricity makes her stand out.
examples.zh: 她的古怪让她脱颖而出。

examples.en: His eccentricity is part of his charm.
examples.zh: 他的怪癖是他魅力的一部分。

definitions.en: n. a substance that abrades or wears down
definitions.zh: n. 研磨料

definitions.en: s. causing abrasion
definitions.zh: a. 有研磨作用的

examples.en: Sandpaper is an abrasive material.
examples.zh: 砂纸是一种研磨材料。

examples.en: His abrasive tone upset everyone.
examples.zh: 他研磨般的语气让所有人不快。

definitions.en: a. not conclusive; not putting an end to doubt or question
definitions.zh: a. 非决定性的, 无效果的, 不得要领的
[法] 非决定性的, 不确定的, 无结果的

examples.en: The test results were inconclusive.
examples.zh: 测试结果没有定论。

examples.en: The evidence remains inconclusive so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止证据仍不确定。

definitions.en: n. a wrongful interference with the possession of property (personal property as well as realty), or the action instituted to recover damages
definitions.zh: n. 擅自进入, 非法侵入, 侵害

definitions.en: n. entry to another's property without right or permission
definitions.zh: vi. 侵害, 侵入, 打扰, 冒犯

examples.en: Do not trespass on private property.
examples.zh: 不要擅自进入私人财产。

examples.en: Trespass is against the law.
examples.zh: 非法侵入是违法的。

definitions.en: n. (surgery) tissue or organ transplanted from a donor to a recipient; in some cases the patient can be both donor and recipient
definitions.zh: n. 嫁接, 贪污

definitions.en: n. the act of grafting something onto something else
definitions.zh: v. 嫁接, 移植, 贪污

examples.en: The doctor performed a skin graft.
examples.zh: 医生进行了皮肤移植。

examples.en: He was accused of graft in office.
examples.zh: 他被指控在办公室贪污。

definitions.en: s. revealing lack of perceptiveness or judgment or finesse
definitions.zh: a. 不适当的, 不理智的, 笨拙的
[法] 不称职者, 无能的, 不符要求的

examples.en: He is inept at fixing cars.
examples.zh: 他修理汽车很笨拙。

examples.en: Her inept comment embarrassed everyone.
examples.zh: 她不适当的评论让所有人尴尬。

definitions.en: v. take the place or move into the position of
definitions.zh: vt. 排挤掉, 代替

examples.en: New technology may supplant old methods.
examples.zh: 新技术可能会取代旧方法。

examples.en: He tried to supplant his rival.
examples.zh: 他试图排挤掉他的对手。

definitions.en: a. firm in purpose or belief; characterized by firmness and determination
definitions.zh: n. 果断的人
a. 坚决的, 刚毅的, 毅然的

examples.en: She remained resolute in her decision.
examples.zh: 她对自己的决定保持坚决。

examples.en: He gave a resolute answer to the question.
examples.zh: 他对问题给出了毅然的回答。

definitions.en: s. suggesting an unhealthy mental state
definitions.zh: a. 致病的, 病态的, 疾病的, 可怕的
[医] 病的

examples.en: He has a morbid interest in death.
examples.zh: 他对死亡有病态的兴趣。

examples.en: The movie had a morbid atmosphere.
examples.zh: 电影有一种病态的气氛。

definitions.en: r. freely in a nonliteral manner
definitions.zh: adv. 宽大地, 大方地, 自由地

examples.en: She applied sunscreen liberally to her skin.
examples.zh: 她大量地涂抹防晒霜在皮肤上。

examples.en: He spends money liberally on gifts.
examples.zh: 他大方地花钱买礼物。

definitions.en: v. become looser or slack
definitions.zh: vt. 使松弛, 放松, 放慢

definitions.en: v. make slack as by lessening tension or firmness
definitions.zh: vi. 变松弛, 减弱, 松劲

examples.en: The rope began to slacken in the wind.
examples.zh: 绳子在风中开始松弛。

examples.en: He slackened his pace as he got tired.
examples.zh: 他累了就放慢了脚步。

definitions.en: n. a red or brown oxide coating on iron or steel caused by the action of oxygen and moisture
definitions.zh: n. 锈, 生锈, 衰退

definitions.en: n. a plant disease that produces a reddish-brown discoloration of leaves and stems; caused by various rust fungi
definitions.zh: vi. 生锈, 衰退

definitions.en: n. the formation of reddish-brown ferric oxides on iron by low-temperature oxidation in the presence of water
definitions.zh: vt. 使生锈, 腐蚀

examples.en: The old gate has a lot of rust on it.
examples.zh: 旧门上有很多锈。

examples.en: If you leave iron outside, it will rust quickly.
examples.zh: 如果你把铁放在外面，它会很快生锈。

definitions.en: s. relying on another for support
definitions.zh: a. 依赖的, 信赖的

examples.en: She is reliant on her parents for support.
examples.zh: 她依赖父母的支持。

examples.en: The country is reliant on oil imports.
examples.zh: 这个国家依赖石油进口。

definitions.en: a. belonging to or active during the night
definitions.zh: a. 夜的, 夜曲的

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or occurring in the night
definitions.zh: [医] 夜间的

examples.en: Owls are nocturnal animals.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰是夜行动物。

examples.en: He prefers nocturnal activities.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢夜间活动。

definitions.en: a. stimulating or exalting to the spirit
definitions.zh: a. 鼓舞人心的

examples.en: Her speech was truly inspiring to everyone.
examples.zh: 她的演讲确实鼓舞了每个人。

examples.en: The inspiring movie made me feel hopeful.
examples.zh: 这部鼓舞人心的电影让我感到充满希望。

definitions.en: s. marked by or showing hopelessness
definitions.zh: a. 孤独的, 悲惨的, 凄凉的

examples.en: The lost puppy looked forlorn.
examples.zh: 迷路的小狗看起来很凄凉。

examples.en: She felt forlorn after her friend left.
examples.zh: 朋友离开后她感到孤独。

definitions.en: v. entrap
definitions.zh: vt. 使纠缠, 卷入, 使混乱

examples.en: The wires entangle easily.
examples.zh: 电线容易纠缠在一起。

examples.en: He got entangled in a legal dispute.
examples.zh: 他被卷入一场法律纠纷。

definitions.en: s. unaffected by self-interest
definitions.zh: a. 无私欲的, 廉洁的, 公平的

examples.en: A judge must be disinterested.
examples.zh: 法官必须公正无私。

examples.en: She gave disinterested advice to her friend.
examples.zh: 她给朋友提供了公正的建议。

definitions.en: n. a proposition obtained by conversion
definitions.zh: n. 相反的事物, 倒, 逆向

definitions.en: v. carry on a conversation
definitions.zh: a. 相反的, 逆向的, 颠倒的

definitions.en: s. of words so related that one reverses the relation denoted by the other
definitions.zh: vi. 交谈, 谈话

examples.en: They converse in English every day.
examples.zh: 他们每天用英语交谈。

examples.en: The converse of that statement is true.
examples.zh: 那个陈述的反面是正确的。

definitions.en: r. in an abundant manner
definitions.zh: adv. 大量地, 丰富地

examples.en: The garden grows flowers abundantly.
examples.zh: 花园里大量地生长着花朵。

examples.en: Rain falls abundantly in this region.
examples.zh: 这个地区降雨丰富。

definitions.en: n. a college or university building containing living quarters for students
definitions.zh: n. 宿舍

examples.en: She lives in a dormitory near the university.
examples.zh: 她住在大学附近的宿舍里。

examples.en: The dormitory has a common room for students.
examples.zh: 宿舍有一个供学生使用的公共休息室。

definitions.en: n a particular environment or surrounding influence
definitions.zh: n. 周围环境, 气氛

examples.en: The restaurant has a cozy ambience.
examples.zh: 餐厅有一种舒适的气氛。

examples.en: Soft music adds to the ambience.
examples.zh: 轻柔的音乐增添了气氛。

definitions.en: n. an apparatus consisting of an object mounted so that it swings freely under the influence of gravity
definitions.zh: n. 钟摆, 摇锤, 摇摆不定的事态(或局面)
[化] 摆

examples.en: The pendulum swings back and forth.
examples.zh: 钟摆来回摆动。

examples.en: He watched the pendulum of the clock.
examples.zh: 他看着时钟的钟摆。

definitions.en: n. reasoning that involves the formation of conclusions from incomplete evidence
definitions.zh: n. 推测, 猜想, 揣摩
v. 推测, 猜想, 揣摩
[计] 推测; 猜测

examples.en: That is just a conjecture, not fact.
examples.zh: 那只是推测，不是事实。

examples.en: We can only conjecture what happened.
examples.zh: 我们只能推测发生了什么。

definitions.en: s. dug in
definitions.zh: a. 牢固的, 根深蒂固的

examples.en: Old habits are deeply entrenched.
examples.zh: 旧习惯根深蒂固。

examples.en: The company has an entrenched culture.
examples.zh: 这家公司有牢固的文化。

definitions.en: n. the act of nourishing
definitions.zh: n. 滋养品, 养料, 营养
[医] 营养, 营养品

examples.en: Milk provides good nourishment for babies.
examples.zh: 牛奶为婴儿提供良好的营养。

examples.en: Plants get nourishment from the soil.
examples.zh: 植物从土壤中获取养料。

definitions.en: n. an affront to one's dignity or self-esteem
definitions.zh: n. 侮辱
[法] 侮辱的言行, 无礼, 有伤尊严

examples.en: He suffered the indignity of being fired.
examples.zh: 他遭受了被解雇的侮辱。

examples.en: The treatment was an indignity to her.
examples.zh: 这种待遇对她是一种侮辱。

definitions.en: a. not admitting of passage or capable of being affected
definitions.zh: a. 透不过的, 不易损坏的, 无动于衷的, 不受影响的
[医] 不能透过的

examples.en: This material is impervious to water.
examples.zh: 这种材料不透水。

examples.en: He remained impervious to criticism.
examples.zh: 他对批评无动于衷。

definitions.en: v. suffuse with color
definitions.zh: vt. 使感染, 灌输, 使浸透

examples.en: Her speech imbued us with hope.
examples.zh: 她的演讲使我们充满希望。

examples.en: The artist imbues his work with emotion.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家将情感注入作品。

definitions.en: s. produced or growing in extreme abundance
definitions.zh: a. 繁茂的, 丰富的, 生气勃勃的
[医] 生成过多的, 高度增生的

examples.en: The garden was exuberant with flowers.
examples.zh: 花园里繁花似锦。

examples.en: She gave an exuberant laugh.
examples.zh: 她发出了充满活力的笑声。

definitions.en: v avoid and stay away from deliberately; stay clear of
definitions.zh: vt. 避开, 远避

examples.en: He eschews violence in all situations.
examples.zh: 他在所有情况下都避免暴力。

examples.en: She eschews processed foods for health.
examples.zh: 为了健康，她避开加工食品。

definitions.en: v. prove to be false
definitions.zh: vt. 证明...是不对的, 提出...的反证, 反驳
[法] 证明...不成立, 反驳, 驳斥

examples.en: New evidence disproved the old theory.
examples.zh: 新证据推翻了旧理论。

examples.en: They tried to disprove his claim.
examples.zh: 他们试图反驳他的说法。

definitions.en: n. a measure or standard used for comparison
definitions.zh: n. 码尺, 计算标准, 准绳

definitions.en: n. a ruler or tape that is three feet long
definitions.zh: [法] 尺度, 衡量标准, 任何评判或比较的标准

examples.en: Success is not the only yardstick.
examples.zh: 成功不是唯一的衡量标准。

examples.en: We need a yardstick to measure progress.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个标准来衡量进展。

definitions.en: a. conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being
definitions.zh: a. 有益健康的, 合乎卫生的, 健全的, 有益的, 有生气的, 审慎的

examples.en: Eating fruits is wholesome for your health.
examples.zh: 吃水果对你的健康有益。

examples.en: She enjoys wholesome family activities.
examples.zh: 她喜欢有益健康的家庭活动。

definitions.en: v. use a surgical instrument to hold open (the edges of a wound or an organ)
definitions.zh: v. 缩回, 收回, 取消, 撤消

examples.en: The cat can retract its claws.
examples.zh: 猫能缩回爪子。

examples.en: He retracted his statement after the backlash.
examples.zh: 他在强烈反对后收回了声明。

definitions.en: v. shape anew or differently
definitions.zh: vt. 改造, 使成新的形状, 打开新局面

definitions.en: v. shape again or shape differently
definitions.zh: vt. 整形
vi. 整形

examples.en: The new policy will reshape the industry.
examples.zh: 新政策将重塑这个行业。

examples.en: She wants to reshape her career path.
examples.zh: 她想重新规划自己的职业道路。

definitions.en: v. put down by force or intimidation
definitions.zh: vt. 镇压, 抑制, 压制

definitions.en: v. block the action of
definitions.zh: vi. 压制

examples.en: The government tried to repress dissent.
examples.zh: 政府试图压制异议。

examples.en: He learned to repress his anger.
examples.zh: 他学会了抑制自己的愤怒。

definitions.en: v extend out or project in space
definitions.zh: vi. 伸出, 突出

definitions.en: v bulge outward
definitions.zh: vt. 使伸出, 使突出

examples.en: A nail protrudes from the wooden board.
examples.zh: 一颗钉子从木板上突出。

examples.en: His teeth protrude slightly.
examples.zh: 他的牙齿稍微突出。

definitions.en: a. lacking in harmony or compatibility or appropriateness
definitions.zh: a. 不协调的, 不一致的, 不合适的

examples.en: The modern chair looked incongruous in the old room.
examples.zh: 现代椅子在老房间里显得不协调。

examples.en: His joke was incongruous with the serious meeting.
examples.zh: 他的笑话与严肃的会议不一致。

definitions.en: a. having or revealing keen insight and good judgment
definitions.zh: a. 有眼力的, 敏锐的, 有辨别能力的, 有洞察力的

examples.en: She is a discerning art collector.
examples.zh: 她是一位有眼力的艺术收藏家。

examples.en: His discerning eye caught the mistake.
examples.zh: 他敏锐的眼睛发现了错误。

definitions.en: n. a state of misfortune or affliction
definitions.zh: n. 逆境, 不幸, 灾祸, 灾难

examples.en: She faced adversity with great courage.
examples.zh: 她以极大的勇气面对逆境。

examples.en: Adversity can make you stronger.
examples.zh: 逆境能让你变得更坚强。

definitions.en: n. the process whereby heat changes something from a solid to a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 融解, 融化, 解冻时期

definitions.en: n. warm weather following a freeze; snow and ice melt
definitions.zh: vt. 使融解, 使缓和

definitions.en: n. a relaxation or slackening of tensions or reserve; becoming less hostile
definitions.zh: vi. 融化, 解冻

examples.en: The ice will thaw in the spring sun.
examples.zh: 冰会在春天的阳光下融化。

examples.en: Let the frozen meat thaw before cooking.
examples.zh: 让冷冻肉在烹饪前解冻。

definitions.en: v. grow rapidly
definitions.zh: vi. 增殖, 激增, 扩散

definitions.en: v. cause to grow or increase rapidly
definitions.zh: vt. 使激增

examples.en: Rumors proliferate quickly on social media.
examples.zh: 谣言在社交媒体上迅速扩散。

examples.en: The cells proliferate at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 细胞以惊人的速度增殖。

definitions.en: v. declare invalid
definitions.zh: vt. 使无效

definitions.en: v. show to be invalid
definitions.zh: [法] 使无效, 使无效力, 使作废

examples.en: The new evidence may invalidate the claim.
examples.zh: 新证据可能使这个主张无效。

examples.en: A typo can invalidate a contract.
examples.zh: 一个打字错误可能使合同无效。

definitions.en: n. very light rain; stronger than mist but less than a shower
definitions.zh: n. 细雨

definitions.en: v. rain lightly
definitions.zh: v. 下毛毛雨

examples.en: A light drizzle began to fall.
examples.zh: 开始下起了毛毛雨。

examples.en: It will drizzle all morning.
examples.zh: 整个早上都会下毛毛雨。

definitions.en: s. no longer in force or use; inactive
definitions.zh: a. 死的, 不能使用的

definitions.en: s. having ceased to exist or live
definitions.zh: n. 死者

examples.en: The company is now defunct.
examples.zh: 这家公司现在已经倒闭了。

examples.en: That old law is defunct.
examples.zh: 那条旧法律已经失效了。

definitions.en: n. bait consisting of chopped fish and fish oils that are dumped overboard to attract fish
definitions.zh: n. 密友, 室友
vi. 结为密友

examples.en: He is my old chum from school.
examples.zh: 他是我学校的老朋友。

examples.en: They chum around together every weekend.
examples.zh: 他们每个周末都结伴玩耍。

definitions.en: v have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal
definitions.zh: a. 有抱负的, 有志气的

examples.en: She is an aspiring young writer.
examples.zh: 她是一位有抱负的年轻作家。

examples.en: Aspiring musicians practice every day.
examples.zh: 有抱负的音乐家每天练习。

definitions.en: n. a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity
definitions.zh: a. 好交际的, 社交的, 过社会生活的

definitions.en: a. inclined to or conducive to companionship with others
definitions.zh: n. 联谊会

examples.en: He is a very sociable person.
examples.zh: 他是一个非常好交际的人。

examples.en: We had a sociable evening with friends.
examples.zh: 我们和朋友度过了一个愉快的社交之夜。

definitions.en: s. functioning in a supporting capacity
definitions.zh: n. 辅助者, 辅助物, 附属机构, 助动词
a. 辅助的, 备用的

examples.en: The hospital has an auxiliary power generator.
examples.zh: 医院有一台辅助发电机。

examples.en: She works as an auxiliary nurse in the clinic.
examples.zh: 她在诊所里做辅助护士。

definitions.en: n. an unsophisticated country person
definitions.zh: n. 乡下人, 乡巴佬
a. 乡村的, 纯朴的, 手工粗糙的

examples.en: They live in a rustic cabin in the woods.
examples.zh: 他们住在林间一座乡村风格的小屋里。

examples.en: The rustic furniture is simple but charming.
examples.zh: 这些乡村风格的家具简单而迷人。

definitions.en: s. occurring with no delay
definitions.zh: a. 即时的, 瞬间的, 猝发的
[机] 瞬时的

examples.en: The reaction was almost instantaneous.
examples.zh: 反应几乎是瞬间的。

examples.en: She gave an instantaneous reply to him.
examples.zh: 她立即给了他回复。

definitions.en: n. someone who is punished for the errors of others
definitions.zh: n. 替罪羔羊, 替人顶罪者, 替身
[法] 替罪羊, 代人受过者

examples.en: He became the scapegoat for the team's failure.
examples.zh: 他成了团队失败的替罪羊。

examples.en: Don't scapegoat others for your own mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要把自己的错误归咎于别人。

definitions.en: s carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger
definitions.zh: a. 警觉的, 警戒的, 警惕的
[法] 警醒的, 警戒的, 注意的

examples.en: Stay vigilant against potential threats.
examples.zh: 对潜在威胁保持警惕。

examples.en: The guard was vigilant all night.
examples.zh: 警卫整夜保持警觉。

definitions.en: n. a sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients
definitions.zh: n. 汉堡(德国港口), 肉饼, 汉堡包, 纯精牛肉, 汉堡牛排

examples.en: I would like a hamburger with cheese, please.
examples.zh: 我想要一个芝士汉堡。

examples.en: He ate a hamburger for lunch today.
examples.zh: 他今天午餐吃了一个汉堡包。

definitions.en: n. rules governing socially acceptable behavior
definitions.zh: n. 礼仪, 礼节, 成规
[法] 规则, 成规, 礼节

examples.en: Table etiquette is important in formal dinners.
examples.zh: 餐桌礼仪在正式晚宴中很重要。

examples.en: She knows the proper etiquette for the event.
examples.zh: 她知道这个活动的适当礼节。

definitions.en: v. put into a rage; make violently angry
definitions.zh: vt. 激怒, 使暴怒

examples.en: His rude comment enraged her.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的评论激怒了她。

examples.en: The unfair decision enraged the workers.
examples.zh: 不公平的决定激怒了工人们。

definitions.en: a. suitable to your needs
definitions.zh: a. 协调的, 一致的, 适意的, 趣味相同的

examples.en: We found a congenial atmosphere in the café.
examples.zh: 我们在咖啡馆找到了宜人的氛围。

examples.en: He is a congenial companion for the trip.
examples.zh: 他是一个适合同行的愉快伙伴。

definitions.en: a. worthy of trust or belief
definitions.zh: a. 可信赖的

definitions.en: s. taking responsibility for one's conduct and obligations
definitions.zh: [法] 可信任的, 可靠的, 可信赖的

examples.en: She is a trustworthy friend.
examples.zh: 她是一位值得信赖的朋友。

examples.en: The news source is not trustworthy.
examples.zh: 这个新闻来源不可靠。

definitions.en: n. a barrier (usually thrown up hastily) to impede the advance of an enemy
