examples.zh: 他滑稽的表情让大家都笑了。

definitions.en: n subtly skillful handling of a situation
definitions.zh: n. 策略, 手段, (桥牌中的)飞牌
v. 用计谋处理, 出小牌

examples.en: She handled the difficult situation with great finesse.
examples.zh: 她以高超的技巧处理了困难局面。

examples.en: His finesse in negotiation impressed everyone.
examples.zh: 他在谈判中的策略给所有人留下了深刻印象。

definitions.en: v. kindle anew, as of a fire
definitions.zh: vt. 再点火, 重新激起

definitions.en: v. arouse again
definitions.zh: vi. 重新燃烧

examples.en: They tried to rekindle their friendship.
examples.zh: 他们试图重燃友谊。

examples.en: The campfire was rekindled with new wood.
examples.zh: 篝火用新木柴重新点燃。

definitions.en: v be false to; be dishonest with
definitions.zh: vt. 迷惑, 蛊惑

examples.en: Don't delude yourself into thinking it's easy.
examples.zh: 不要欺骗自己认为这很容易。

examples.en: He deluded her with false promises.
examples.zh: 他用虚假的承诺欺骗了她。

definitions.en: n a quarrel about petty points
definitions.zh: vi. 争吵, 口角

definitions.en: v argue over petty things
definitions.zh: n. 争吵, 口角

examples.en: The children squabbled over the toy.
examples.zh: 孩子们为玩具争吵起来。

examples.en: They had a silly squabble about nothing.
examples.zh: 他们为一点小事发生了愚蠢的口角。

definitions.en: r. with extreme conscientiousness
definitions.zh: adv. 严谨, 一丝不苟, 用心, 准确, 多顾虑, 小心翼翼, 审慎, 诚实, 真心实意

examples.en: She scrupulously checked every detail.
examples.zh: 她一丝不苟地检查每个细节。

examples.en: He scrupulously followed the instructions.
examples.zh: 他严谨地遵循指示。

definitions.en: a. having scruples; arising from a sense of right and wrong; principled
definitions.zh: a. 小心谨慎的, 细心的

examples.en: She is a scrupulous worker.
examples.zh: 她是个一丝不苟的工人。

examples.en: He is scrupulous about details.
examples.zh: 他对细节很谨慎。

definitions.en: s showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
definitions.zh: a. 精明的, 谨慎的, 节约的

examples.en: She is a canny investor who never loses money.
examples.zh: 她是一个精明的投资者，从不亏钱。

examples.en: His canny decision saved the company from bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 他精明的决定使公司免于破产。

definitions.en: v make obsolete or old-fashioned
definitions.zh: a. 陈旧的, 过时的, 年老的

examples.en: The school uses antiquated teaching methods.
examples.zh: 这所学校使用过时的教学方法。

examples.en: This antiquated machine needs to be replaced.
examples.zh: 这台陈旧的机器需要更换。

definitions.en: s. of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
definitions.zh: a. 高尚的, 尊贵的, 高位的, 兴奋的

examples.en: She felt exalted after winning the award.
examples.zh: 获奖后她感到兴奋。

examples.en: He held an exalted position in the company.
examples.zh: 他在公司里担任高位。

definitions.en: s (usually followed by `to') strongly opposed
definitions.zh: a. 不愿意的, 反对的

examples.en: He is averse to taking any risks.
examples.zh: 他反对承担任何风险。

examples.en: She is not averse to trying new foods.
examples.zh: 她不反对尝试新食物。

definitions.en: s. characterized by great force or energy
definitions.zh: a. 热烈的, 激烈的

examples.en: He made a vehement protest.
examples.zh: 他提出了激烈的抗议。

examples.en: Her speech was vehement and powerful.
examples.zh: 她的演讲激烈而有力。

definitions.en: a. not pleasant or acceptable to the taste or mind
definitions.zh: a. 不可口的, 味道差的, 不好吃的

examples.en: The food was unpalatable and bland.
examples.zh: 食物不可口且淡而无味。

examples.en: The truth can sometimes be unpalatable.
examples.zh: 真相有时可能令人难以接受。

definitions.en: s. tending to discourage (especially of prices)
definitions.zh: a. 禁止的, 禁止性的
[经] 禁止性的, 抑制的

examples.en: The cost of the car was prohibitive for them.
examples.zh: 汽车的价格对他们来说高得令人望而却步。

examples.en: Prohibitive laws prevented the sale of alcohol.
examples.zh: 禁止性的法律阻止了酒精销售。

definitions.en: v cause to seem less serious; play down
definitions.zh: vt. 轻视, 贬低

examples.en: Don't belittle his efforts; he tried hard.
examples.zh: 不要贬低他的努力；他尽力了。

examples.en: She felt belittled by her boss's comments.
examples.zh: 她感到被老板的评论轻视了。

definitions.en: s. of the most contemptible kind
definitions.zh: a. 绝望无助的, 可怜的, 糟透的, 卑鄙的, 自卑的

definitions.en: s. most unfortunate or miserable
definitions.zh: [法] 卑鄙的, 卑下的, 可怜的

examples.en: He lived in abject poverty for many years.
examples.zh: 他多年生活在赤贫中。

examples.en: The abject apology did not satisfy her.
examples.zh: 卑微的道歉没有让她满意。

definitions.en: n. a unit of apothecary weight equal to 20 grains
definitions.zh: n. 踌躇, 犹豫, 微量

definitions.en: n. uneasiness about the fitness of an action
definitions.zh: vi. 踌躇, 有顾忌

examples.en: He had no scruple about lying to get ahead.
examples.zh: 他对为了成功而撒谎毫无顾忌。

examples.en: She scrupled to accept the money without working.
examples.zh: 她对于不劳而获地接受这笔钱感到犹豫。

definitions.en: v. have a long or continuing effect
definitions.zh: vi. 回响, 反响, 被反射

definitions.en: v. be reflected as heat, sound, or light or shock waves
definitions.zh: vt. 使反响, 使回响, 反射

definitions.en: v. treat, process, heat, melt, or refine in a reverberatory furnace
definitions.zh: a. 回响的, 反射的

examples.en: The sound of the bell reverberated through the hall.
examples.zh: 钟声在大厅里回响。

examples.en: The news reverberated across the entire country.
examples.zh: 这个消息在全国引起了反响。

definitions.en: v communicate vividly
definitions.zh: a. 突出的, 伸出的

examples.en: The rock is projecting from the cliff.
examples.zh: 岩石从悬崖上突出。

examples.en: She is projecting her voice to the crowd.
examples.zh: 她向人群大声说话。

definitions.en: s. skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands
definitions.zh: a. 敏捷熟练的, 灵巧的

examples.en: The surgeon's deft hands performed the operation.
examples.zh: 外科医生灵巧的双手进行了手术。

examples.en: She gave a deft reply to the difficult question.
examples.zh: 她对那个难题给出了巧妙的回答。

definitions.en: n. someone who censures or condemns
definitions.zh: n. 检查员

definitions.en: n. a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
definitions.zh: vt. 检查, 审查, 删改

examples.en: The censor removed some scenes from the film.
examples.zh: 审查员删除了电影中的一些场景。

examples.en: They censor all letters before sending them.
examples.zh: 他们在寄出前审查所有信件。

definitions.en: v affect with wonder
definitions.zh: vt. 使惊讶

examples.en: The news will astonish everyone.
examples.zh: 这个消息会使所有人惊讶。

examples.en: Her talent never fails to astonish me.
examples.zh: 她的才华总是让我惊讶。

definitions.en: v attract; cause to be enamored
definitions.zh: vt. 迷住, 迷惑

examples.en: The beautiful music captivated the audience.
examples.zh: 优美的音乐迷住了观众。

examples.en: Her story captivated everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的故事吸引了房间里的每个人。

definitions.en: s invulnerable to fear or intimidation
definitions.zh: a. 无畏的, 勇猛的

examples.en: The intrepid explorer climbed the highest mountain.
examples.zh: 无畏的探险家爬上了最高的山。

examples.en: She is an intrepid journalist reporting from war zones.
examples.zh: 她是一名在战区报道的无畏记者。

definitions.en: n an indirect (and usually malicious) implication
definitions.zh: n. 讽刺, 暗讽
vi. 说讽刺话
vt. 暗示

examples.en: His comment was full of innuendo about her past.
examples.zh: 他的评论充满了对她过去的暗讽。

examples.en: She ignored the innuendo and continued her work.
examples.zh: 她无视了暗讽，继续她的工作。

definitions.en: a. easily excited
definitions.zh: a. 能被激动的, 易兴奋的, 易怒的

definitions.en: s. capable of responding to stimuli
definitions.zh: [医] 应激的, [可]兴奋的

examples.en: The puppy is very excitable.
examples.zh: 这只小狗很容易兴奋。

examples.en: Excitable children need calm guidance.
examples.zh: 易兴奋的孩子需要冷静的引导。

definitions.en: n a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people
definitions.zh: n. 格言, 谚语

examples.en: The old adage says time heals all wounds.
examples.zh: 老谚语说时间能治愈一切创伤。

examples.en: She lives by the adage 'honesty is the best policy'.
examples.zh: 她遵循‘诚实为上策’这句格言生活。

definitions.en: n. an implement for practical use (especially in a household)
definitions.zh: n. 器皿, 用具

examples.en: A knife is a useful kitchen utensil.
examples.zh: 刀是一种有用的厨房用具。

examples.en: She washed every utensil after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后她洗了每一件器皿。

definitions.en: s. hard to endure
definitions.zh: a. 难受的, 难堪的
[法] 裁决, 审判, 审理; 使人痛苦的, 难堪的, 难处的

examples.en: This has been a trying experience.
examples.zh: 这是一次难熬的经历。

examples.en: She had a trying day at work.
examples.zh: 她工作了一天很辛苦。

definitions.en: n. a behavioral attribute that is distinctive and peculiar to an individual
definitions.zh: n. 气质, 特性, 风格
[化] 特异反应; 特异性体质

examples.en: His idiosyncrasy is tapping his foot.
examples.zh: 他的怪癖是跺脚。

examples.en: Everyone has a small idiosyncrasy.
examples.zh: 每个人都有点小怪癖。

definitions.en: n. a passage selected from a larger work
definitions.zh: n. 摘录

definitions.en: v. take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy
definitions.zh: v. 引用, 摘录

examples.en: He read an excerpt from the novel aloud.
examples.zh: 他大声朗读了小说的一段摘录。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to excerpt key points.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们摘录关键点。

definitions.en: s having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
definitions.zh: n. 高手, 专家

definitions.en: a of or relating to technique or proficiency in a practical skill
definitions.zh: a. 精通的, 熟练的

examples.en: She is proficient in playing the piano.
examples.zh: 她精通弹钢琴。

examples.en: He became proficient at using computers.
examples.zh: 他变得熟练使用电脑。

definitions.en: n. an instance of intense argument (as in bargaining)
definitions.zh: vi. 争论, 杀价

definitions.en: v. wrangle (over a price, terms of an agreement, etc.)
definitions.zh: vt. 乱砍, 乱劈
n. 杀价, 讨论, 争论

examples.en: They haggled over the price of the car.
examples.zh: 他们就汽车的价格讨价还价。

examples.en: She hates to haggle at the market.
examples.zh: 她讨厌在市场里杀价。

definitions.en: n. quality of being easily damaged or destroyed
definitions.zh: n. 脆弱, 虚弱

definitions.en: n. lack of physical strength
definitions.zh: [化] 易碎性

examples.en: The fragility of the glass is obvious.
examples.zh: 玻璃的易碎性很明显。

examples.en: Her fragility made her seem vulnerable.
examples.zh: 她的脆弱让她显得易受伤害。

definitions.en: a. difficult to use or handle or manage because of size or weight or shape
definitions.zh: a. 难处理的, 笨大难使用的, 笨拙的

examples.en: The box was too unwieldy to carry alone.
examples.zh: 箱子太笨重了，一个人搬不动。

examples.en: The new software is unwieldy and difficult to use.
examples.zh: 新软件笨拙难用。

definitions.en: s totally unlikely
definitions.zh: a. 不能想象的, 不可思议的

examples.en: The destruction was unimaginable.
examples.zh: 破坏程度难以想象。

examples.en: It is unimaginable to live without water.
examples.zh: 没有水生活是不可想象的。

definitions.en: s briefly giving the gist of something
definitions.zh: a. 简洁的, 紧缩的

examples.en: Her speech was succinct and very clear.
examples.zh: 她的演讲简洁明了。

examples.en: He gave a succinct answer to the question.
examples.zh: 他对问题给出了一个简洁的回答。

definitions.en: n. (Greek mythology) the goddess of healing; daughter of Aesculapius and sister of Hygeia
definitions.zh: n. 万能药, 灵丹妙药

definitions.en: n. hypothetical remedy for all ills or diseases; once sought by the alchemists
definitions.zh: [医] 万应药

examples.en: There is no panacea for all problems.
examples.zh: 没有能解决所有问题的万能药。

examples.en: People often seek a panacea for their troubles.
examples.zh: 人们常常为烦恼寻找灵丹妙药。

definitions.en: v. grow too large or too mature for
definitions.zh: vt. 过大而不适于, 长得比...高(或大、快), 成长得不再具有...

examples.en: Children quickly outgrow their clothes.
examples.zh: 孩子们很快长大穿不下衣服。

examples.en: He will outgrow his shyness eventually.
examples.zh: 他最终会克服害羞。

definitions.en: s worthy of high praise
definitions.zh: a. 值得赞赏的, 值得佩服的
[医] 健康的

examples.en: Her effort is truly laudable.
examples.zh: 她的努力确实值得赞赏。

examples.en: That was a laudable goal.
examples.zh: 那是一个值得称赞的目标。

definitions.en: r. in a laborious manner
definitions.zh: adv. 辛苦地；费力地；不流畅地

examples.en: He laboriously wrote each letter by hand.
examples.zh: 他费力地手写每个字母。

examples.en: She laboriously climbed the steep hill.
examples.zh: 她费力地爬上陡峭的山丘。

definitions.en: a. favorable to life and growth
definitions.zh: a. 好客的, 招待周到的

examples.en: The local people are very hospitable to visitors.
examples.zh: 当地人对游客非常热情好客。

examples.en: They live in a hospitable climate.
examples.zh: 他们生活在宜人的气候中。

definitions.en: s. stubbornly unyielding
definitions.zh: a. 顽固的, 顽强的

examples.en: His dogged determination helped him succeed.
examples.zh: 他顽强的决心帮助他成功了。

examples.en: She showed dogged persistence in her studies.
examples.zh: 她在学习中表现出顽强的毅力。

definitions.en: a. depriving of confidence or hope or enthusiasm and hence often deterring action
definitions.zh: a. 令人气馁的

examples.en: The news was very discouraging.
examples.zh: 这个消息非常令人气馁。

examples.en: Discouraging results made him give up.
examples.zh: 令人气馁的结果让他放弃了。

definitions.en: r. with diligence; in a diligent manner
definitions.zh: adv. 勤奋地；勤勉地

examples.en: She studied diligently for the exam.
examples.zh: 她勤奋地备考。

examples.en: He worked diligently on the project.
examples.zh: 他勤奋地做这个项目。

definitions.en: s. suitable for cutting or piercing
definitions.zh: a. 敏锐的, 机敏的, 激烈的, 切入的, 锋利的
[医] 切牙的, 切的

examples.en: She made an incisive comment about the issue.
examples.zh: 她对这个问题发表了敏锐的评论。

examples.en: His incisive analysis impressed everyone.
examples.zh: 他敏锐的分析给所有人留下了印象。

definitions.en: n. the roughness of a substance that causes abrasions
definitions.zh: n. 粗糙事物, 刺耳, 严肃

examples.en: The harshness of winter is hard to bear.
examples.zh: 冬天的严酷难以忍受。

examples.en: He spoke with harshness in his voice.
examples.zh: 他说话声音刺耳。

definitions.en: v keep from happening or arising; make impossible
definitions.zh: vt. 预先阻止, 先...一步行动, 占先一步, 垄断, 阻碍

definitions.en: v act in advance of; deal with ahead of time
definitions.zh: [法] 先采取行动预防或阻止, 垄断

examples.en: They acted quickly to forestall any problems.
examples.zh: 他们迅速行动以预先阻止任何问题。

examples.en: She forestalled his criticism by apologizing first.
examples.zh: 她先道歉，阻止了他的批评。

definitions.en: n. the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material
definitions.zh: n. 木材, 破旧家俱, 废物, 隆隆声

definitions.en: v. move heavily or clumsily
definitions.zh: vt. 砍伐木材, 乱堆
vi. 笨拙地移动, 喧闹地向前走, 隆隆地移动

examples.en: They used lumber to build the house.
examples.zh: 他们用木材建造房子。

examples.en: The bear began to lumber through the woods.
examples.zh: 熊开始笨重地穿过树林。

definitions.en: n. the qualities of a hero or heroine; exceptional or heroic courage when facing danger (especially in battle)
definitions.zh: n. 英勇, 勇敢事迹, 豪侠行为

examples.en: His heroism saved many lives that day.
examples.zh: 他那天的英勇行为挽救了许多生命。

examples.en: The soldier showed great heroism in battle.
examples.zh: 这名士兵在战斗中表现出极大的英勇。

definitions.en: s. marked by strong resentment or cynicism
definitions.zh: a. 尖刻的, 讥讽的, 激烈的

examples.en: The debate became acrimonious and personal.
examples.zh: 辩论变得尖刻且针对个人。

examples.en: They had an acrimonious divorce settlement.
examples.zh: 他们有一个尖刻的离婚协议。

definitions.en: s. without cause
definitions.zh: a. 免费的, 无理由的

definitions.en: s. unnecessary and unwarranted
definitions.zh: [经] 无代价的

examples.en: The movie contained gratuitous violence.
examples.zh: 电影包含了无理由的暴力。

examples.en: His gratuitous advice was not appreciated.
examples.zh: 他无理由的建议不被欣赏。

definitions.en: n. English aeronautical engineer who invented the jet aircraft engine (1907-1996)
definitions.zh: vt. 逐渐削薄, 削整, 削弱, 削减

definitions.en: v. cut small bits or pare shavings from
definitions.zh: vi. 削木头
n. 大刀, 屠刀

examples.en: He likes to whittle wood into small figures.
examples.zh: 他喜欢把木头削成小雕像。

examples.en: They whittled down the list to ten candidates.
examples.zh: 他们把名单削减到十个候选人。

definitions.en: r. in a strenuous manner; strongly or vigorously
definitions.zh: adv. 勤奋地；费力地

examples.en: She worked strenuously to finish the project.
examples.zh: 她勤奋地工作以完成项目。

examples.en: He strenuously denied the accusations against him.
examples.zh: 他费力地否认了对他的指控。

definitions.en: n. a hoe that is used by pushing rather than pulling
definitions.zh: vi. 扭打, 混战, 拖着脚走, 敷衍了事

definitions.en: v. fight or struggle in a confused way at close quarters
definitions.zh: n. 扭打, 混战, 拖着脚走

examples.en: A scuffle broke out between the two boys.
examples.zh: 两个男孩之间发生了一场扭打。

examples.en: They scuffled briefly over the last piece of cake.
examples.zh: 他们为最后一块蛋糕短暂扭打起来。

definitions.en: v. be a mystery or bewildering to
definitions.zh: vt. 使困惑, 使复杂化, 使为难
[法] 困惑, 使复杂化, 使纠缠不清

examples.en: The difficult question will perplex the students.
examples.zh: 这个难题会使学生们困惑。

examples.en: His strange behavior began to perplex me.
examples.zh: 他奇怪的行为开始让我困惑。

definitions.en: v. throw away, of something encumbering
definitions.zh: n. 投弃, 投弃货物

definitions.en: v. throw as from an airplane
definitions.zh: [经] 抛弃, 船货投海

examples.en: The plane had to jettison fuel to land safely.
examples.zh: 飞机不得不抛弃燃料以安全着陆。

examples.en: They jettisoned the old plan for a new one.
examples.zh: 他们抛弃了旧计划，采用新计划。

definitions.en: s being deepest within the self
definitions.zh: a. 内心的, 秘密的, 最深处的

examples.en: She shared her innermost thoughts with me.
examples.zh: 她与我分享了她内心深处的想法。

examples.en: The innermost room was dark and quiet.
examples.zh: 最里面的房间又暗又安静。

definitions.en: s excessively agitated; distraught with fear or other violent emotion
definitions.zh: a. 发狂的, 狂热的
n. 发狂者

examples.en: The frenetic pace of city life exhausted her.
examples.zh: 城市生活狂热的节奏让她筋疲力尽。

examples.en: He worked at a frenetic speed to finish on time.
examples.zh: 他以狂热的速度工作以按时完成。

definitions.en: s. occurring by happy chance
definitions.zh: a. 偶然的
[医] 偶然的, 机会的

examples.en: Their meeting was entirely fortuitous.
examples.zh: 他们的相遇完全是偶然的。

examples.en: A fortuitous discovery led to a new invention.
examples.zh: 一个偶然的发现导致了一项新发明。

definitions.en: v mar or spoil the appearance of
definitions.zh: vt. 毁损...的外形, 玷污, 损害, 毁损...的容貌
[法] 损毁容颜, 破相

examples.en: The accident disfigured his face badly.
examples.zh: 事故严重毁损了他的容貌。

examples.en: Graffiti can disfigure public buildings.
examples.zh: 涂鸦会玷污公共建筑的外观。

definitions.en: n. an equal exchange
definitions.zh: n. 物物交换, 实物交易

definitions.en: v. exchange goods without involving money
definitions.zh: v. 物物交换, 交换

examples.en: They used barter to trade goods without money.
examples.zh: 他们用物物交换来交易货物，不用钱。

examples.en: In some villages, people still barter for food.
examples.zh: 在一些村庄，人们仍然用物物交换换取食物。

definitions.en: r. in an uneven and irregular way
definitions.zh: adv. 不平坦地；不均衡地；不平行地

examples.en: The cake was cut unevenly into pieces.
examples.zh: 蛋糕被不均匀地切成块。

examples.en: The road was unevenly paved and bumpy.
examples.zh: 这条路铺得不平坦，很颠簸。

definitions.en: s. unshaken in purpose
definitions.zh: a. 大无畏的, 勇敢的

examples.en: She remained undaunted by the difficult task.
examples.zh: 她面对艰巨任务仍大无畏。

examples.en: Undaunted, he continued climbing the mountain.
examples.zh: 他毫不畏惧，继续爬山。

definitions.en: v. beat through cleverness and wit
definitions.zh: vt. 瞒骗, 以智取胜

examples.en: The fox outwitted the hunter easily.
examples.zh: 狐狸轻松地以智取胜了猎人。

examples.en: She outwitted her opponent in the game.
examples.zh: 她在游戏中以智取胜了对手。

definitions.en: n. a laborer who moves from place to place as demanded by employment
definitions.zh: a. 巡回的

definitions.en: s. traveling from place to place to work
definitions.zh: n. 巡回者

examples.en: The itinerant worker moved from farm to farm.
examples.zh: 那个巡回工人从一个农场搬到另一个。

examples.en: He lived as an itinerant musician for years.
examples.zh: 他作为巡回音乐家生活了多年。

definitions.en: v. fuse or cause to grow together
definitions.zh: vi. 合并, 联合, 合生
[计] 结合

examples.en: The two groups coalesced into one team.
examples.zh: 这两个团体合并成了一个团队。

examples.en: Their ideas coalesced into a clear plan.
examples.zh: 他们的想法合并成了一个清晰的计划。

definitions.en: n. the state of being under the control of a force or influence or abstract power
definitions.zh: n. 奴役, 束缚

definitions.en: n. the state of being under the control of another person
definitions.zh: [法] 束缚, 监禁, 奴隶

examples.en: They lived in bondage for many years.
examples.zh: 他们在奴役中生活了许多年。

examples.en: He escaped from the bondage of debt.
examples.zh: 他摆脱了债务的束缚。

definitions.en: v. color lightly
definitions.zh: n. 色彩, 浅色
vt. 染色于

examples.en: She added a blue tint to the paint.
examples.zh: 她在颜料中加入了一点蓝色色彩。

examples.en: The windows have a slight green tint.
examples.zh: 窗户带有一点浅绿色。

definitions.en: n. a shelter with perches for fowl or other birds
definitions.zh: n. 栖木, 休息所, 群栖的禽鸟

definitions.en: n. a perch on which domestic fowl rest or sleep
definitions.zh: vi. 栖息, 安歇

definitions.en: v. settle down or stay, as if on a roost
definitions.zh: vt. 使栖息

examples.en: The chickens returned to their roost at night.
examples.zh: 鸡群晚上回到了它们的栖木上。

examples.en: Birds roost in the trees during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，鸟儿在树上栖息。

definitions.en: v. treat or speak of with contempt
definitions.zh: vt. 嘲弄, 嘲笑

examples.en: They deride his efforts to learn English.
examples.zh: 他们嘲笑他学习英语的努力。

examples.en: Do not deride others for their mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要嘲笑别人的错误。

definitions.en: n. a storm resulting from strong rising air currents; heavy rain or hail along with thunder and lightning
definitions.zh: n. 雷暴雨

examples.en: A thunderstorm is coming, so stay indoors.
examples.zh: 雷暴雨要来了，所以待在室内。

examples.en: The thunderstorm woke me up last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的雷暴雨把我吵醒了。

definitions.en: n a small piece of anything (especially a piece that has been snipped off)
definitions.zh: n. 小片, 片断, 摘录

examples.en: I read a snippet of the news online.
examples.zh: 我在网上读到了一小段新闻。

examples.en: She shared a snippet of her conversation.
examples.zh: 她分享了对话的一个片段。

definitions.en: n the trait of being uncommunicative; not volunteering anything more than necessary
definitions.zh: n. 无言, 沉默, 勉强

examples.en: His reticence made it hard to know his feelings.
examples.zh: 他的沉默让人难以了解他的感受。

examples.en: She spoke with reticence about her past.
examples.zh: 她勉强地谈起了自己的过去。

definitions.en: n. an expression of lack of respect
definitions.zh: n. 不敬, 失礼, 无礼

examples.en: He showed disrespect to his teacher.
examples.zh: 他对老师表现出不敬。

examples.en: Disrespect is not tolerated in this class.
examples.zh: 这个班级不容忍无礼行为。

definitions.en: v. persist stubbornly
definitions.zh: a. 倔强的, 顽固的, 不让步的

examples.en: The obstinate child refused to eat vegetables.
examples.zh: 这个倔强的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。

examples.en: He is obstinate and never changes his mind.
examples.zh: 他很顽固，从不改变主意。

definitions.en: n. a sheltered and secluded place
definitions.zh: n. 角落, 躲蔽处, 隐匿处, 凹处

examples.en: She found a quiet nook to read her book.
examples.zh: 她找到一个安静的角落读书。

examples.en: The cat hid in a small nook under the stairs.
examples.zh: 猫躲在楼梯下的一个小角落里。

definitions.en: v. cast off
definitions.zh: vt. 否认
[计] 不认, 驱逐

examples.en: He decided to disown his family's business.
examples.zh: 他决定否认与家族企业的关系。

examples.en: She threatened to disown her son if he lied.
examples.zh: 她威胁说如果儿子撒谎就与他断绝关系。

definitions.en: v. make politically neutral and thus inoffensive
definitions.zh: vt. 使中立, 使成中立地带, 使中和, 抵销

definitions.en: v. make ineffective by counterbalancing the effect of
definitions.zh: vi. 中立化, 变无效, 中和

examples.en: The medicine helps neutralize the acid.
examples.zh: 这种药有助于中和酸。

examples.en: They tried to neutralize the threat quickly.
examples.zh: 他们试图迅速消除威胁。

definitions.en: n. a mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something (especially on a person's body)
definitions.zh: n. 污点, 缺点

definitions.en: v. mar or impair with a flaw
definitions.zh: vt. 弄脏, 玷污, 损害

examples.en: She had a small blemish on her cheek.
examples.zh: 她脸颊上有一个小污点。

examples.en: The accident blemished his perfect record.
examples.zh: 那次事故玷污了他的完美记录。

definitions.en: n. a state of great suffering and distress due to adversity
definitions.zh: n. 苦恼, 折磨, 苦恼的事由

examples.en: He suffered from a painful affliction.
examples.zh: 他遭受了一种痛苦的折磨。

examples.en: Poverty is a common affliction in many areas.
examples.zh: 贫困是许多地区的常见苦恼。

definitions.en: n an insufficient quantity or number
definitions.zh: n. 少数, 少量, 缺乏

examples.en: There is a paucity of clean water here.
examples.zh: 这里缺乏干净的水。

examples.en: The paucity of evidence led to his release.
examples.zh: 证据的缺乏导致他被释放。

definitions.en: v force somebody to do something
definitions.zh: a. 乐于施惠的, 体贴的, 有礼貌的

examples.en: The obliging waiter helped us with the menu.
examples.zh: 乐于施惠的服务员帮我们看菜单。

examples.en: She is an obliging person who always assists.
examples.zh: 她是个乐于施惠的人，总是帮忙。

definitions.en: s. greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
definitions.zh: a. 过度的, 过高的, 过分的

examples.en: The price of that car is exorbitant.
examples.zh: 那辆车的价格过高。

examples.en: They charged an exorbitant fee for the service.
examples.zh: 他们对这项服务收取了过高的费用。

definitions.en: a. not having inhabitants; not lived in
definitions.zh: a. 无人居住的, 杳无人迹的

examples.en: The island was completely uninhabited.
examples.zh: 那个岛完全无人居住。

examples.en: They explored an uninhabited forest area.
examples.zh: 他们探索了一片无人居住的森林区域。

definitions.en: n the feeling of being bored by something tedious
definitions.zh: n. 单调乏味, 沉闷

examples.en: The long meeting was full of tedium.
examples.zh: 漫长的会议充满了单调乏味。

examples.en: She tried to escape the tedium of daily life.
examples.zh: 她试图逃避日常生活的单调乏味。

definitions.en: v. cause to come out in a squirt
definitions.zh: v. 喷出, 溅迸, 注射

definitions.en: v. wet with a spurt of liquid
definitions.zh: n. 水枪, 注射器, 喷出

examples.en: The lemon squirted juice into her eye.
examples.zh: 柠檬喷出的汁液溅到了她的眼睛里。

examples.en: He used a squirt gun to play with water.
examples.zh: 他用一把水枪玩水。

definitions.en: n. an opening that allows the passage of liquids or grain
definitions.zh: n. 喷口, 从喷口流出的水, 水落管, 水龙卷
vt. 喷出, 喷射, 滔滔不绝说出, 典押
vi. 喷射, 高谈阔论

examples.en: Water came out of the teapot spout.
examples.zh: 水从茶壶的壶嘴流出来。

examples.en: The whale spouted water into the air.
examples.zh: 鲸鱼向空中喷水。

definitions.en: v. disturb in mind or make uneasy or cause to be worried or alarmed
definitions.zh: vt. 扰乱, 使混乱, 使心绪不宁

examples.en: The news did not perturb him.
examples.zh: 这消息没有让他不安。

examples.en: Don't perturb the sleeping cat.
examples.zh: 别打扰睡觉的猫。

definitions.en: n. a miniature model of something
definitions.zh: n. 小宇宙, 小世界, 人类

examples.en: The garden is a microcosm of nature.
examples.zh: 这个花园是大自然的缩影。

examples.en: This town is a microcosm of society.
examples.zh: 这个小镇是社会的缩影。

definitions.en: n. a disorder of digestive function characterized by discomfort or heartburn or nausea
definitions.zh: n. 消化不良
[医] 消化不良, 不消化

examples.en: Eating too fast can cause indigestion.
examples.zh: 吃得太快会导致消化不良。

examples.en: She took medicine for her indigestion.
examples.zh: 她服了药来治疗消化不良。

definitions.en: s. longing to return home
definitions.zh: a. 思家的, 思乡病的

examples.en: She felt homesick during her first week at camp.
examples.zh: 她在夏令营的第一周感到想家。

examples.en: He became homesick after moving to a new city.
examples.zh: 搬到新城市后，他变得思乡。

definitions.en: n. a compensating equivalent
definitions.zh: vt. 使平均, 使平衡, 使弥补
n. 平衡量, 平衡力, 势均力敌

examples.en: The weights counterbalance each other.
examples.zh: 这些砝码相互平衡。

examples.en: Her kindness is a counterbalance to his temper.
examples.zh: 她的善良是对他脾气的平衡。

definitions.en: s. changeable
definitions.zh: a. 反复无常的, 多变的, 任性的

examples.en: The weather here is very capricious.
examples.zh: 这里的天气非常反复无常。

examples.en: She is capricious and changes her mind often.
examples.zh: 她反复无常，经常改变主意。

definitions.en: n. a tapering point
definitions.zh: n. 敏锐, 聪明

examples.en: Her business acumen is impressive.
examples.zh: 她的商业头脑令人印象深刻。

examples.en: He has great acumen for solving problems.
examples.zh: 他有很强的解决问题能力。

definitions.en: v. bestow glory upon
definitions.zh: vt. 赞美, 美化, 赞扬, 使辉煌

examples.en: They glorify the achievements of their team.
examples.zh: 他们赞美团队的成就。

examples.en: The movie tries to glorify war and violence.
examples.zh: 这部电影试图美化战争和暴力。

definitions.en: s. (used especially of clothes) marked by conspicuous display
definitions.zh: a. 闪光的, 一瞬间的, 浮华的

examples.en: He wore a flashy suit to the party.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套浮华的西装去派对。

examples.en: Her flashy jewelry attracted everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 她闪光的珠宝吸引了所有人的注意。

definitions.en: n. powerful and effective language
definitions.zh: n. 口才, 雄辩术, 雄辩
[法] 善辩, 口才

examples.en: Her eloquence moved the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 她的口才让全体观众感动落泪。

examples.en: He spoke with great eloquence at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会议上以极大的雄辩发言。

definitions.en: v. give up, such as power, as of monarchs and emperors, or duties and obligations
definitions.zh: vt. 正式放弃
vi. 退位, 退出, 辞职

examples.en: The king decided to abdicate the throne.
examples.zh: 国王决定退位。

examples.en: He abdicated his responsibility as a leader.
examples.zh: 他放弃了作为领导者的责任。

definitions.en: s. occurring or coming into existence after a person's death
definitions.zh: a. 遗腹的, 死后的
[医] 遗腹的

examples.en: He received a posthumous award.
examples.zh: 他死后获得了奖项。

examples.en: Her book was published posthumously.
examples.zh: 她的书在死后出版了。

definitions.en: a. not capable of being surmounted or overcome
definitions.zh: a. 难以克服的, 不能超越的

examples.en: The obstacle seemed insurmountable at first.
examples.zh: 这个障碍起初似乎难以克服。

examples.en: They faced insurmountable financial problems.
examples.zh: 他们面临难以克服的财务问题。

definitions.en: v. be teeming, be abuzz
definitions.zh: vi. 充满, 充足, 倾注
vt. 倒出

examples.en: The river teems with fish.
examples.zh: 这条河里鱼很多。

examples.en: The market teems with shoppers on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末市场里挤满了购物者。

definitions.en: n. a temporary stay (e.g., as a guest)
definitions.zh: n. 逗留, 旅居

definitions.en: v. spend a certain length of time; reside temporarily
definitions.zh: vi. 逗留, 旅居

examples.en: They had a brief sojourn in Paris.
examples.zh: 他们在巴黎短暂逗留。

examples.en: He sojourned in the mountains for a month.
examples.zh: 他在山里旅居了一个月。

definitions.en: v. urge or force (a person) to an action; constrain or motivate
definitions.zh: vt. 推动, 激励, 驱使, 迫使

examples.en: Curiosity impelled her to explore the cave.
examples.zh: 好奇心驱使她探索洞穴。

examples.en: Hunger impelled him to find food.
examples.zh: 饥饿迫使他去寻找食物。

definitions.en: s not yet discovered
definitions.zh: a. 未勘查过的

examples.en: The cave remained unexplored for centuries.
examples.zh: 这个洞穴几个世纪以来一直未勘查过。

examples.en: They ventured into unexplored territory.
examples.zh: 他们冒险进入了未勘查过的区域。

definitions.en: n a line that indicates a boundary
definitions.zh: vt. 量, 测量, 分配
n. 边界, 界石

examples.en: The judge will mete out a fair punishment.
examples.zh: 法官将给予公平的惩罚。

examples.en: They meted out justice to the criminals.
examples.zh: 他们对罪犯施以正义。

definitions.en: v. make drunk (with alcoholic drinks)
definitions.zh: vt. 使陶醉, 使喝醉

examples.en: The wine began to intoxicate him.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒开始让他陶醉。

examples.en: The music intoxicated the crowd.
examples.zh: 音乐使人群陶醉。

definitions.en: n. exemption from punishment or loss
definitions.zh: n. 不受惩罚, 无事, 无患
[法] 不受刑罚, 免罚, 免罪

examples.en: He broke the rules with impunity.
examples.zh: 他违反规则却不受惩罚。

examples.en: No one can commit crimes with impunity.
examples.zh: 没有人可以犯罪而不受惩罚。

definitions.en: v. raise in rank, character, or status
definitions.zh: vt. 提升, 提高, 赞扬, 使得意
vi. 使人兴奋, 使人得意

examples.en: They exalt the virtues of hard work.
examples.zh: 他们赞扬勤奋的美德。

examples.en: The king was exalted above all others.
examples.zh: 国王被提升到高于所有人的地位。

definitions.en: v. support with evidence or authority or make more certain or confirm
definitions.zh: vt. 巩固, 确证
[法] 确证, 确定, 证实

examples.en: The evidence corroborates his story.
examples.zh: 证据证实了他的说法。

examples.en: Can you corroborate her alibi?
examples.zh: 你能证实她的不在场证明吗？

definitions.en: v. take to task
definitions.zh: vt. 警告, 劝告, 训诫, 告诫

examples.en: The teacher admonished the student for talking.
examples.zh: 老师因学生讲话而训诫他。

examples.en: She admonished him to drive carefully.
examples.zh: 她告诫他要小心驾驶。

definitions.en: s. open to or swept by wind
definitions.zh: a. 风刮的, 被风吹扫的, 暴露在风中的

examples.en: The windswept beach was cold and empty.
examples.zh: 被风吹扫的海滩又冷又空。

examples.en: She stood on the windswept hilltop.
examples.zh: 她站在被风吹扫的山顶上。

definitions.en: a. lacking flavor
definitions.zh: a. 没味道的, 无鉴赏力的

examples.en: The food was bland and completely tasteless.
examples.zh: 食物淡而无味，完全没味道。

examples.en: He made a tasteless joke at the party.
examples.zh: 他在派对上开了一个无鉴赏力的玩笑。

definitions.en: v. yield (to); give satisfaction to
definitions.zh: vt. 使满足

examples.en: The good news gratified her greatly.
examples.zh: 好消息使她非常满足。

examples.en: He gratified his curiosity by reading the book.
examples.zh: 他通过读这本书满足了好奇心。

definitions.en: v indicate by signs
definitions.zh: vt. 成为前兆, 预示

examples.en: Dark clouds foreshadow a storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着一场风暴。

examples.en: His words foreshadowed the coming crisis.
examples.zh: 他的话预示了即将到来的危机。

definitions.en: n. high status importance owing to marked superiority
definitions.zh: n. 显赫, 名家, 高处
[医] 隆起, 隆凸

examples.en: She achieved eminence in her field.
examples.zh: 她在自己的领域取得了显赫地位。

examples.en: He is a scholar of great eminence.
examples.zh: 他是一位非常杰出的学者。

definitions.en: a. of or located in the lower part of a town, or in the business center
definitions.zh: n. 市中心区

definitions.en: r. toward or in the lower or central part of town
definitions.zh: a. 市中心的
adv. 往闹市区

examples.en: We went downtown to shop.
examples.zh: 我们去市中心购物。

examples.en: The downtown area is very busy.
examples.zh: 市中心区域非常繁忙。

definitions.en: n. the point above the observer that is directly opposite the nadir on the imaginary sphere against which celestial bodies appear to be projected
definitions.zh: n. 顶点；最高点；顶峰

examples.en: The sun reached its zenith at noon.
examples.zh: 太阳在正午达到顶点。

examples.en: His career was at its zenith then.
examples.zh: 他的事业当时处于顶峰。

definitions.en: n. a drug that temporarily quickens some vital process
definitions.zh: a. 兴奋性的, 激励的, 鼓舞的

definitions.en: s. that stimulates
definitions.zh: n. 兴奋剂, 酒精饮料

examples.en: Coffee is a common stimulant.
examples.zh: 咖啡是一种常见的兴奋剂。

examples.en: The news was a stimulant for the team.
examples.zh: 这个消息对团队是一种激励。

definitions.en: r. in an irregular manner
definitions.zh: adv. 不规则, 不整齐, 不合法

examples.en: The train arrived irregularly due to the storm.
examples.zh: 由于暴风雨，火车不规则地到达。

examples.en: He brushed his teeth irregularly as a child.
examples.zh: 他小时候刷牙不规律。

definitions.en: s. having or showing excessive or compulsive concern with something
definitions.zh: a. 常出现鬼的, 闹鬼的

examples.en: The old house was said to be haunted.
examples.zh: 据说那栋老房子闹鬼。

examples.en: He had a haunted look in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他眼中带着一种被困扰的神情。

definitions.en: n an annoying or frustrating or catastrophic event
definitions.zh: n. 苦难, 困苦, 苦难的缘由

examples.en: They faced great tribulation together.
examples.zh: 他们共同面对巨大的苦难。

examples.en: Tribulation can make people stronger.
examples.zh: 苦难能让人更坚强。

definitions.en: n the season of growth
definitions.zh: n. 春天, 春季, 初期

examples.en: Springtime is my favorite season.
examples.zh: 春天是我最喜欢的季节。

examples.en: Flowers bloom in the springtime.
examples.zh: 花在春天开放。

definitions.en: n. a small cursive script developed from uncial between the 7th and 9th centuries and used in medieval manuscripts
definitions.zh: n. 小书写体, 小写字

definitions.en: a. of or relating to a small cursive script developed from uncial; 7th to 9th centuries
definitions.zh: a. 用小书写体的, 小写字的

examples.en: The font size was minuscule.
examples.zh: 字体大小非常小。

examples.en: He wrote in a minuscule script.
examples.zh: 他用小书写体写字。

definitions.en: v. invade in great numbers
definitions.zh: vt. 骚扰, 寄生于, 大批出没

definitions.en: v. live on or in a host, as of parasites
definitions.zh: [医] 传染, 感染

examples.en: Rats infest the old building.
examples.zh: 老鼠大批出没于旧楼。

examples.en: Parasites can infest the body.
examples.zh: 寄生虫可以寄生于人体。

definitions.en: v hold spellbound
definitions.zh: vt. 迷住, 奴役, 使做奴隶, 吸引住

examples.en: The story enthralled the children completely.
examples.zh: 这个故事完全迷住了孩子们。

examples.en: Her performance enthralled the entire audience.
examples.zh: 她的表演吸引了全体观众。

definitions.en: s. worthy of being depended on
definitions.zh: a. 可信任的, 可靠的, 可信赖的

examples.en: She is a dependable friend who always helps.
examples.zh: 她是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。

examples.en: This car is old but very dependable.
examples.zh: 这辆车旧了，但非常可靠。

definitions.en: s showing deference
definitions.zh: a. 恭敬的
[医] 输精管的

examples.en: The student was deferential to the teacher.
examples.zh: 这个学生对老师很恭敬。

examples.en: He spoke in a deferential tone to his boss.
examples.zh: 他用恭敬的语气对老板说话。

definitions.en: s. uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
definitions.zh: a. 不停的, 不断的

examples.en: The ceaseless rain flooded the streets.
examples.zh: 不停的雨淹没了街道。

examples.en: Her ceaseless efforts finally paid off.
examples.zh: 她不断的努力终于得到了回报。

definitions.en: v. subject to prolonged examination, discussion, or deliberation
definitions.zh: vt. 使烦恼, 使苦恼
vi. 烦恼

examples.en: His constant questions vex me.
examples.zh: 他不断的问题使我烦恼。

examples.en: Don't vex your mother with noise.
examples.zh: 不要用噪音烦扰你的母亲。

definitions.en: v. cause to be calm or quiet as by administering a sedative to
definitions.zh: a. 沉着的, 镇静的, 安静的

definitions.en: s. characterized by dignity and propriety
definitions.zh: vt. 给...服镇静剂

examples.en: The doctor gave a sedate medicine.
examples.zh: 医生给了一种镇静药。

examples.en: She remained sedate during the crisis.
examples.zh: 她在危机中保持镇静。

definitions.en: n. the quality of being predictable
definitions.zh: n. 可预言
[电] 可预测性

examples.en: The predictability of the weather helped planning.
examples.zh: 天气的可预测性有助于规划。

examples.en: He disliked the predictability of his daily routine.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢日常生活的可预测性。

definitions.en: n. the quality of being magnificent or splendid or grand
definitions.zh: n. 富丽堂皇, 华丽, 宏大

examples.en: The palace's magnificence amazed all visitors.
examples.zh: 宫殿的富丽堂皇令所有游客惊叹。

examples.en: She admired the magnificence of the sunset.
examples.zh: 她欣赏日落的壮丽。

definitions.en: s. unwillingness to do something contrary to your custom
definitions.zh: a. 不情愿的, 厌恶的

examples.en: He was loath to leave the party.
examples.zh: 他不情愿离开派对。

examples.en: She is loath to admit her mistake.
examples.zh: 她不愿承认自己的错误。

definitions.en: v. gush forth in a sudden stream or jet
definitions.zh: n. 喷射, 冲刺
vt. 喷射
vi. 喷出, 迸发, 冲刺

examples.en: Water began to spurt from the broken pipe.
examples.zh: 水开始从破裂的管道中喷射出来。

examples.en: He made a final spurt to win the race.
examples.zh: 他做了最后的冲刺以赢得比赛。

definitions.en: n. a dormant or quiescent state
definitions.zh: n. 睡眠, 麻木状态
vi. 微睡, 静止, 麻木
vt. 睡着度过(时间)

examples.en: The baby fell into a deep slumber.
examples.zh: 婴儿进入了深深的睡眠。

examples.en: She slumbered peacefully through the night.
examples.zh: 她整夜安静地微睡。

definitions.en: n. the act of secluding yourself from others
definitions.zh: n. 隔离, 隐退

examples.en: She enjoyed the seclusion of her mountain cabin.
examples.zh: 她喜欢山间小屋的隔离。

examples.en: He sought seclusion after the stressful event.
examples.zh: 他在紧张事件后寻求隐退。

definitions.en: a. acceptable to the taste or mind
definitions.zh: a. 美味的, 好吃的, 可口的
[医] 适口的, 味美的

examples.en: The food was quite palatable.
examples.zh: 食物相当可口。

examples.en: She found the idea palatable.
examples.zh: 她觉得这个想法可以接受。

definitions.en: a. having or showing no mercy
definitions.zh: a. 无慈悲心的, 残忍的

examples.en: The merciless sun beat down on the desert.
examples.zh: 无情的太阳炙烤着沙漠。

examples.en: He was a merciless critic of bad art.
examples.zh: 他对糟糕的艺术是一个残忍的批评者。

definitions.en: v. intrude in other people's affairs or business; interfere unwantedly
definitions.zh: vi. 干涉, 干预, 擅自摸弄
[法] 干预, 插手, 弄乱

examples.en: Don't meddle in other people's affairs.
examples.zh: 不要干涉别人的事情。

examples.en: She always meddles with my plans.
examples.zh: 她总是干预我的计划。

definitions.en: s. arrived at without due care or effort; lacking depth
definitions.zh: a. 容易的, 灵巧的, 温和的

examples.en: His answer was too facile.
examples.zh: 他的回答太肤浅了。

examples.en: She gave a facile explanation.
examples.zh: 她给出了一个轻率的解释。

definitions.en: v. make a slave of; bring into servitude
definitions.zh: vt. 奴役, 束缚, 使受控制, 征服

examples.en: The dictator tried to enslave the people.
examples.zh: 独裁者试图奴役人民。

examples.en: Addiction can enslave a person.
examples.zh: 成瘾可以奴役一个人。

definitions.en: n. a swaggering show of courage
definitions.zh: n. 虚张声势

examples.en: His bravado hid his fear.
examples.zh: 他的虚张声势掩盖了恐惧。

examples.en: She acted with false bravado.
examples.zh: 她以虚假的勇气行事。

definitions.en: n. strong feelings of embarrassment
definitions.zh: n. 懊恼
vt. 使懊恼

examples.en: To his chagrin, he lost the game.
examples.zh: 令他懊恼的是，他输了比赛。

examples.en: She felt chagrin at the mistake.
examples.zh: 她对错误感到懊恼。

definitions.en: a. incapable of being retracted or revoked
definitions.zh: a. 不能挽回的, 不能取消的, 不能变更的
[经] 不能撤销的, 不能恢复的

examples.en: The decision was irrevocable.
examples.zh: 这个决定不可撤销。

examples.en: He made an irrevocable promise.
examples.zh: 他做出了不可撤回的承诺。

definitions.en: v. become wider
definitions.zh: vi. 扩大, 详述, 膨胀
vt. 使膨胀

examples.en: The pupils dilate in the dark.
examples.zh: 瞳孔在黑暗中会扩大。

examples.en: The doctor dilated the patient's eyes.
examples.zh: 医生扩大了病人的瞳孔。

definitions.en: s beyond normal limits
definitions.zh: a. 过度的, 紊乱的, 过分的

examples.en: He spent an inordinate amount of time.
examples.zh: 他花了过多的时间。

examples.en: Her inordinate pride caused problems.
examples.zh: 她过度的骄傲导致了问题。

definitions.en: s. showing little or no emotion or animation
definitions.zh: a. 缺乏感情的, 无动于衷的, 缺乏兴趣的

definitions.en: s. marked by a lack of interest; it is simply indifferent"
definitions.zh: [医] 无情[感]的, 淡漠的

examples.en: The students were apathetic about the lecture.
examples.zh: 学生们对讲座无动于衷。

examples.en: She felt apathetic and didn't want to do anything.
examples.zh: 她感到缺乏兴趣，什么都不想做。

definitions.en: s. unlikely to bring about favorable results or enjoyment
definitions.zh: a. 没有希望的, 没有前途的, 结果未必良好的

examples.en: The start of the project was unpromising.
examples.zh: 项目的开始没有希望。

examples.en: He had an unpromising career as a musician.
examples.zh: 他作为音乐家的前途并不看好。

definitions.en: n. a foreboding about what is about to happen
definitions.zh: n. 预感, 预兆, 预知
vt. 预示, 预言
vi. 预感, 预言

examples.en: The dark clouds presage a storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着一场风暴。

examples.en: His silence presaged bad news.
examples.zh: 他的沉默预示了坏消息。

definitions.en: v overcome
definitions.zh: a. 傲慢的, 骄傲自大的, 蛮横的, 压倒一切的

definitions.en: v bear too much
definitions.zh: [法] 自大的, 专制的, 压倒的

examples.en: Her overbearing boss made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 她傲慢的老板让所有人都不舒服。

examples.en: He has an overbearing attitude towards his team.
examples.zh: 他对团队有一种蛮横的态度。

definitions.en: s elaborately or excessively ornamented
definitions.zh: a. 华丽的, 红润的

definitions.en: s inclined to a healthy reddish color often associated with outdoor life
definitions.zh: [医] 鲜红的

examples.en: She wore a florid dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件华丽的裙子去派对。

examples.en: His florid cheeks showed he was healthy.
examples.zh: 他红润的脸颊显示他很健康。

definitions.en: a. full of events or incidents
definitions.zh: a. 变故多的, 多事的, 重要的

examples.en: It was an eventful day full of surprises.
examples.zh: 这是多事的一天，充满了惊喜。

examples.en: Her eventful life inspired many stories.
examples.zh: 她多事的一生启发了很多故事。

definitions.en: s. lacking bodily or muscular strength or vitality
definitions.zh: a. 衰老的

examples.en: The old house looked decrepit and unsafe.
examples.zh: 老房子看起来衰老且不安全。

examples.en: A decrepit man walked slowly down the street.
examples.zh: 一个衰老的男人慢慢走在街上。

definitions.en: s. engaged in war
definitions.zh: a. 好战的, 交战的, 交战国的
[法] 交战一方, 交战国, 交战集团

examples.en: The belligerent nations finally signed a treaty.
examples.zh: 交战的国家最终签署了条约。

examples.en: He had a belligerent attitude during the debate.
examples.zh: 他在辩论中表现出好战的态度。

definitions.en: a. auguring favorable circumstances and good luck
definitions.zh: a. 吉兆的, 幸运的

examples.en: The sunny day was an auspicious start.
examples.zh: 晴天是一个吉兆的开始。

examples.en: They chose an auspicious date for the wedding.
examples.zh: 他们为婚礼选了一个幸运的日子。

definitions.en: v cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
definitions.zh: vt. 平息, 缓和, 减轻

examples.en: A kind word can assuage her fears.
examples.zh: 一句好话可以平息她的恐惧。

examples.en: He drank water to assuage his thirst.
examples.zh: 他喝水来减轻口渴。

definitions.en: s. densely populated
definitions.zh: a. 人口多的, 人口稠密的

examples.en: Tokyo is a very populous city.
examples.zh: 东京是一个人口稠密的城市。

examples.en: Populous areas often have traffic problems.
examples.zh: 人口稠密的地区常有交通问题。

definitions.en: n. the act of persisting or persevering; continuing or repeating behavior
definitions.zh: n. 毅力, 忍耐, 锲而不舍, 不屈不挠

examples.en: Her perseverance helped her learn English well.
examples.zh: 她的毅力帮助她学好英语。

examples.en: Perseverance is key to achieving your goals.
examples.zh: 锲而不舍是实现目标的关键。

definitions.en: s. being on the point of death; breathing your last
definitions.zh: a. 垂死的
n. 垂死的人

examples.en: The moribund patient received final care.
examples.zh: 垂死的病人接受了临终关怀。

examples.en: The industry is now moribund and failing.
examples.zh: 这个行业现在垂死且衰败。

definitions.en: s full of or showing high-spirited merriment
definitions.zh: a. 快活的, 高兴的, 愉快的
[计] 国际算法语言的朱尔斯文本

examples.en: He is a jovial man who loves jokes.
examples.zh: 他是一个快活的人，喜欢开玩笑。

examples.en: Her jovial laugh filled the room.
examples.zh: 她愉快的笑声充满了房间。

definitions.en: n. a word formed from the initial letters of the several words in the name
definitions.zh: n. 首字母缩拼词, 首字母组合词
[计] 字首组合词

examples.en: NASA is an acronym for National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
examples.zh: NASA是国家航空航天局的首字母缩拼词。

examples.en: LOL is a common acronym in texting.
examples.zh: LOL是短信中常见的首字母组合词。

definitions.en: s expressing extreme contempt
definitions.zh: a. 轻蔑的

examples.en: She gave a scornful laugh at his idea.
examples.zh: 她对她的想法轻蔑地笑了笑。

examples.en: His scornful remarks hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 他轻蔑的评论伤了她的感情。

definitions.en: s moving quickly and lightly
definitions.zh: a. 敏捷的, 伶俐的, 聪明的

examples.en: The nimble cat jumped over the fence.
examples.zh: 敏捷的猫跳过了篱笆。

examples.en: She has a nimble mind for solving puzzles.
examples.zh: 她有一个聪明的头脑来解决谜题。

definitions.en: s. (of persons) so unrefined as to be lacking in discrimination and sensibility
definitions.zh: a. 粗俗的, 愚钝的, 粗糙的, 非常的

examples.en: His crass remarks offended everyone.
examples.zh: 他粗俗的言论冒犯了所有人。

examples.en: That was a crass display of ignorance.
examples.zh: 那是愚钝的无知表现。

definitions.en: v. expose to the circulation of fresh air so as to retard spoilage
definitions.zh: vt. 使空气流通, 使通风, 公开讨论, 公开

definitions.en: v. circulate through and freshen
definitions.zh: [医] 通风, 换气

examples.en: Open the windows to ventilate the room.
examples.zh: 打开窗户让房间通风。

examples.en: They ventilate the issue in the meeting.
examples.zh: 他们在会议上公开讨论这个问题。

definitions.en: n. hair resembling thatched roofing material
definitions.zh: n. 盖屋顶的茅草, 用草盖的屋顶, 浓密头发

definitions.en: n. plant stalks used as roofing material
definitions.zh: vt. 用茅草覆盖

examples.en: The cottage had a thick thatch roof.
examples.zh: 小屋有一个厚厚的茅草屋顶。

examples.en: They thatch the roof with straw every year.
examples.zh: 他们每年用稻草覆盖屋顶。

definitions.en: n. meat of edible aquatic invertebrate with a shell (especially a mollusk or crustacean)
definitions.zh: n. 贝, 甲壳类水生物
[医] 牡蛎

examples.en: She is allergic to shellfish like shrimp.
examples.zh: 她对虾等贝类过敏。

examples.en: We had fresh shellfish for dinner last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚晚餐吃了新鲜的贝类。

definitions.en: n. a substance that destroys micro-organisms that carry disease without harming body tissues
definitions.zh: n. 抗菌剂, 防腐剂

definitions.en: a. thoroughly clean and free of or destructive to disease-causing organisms
definitions.zh: a. 抗菌的, 防腐的

examples.en: She cleaned the wound with antiseptic.
examples.zh: 她用抗菌剂清洁了伤口。

examples.en: The hospital room smelled antiseptic and clean.
examples.zh: 医院房间闻起来有防腐剂的味道且干净。

definitions.en: s. requiring sitting or little activity
definitions.zh: a. 久坐的, 坐惯的, 定栖的
[医] 静坐的; 坐式的

examples.en: A sedentary lifestyle can harm your health.
examples.zh: 久坐的生活方式会损害健康。

examples.en: He has a sedentary job at a desk.
examples.zh: 他有一份坐在办公桌前的久坐工作。

definitions.en: s. (usually followed by `with') well informed about or knowing thoroughly
definitions.zh: a. 熟悉的, 亲近的, 有交情的

examples.en: He is conversant with French literature.
examples.zh: 他熟悉法国文学。

examples.en: She is conversant in several programming languages.
examples.zh: 她熟悉几种编程语言。

definitions.en: a. possessing the ability to repel
definitions.zh: a. 排斥的, 可恶的, 击退的

examples.en: The smell was repulsive and made her sick.
examples.zh: 那气味令人厌恶，让她恶心。

examples.en: He found the idea of eating insects repulsive.
examples.zh: 他觉得吃昆虫的想法很可恶。

definitions.en: v. put forward, as of an idea
definitions.zh: vt. 提出供考虑
[法] 提出建议, 提出供考虑, 提出

examples.en: The teacher propounded a difficult question.
examples.zh: 老师提出了一个难题。

examples.en: He propounded a new theory about the universe.
examples.zh: 他提出了一个关于宇宙的新理论。

definitions.en: v. injure or wound seriously and leave permanent disfiguration or mutilation
definitions.zh: vt. 使残废, 使不能工作, 使伤残
[医] 伤残, 残废

examples.en: The accident could maim him for life.
examples.zh: 事故可能使他终身残废。

examples.en: The explosion maimed several soldiers.
examples.zh: 爆炸使几名士兵伤残。

definitions.en: a. open to two or more interpretations; or of uncertain nature or significance; or (often) intended to mislead
definitions.zh: a. 意义不明确的, 模棱两可的

definitions.en: s. open to question
definitions.zh: [医] 双关的, 两可的

examples.en: His answer was equivocal.
examples.zh: 他的回答模棱两可。

examples.en: She gave an equivocal response.
examples.zh: 她给出了一个含糊的回应。

definitions.en: n a state of deep-seated ill-will
definitions.zh: n. 敌意, 憎恨

examples.en: There is a long history of enmity between them.
examples.zh: 他们之间有长期的敌意。

examples.en: His words were full of enmity.
examples.zh: 他的话充满了憎恨。

definitions.en: v censure severely or angrily
definitions.zh: vt. 严责

examples.en: The teacher berated the student for being late.
examples.zh: 老师因迟到而严责学生。

examples.en: She berated herself for the mistake.
examples.zh: 她因错误而严责自己。

definitions.en: s characterized by intense emotion
definitions.zh: a. 充满激情的, 狂热的, 热烈的

examples.en: She gave an impassioned speech about justice.
examples.zh: 她就正义发表了充满激情的演讲。

examples.en: His impassioned plea moved everyone.
examples.zh: 他狂热的恳求感动了所有人。

definitions.en: s. politely warm and friendly
definitions.zh: n. 兴奋剂, 补品

definitions.en: s. sincerely or intensely felt
definitions.zh: a. 热忱的, 诚恳的, 有兴奋作用的

examples.en: She gave us a cordial welcome.
examples.zh: 她热情地欢迎了我们。

examples.en: Their cordial relationship is admirable.
examples.zh: 他们热忱的关系令人钦佩。

definitions.en: n. clothing of a distinctive style or for a particular occasion
definitions.zh: n. 服装, 盛装
vt. 使穿衣, 打扮

examples.en: She wore formal attire to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿着正式服装去参加派对。

examples.en: The king was attired in royal robes.
examples.zh: 国王穿着皇家盛装。

definitions.en: s marked by active interest and enthusiasm
definitions.zh: a. 热衷的, 热诚的, 热心的, 热情的

examples.en: He is a zealous supporter of the team.
examples.zh: 他是球队的热心支持者。

examples.en: She is zealous about learning English.
examples.zh: 她热衷于学习英语。

definitions.en: s. unpleasantly loud and harsh
definitions.zh: a. 沙哑的, 粗声的, 喧闹的

examples.en: The raucous crowd cheered loudly.
examples.zh: 喧闹的人群大声欢呼。

examples.en: His raucous laugh filled the room.
examples.zh: 他沙哑的笑声充满了房间。

definitions.en: v. catch fire
definitions.zh: vt. 点燃, 使着火, 引起, 照亮

definitions.en: v. cause to start burning
definitions.zh: vi. 着火, 激动, 发亮

examples.en: She used a match to kindle the fire.
examples.zh: 她用火柴点燃了火。

examples.en: The story kindled his interest in history.
examples.zh: 这个故事引起了他对历史的兴趣。

definitions.en: a. not eligible
definitions.zh: a. 无被选任资格的, 不适任的, 无益的

definitions.en: s. prohibited by official rules
definitions.zh: n. 无被选任资格的人, 不合录用资格的人

examples.en: He is ineligible for the scholarship.
examples.zh: 他没有资格获得奖学金。

examples.en: She was ineligible to vote in the election.
examples.zh: 她没有资格在选举中投票。

definitions.en: v. separate (substances) into constituent elements or parts
definitions.zh: v. 分解, (使)腐烂

examples.en: Leaves decompose and enrich the soil.
examples.zh: 叶子腐烂并肥沃土壤。

examples.en: Scientists decompose the compound into elements.
examples.zh: 科学家将化合物分解成元素。

definitions.en: v. become tight or as if tight
definitions.zh: vt. 压缩, 束紧, 使收缩
vi. 收缩

examples.en: The snake will constrict its prey.
examples.zh: 蛇会收缩勒紧它的猎物。

examples.en: Tight clothes can constrict your movement.
examples.zh: 紧身衣服会束缚你的行动。

definitions.en: n. elaboration of an interpretation by the use of decorative (sometimes fictitious) detail
definitions.zh: n. 装饰, 润色, 修饰

examples.en: The story had too much embellishment to be true.
examples.zh: 这个故事修饰太多，不真实。

examples.en: She added a few embellishments to her dress.
examples.zh: 她在裙子上加了一些装饰。

definitions.en: n. a representation of a person (especially in the form of sculpture)
definitions.zh: n. 肖像, 雕像

examples.en: They burned an effigy of the dictator.
examples.zh: 他们烧了独裁者的肖像。

examples.en: The museum displayed a stone effigy.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了一座石雕像。

definitions.en: v. create by shaping stone or wood or any other hard material
definitions.zh: v. 雕刻, 造型

examples.en: He loves to sculpt figures from clay.
examples.zh: 他喜欢用黏土雕刻人物。

examples.en: The artist will sculpt a statue of the hero.
examples.zh: 艺术家将雕刻英雄的雕像。

definitions.en: n. an exercise device consisting of an endless belt on which a person can walk or jog without changing place
definitions.zh: n. 踏车, 令人厌倦的工作

definitions.en: n. a mill that is powered by men or animals walking on a circular belt or climbing steps
definitions.zh: [法] 踏车

examples.en: She runs on the treadmill every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上在跑步机上跑步。

examples.en: His job feels like a boring treadmill.
examples.zh: 他的工作感觉像一台无聊的踏车。

definitions.en: a capable of being avoided or warded off
definitions.zh: a. 可避免的
[法] 可作为无效的, 可回避的, 可避免的

examples.en: This mistake was completely avoidable.
examples.zh: 这个错误完全可以避免。

examples.en: Many accidents are avoidable with care.
examples.zh: 许多事故通过小心是可以避免的。

definitions.en: a good at remembering
definitions.zh: a. 紧握的, 固执的, 不屈不挠的, 黏着力强的

definitions.en: s stubbornly unyielding
definitions.zh: [医] 坚韧的

examples.en: She is a tenacious defender of her beliefs.
examples.zh: 她是自己信念的固执捍卫者。

examples.en: The dog had a tenacious grip on the bone.
examples.zh: 狗紧握着骨头不放。

definitions.en: r. in a methodical manner
definitions.zh: adv. 有系统地, 有方法地

examples.en: He methodically organized his desk drawers.
examples.zh: 他有条不紊地整理了他的抽屉。

examples.en: She methodically checked each answer twice.
examples.zh: 她有条不紊地检查了每个答案两次。

definitions.en: v. mar or spoil the appearance of
definitions.zh: vt. 损伤外观
[法] 毁伤外貌, 破坏外观, 涂污

examples.en: Vandals defaced the monument with paint.
examples.zh: 破坏者用油漆损伤了纪念碑的外观。

examples.en: Do not deface library books.
examples.zh: 不要涂污图书馆的书籍。

definitions.en: v. cause to spread or flush or flood through, over, or across
definitions.zh: vt. 遍布, 弥漫, 充满

examples.en: A warm glow suffused her face.
examples.zh: 温暖的光辉遍布她的脸庞。

examples.en: The room was suffused with soft light.
examples.zh: 房间弥漫着柔和的光线。

definitions.en: s completely neat and clean
definitions.zh: a. 无脏污的, 无缺点的, 无可挑剔的

examples.en: Her kitchen is always spotless and clean.
examples.zh: 她的厨房总是干净无瑕。

examples.en: He keeps his car spotless inside and out.
examples.zh: 他把车内外保持得一尘不染。

definitions.en: v. smell badly and offensively
definitions.zh: n. 烟, 水蒸气, 臭气散发

definitions.en: v. be wet with sweat or blood, as of one's face
definitions.zh: vi. 冒烟, 发臭气, 散发

definitions.en: v. give off smoke, fumes, warm vapour, steam, etc.
definitions.zh: vt. 用烟熏, 散发

examples.en: The room reeked of smoke.
examples.zh: 房间散发着烟臭气。

examples.en: His clothes reek of sweat after exercise.
examples.zh: 运动后他的衣服散发着汗臭。

definitions.en: a. deficient in alertness or activity
definitions.zh: a. 昏睡的, 无生气的, 泠漠的, 冷淡的
[医] 昏睡的, 嗜眠的

examples.en: He felt lethargic after a long day.
examples.zh: 漫长的一天后他感到昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: The hot weather made everyone lethargic.
examples.zh: 炎热的天气让每个人都无精打采。

definitions.en: s. impossible to repress or control
definitions.zh: a. 约束不住的, 抑制不住的

examples.en: Her irrepressible laughter filled the room.
examples.zh: 她抑制不住的笑声充满了房间。

examples.en: The child's irrepressible energy amazed us.
examples.zh: 那孩子抑制不住的精力让我们惊讶。

definitions.en: v make unable to perform a certain action
definitions.zh: vt. 使无能力, 使无行为能力

definitions.en: v injure permanently
definitions.zh: [法] 使无资格, 使无能力, 剥夺资格

examples.en: The injury could incapacitate him for weeks.
examples.zh: 这次受伤可能使他几周无法行动。

examples.en: A bad cold can incapacitate a person.
examples.zh: 重感冒能让人失去能力。

definitions.en: a. showing or experiencing dissatisfaction or restless longing
definitions.zh: a. 不满意的

examples.en: The workers are discontented with their pay.
examples.zh: 工人们对工资不满。

examples.en: She felt discontented with her current job.
examples.zh: 她对目前的工作感到不满。

definitions.en: n. an elaborate poetic image or a far-fetched comparison of very dissimilar things
definitions.zh: n. 自负, 空想, 狂妄

examples.en: His conceit makes him hard to work with.
examples.zh: 他的自负使他难以共事。

examples.en: She is full of conceit about her looks.
examples.zh: 她对自己的外貌充满自负。

definitions.en: n. a split or indentation in something (as the palate or chin)
definitions.zh: n. 裂缝, 裂口

definitions.en: s. having one or more incisions reaching nearly to the midrib
definitions.zh: a. 劈开的
cleave的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The rock had a deep cleft in it.
examples.zh: 岩石上有一道深深的裂缝。

examples.en: He was born with a cleft chin.
examples.zh: 他天生有一个裂开的下巴。

definitions.en: s. invulnerable to fear or intimidation
definitions.zh: a. 大胆的, 鲁莽的, 胆大妄为的

examples.en: The audacious plan surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 这个大胆的计划让所有人惊讶。

examples.en: She made an audacious move in the game.
examples.zh: 她在游戏中做了一个鲁莽的举动。

definitions.en: a. inclined or willing to submit to orders or wishes of others or showing such inclination
definitions.zh: a. 服从的, 顺从的

examples.en: The dog was submissive to its owner.
examples.zh: 那只狗对主人很顺从。

examples.en: She had a submissive attitude in class.
examples.zh: 她在课堂上态度顺从。

definitions.en: n short underpants for women or children (usually used in the plural)
definitions.zh: a. 缺乏的, 仅有的, 不够的, 狭小的, 吝啬的

examples.en: The meal was scanty and left him hungry.
examples.zh: 那顿饭量很少，让他还饿着。

examples.en: She wore a scanty dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件暴露的裙子去派对。

definitions.en: v. satisfy (thirst)
definitions.zh: vt. 熄灭, 结束, 使冷却, 将...淬火

definitions.en: v. electronics: suppress (sparking) when the current is cut off in an inductive circuit, or suppress (an oscillation or discharge) in a component or device
definitions.zh: vi. 熄灭, 平息

examples.en: Water can quench your thirst quickly.
examples.zh: 水能迅速解渴。

examples.en: They tried to quench the fire with sand.
examples.zh: 他们试图用沙子灭火。

definitions.en: s. impelled by physical force especially against resistance
definitions.zh: a. 强制的, 强迫的, 有气力的
[法] 强制的, 强迫的, 有势力的

examples.en: The police used forcible entry to open the door.
examples.zh: 警察强行破门而入。

examples.en: Forcible removal of the crowd was necessary.
examples.zh: 强行驱散人群是必要的。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or resembling fish
definitions.zh: a. 鱼似的, 多鱼的, 腥臭的, 呆滞的

examples.en: The story sounds fishy to me.
examples.zh: 这个故事听起来可疑。

examples.en: There is a fishy smell in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里有股鱼腥味。

definitions.en: n. a person who delivers a speech or oration
definitions.zh: n. 演说者, 演讲者, 雄辩家, 原告, 请愿人
[法] 请愿人, 原告, 雄辩者

examples.en: The orator moved the audience with his speech.
examples.zh: 演说家用他的演讲打动了观众。

examples.en: She is a skilled orator at debates.
examples.zh: 她在辩论中是一位技巧娴熟的演说家。

definitions.en: n. a stairway whose steps move continuously on a circulating belt
definitions.zh: n. 电动扶梯, 自动扶梯
[机] 升降阶梯

examples.en: Take the escalator to the second floor.
examples.zh: 乘自动扶梯到二楼。

examples.en: The escalator is not working today.
examples.zh: 今天自动扶梯坏了。

definitions.en: s. not yet fully developed
definitions.zh: a. 开发不充分的, 不发达的, 发育不全的

examples.en: The region remains underdeveloped economically.
examples.zh: 该地区经济上仍然不发达。

examples.en: His muscles are underdeveloped from lack of exercise.
examples.zh: 他的肌肉因缺乏锻炼而发育不全。

definitions.en: n the immediate descendants of a person
definitions.zh: n. 子孙, 后裔, 成果
[医] 后代, 后裔

examples.en: The farmer cared for his cattle's progeny.
examples.zh: 农夫照顾他的牛的后代。

examples.en: Her progeny all became successful doctors.
examples.zh: 她的后代都成了成功的医生。

definitions.en: n. the act of lodging
definitions.zh: n. 寄宿处, 寄宿
[法] 提起, 住所

examples.en: We found cheap lodging near the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站附近找到了便宜的寄宿处。

examples.en: The hotel provides lodging for the night.
examples.zh: 酒店提供过夜住宿。

definitions.en: n. cultivated land that is not seeded for one or more growing seasons
definitions.zh: n. 休耕地

definitions.en: s. left unplowed and unseeded during a growing season
definitions.zh: a. 休耕的, 淡棕色的

examples.en: The field lay fallow for a season.
examples.zh: 那块地休耕了一个季节。

examples.en: Farmers let the land rest as fallow.
examples.zh: 农民让土地休耕以休息。

definitions.en: a. not subjected to tapping
definitions.zh: a. 塞子未开的, 未利用的

examples.en: The region has untapped natural resources.
examples.zh: 该地区有未开发的自然资源。

examples.en: Her potential remains untapped in this job.
examples.zh: 她的潜力在这份工作中尚未被利用。

definitions.en: s. outfitted or supplied with clothing
definitions.zh: a. 适合的

examples.en: This job is well suited for her skills.
examples.zh: 这份工作非常适合她的技能。

examples.en: He is suited to be a teacher.
examples.zh: 他适合当老师。

definitions.en: s. having great mass and weight and unwieldiness
definitions.zh: a. 沉重的, 笨重的, 毫无趣味的, 生硬的

examples.en: The ponderous elephant moved slowly.
examples.zh: 笨重的大象缓慢地移动。

examples.en: His ponderous speech bored the audience.
examples.zh: 他沉闷的演讲让观众感到无聊。

definitions.en: v be a mystery or bewildering to
definitions.zh: a. 令人费解的, 令人困惑的

examples.en: The puzzle was perplexing to everyone.
examples.zh: 这个谜题让所有人都困惑。

examples.en: Her behavior is perplexing and hard to understand.
examples.zh: 她的行为令人费解，难以理解。

definitions.en: a. made or produced in the home or by yourself
definitions.zh: a. 自制的, 国产的

examples.en: She brought homemade cookies to the party.
examples.zh: 她带了自制的饼干去派对。

examples.en: Homemade bread tastes better than store-bought.
examples.zh: 自制的面包比买来的好吃。

definitions.en: n. strength of mind that enables one to endure adversity with courage
definitions.zh: n. 刚毅, 坚毅, 不屈不挠

examples.en: She faced the challenge with great fortitude.
examples.zh: 她以极大的毅力面对挑战。

examples.en: His fortitude during the crisis inspired us.
examples.zh: 他在危机中的坚毅激励了我们。

definitions.en: n. hard monotonous routine work
definitions.zh: n. 苦差事, 苦工

examples.en: He hated the drudgery of housework.
examples.zh: 他讨厌家务的苦差事。

examples.en: Daily drudgery made her feel tired.
examples.zh: 每天的苦工让她感到疲惫。

definitions.en: v. draw a line around
definitions.zh: vt. 在...周围画线, 限制

examples.en: The rules circumscribe our actions.
examples.zh: 规则限制了我们的行动。

examples.en: Please circumscribe the area with a line.
examples.zh: 请用线在区域周围画线。

definitions.en: v be in contradiction with
definitions.zh: vt. 掩饰, 与...不符, 使失望

examples.en: Her smile belies her true sadness.
examples.zh: 她的微笑掩饰了真实的悲伤。

examples.en: His actions belie his kind words.
examples.zh: 他的行为与他的好话不符。

definitions.en: a. not subject to restraint
definitions.zh: a. 未克制的, 无限制的, 放纵的
[法] 无拘束的, 无限制的:自由的, 过度的

examples.en: His unrestrained laughter filled the room.
examples.zh: 他无拘无束的笑声充满了房间。

examples.en: Unrestrained spending led to debt.
examples.zh: 无节制的消费导致了债务。

definitions.en: n. a step to one side (as in boxing or dancing)
definitions.zh: n. 横跨的一步, 台阶
vt. 横跨一步躲避, 回避
vi. 回避问题, 躲避打击

examples.en: He tried to sidestep the question.
examples.zh: 他试图回避这个问题。

examples.en: She took a quick sidestep to avoid him.
examples.zh: 她快速横跨一步躲开他。

definitions.en: s extremely harmful; bringing physical or financial ruin
definitions.zh: a. 破坏性的, 招致毁灭的

examples.en: The flood caused ruinous damage.
examples.zh: 洪水造成了毁灭性的破坏。

examples.en: His spending habits were ruinous.
examples.zh: 他的消费习惯是毁灭性的。

definitions.en: s easily influenced
definitions.zh: a. 有延展性的, 可锻的

definitions.en: s capable of being shaped or bent or drawn out
definitions.zh: [医] 可展的, 易适应的

examples.en: Gold is a very malleable metal.
examples.zh: 金是一种非常有延展性的金属。

examples.en: Young minds are malleable and easy to teach.
examples.zh: 年轻的思想是可塑的，容易教导。

definitions.en: s. marked by erratic changeableness in affections or attachments
definitions.zh: a. 变幻无常的, 浮燥的, 薄情的

examples.en: The weather is fickle in spring.
examples.zh: 春天的天气变幻无常。

examples.en: She is fickle and changes her mind often.
examples.zh: 她浮燥，经常改变主意。

definitions.en: v. hold spellbound
definitions.zh: vt. 施魔法, 使入迷

examples.en: The music will enchant the audience.
examples.zh: 音乐会使观众入迷。

examples.en: She enchanted everyone with her beautiful voice.
examples.zh: 她用美妙的声音迷住了所有人。

definitions.en: s. diffusing warmth and friendliness
definitions.zh: a. 和蔼可亲的, 友善的, 亲切的, 慈祥的

examples.en: The teacher is very affable and kind.
examples.zh: 这位老师非常和蔼可亲。

examples.en: He has an affable smile for everyone.
examples.zh: 他对每个人都有友善的微笑。

definitions.en: n. a blue to grey green mineral consisting of copper aluminum phosphate
definitions.zh: n. 绿松石, 绿松石色

examples.en: She wore a beautiful turquoise necklace.
examples.zh: 她戴了一条美丽的绿松石项链。

examples.en: The sea was a bright turquoise color.
examples.zh: 大海是明亮的绿松石色。

definitions.en: n. a state of comatose torpor (as found in sleeping sickness)
definitions.zh: n. 昏睡, 瞌睡, 无力气
[医] 昏睡, 嗜眠

examples.en: The heat caused a feeling of lethargy.
examples.zh: 炎热引起了一种昏睡感。

examples.en: He suffered from lethargy after the illness.
examples.zh: 他病后感到无力气。

definitions.en: r. in an identifiably distinctive manner
definitions.zh: adv. 区别地, 特殊地

examples.en: She dresses distinctively with bright colors.
examples.zh: 她穿着鲜艳的颜色，与众不同。

examples.en: His voice is distinctively deep and loud.
examples.zh: 他的声音特别低沉响亮。

definitions.en: v. separate the limbs from the body
definitions.zh: vt. 割断手足, 支解, 分割

examples.en: The killer tried to dismember the body.
examples.zh: 凶手试图肢解尸体。

examples.en: The company plans to dismember the division.
examples.zh: 公司计划拆分这个部门。

definitions.en: s. morally reprehensible
definitions.zh: a. 可鄙的, 卑劣的

examples.en: His behavior was truly despicable.
examples.zh: 他的行为确实可鄙。

examples.en: She found the lie despicable and wrong.
examples.zh: 她觉得这个谎言卑劣且错误。

definitions.en: n. (law) a formal objection to an opponent's pleadings
definitions.zh: vi. 提出异议, 反对, 抗辩

definitions.en: v. take exception to
definitions.zh: n. 异议, 反对

examples.en: She did not demur when asked to help.
examples.zh: 当被要求帮忙时，她没有提出异议。

examples.en: The lawyer filed a demur to the claim.
examples.zh: 律师对索赔提出了异议。

definitions.en: v. eject or send out in large quantities, also metaphorical
definitions.zh: vi. 呕吐, 喷涌
vt. 呕出, 喷
n. 呕吐物, 喷涌物

examples.en: The volcano began to spew hot lava.
examples.zh: 火山开始喷出炽热的熔岩。

examples.en: He felt sick and started to spew.
examples.zh: 他感到恶心，开始呕吐。

definitions.en: a. showing or giving mercy
definitions.zh: a. 仁慈的, 慈悲的

examples.en: The judge was merciful to the young offender.
examples.zh: 法官对年轻罪犯很仁慈。

examples.en: She is a merciful person who forgives easily.
examples.zh: 她是个仁慈的人，容易原谅别人。

definitions.en: n. a domestic servant
definitions.zh: a. 适合仆人做的, 卑微的
n. 仆人

examples.zh: 持异议的法官写了单独意见。

examples.zh: 医生对尸体进行了尸检。

definitions.en: s lasting a very short time

examples.zh: 花朵的美丽是暂时的。

definitions.en: n clothing of a distinctive style or for a particular occasion
