definitions.en: v. upset and make nauseated
definitions.zh: vi. 生病, 作呕

examples.en: The smell made him sicken.
examples.zh: 那气味让他恶心。

examples.en: Violence sickens most people.
examples.zh: 暴力让大多数人感到厌恶。

definitions.en: v. talk in a noisy, excited, or declamatory manner
definitions.zh: v. 咆哮, 痛骂
n. 咆哮, 大话

examples.en: He began to rant about the unfair rules.
examples.zh: 他开始咆哮着说不公平的规则。

examples.en: His rant lasted for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 他的咆哮持续了十分钟。

definitions.en: n. a trite or obvious remark
definitions.zh: n. 单调, 平凡, 陈腐, 陈词滥调

examples.en: His speech was full of platitudes.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了陈词滥调。

examples.en: She ignored his platitude and asked a real question.
examples.zh: 她忽略了他的陈词滥调，问了一个真正的问题。

definitions.en: a. permitting the unwanted passage of fluids or gases
definitions.zh: a. 有漏洞的, 易泄漏秘密的, 爱哭的

definitions.en: s. used informally; unable to retain urine
definitions.zh: [电] 漏的

examples.en: The roof is leaky after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨后屋顶漏水了。

examples.en: A leaky pipe caused water damage.
examples.zh: 漏水的管道造成了水损。

definitions.en: a. showing lack of due respect or veneration
definitions.zh: a. 不敬的, 不逊的, 无礼的

examples.en: His irreverent jokes offended some people.
examples.zh: 他不敬的玩笑冒犯了一些人。

examples.en: She has an irreverent attitude toward authority.
examples.zh: 她对权威有一种不敬的态度。

definitions.en: v. assume or act the character of
definitions.zh: vt. 模仿, 扮演, 体现, 使人格化

definitions.en: v. represent another person with comic intentions
definitions.zh: [法] 体现, 模仿, 拟人

examples.en: He tried to impersonate a police officer.
examples.zh: 他试图模仿警察。

examples.en: She can impersonate many famous singers.
examples.zh: 她能模仿许多著名歌手。

definitions.en: n. the quality of being so overabundant that prices fall
definitions.zh: n. 大量, 供过于求
vt. 使充满, 使吃饱, 过多供应
vi. 吃得过多, 狼吞虎咽

examples.en: The market has a glut of cheap goods.
examples.zh: 市场上充斥着廉价商品。

examples.en: They glutted themselves with food at the party.
examples.zh: 他们在派对上大吃大喝。

definitions.en: s. sufficiently fat so as to have a pleasing fullness of figure;
definitions.zh: a. 圆胖的

examples.en: The baby has chubby cheeks and a smile.
examples.zh: 婴儿有胖乎乎的脸蛋和笑容。

examples.en: He was a chubby little boy.
examples.zh: 他是个胖乎乎的小男孩。

definitions.en: s. not wise in the ways of the world
definitions.zh: a. 不懂世故的, 单纯的, 不精细的, 纯洁的

examples.en: She is unsophisticated but very kind.
examples.zh: 她单纯但非常善良。

examples.en: His taste in music is unsophisticated.
examples.zh: 他对音乐的品味很单纯。

definitions.en: v. make a travesty of
definitions.zh: n. 拙劣的模仿作品, 嘲弄, 滑稽模仿
vt. 滑稽地模仿, 歪曲

examples.en: The trial was a travesty of justice.
examples.zh: 这场审判是对正义的嘲弄。

examples.en: His performance was a travesty of the original play.
examples.zh: 他的表演是对原剧的拙劣模仿。

definitions.en: s quick to take offense
definitions.zh: a. 易怒的, 难以取悦的, 过于敏感的

examples.en: He is very touchy about his height.
examples.zh: 他对自己的身高非常敏感。

examples.en: Don't ask her about her job; she's touchy today.
examples.zh: 别问她工作的事，她今天易怒。

definitions.en: n an instance of driving away or warding off
definitions.zh: n. 击退, 拒绝

definitions.en: v force or drive back
definitions.zh: vt. 厌恶, 击退, 拒绝

examples.en: The army repulsed the enemy attack.
examples.zh: 军队击退了敌人的进攻。

examples.en: She repulsed his advances politely.
examples.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了他的追求。

definitions.en: n. an optical illusion in which atmospheric refraction by a layer of hot air distorts or inverts reflections of distant objects
definitions.zh: n. 海市蜃楼, 幻景, 妄想

examples.en: The desert mirage looked like a lake.
examples.zh: 沙漠中的海市蜃楼看起来像湖。

examples.en: His dream of wealth was just a mirage.
examples.zh: 他的财富梦想只是幻景。

definitions.en: r. in minute detail
definitions.zh: adv. 详细地, 精密地

examples.en: She explained the plan minutely.
examples.zh: 她详细地解释了计划。

examples.en: The report was minutely examined.
examples.zh: 这份报告被精密地检查了。

definitions.en: a. given to examining own sensory and perceptual experiences
definitions.zh: a. 内省的
[医] 内省的

examples.en: She became more introspective after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后她变得更加内省。

examples.en: His introspective nature makes him a good writer.
examples.zh: 他内省的性格使他成为好作家。

definitions.en: v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
definitions.zh: vt. 下狱, 监禁, 禁闭
[法] 监禁, 使下狱, 禁闭

examples.en: The court decided to incarcerate the criminal.
examples.zh: 法院决定监禁这名罪犯。

examples.en: He was incarcerated for five years.
examples.zh: 他被监禁了五年。

definitions.en: r in a polite manner
definitions.zh: adv. 亲切地；有礼貌地

examples.en: He spoke courteously to everyone.
examples.zh: 他亲切地对每个人说话。

examples.en: The waiter served us courteously.
examples.zh: 服务员有礼貌地为我们服务。

definitions.en: n. a lump of material formed from the content of a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 凝块, 一团

definitions.en: v. change from a liquid to a thickened or solid state
definitions.zh: v. (使)凝结, (使)聚集

examples.en: A blood clot can be dangerous.
examples.zh: 血凝块可能很危险。

examples.en: The milk started to clot in the heat.
examples.zh: 牛奶在高温下开始凝结。

definitions.en: v. become pale and sickly
definitions.zh: a. 苍白的, 无血色的, 病态的, 暗淡的

definitions.en: s. lacking vitality as from weariness or illness or unhappiness
definitions.zh: v. (使)变苍白
[计] 广域网

examples.en: She looked wan after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病后她看起来苍白。

examples.en: His wan smile showed his exhaustion.
examples.zh: 他苍白的微笑显示出疲惫。

definitions.en: s. without bias
definitions.zh: a. 没有偏见的
[法] 无偏见的, 大公无私的, 公平的

examples.en: A judge must be unbiased.
examples.zh: 法官必须没有偏见。

examples.en: She gave an unbiased opinion.
examples.zh: 她给出了公平的意见。

definitions.en: v. make solid or more solid; cause to solidify
definitions.zh: v. (使)凝固, (使)团结, 巩固

examples.en: Water will solidify into ice when frozen.
examples.zh: 水冻结时会凝固成冰。

examples.en: The plan began to solidify after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议后计划开始巩固。

definitions.en: v. renounce a legal claim or title to
definitions.zh: v. 放弃, 弃权, 拒绝承认

examples.en: He disclaimed any knowledge of the crime.
examples.zh: 他否认对犯罪知情。

examples.en: The company disclaimed responsibility for the accident.
examples.zh: 公司拒绝承认对事故负责。

definitions.en: v. teach and impress by frequent repetitions or admonitions
definitions.zh: vt. 反复灌输, 谆谆教诲

examples.en: Parents inculcate good manners in their children.
examples.zh: 父母向孩子反复灌输良好的礼仪。

examples.en: Teachers inculcate a love of learning in students.
examples.zh: 老师向学生谆谆教诲对学习的热爱。

definitions.en: n. an encircling or ringlike structure
definitions.zh: n. 腰带, 围绕物

definitions.en: n. a band of material around the waist that strengthens a skirt or trousers
definitions.zh: vt. 用腰带束缚, 围绕

examples.en: She wore a leather girdle around her waist.
examples.zh: 她腰间系着一条皮带。

examples.en: The mountains girdle the small valley.
examples.zh: 群山环绕着这个小山谷。

definitions.en: n. a very tall building with many stories
definitions.zh: n. 摩天楼, 三角形天帆

examples.en: The skyscraper touches the clouds.
examples.zh: 摩天大楼触及云端。

examples.en: We saw a tall skyscraper in the city.
examples.zh: 我们在城里看到一座高摩天楼。

definitions.en: s marked by casual disrespect
definitions.zh: n. 侮慢无礼的人

definitions.en: s unrestrained by convention or propriety
definitions.zh: a. 粗野的, 无礼的, 侮慢的

examples.en: The insolent boy talked back to his teacher.
examples.zh: 那个无礼的男孩顶撞老师。

examples.en: Her insolent remarks made everyone angry.
examples.zh: 她侮慢的言论激怒了所有人。

definitions.en: n. the surface soil that must be moved away to get at coal seams and mineral deposits
definitions.zh: vt. 装载过多, 负担过多, 使过劳

definitions.en: v. burden with too much work or responsibility
definitions.zh: [经] 过重的货物, 重担, 过度的负担

examples.en: Don't overburden yourself with work.
examples.zh: 不要让自己负担过多工作。

examples.en: The system is overburdened by requests.
examples.zh: 系统被请求过度负担。

definitions.en: s. lacking zest or vivacity
definitions.zh: a. 倦怠的, 无精打采的
[经] 交易清淡的

examples.en: He felt listless and didn't want to do anything.
examples.zh: 他感到无精打采，什么都不想做。

examples.en: The hot weather made everyone listless.
examples.zh: 炎热的天气让每个人都倦怠无力。

definitions.en: a. lacking respectability in character or behavior or appearance
definitions.zh: a. 名誉不好的, 不光彩的, 声名狼藉的

examples.en: That man has a disreputable past.
examples.zh: 那个人有名誉不好的过去。

examples.en: They avoided the disreputable area.
examples.zh: 他们避开了那个声名狼藉的地区。

definitions.en: s. heedful of potential consequences
definitions.zh: a. 细心的, 慎重的

examples.en: Be circumspect when making decisions.
examples.zh: 做决定时要慎重。

examples.en: She is a circumspect investor.
examples.zh: 她是一个细心的投资者。

definitions.en: v lie adjacent to another or share a boundary
definitions.zh: v. 邻接, 毗邻

examples.en: Our garden abuts the neighbor's property.
examples.zh: 我们的花园毗邻邻居的房产。

examples.en: The new building abuts the old library.
examples.zh: 新建筑紧挨着旧图书馆。

definitions.en: n. a state of commotion and noise and confusion
definitions.zh: n. 骚动, 吵闹, 混乱

definitions.en: n. violent agitation
definitions.zh: [法] 骚乱, 骚动, 暴乱

examples.en: The crowd caused a great tumult in the square.
examples.zh: 人群在广场上引起了巨大的骚动。

examples.en: There was tumult in the streets after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛后街上混乱不堪。

definitions.en: a. impossible to reconcile
definitions.zh: a. 不能和解的, 不能协调的, 矛盾的

examples.en: Their differences were irreconcilable.
examples.zh: 他们的分歧是不可调和的。

examples.en: The two theories are irreconcilable with each other.
examples.zh: 这两种理论相互矛盾。

definitions.en: s. emitting light as a result of being heated
definitions.zh: a. 白热的, 闪闪发光的, 辉耀的, 灿烂的

definitions.en: s. characterized by ardent emotion or intensity or brilliance
definitions.zh: [医] 白炽的, 白热的

examples.en: The incandescent bulb gives bright light.
examples.zh: 白炽灯泡发出明亮的光。

examples.en: Her incandescent smile lit up the room.
examples.zh: 她灿烂的笑容照亮了房间。

definitions.en: n. imitating the mannerisms of another person
definitions.zh: n. 扮演, 装扮, 模仿
[计] 模仿

examples.en: His impersonation of the actor was funny.
examples.zh: 他对那个演员的模仿很有趣。

examples.en: Impersonation of a police officer is illegal.
examples.zh: 扮演警察是违法的。

definitions.en: s rounded like an egg
definitions.zh: a. 椭圆的

definitions.en: s characterized by extreme economy of expression or omission of superfluous elements
definitions.zh: [医] 椭圆形的

examples.en: The planet has an elliptical orbit.
examples.zh: 这颗行星有椭圆轨道。

examples.en: His elliptical speech was hard to follow.
examples.zh: 他简略的讲话难以理解。

definitions.en: s. intended to deceive
definitions.zh: a. 欺诈的

examples.en: He gave a deceitful answer.
examples.zh: 他给出了欺诈的回答。

examples.en: Her deceitful behavior hurt many people.
examples.zh: 她欺诈的行为伤害了很多人。

definitions.en: s. occupied with or fond of the pleasures of good company
definitions.zh: a. 酒宴的, 欢宴的, 欢乐的

examples.en: The party had a convivial atmosphere.
examples.zh: 聚会气氛欢快友好。

examples.en: He is a convivial person who loves company.
examples.zh: 他是个喜欢社交的欢乐之人。

definitions.en: n. partial or total loss of memory
definitions.zh: n. 健忘症, 记忆缺失
[医] 记忆缺失, 遗忘[症]

examples.en: He suffered from amnesia after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后他患上了健忘症。

examples.en: The patient's amnesia was temporary.
examples.zh: 病人的记忆缺失是暂时的。

definitions.en: s joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success
definitions.zh: a. 欢呼的, 喜洋洋的

examples.en: The crowd was jubilant after the victory.
examples.zh: 胜利后人群欢呼雀跃。

examples.en: She felt jubilant about her promotion.
examples.zh: 她对自己的晋升感到喜洋洋。

definitions.en: n. excessive intolerance of opposing views
definitions.zh: n. 狂热, 入迷

examples.en: Fanaticism can lead to violence.
examples.zh: 狂热可能导致暴力。

examples.en: His fanaticism for sports is extreme.
examples.zh: 他对体育的狂热是极端的。

definitions.en: s. extremely pleasing to the sense of taste
definitions.zh: a. 令人快乐的, 美味的, 使人愉快的

examples.en: The cake was absolutely delectable.
examples.zh: 这块蛋糕非常美味。

examples.en: We enjoyed a delectable meal together.
examples.zh: 我们一起享用了令人愉快的一餐。

definitions.en: s strong and sharp
definitions.zh: a. 苦味的, 辛辣的, 讥讽的, 刻薄的

definitions.en: s harsh or corrosive in tone
definitions.zh: [医] 辛辣的

examples.en: The acrid smoke made everyone cough.
examples.zh: 辛辣的烟雾让每个人都咳嗽。

examples.en: His acrid remarks hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 他刻薄的言论伤害了她的感情。

definitions.en: s. lighted by sunlight
definitions.zh: a. 阳光照射的

examples.en: The room was bright and sunlit.
examples.zh: 房间明亮且阳光照射。

examples.en: We walked in a sunlit field.
examples.zh: 我们在阳光照射的田野里散步。

definitions.en: n. any plant of the genus Helianthus having large flower heads with dark disk florets and showy yellow rays
definitions.zh: n. 向日葵

examples.en: The sunflower turns toward the sun.
examples.zh: 向日葵朝向太阳。

examples.en: She planted a sunflower in the garden.
examples.zh: 她在花园里种了一棵向日葵。

definitions.en: n. the status of being acknowledged as a star
definitions.zh: n. 明星身分, 明星们

examples.en: She achieved stardom at a young age.
examples.zh: 她在年轻时获得了明星身份。

examples.en: Many dream of stardom in Hollywood.
examples.zh: 许多人梦想在好莱坞成为明星。

definitions.en: a. not liable to or capable of change
definitions.zh: n. 不变的东西, 常数
a. 不变的, 常数的

examples.en: His routine is invariable every day.
examples.zh: 他的日常每天都是不变的。

examples.en: The laws of physics are invariable.
examples.zh: 物理定律是不变的。

definitions.en: s. (of hair) having waves
definitions.zh: a. 有波浪的, 多浪的, 波浪状的, 波动的, 不稳定的

examples.en: She has beautiful wavy hair.
examples.zh: 她有美丽的波浪状头发。

examples.en: The sea was wavy this morning.
examples.zh: 今早海面有波浪。

definitions.en: s having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy
definitions.zh: a. 傲慢的, 骄傲的, 崇高的

examples.en: The haughty queen ignored the poor.
examples.zh: 傲慢的女王无视穷人。

examples.en: Her haughty attitude made her unpopular.
examples.zh: 她骄傲的态度让她不受欢迎。

definitions.en: n. a mechanical device that blows a strong current of air; used to make a fire burn more fiercely or to sound a musical instrument
definitions.zh: n. 风箱
[化] 手风箱; 皮老虎; 波纹管

examples.en: He used bellows to start the fire.
examples.zh: 他用风箱生火。

examples.en: The blacksmith's bellows are old.
examples.zh: 铁匠的风箱很旧了。

definitions.en: v. measure the depth of something
definitions.zh: n. 铅锤, 垂直

definitions.en: v. weight with lead
definitions.zh: a. 垂直的

definitions.en: v. examine thoroughly and in great depth
definitions.zh: vt. 使垂直, 探测

examples.en: The wall is not plumb; it leans slightly.
examples.zh: 这面墙不垂直，有点倾斜。

examples.en: He used a plumb to check the depth.
examples.zh: 他用铅锤测量深度。

definitions.en: n. the process of purifying a liquid by boiling it and condensing its vapors
definitions.zh: n. 蒸馏
[化] 蒸馏; 蒸馏法

examples.en: Distillation purifies water effectively.
examples.zh: 蒸馏能有效净化水。

examples.en: They learned about distillation in class.
examples.zh: 他们在课堂上学习了蒸馏法。

definitions.en: s lacking refinement or cultivation or taste
definitions.zh: a. 笨拙的, 粗野的, 荒凉的

examples.en: His uncouth manners embarrassed everyone.
examples.zh: 他粗野的举止让每个人都尴尬。

examples.en: She found his behavior uncouth and rude.
examples.zh: 她觉得他的行为笨拙且粗鲁。

definitions.en: s (of unknown regions) not yet surveyed or investigated
definitions.zh: a. 图上未标明的, 未知的
[法] 无人探险过的, 未知的, 海图上未载明的

examples.en: They explored uncharted territory.
examples.zh: 他们探索了未知的领域。

examples.en: The map shows uncharted islands.
examples.zh: 地图上显示了图上未标明的岛屿。

definitions.en: v spread negative information about
definitions.zh: v. 辱骂, 斥责

examples.en: They began to revile the politician loudly.
examples.zh: 他们开始大声辱骂那位政客。

examples.en: Do not revile others in anger.
examples.zh: 不要在愤怒中斥责他人。

definitions.en: v. drop sharply
definitions.zh: n. 测深锤, 铅坠
vi. 垂直落下

examples.en: The stock prices plummeted overnight.
examples.zh: 股票价格一夜之间暴跌。

examples.en: Temperatures plummeted below freezing last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚气温骤降至冰点以下。

definitions.en: n. the founder of a family
definitions.zh: n. 祖先

examples.en: Our forefathers built this city.
examples.zh: 我们的祖先建造了这座城市。

examples.en: He honored his forefather's traditions.
examples.zh: 他尊重祖先的传统。

definitions.en: v. kill en masse; kill on a large scale; kill many
definitions.zh: vt. 扑灭, 消灭, 根绝

examples.en: They plan to exterminate the pests.
examples.zh: 他们计划消灭害虫。

examples.en: The disease could exterminate the entire population.
examples.zh: 这种疾病可能根绝整个种群。

definitions.en: n the exterior covering of a bird's egg
definitions.zh: n. 蛋壳

examples.en: The eggshell broke easily.
examples.zh: 蛋壳很容易破碎。

examples.en: She painted the eggshell carefully.
examples.zh: 她小心地画蛋壳。

definitions.en: s. seemingly boundless in amount, number, degree, or especially extent
definitions.zh: a. 无限的, 无边无际的
[经] 无限的

examples.en: The ocean seems boundless.
examples.zh: 海洋看起来无边无际。

examples.en: Her energy is boundless.
examples.zh: 她的精力是无限的。

definitions.en: s. bewildering or striking dumb with wonder
definitions.zh: a. 令人惊骇的

examples.en: The view from the top was astounding.
examples.zh: 顶部的景色令人惊骇。

examples.en: He made an astounding discovery.
examples.zh: 他做出了令人惊骇的发现。

definitions.en: n the quality of lacking taste and refinement
definitions.zh: n. 粗俗, 粗鄙, 粗话
[法] 粗鄙, 粗野行为

examples.en: His vulgarity offended everyone.
examples.zh: 他的粗俗冒犯了所有人。

examples.en: She dislikes vulgarity in conversation.
examples.zh: 她不喜欢谈话中的粗鄙。

definitions.en: v extend out or project in space
definitions.zh: v. （使某物）伸出, （使某物）突出( protrude的现在分词 ); 凸

examples.en: A nail is protruding from the board.
examples.zh: 一颗钉子从木板中突出。

examples.en: He has a protruding belly.
examples.zh: 他有一个突出的肚子。

definitions.en: n. food that will decay rapidly if not refrigerated
definitions.zh: a. 易腐坏的, 会枯萎的, 易毁灭的, 不经久的

definitions.en: a. liable to perish; subject to destruction or death or decay
definitions.zh: n. 易腐坏的东西

examples.en: Milk is a perishable food item.
examples.zh: 牛奶是易腐坏的食品。

examples.en: Store perishable goods in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 将易腐坏的食物存放在冰箱里。

definitions.en: n. ancient Celtic god
definitions.zh: v. 拖, 拉

definitions.en: n. a projecting piece that is used to lift or support or turn something
definitions.zh: n. 一拖, 一拉, 耳朵, 耳状物, 装腔作势, 勒索

examples.en: He had to lug the heavy suitcase upstairs.
examples.zh: 他不得不把沉重的行李箱拖上楼。

examples.en: The lug on the machine broke off.
examples.zh: 机器上的耳状物断裂了。

definitions.en: s out of condition; not strong or robust; incapable of exertion or endurance
definitions.zh: a. 软弱的, 没气力的, 不稳的, 松弛的

examples.en: He has flabby muscles from lack of exercise.
examples.zh: 他因缺乏锻炼而肌肉松弛。

examples.en: Her flabby argument was easily defeated.
examples.zh: 她软弱的论点轻易被驳倒了。

definitions.en: n. a subordinate who performs an important but routine function
definitions.zh: n. 嵌齿, 小船

definitions.en: n. tooth on the rim of gear wheel
definitions.zh: vt. 给...装配齿轮, 欺骗

examples.en: The cog in the machine broke.
examples.zh: 机器里的嵌齿坏了。

examples.en: He is just a cog in the system.
examples.zh: 他只是系统中的一个嵌齿。

definitions.en: s. informal or slang terms for mentally irregular
definitions.zh: a. 芳香的, 温和的, 止痛的

definitions.en: s. mild and pleasant
definitions.zh: [化] 香脂气味的

examples.en: The balmy breeze felt pleasant on the skin.
examples.zh: 温和的微风拂过皮肤感觉很舒适。

examples.en: We enjoyed a balmy evening by the sea.
examples.zh: 我们在海边享受了一个温和的夜晚。

definitions.en: s moderately warm
definitions.zh: a. 微温的, 温热的, 不太热烈的

definitions.en: s feeling or showing little interest or enthusiasm
definitions.zh: [医] 微温的

examples.en: The water in the pool was tepid.
examples.zh: 游泳池里的水是微温的。

examples.en: His tepid response showed little interest.
examples.zh: 他不太热烈的回应显示出没什么兴趣。

definitions.en: s annoyed and irritable
definitions.zh: a. 性情乖戾的, 脾气暴躁的, 生气的

examples.en: The old man was grumpy because he didn't sleep well.
examples.zh: 老人脾气暴躁，因为他没睡好。

examples.en: She felt grumpy after waiting for an hour.
examples.zh: 等了一个小时后，她感到生气。

definitions.en: n. malicious satisfaction
definitions.zh: vi. 满足地看, 幸灾乐祸, 贪婪地盯视

definitions.en: v. dwell on with satisfaction
definitions.zh: n. 贪婪的盯视, 满足的注视, 幸灾乐祸

examples.en: He couldn't help but gloat over his victory.
examples.zh: 他忍不住对自己的胜利幸灾乐祸。

examples.en: She gave a gloat when she saw his mistake.
examples.zh: 看到他犯错时，她露出了满足的注视。

definitions.en: n. dryness resulting from the removal of water
definitions.zh: n. 脱水

definitions.en: n. depletion of bodily fluids
definitions.zh: [化] 脱水; 脱水作用

examples.en: Drink water to avoid dehydration.
examples.zh: 喝水以避免脱水。

examples.en: Dehydration can cause headaches and fatigue.
examples.zh: 脱水会导致头痛和疲劳。

definitions.en: n. words falsely spoken that damage the reputation of another
definitions.zh: n. 中伤, 诽谤
vt. 中伤, 诽谤

examples.en: Spreading slander about others is wrong.
examples.zh: 散布关于他人的诽谤是错误的。

examples.en: He tried to slander his rival's name.
examples.zh: 他试图中伤对手的名声。

definitions.en: n. a chemical compound that is added to protect against decay or decomposition
definitions.zh: a. 有助于保存的, 有保存力的

definitions.en: s. tending or having the power to preserve
definitions.zh: n. 预防药, 防腐剂

examples.en: This food contains no artificial preservatives.
examples.zh: 这种食物不含人工防腐剂。

examples.en: Salt acts as a preservative for meat.
examples.zh: 盐作为肉的防腐剂。

definitions.en: n. propriety in manners and conduct
definitions.zh: n. 端正, 礼貌, 合宜, 礼仪

examples.en: He behaved with great decorum at the formal dinner.
examples.zh: 他在正式晚宴上表现得很有礼貌。

examples.en: The students maintained decorum during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 学生们在仪式上保持了礼仪。

definitions.en: v. cause to deteriorate due to the action of water, air, or an acid
definitions.zh: vt. 使腐蚀, 侵蚀, 破坏

definitions.en: v. become destroyed by water, air, or a corrosive such as an acid
definitions.zh: vi. 被侵蚀, 起腐蚀作用

examples.en: Salt water can corrode metal quickly.
examples.zh: 盐水能迅速腐蚀金属。

examples.en: The old pipe began to corrode over time.
examples.zh: 旧管道随时间开始被侵蚀。

definitions.en: n. an unusually gifted or intelligent (young) person; someone whose talents excite wonder and admiration
definitions.zh: n. 惊人的事物, 奇迹, 不凡的人, 奇才, 神童, 预兆

examples.en: The young pianist was a prodigy at age five.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在五岁时就是个神童。

examples.en: She is a prodigy in mathematics and science.
examples.zh: 她在数学和科学方面是个奇才。

definitions.en: n. a substance capable of bringing about fermentation
definitions.zh: n. 酵素, 发酵, 动乱

definitions.en: v. be in an agitated or excited state
definitions.zh: v. (使)发酵, (使)动乱

examples.en: The grapes ferment to make wine in the cellar.
examples.zh: 葡萄在地窖里发酵制成酒。

examples.en: Political ferment spread quickly through the country.
examples.zh: 政治动乱迅速在全国蔓延。

definitions.en: s. marked by abrupt transitions
definitions.zh: a. 猛地一动一停的, 突变的

definitions.en: s. rough with small waves
definitions.zh: [经] 震荡的

examples.en: The sea was choppy today.
examples.zh: 今天海面波涛汹涌。

examples.en: His speech was choppy and unclear.
examples.zh: 他的演讲不连贯且不清楚。

definitions.en: s. refined or imposing in manner or appearance; befitting a royal court
definitions.zh: a. 谦恭的, 礼让的, 有教养的

examples.en: He had a courtly manner.
examples.zh: 他有谦恭的举止。

examples.en: The knight was courtly and polite.
examples.zh: 骑士谦恭且有礼。

definitions.en: n. someone who proclaims a message publicly
definitions.zh: n. 节目报告员, 宣告者

examples.en: The announcer read the news clearly.
examples.zh: 播音员清晰地读了新闻。

examples.en: The announcer introduced the next singer.
examples.zh: 报幕员介绍了下一位歌手。

definitions.en: n. the soft brown fur of the beaver
definitions.zh: n. 海狸(毛皮)

definitions.en: n. a full beard
definitions.zh: [机] 轻型及中型飞机加油

examples.en: The beaver built a dam.
examples.zh: 海狸筑了一个水坝。

examples.en: He wore a hat made of beaver.
examples.zh: 他戴了一顶海狸毛皮做的帽子。

definitions.en: n an intricate trap that entangles or ensnares its victim
definitions.zh: n. 纠缠, 卷入, 缠绕物
[化] 缠结

examples.en: The rope caused an entanglement.
examples.zh: 绳子导致了缠绕。

examples.en: He avoided emotional entanglement.
examples.zh: 他避免了情感纠缠。

definitions.en: a. acting or arriving or performed exactly at the time appointed
definitions.zh: a. 准时的, 守时的, 点状的, 中肯的
[经] 准时的, 不误期的, 准时

examples.en: She is always punctual for class.
examples.zh: 她上课总是准时。

examples.en: The train arrived punctual at nine.
examples.zh: 火车准时在九点到达。

definitions.en: v live longer than
definitions.zh: vt. 比...长久, 从...中逃生

examples.en: This material will outlast the others.
examples.zh: 这种材料会比其他的更持久。

examples.en: She hopes to outlast her illness.
examples.zh: 她希望从疾病中逃生。

definitions.en: v command against
definitions.zh: vt. 剥夺...的公民权, 使失去法律保护, 把...充军, 把...放逐, 排斥, 禁止

examples.en: The law proscribes the use of certain chemicals.
examples.zh: 法律禁止使用某些化学品。

examples.en: The school proscribes bullying in any form.
examples.zh: 学校禁止任何形式的欺凌。

definitions.en: n. loud confused noise from many sources
definitions.zh: n. 吵闹声, 叫嚷声, 混乱

examples.en: The hubbub in the market was overwhelming.
examples.zh: 市场里的吵闹声让人受不了。

examples.en: I couldn't hear him over the hubbub.
examples.zh: 在吵闹声中我听不见他说话。

definitions.en: n. an act of mass destruction and loss of life (especially in war or by fire)
definitions.zh: n. 大屠杀, 大火灾, 毁灭, 大规模烧杀

examples.en: The holocaust caused immense suffering.
examples.zh: 大屠杀造成了巨大的痛苦。

examples.en: They remember the holocaust every year.
examples.zh: 他们每年都纪念大屠杀。

definitions.en: n. an instance of boastful talk
definitions.zh: n. 吹牛
v. 吹牛

examples.en: He likes to brag about his car.
examples.zh: 他喜欢吹嘘他的车。

examples.en: Don't brag about your achievements.
examples.zh: 不要吹嘘你的成就。

definitions.en: v. cause to conform to standard or norm
definitions.zh: vt. 使标准化, 使合于标准, 用标准检验

definitions.en: v. evaluate by comparing with a standard
definitions.zh: [计] 标准化; 规格化

examples.en: We need to standardize the testing process.
examples.zh: 我们需要标准化测试流程。

examples.en: The company will standardize all products.
examples.zh: 公司将使所有产品标准化。

definitions.en: n. a creation created or assembled by needle and thread
definitions.zh: n. 刺绣, 缝纫

examples.en: She enjoys doing needlework in her free time.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在空闲时间做针线活。

examples.en: The needlework on this dress is beautiful.
examples.zh: 这件裙子上的刺绣很漂亮。

definitions.en: s. showing sustained enthusiastic action with unflagging vitality
definitions.zh: a. 不知疲倦的, 有耐性的, 不屈不挠的

examples.en: She is an indefatigable worker.
examples.zh: 她是一个不知疲倦的工作者。

examples.en: His indefatigable spirit inspired everyone.
examples.zh: 他不知疲倦的精神激励了每个人。

definitions.en: r. in an erratic unpredictable manner
definitions.zh: adv. 不规律地, 不定地

examples.en: The car moved erratically on the road.
examples.zh: 汽车在路上不规律地行驶。

examples.en: He behaves erratically when stressed.
examples.zh: 他压力大时行为不定。

definitions.en: a. affected or marked by low spirits
definitions.zh: a. 沮丧的, 灰心的

examples.en: He looked dejected after losing the game.
examples.zh: 输掉比赛后，他看起来很沮丧。

examples.en: She felt dejected by the bad news.
examples.zh: 她因坏消息而感到沮丧。

definitions.en: v. organize into a code or system, such as a body of law
definitions.zh: vt. 编成法典
[法] 使成文法化, 编成法典, 编纂

examples.en: They want to codify the new rules.
examples.zh: 他们想把新规则编成法典。

examples.en: The lawyer helped codify the company's policies.
examples.zh: 律师帮助编纂了公司的政策。

definitions.en: v speak to someone
definitions.zh: vt. 招呼, 搭讪, 勾引

definitions.en: v approach with an offer of sexual favors
definitions.zh: [法] 勾引, 引诱

examples.zh: 一个陌生人在街上跟她搭讪。

examples.en: He was accosted by a beggar for money.
examples.zh: 一个乞丐上前向他讨钱。

definitions.en: v. pierce with a sharp stake or point
definitions.zh: vt. 刺穿, 使呆住, 使固定

examples.zh: 长矛刺穿了目标。

examples.en: The news transfixed the audience.
examples.zh: 新闻使观众呆住了。

definitions.en: v. conduct business
definitions.zh: vt. 办理, 处理
vi. 作交易, 谈判

examples.en: They transact business online.
examples.zh: 他们在网上办理业务。

examples.en: We need to transact this deal quickly.
examples.zh: 我们需要尽快处理这笔交易。

definitions.en: a. impossible to repair, rectify, or amend
definitions.zh: a. 不能修补的, 不能挽回的
[法] 不可弥补的, 不可挽回的

examples.en: The damage was irreparable.
examples.zh: 损害是不能修补的。

examples.en: His mistake caused irreparable harm.
examples.zh: 他的错误造成了不能挽回的伤害。

definitions.en: v give expression to
definitions.zh: vt. 表明(感情等), 表示出(特性等)

examples.en: He evinced great interest in the project.
examples.zh: 他对这个项目表现出极大的兴趣。

examples.en: She evinced no surprise at the news.
examples.zh: 她对这消息没有表现出惊讶。

definitions.en: n the state of being degenerate in mental or moral qualities
definitions.zh: n. 颓废

examples.zh: 这座城市的颓废让许多人担忧。

examples.en: They criticized the decadence of modern society.
examples.zh: 他们批评现代社会的颓废。

definitions.en: n. a man-made object taken as a whole
definitions.zh: n. 人工制品

examples.zh: 这件人工制品来自古埃及。

examples.en: The museum displays many historical artifacts.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了许多历史文物。

definitions.en: n. division of a group into opposing factions
definitions.zh: n. 分裂, 分立, 分裂教会罪

definitions.en: n. the formal separation of a church into two churches or the withdrawal of one group over doctrinal differences
definitions.zh: [法] 分裂, 分裂宗教罪, 宗派

examples.en: The schism divided the political party.
examples.zh: 分裂使政党分成了两派。

examples.en: A schism occurred in the religious group.
examples.zh: 这个宗教团体内部发生了分裂。

definitions.en: v. make an inversion (in a musical composition)

definitions.en: v. reverse the position, order, relation, or condition of
definitions.zh: vt. 使反转, 使颠倒, 使转化

examples.zh: 倒转玻璃杯以排水。

examples.en: You can invert the order of the list.
examples.zh: 你可以颠倒列表的顺序。

definitions.en: v. kill by piercing with a spear or sharp pole
definitions.zh: vt. 刺穿, 使绝望, 钉住

examples.zh: 昆虫被钉在别针上。

examples.en: He impaled the piece of meat on a fork.
examples.zh: 他用叉子叉起那块肉。

definitions.en: n. a usually brief state of excitement and mental confusion often accompanied by hallucinations
definitions.zh: n. 精神错乱, 说谵语状态, 狂热

examples.zh: 病人出现了谵妄状态。

examples.en: In his delirium, he spoke nonsense.
examples.zh: 在精神错乱中，他说着胡话。

definitions.en: n. a reference work (often in several volumes) containing articles on various topics (often arranged in alphabetical order) dealing with the entire range of human knowledge or with some particular specialty

examples.zh: 我在百科全书里读了一篇文章。

examples.en: The encyclopedia has many interesting facts.
examples.zh: 这本百科全书有很多有趣的知识。

definitions.en: n. the metabolic processes whereby certain organisms obtain energy from organic molecules; processes that take place in the cells and tissues during which energy is released and carbon dioxide is produced and absorbed by the blood to be transported to the lungs
definitions.zh: n. 呼吸, 一口气, 呼吸作用

definitions.en: n. a single complete act of breathing in and out
definitions.zh: [化] 呼吸

examples.en: Respiration is essential for life.
examples.zh: 呼吸对生命至关重要。

examples.en: He checked the patient's respiration rate.
examples.zh: 他检查了病人的呼吸频率。

definitions.en: n. the process of cooling or freezing (e.g., food) for preservative purposes
definitions.zh: n. 冷却, 冷藏, 冷冻

definitions.en: n. deliberately lowering the body's temperature for therapeutic purposes
definitions.zh: [计] 致冷

examples.zh: 冷藏保持食物新鲜。

examples.en: The milk needs refrigeration.
examples.zh: 牛奶需要冷藏。

definitions.en: n. the state of being weak in health or body (especially from old age)
definitions.zh: n. 虚弱, 病身, 疾病

examples.en: Old age often brings infirmity.
examples.zh: 老年常带来虚弱。

examples.en: He suffered from a chronic infirmity.
examples.zh: 他患有慢性疾病。

definitions.en: a. relating to or included in a category or categories
definitions.zh: a. 范畴的, 绝对的, 明确的

examples.zh: 她明确拒绝了那个提议。

examples.en: The data is categorical, not numerical.
examples.zh: 这些数据是范畴性的，不是数值型的。

definitions.en: v support oneself
definitions.zh: vt. 供给食物, 供养
vi. 生存, 存在

examples.en: They subsist on rice and vegetables.
examples.zh: 他们靠米饭和蔬菜维持生存。

examples.en: Many animals subsist in the wild.
examples.zh: 许多动物在野外生存。

definitions.en: s extremely poisonous or injurious; producing venom

definitions.en: s marked by deep ill will; deliberately harmful
definitions.zh: [医] 毒的, 有毒的

examples.en: The snake is venomous.
examples.zh: 这条蛇有毒。

examples.en: She gave a venomous look.
examples.zh: 她投以恶毒的目光。

definitions.en: n. a container that is used to put or keep things in
definitions.zh: n. 容器, 花托, 插座

definitions.en: n. enlarged tip of a stem that bears the floral parts
definitions.zh: [医] 容器, [接]受器, 花托

examples.en: Put the trash in the receptacle.
examples.zh: 把垃圾放进容器里。

examples.en: The flower's receptacle holds the petals.
examples.zh: 花的花托支撑着花瓣。

definitions.en: s. impossible to subdue
definitions.zh: a. 不屈服的, 不屈不挠的

examples.en: She has an indomitable spirit.
examples.zh: 她有不屈不挠的精神。

examples.en: His indomitable will helped him succeed.
examples.zh: 他不屈服的意志帮助他成功。

definitions.en: n. the quality of not moving
definitions.zh: n. 不动性, 不动, 固定
[医] 不动[性]

examples.zh: 事故导致了他的不动性。

examples.en: She sat in complete immobility.
examples.zh: 她完全不动地坐着。

definitions.en: s. offensive to the mind

examples.zh: 暴力对大多数人来说是令人憎恨的。

examples.en: She found the idea abhorrent.
examples.zh: 她觉得这个想法很可恶。

definitions.en: v. shorten
definitions.zh: vt. 缩写, 使...简略, 缩短

examples.en: Please abbreviate the word 'Mister'.
examples.zh: 请缩写'Mister'这个词。

examples.en: We can abbreviate the meeting time.
examples.zh: 我们可以缩短会议时间。

definitions.en: s excessively forward
definitions.zh: a. 放肆的, 冒昧的, 傲慢的

examples.en: It was presumptuous of him to ask.
examples.zh: 他这样问是冒昧的。

examples.en: Her presumptuous attitude annoyed me.
examples.zh: 她放肆的态度惹恼了我。

definitions.en: n. a small ax with a short handle used with one hand (usually to chop wood)
definitions.zh: n. 斧头, 手斧, 战斧
[机] 小斧, 手斧

examples.en: He used a hatchet to chop wood.
examples.zh: 他用一把小斧头劈柴。

examples.en: The hatchet was sharp and small.
examples.zh: 这把小斧头又锋利又小巧。

definitions.en: s avoiding waste
definitions.zh: a. 节俭的, 朴素的

examples.en: She leads a frugal life to save money.
examples.zh: 她过着节俭的生活以省钱。

examples.en: Being frugal helps them avoid debt.
examples.zh: 节俭帮助他们避免债务。

definitions.en: s. having or showing profound knowledge
definitions.zh: a. 博学的
n. 博学者

examples.en: The erudite professor gave a lecture.
examples.zh: 那位博学的教授做了一场讲座。

examples.en: She is an erudite scholar of history.
examples.zh: 她是一位博学的历史学者。

definitions.en: n. soreness and warmth caused by friction
definitions.zh: n. 擦伤, 气恼

definitions.en: v. become or make sore by or as if by rubbing
definitions.zh: v. 摩擦, 擦痛, 激怒

examples.en: The tight shoes chafe my feet.
examples.zh: 紧鞋子擦痛了我的脚。

examples.en: He felt a chafe on his skin.
examples.zh: 他感到皮肤上一阵擦伤。

definitions.en: a. disregarding your own advantages and welfare over those of others
definitions.zh: a. 不自私的, 无我的, 不谋私利的

examples.en: She is an unselfish person.
examples.zh: 她是一个不自私的人。

examples.en: His unselfish act helped many people.
examples.zh: 他不谋私利的行为帮助了很多人。

definitions.en: n. a set of three literary or dramatic works related in subject or theme
definitions.zh: n. 三部剧, 三部曲
[医] 三联, 三联症

examples.en: I just finished reading the trilogy.
examples.zh: 我刚读完这部三部曲。

examples.en: The movie trilogy was very popular.
examples.zh: 这部电影三部曲非常受欢迎。

definitions.en: n. a message that departs from the main subject
definitions.zh: n. 离题, 扯到枝节上, 偏离

examples.en: His speech had a long digression.
examples.zh: 他的演讲有一个很长的离题部分。

examples.en: Avoid digression in your essay.
examples.zh: 在你的文章中避免离题。

definitions.en: v. encourage or assent to illegally or criminally
definitions.zh: vi. 默许, 共谋, 纵容
[法] 默许, 纵容, 共谋

examples.en: They connive to cheat in the exam.
examples.zh: 他们共谋在考试中作弊。

examples.en: The guard connived at the escape.
examples.zh: 守卫默许了逃跑。

definitions.en: a. not differentiated
definitions.zh: a. 无差别的, 一致的, 尚未显出差别的

examples.en: The cells were still undifferentiated in the lab.
examples.zh: 这些细胞在实验室里尚未分化。

examples.en: He saw the crowd as an undifferentiated mass.
examples.zh: 他把人群看作无差别的整体。

definitions.en: n a sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory
definitions.zh: n. 概要, 摘要, 大意
[化] 一览表; 提要

examples.en: Read the synopsis of the book first.
examples.zh: 先读一下这本书的概要。

examples.en: She wrote a synopsis of the movie.
examples.zh: 她写了这部电影的摘要。

definitions.en: n forced submission to control by others
definitions.zh: n. 征服, 服从, 隶属

definitions.en: n the act of conquering
definitions.zh: [法] 隶属, 服从, 屈从

examples.en: The nation lived under subjection for years.
examples.zh: 这个国家多年处于被征服状态。

examples.en: They fought against subjection to foreign rule.
examples.zh: 他们反抗对外国统治的屈从。

definitions.en: n. a wrecked ship (or a part of one)
definitions.zh: n. 遇难船, 海难

definitions.en: n. an irretrievable loss
definitions.zh: vt. 遇海难, 毁灭, 使失事

examples.en: The shipwreck was found on the ocean floor.
examples.zh: 沉船在海床上被发现。

examples.en: A storm caused the shipwreck last night.
examples.zh: 一场风暴导致了昨晚的海难。

definitions.en: a. (of handwriting, print, etc.) not legible
definitions.zh: a. 难辨认的, 字迹模糊的

examples.en: His handwriting is completely illegible.
examples.zh: 他的笔迹完全难以辨认。

examples.en: The note was illegible due to water damage.
examples.zh: 便条因水渍而字迹模糊。

definitions.en: v. overturn accidentally
definitions.zh: v. 翻覆, 倾覆

examples.en: The boat began to capsize in the storm.
examples.zh: 船在风暴中开始倾覆。

examples.en: Strong winds can capsize small ships.
examples.zh: 强风能使小船翻覆。

definitions.en: n a span of 1000 years
definitions.zh: 一千年, 千年周年纪念日, 千年庆典, 千年期, (喻)太平盛世, 想象中的黄金时代

examples.en: This tradition has lasted for millennia.
examples.zh: 这个传统持续了数千年。

examples.en: The desert has been dry for millennia.
examples.zh: 这片沙漠已经干旱了数千年。

definitions.en: n. a form of sexual desire in which gratification depends to an abnormal degree on some object or item of clothing or part of the body
definitions.zh: n. 物神, 偶像, 迷信

definitions.en: n. excessive or irrational devotion to some activity
definitions.zh: [医] 恋物对象

examples.en: He has a fetish for old coins.
examples.zh: 他对旧硬币有一种迷恋。

examples.en: Her fetish for cleanliness is extreme.
examples.zh: 她对清洁的迷恋到了极端。

definitions.en: v. store grain
definitions.zh: n. 谷仓, 积蓄
vt. 储存, 贮藏

examples.en: She garnered support from the community.
examples.zh: 她获得了社区的支持。

examples.en: The farmer garnered the wheat in the barn.
examples.zh: 农夫把小麦储藏在谷仓里。

definitions.en: v. obtain through intimidation
definitions.zh: vt. 勒索, 敲诈, 强要

definitions.en: v. obtain by coercion or intimidation
definitions.zh: [医] 外旋

examples.en: They tried to extort money from him.
examples.zh: 他们试图向他勒索钱财。

examples.en: The criminal extorted a confession by force.
examples.zh: 罪犯用武力强要了一份供词。

definitions.en: v. make moist
definitions.zh: vt. 弄湿
vi. 变潮湿

examples.en: Please moisten the cloth before cleaning.
examples.zh: 请先弄湿布再清洁。

examples.en: She used water to moisten the soil.
examples.zh: 她用水把土壤弄湿。

definitions.en: n a cargo ship
definitions.zh: n. 租船人, 承运人, 托运人, 货船, 运输机
[经] 装货人, 货主, 承运人

examples.en: The freighter carried goods across the ocean.
examples.zh: 这艘货船运载货物穿越大洋。

examples.en: A large freighter docked at the port.
examples.zh: 一艘大货船停靠在港口。

definitions.en: v declare invalid
definitions.zh: vt. 废除, 宣告无效, 取消

definitions.en: v cancel officially
definitions.zh: [经] 撤销, 宣告无效

examples.en: The court decided to annul the contract.
examples.zh: 法院决定废除这份合同。

examples.en: They annulled their marriage last year.
examples.zh: 他们去年宣告婚姻无效。

definitions.en: n. one of two stout poles with foot rests in the middle; used for walking high above the ground
definitions.zh: n. 高跷, 支柱, 脚柱

examples.en: The performer walked on a tall stilt.
examples.zh: 表演者踩着高跷行走。

examples.en: Children tried to balance on a stilt.
examples.zh: 孩子们试着在高跷上保持平衡。

definitions.en: n. someone who forces their way aboard ship
definitions.zh: n. 寄膳者, 寄膳宿者

examples.en: The boarder paid for meals and a room.
examples.zh: 这位寄膳宿者支付了食宿费用。

examples.en: She became a boarder at the school.
examples.zh: 她成了学校的寄宿生。

definitions.en: n. a short thin stick of wood used in making matches
definitions.zh: n. 火柴

examples.en: He used a matchstick to light the candle.
examples.zh: 他用一根火柴点燃了蜡烛。

examples.en: The matchstick broke when he struck it.
examples.zh: 火柴在划的时候断了。

definitions.en: n. unwillingness to tell lies
definitions.zh: n. 说话老实, 老实, 诚实

examples.en: I doubt the veracity of his story.
examples.zh: 我怀疑他故事的真实性。

examples.en: Her veracity is well known among friends.
examples.zh: 她的诚实朋友们都知道。

definitions.en: s excessively greedy and grasping
definitions.zh: a. 贪吃的, 狼吞虎咽的, 贪婪的

examples.en: He is a voracious reader of books.
examples.zh: 他是一个贪婪的读书者。

examples.en: The voracious eater finished the whole cake.
examples.zh: 贪吃的食客吃完了整个蛋糕。

definitions.en: s of the remaining member of a pair, of socks e.g.
definitions.zh: a. 无比的, 无匹敌的, 不相配的

definitions.en: s eminent beyond or above comparison
definitions.zh: [化] 不匹配的

examples.en: Her talent is unmatched in the team.
examples.zh: 她的才能在团队中无与伦比。

examples.en: He wore unmatched socks by mistake.
examples.zh: 他误穿了不相配的袜子。

definitions.en: v. alter the nature of (elements)
definitions.zh: vt. 使变形, 使变质
vi. 变形, 变质

examples.en: Alchemists tried to transmute lead into gold.
examples.zh: 炼金术士试图把铅变成金。

examples.en: Time can transmute sorrow into wisdom.
examples.zh: 时间能把悲伤变成智慧。

definitions.en: s containing little excess
definitions.zh: a. 不足的, 吝啬的

examples.en: The meal was skimpy and left him hungry.
examples.zh: 这顿饭分量不足，让他还饿着。

examples.en: She wore a skimpy dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件暴露的裙子去派对。

definitions.en: s done with very great haste and without due deliberation
definitions.zh: a. 陡峭的, 轻率的

examples.en: The cliff was precipitous and dangerous.
examples.zh: 悬崖陡峭而危险。

examples.en: His decision was too precipitous to be wise.
examples.zh: 他的决定太轻率，不够明智。

definitions.en: s vigorously passionate
definitions.zh: a. 健壮的, 精力充沛的

examples.en: The baby gave a lusty cry.
examples.zh: 婴儿发出健壮的哭声。

examples.en: He is a lusty young man full of energy.
examples.zh: 他是一个精力充沛的健壮年轻人。

definitions.en: v. praise, glorify, or honor
definitions.zh: n. 赞美, 称赞
vt. 赞美, 称赞

examples.en: They laud her for her charitable work.
examples.zh: 他们称赞她的慈善工作。

examples.en: The critics lauded the new film.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞了这部新电影。

definitions.en: n. great merriment
definitions.zh: n. 欢喜, 高兴

examples.en: The joke caused hilarity among the crowd.
examples.zh: 这个笑话引起了人群的欢笑。

examples.en: Hilarity filled the room during the game.
examples.zh: 游戏期间房间里充满了欢乐。

definitions.en: v. change radically
definitions.zh: vt. 向...鼓吹革命, 使发生革命性剧变

examples.en: The internet will revolutionize communication.
examples.zh: 互联网将彻底改变通信方式。

examples.en: This invention could revolutionize farming.
examples.zh: 这项发明可能使农业发生革命性变化。

definitions.en: v. expand and contract rhythmically; beat rhythmically
definitions.zh: vi. 搏动, 悸动, 震动

definitions.en: v. move with or as if with a regular alternating motion
definitions.zh: [医] 搏动

examples.en: His heart began to pulsate rapidly.
examples.zh: 他的心脏开始快速搏动。

examples.en: The music made the room pulsate with energy.
examples.zh: 音乐让房间充满活力地悸动。

definitions.en: n. the product of percolation
definitions.zh: vt.vi. 滤, 滤过, 渗开, (使)渗透, (使)渗滤

definitions.en: v. spread gradually
definitions.zh: n. 滤过液, 渗出液

definitions.en: v. prepare in a percolator
definitions.zh: vt. 用渗滤壶煮(咖啡)

examples.en: Coffee percolates through the filter.
examples.zh: 咖啡通过过滤器渗滤。

examples.en: News percolates slowly through the village.
examples.zh: 消息在村庄里慢慢传开。

definitions.en: a incapable of reproducing
definitions.zh: a. 不肥沃的, 不毛的, 不结果实的

examples.en: The soil in this area is infertile.
examples.zh: 这个地区的土壤不肥沃。

examples.en: The couple learned they were infertile.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇得知他们无法生育。

definitions.en: n. polite attentiveness to women
definitions.zh: n. 华丽, 豪勇, 勇敢行为

examples.en: He showed gallantry by opening the door.
examples.zh: 他开门以示殷勤。

examples.en: The soldier was honored for his gallantry.
examples.zh: 这名士兵因英勇而受表彰。

definitions.en: s. characteristic of informal spoken language or conversation
definitions.zh: a. 会话的, 口语的, 口语体的

examples.en: He used colloquial language with his friends.
examples.zh: 他和朋友说话时用了口语化的语言。

examples.en: Colloquial expressions are common in daily talk.
examples.zh: 口语表达在日常对话中很常见。

definitions.en: a. morally pure (especially not having experienced sexual intercourse)
definitions.zh: a. 贞洁的, 纯洁的, 朴素的

examples.en: She lived a chaste and simple life.
examples.zh: 她过着纯洁而简朴的生活。

examples.en: The chaste design of the room was elegant.
examples.zh: 房间朴素的设计很优雅。

definitions.en: s. marked by care and persistent effort
definitions.zh: a. 勤勉的, 刻苦的

examples.en: The assiduous student studied every night.
examples.zh: 那个勤奋的学生每晚都学习。

examples.en: Her assiduous effort led to great success.
examples.zh: 她刻苦的努力带来了巨大的成功。

definitions.en: n. a treeless grassy plain
definitions.zh: n. 大草原, 草甸

examples.en: The prairie stretches for miles.
examples.zh: 大草原绵延数英里。

examples.en: Bison roam freely on the prairie.
examples.zh: 野牛在大草原上自由漫步。

definitions.en: v assume sponsorship of
definitions.zh: a. 屈尊俯就的, 显示优越感的

examples.en: His patronizing tone annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他屈尊俯就的语气惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: She gave a patronizing smile to the child.
examples.zh: 她对孩子露出了优越感的微笑。

definitions.en: n. a prayer asking God's help as part of a religious service
definitions.zh: n. 祈祷, 符咒

examples.en: The priest began with an invocation.
examples.zh: 牧师以祈祷开始。

examples.en: They recited an invocation for peace.
examples.zh: 他们念诵祈求和平的祷词。

definitions.en: s insanely irresponsible
definitions.zh: a. 白痴的, 愚蠢的, 呆头呆脑的

examples.en: That was an idiotic thing to do.
examples.zh: 那是一件愚蠢的事。

examples.en: His idiotic plan failed completely.
examples.zh: 他愚蠢的计划完全失败了。

definitions.en: n. a portable box-shaped free-reed instrument; the reeds are made to vibrate by air from the bellows controlled by the player
definitions.zh: n. 手风琴
a. 可折叠的

examples.en: He played the accordion at the festival.
examples.zh: 他在节日上演奏手风琴。

examples.en: The accordion has a beautiful sound.
examples.zh: 手风琴的声音很美。

definitions.en: n. an abraded area where the skin is torn or worn off
definitions.zh: n. 磨擦, 磨损, 磨损处

definitions.en: n. erosion by friction
definitions.zh: [化] 磨耗; 磨蚀

examples.en: He had a minor abrasion on his knee.
examples.zh: 他膝盖上有一处轻微擦伤。

examples.en: The abrasion on the pipe caused a leak.
examples.zh: 管道上的磨损导致了泄漏。

definitions.en: n. an evasion of the point of an argument by raising irrelevant distinctions or objections
definitions.zh: n. 遁词, 双关语

definitions.en: v. evade the truth of a point or question by raising irrelevant objections
definitions.zh: vi. 吹毛求疵, 争吵, 说模棱两可的话

definitions.en: v. argue over petty things
definitions.zh: vt. 对...诡辩

examples.en: Don't quibble over small details in the plan.
examples.zh: 不要对计划中的小细节吹毛求疵。

examples.en: His quibble about the time wasted everyone's time.
examples.zh: 他对时间的挑剔浪费了大家的时间。

definitions.en: v. commit to memory; learn by heart
definitions.zh: vt. 记住, 熟记, 背熟

examples.en: I need to memorize these new words.
examples.zh: 我需要记住这些新单词。

examples.en: She can memorize a poem in five minutes.
examples.zh: 她能在五分钟内背熟一首诗。

definitions.en: n. an inability to sleep; chronic sleeplessness
definitions.zh: n. 失眠症
[医] 失眠[症]

examples.en: He suffers from insomnia and cannot sleep well.
examples.zh: 他患有失眠症，睡不好觉。

examples.en: Insomnia often makes people feel tired during the day.
examples.zh: 失眠常常让人白天感到疲倦。

definitions.en: v. attribute or credit to
definitions.zh: vt. 归罪, 使负责, 嫁祸于

examples.en: They impute the mistake to his carelessness.
examples.zh: 他们把错误归咎于他的粗心。

examples.en: Do not impute bad motives to her actions.
examples.zh: 不要将不良动机归因于她的行为。

definitions.en: a. curving inward
definitions.zh: a. 凹的
[医] 凹的, 凹面的

examples.en: The mirror has a concave surface that bends light.
examples.zh: 这面镜子有凹面，能弯曲光线。

examples.en: A concave lens is thinner at the center than edges.
examples.zh: 凹透镜中心比边缘薄。

definitions.en: n. a tool with a flat blade attached at right angles to a long handle
definitions.zh: n. 锄头

definitions.en: v. dig with a hoe
definitions.zh: v. 用锄耕地, 锄

examples.en: He used a hoe to weed the garden.
examples.zh: 他用锄头给花园除草。

examples.en: She will hoe the soil before planting.
examples.zh: 她会在种植前用锄耕地。

definitions.en: n. a work produced by hand labor
definitions.zh: n. 手工艺, 手艺

definitions.en: n. a craft that requires skillful hands
definitions.zh: [经] 手工业, 手工

examples.en: She sells her handicraft at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市场上出售手工艺品。

examples.en: Handicraft requires patience and skill.
examples.zh: 手工艺需要耐心和技巧。

definitions.en: n. formal or perfunctory politeness
definitions.zh: n. 礼貌, 礼仪

examples.en: Civility is important in any conversation.
examples.zh: 礼貌在任何对话中都很重要。

examples.en: He spoke with civility even when angry.
examples.zh: 即使生气时，他也礼貌地说话。

definitions.en: v jump across or leap over (an obstacle)
definitions.zh: a. 有拱顶的, 圆顶的, 拱形的

examples.en: The room had a vaulted ceiling.
examples.zh: 房间有拱形天花板。

examples.en: He vaulted over the fence easily.
examples.zh: 他轻松地跃过了栅栏。

definitions.en: n. painting done in a range of tones of a single color
definitions.zh: n. 单色画, 单色, 黑白
a. 单色的, 黑白的
[计] 单色

examples.en: The photo was in monochrome, only black and white.
examples.zh: 那张照片是单色的，只有黑白两色。

examples.en: He prefers monochrome paintings to colorful ones.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢单色画而非彩色画。

definitions.en: n. slender-bodied non-stinging insect having iridescent wings that are outspread at rest; adults and nymphs feed on mosquitoes etc.
definitions.zh: n. 蜻蜓

examples.en: A dragonfly landed on the flower.
examples.zh: 一只蜻蜓落在花上。

examples.en: The dragonfly has transparent wings.
examples.zh: 蜻蜓有透明的翅膀。

definitions.en: n. sudden violent winds; often accompanied by precipitation
definitions.zh: n. 飑, 喊叫

definitions.en: v. make high-pitched, whiney noises
definitions.zh: vi. 起飑, 嚎啕, 叫嚷

definitions.en: v. blow in a squall
definitions.zh: vt. 尖叫

examples.en: A sudden squall hit the boat during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中一阵突然的飑袭击了船。

examples.en: The baby began to squall loudly for attention.
examples.zh: 婴儿开始大声哭闹以引起注意。

definitions.en: n unusual largeness in size or extent or number
definitions.zh: n. 巨大, 广大, 广漠

examples.en: The vastness of the ocean amazed her.
examples.zh: 海洋的广阔令她惊叹。

examples.en: He contemplated the vastness of space.
examples.zh: 他沉思着太空的广漠。

definitions.en: n. the trait of being difficult to handle or overcome
definitions.zh: n. 倔强；顽强；棘手

examples.en: His stubbornness made him refuse to change.
examples.zh: 他的倔强使他拒绝改变。

examples.en: She overcame her stubbornness to apologize.
examples.zh: 她克服了倔强去道歉。

definitions.en: r. to a prohibitive degree
definitions.zh: adv. 禁止, 起阻止作用, 抑制

examples.en: The cost was prohibitively high for them.
examples.zh: 费用对他们来说高得令人望而却步。

examples.en: The rent was prohibitively expensive.
examples.zh: 租金贵得让人无法承受。

definitions.en: n. complete and confirmed integrity; having strong moral principles
definitions.zh: n. 诚实, 正直

examples.en: His probity is beyond question.
examples.zh: 他的正直无可置疑。

examples.en: She is known for her probity.
examples.zh: 她以正直闻名。

definitions.en: n wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living
definitions.zh: n. 富裕, 丰富, 大量

examples.en: The palace displayed great opulence.
examples.zh: 宫殿展示了极大的富丽堂皇。

examples.en: Their lifestyle was one of opulence.
examples.zh: 他们的生活方式极为奢华。

definitions.en: v. make less rigid or softer
definitions.zh: vt. 平息, 缓和, 减轻, 使变软

examples.en: He tried to mollify his angry boss.
examples.zh: 他试图平息老板的怒气。

examples.en: A kind word can mollify a tense situation.
examples.zh: 一句好话能缓和紧张局势。

definitions.en: s. stubbornly resistant to authority or control
definitions.zh: a. 易怒的, 倔强的, 脾气不好的

examples.en: The fractious child refused to obey.
examples.zh: 那个倔强的孩子拒绝服从。

examples.en: A fractious crowd gathered outside.
examples.zh: 一群易怒的人群聚集在外面。

definitions.en: r in an appropriate manner
definitions.zh: adv. 适切地, 适合地

examples.en: He was fittingly dressed for the occasion.
examples.zh: 他穿着得体，适合这个场合。

examples.en: The award fittingly honored her hard work.
examples.zh: 这个奖项恰当地表彰了她的辛勤工作。

definitions.en: s thin and weak
definitions.zh: a. 小束状的, 细微的, 飘渺的

examples.en: Wispy clouds floated across the sky.
examples.zh: 一缕缕云彩飘过天空。

examples.en: Her hair was thin and wispy.
examples.zh: 她的头发稀疏而纤细。

definitions.en: r. in a sporadic manner
definitions.zh: adv. 偶发地；零星地

examples.en: He worked sporadically throughout the year.
examples.zh: 他一年中零星地工作。

examples.en: Rain fell sporadically during the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午断断续续地下雨。

definitions.en: s causing or able to cause nausea
definitions.zh: a. 讨厌的, 可恶的, 令人憎恶的

examples.en: The smell was loathsome and made her sick.
examples.zh: 气味令人作呕，让她恶心。

examples.en: He found the task loathsome and avoided it.
examples.zh: 他觉得这任务讨厌，就避开了。

definitions.en: a. deserving of contempt or scorn
definitions.zh: a. 卑鄙的, 可轻蔑的, 不足挂齿的

examples.en: That was a contemptible act.
examples.zh: 那是一个卑鄙的行为。

examples.en: His behavior is truly contemptible.
examples.zh: 他的行为确实可轻蔑。

definitions.en: s. according with custom or propriety
definitions.zh: a. 合适的, 适当的

examples.en: That dress is very becoming on you.
examples.zh: 那条裙子很适合你。

examples.en: Her behavior was becoming for a leader.
examples.zh: 她的行为对领导者来说很得体。

definitions.en: v. provoke the hostility of
definitions.zh: vt. 使对抗, 使敌对, 反对

definitions.en: v. act in opposition to
definitions.zh: vi. 引起反抗

examples.en: Don't antagonize your coworkers.
examples.zh: 不要使同事敌对。

examples.en: His words antagonized the entire group.
examples.zh: 他的话引起了全组的反抗。

definitions.en: n a secret store of valuables or money
definitions.zh: vt. 藏起来

definitions.en: v save up as for future use
definitions.zh: n. 隐藏处, 隐藏物

examples.en: He stashed the money under the bed.
examples.zh: 他把钱藏在床底下。

examples.en: She has a secret stash of chocolate.
examples.zh: 她有一个秘密的巧克力隐藏处。

definitions.en: v. work hastily or carelessly; deal with inadequately and superficially
definitions.zh: vt. 少给, 克扣
vi. 吝啬
a. 少的, 不足的

examples.en: Don't skimp on the ingredients.
examples.zh: 不要吝啬材料。

examples.en: He skimped on his homework.
examples.zh: 他草率地做了作业。

definitions.en: v. introduce or insert (oneself) in a subtle manner
definitions.zh: vt. 巴结, 暗示, 使滋长
vi. 旁敲侧击

examples.en: He tried to insinuate himself into the group.
examples.zh: 他试图巴结进入那个团体。

examples.en: She insinuated that he was lying.
examples.zh: 她暗示他在撒谎。

definitions.en: n. large stinging paper wasp
definitions.zh: n. 大黄蜂

examples.en: A hornet buzzed angrily near the window.
examples.zh: 一只大黄蜂在窗边愤怒地嗡嗡叫。

examples.en: He was stung by a hornet in the garden.
examples.zh: 他在花园里被大黄蜂蜇了。

definitions.en: s. not pertinent to the matter under consideration
definitions.zh: a. 外来的, 非必要的, 无关的

definitions.en: s. not essential
definitions.zh: [医] 体外的

examples.en: Remove any extraneous details.
examples.zh: 去掉任何无关的细节。

examples.en: That information is extraneous to the topic.
examples.zh: 那个信息与话题无关。

definitions.en: s. slightly open
definitions.zh: a. 微开的, 半开的, 不和谐的
adv. 微开, 半开, 不协调地

examples.en: The door was left ajar by mistake.
examples.zh: 门不小心被留成半开。

examples.en: She left the window ajar for fresh air.
examples.zh: 她把窗户半开以通风。

definitions.en: n. an additional charge (as for items previously omitted or as a penalty for failure to exercise common caution or common skill)
definitions.zh: n. 装载过多, 超载, 追加罚款, 附加税

definitions.en: v. charge an extra fee, as for a special service
definitions.zh: vt. 使装载过多, 追加罚款, 收附加税

examples.en: There is a surcharge for late payment.
examples.zh: 逾期付款有附加费。

examples.en: The airline surcharged for extra baggage.
examples.zh: 航空公司对额外行李收附加税。

definitions.en: s unpleasantly cool and humid
definitions.zh: a. 阴湿的, 潮湿的

examples.en: The basement felt cold and dank.
examples.zh: 地下室感觉又冷又阴湿。

examples.en: A dank smell came from the cave.
examples.zh: 一股潮湿的气味从洞穴传来。

definitions.en: n. a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable especially in sexual behavior
definitions.zh: vt. 使堕落, 使反常, 歪曲, 滥用, 使左右颠倒, 唆使...性变态

definitions.en: v. change the inherent purpose or function of something
definitions.zh: n. 堕落者, 行为反常者, 背教者, 性欲反常者

examples.en: He tried to pervert the truth.
examples.zh: 他试图歪曲真相。

examples.en: That person is a dangerous pervert.
examples.zh: 那个人是危险的堕落者。

definitions.en: s. devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
definitions.zh: a. 寒冷的, 严寒的, 冷淡的
[医] 寒冷的, 冷淡的, 性感缺失的

examples.en: The frigid wind chilled us to the bone.
examples.zh: 寒冷的寒风使我们冷彻骨髓。

examples.en: She gave him a frigid stare.
examples.zh: 她给了他一个冷淡的凝视。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to motor vehicles
definitions.zh: a. 汽车的

examples.en: He works in the automotive industry.
examples.zh: 他在汽车行业工作。

examples.en: The automotive parts are made in this factory.
examples.zh: 汽车零件在这家工厂制造。

definitions.en: n. a propelling force
definitions.zh: n. 推进, 推进力

definitions.en: n. the act of propelling
definitions.zh: [医] 前冲, 慌张步态

examples.en: The engine provides propulsion for the rocket.
examples.zh: 发动机为火箭提供推进力。

examples.en: Jet propulsion moves the plane forward.
examples.zh: 喷气推进使飞机向前移动。

definitions.en: v. grant credentials to
definitions.zh: vt. 信托, 确认, 归结于, 委派

definitions.en: v. provide or send (envoys or embassadors) with official credentials
definitions.zh: [经] 发行信用证, 信托, 委托

examples.en: The university was accredited by the board.
examples.zh: 这所大学获得了委员会的认证。

examples.en: They accredited the ambassador to the country.
examples.zh: 他们委派大使到那个国家。

definitions.en: n. the quality of disagreeing; being unsuitable and inappropriate
definitions.zh: n. 不协调, 不一致, 不合适
[化] 异元性; 不相容性

examples.en: There was an incongruity in his story.
examples.zh: 他的故事中有不协调之处。

examples.en: The incongruity of the colors was striking.
examples.zh: 颜色的不一致很引人注目。

definitions.en: n. successive change from one thing or state to another and back again
definitions.zh: n. 交互, 轮流, 间隔
[计] 交替工作

examples.en: The alternation of seasons is predictable.
examples.zh: 季节的交替是可以预测的。

examples.en: There was an alternation of hot and cold days.
examples.zh: 天气冷热交替。

definitions.en: v. separate or cut with a tool, such as a sharp instrument
definitions.zh: vt. 劈开, 分开

definitions.en: v. make by cutting into
definitions.zh: vi. 劈开, 分开, 粘着, 依恋

examples.en: He cleaved the wood with an axe.
examples.zh: 他用斧头劈开木头。

examples.en: The knife can cleave through bone.
examples.zh: 这把刀能劈开骨头。

definitions.en: s having existed from the beginning; in an earliest or original stage or state
definitions.zh: a. 原始的, 自原始时代的
[医] 原始的

examples.en: The forest seemed primordial and untouched.
examples.zh: 森林看起来原始而未经触动。

examples.en: Primordial life forms existed long ago.
examples.zh: 原始生命形式很久以前存在。

definitions.en: s. harmful to living things
definitions.zh: a. 有害的, 造成伤害的
[医] 有害的

examples.en: Smoking has deleterious effects on health.
examples.zh: 吸烟对健康有有害影响。

examples.en: This chemical is deleterious to plants.
examples.zh: 这种化学物质对植物有害。

definitions.en: n a situation from which extrication is difficult especially an unpleasant or trying one
definitions.zh: n. 困惑, 迷惑, 为难

examples.en: She was in a quandary about what to do.
examples.zh: 她对于做什么感到困惑。

examples.en: His decision left him in a quandary.
examples.zh: 他的决定使他陷入为难。

definitions.en: s unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech
definitions.zh: a. 过度的, 过分的, 令人生厌的

examples.en: His fulsome praise made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他过分的赞扬让所有人都不舒服。

examples.en: She gave a fulsome apology that seemed fake.
examples.zh: 她做了过分的道歉，看起来很假。

definitions.en: n. the trait of being frivolous; not serious or sensible
definitions.zh: n. 轻薄, 轻率, 不足取的事

examples.en: The party was full of frivolity and laughter.
examples.zh: 派对充满了轻浮和笑声。

examples.en: He dismissed her concerns as frivolity.
examples.zh: 他把她的担忧视为轻率而置之不理。

definitions.en: s befitting or characteristic of those who incline to social exclusiveness and who rebuff the advances of people considered inferior
definitions.zh: a. 自命不凡的, 势利的

examples.en: Her snobbish attitude annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 她势利的态度惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: He is too snobbish to talk to us.
examples.zh: 他太自命不凡，不愿和我们说话。

definitions.en: r in a hasty and foolhardy manner
definitions.zh: adv. 轻率地

examples.en: He rashly quit his job without a plan.
examples.zh: 他轻率地辞了职，没有计划。

examples.en: She rashly agreed to the dangerous trip.
examples.zh: 她轻率地同意了这次危险的旅行。

definitions.en: s. marked by lack of intellectual depth
definitions.zh: a. 能说善道的, 流畅的

examples.en: His glib answer lacked real thought.
examples.zh: 他流畅的回答缺乏真正的思考。

examples.en: She gave a glib speech without substance.
examples.zh: 她做了一个流畅但没有实质的演讲。

definitions.en: v. recite in elocution
definitions.zh: v. 慷慨陈词, 演讲, 朗读

examples.en: He will declaim his poem at the event.
examples.zh: 他将在活动上朗读他的诗。

examples.en: She loves to declaim in front of a crowd.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在人群前慷慨陈词。

definitions.en: n. someone held in bondage
definitions.zh: n. 奴隶, 束缚, 奴役

examples.en: He was a thrall to his own desires.
examples.zh: 他是自己欲望的奴隶。

examples.en: The kingdom kept many thralls for labor.
examples.zh: 王国保留了许多奴隶做苦工。

definitions.en: n. (usually plural) a fragment scraped off of something and collected
definitions.zh: n. 擦去, 抹去, 削去, 刮擦声, 碎屑
a. 刮擦的, 吝啬的

examples.en: He heard a scraping sound from the floor.
examples.zh: 他听到地板上传来刮擦声。

examples.en: She collected the scraping of paint from the wall.
examples.zh: 她收集了墙上的油漆碎屑。

definitions.en: v provide with nourishment
definitions.zh: a. 有营养的, 滋养多的

examples.en: This soup is very nourishing for you.
examples.zh: 这汤对你很有营养。

examples.en: She eats nourishing food every day.
examples.zh: 她每天吃有营养的食物。

definitions.en: s marked by complexity and richness of detail
definitions.zh: a. 繁茂的, 丰富的, 肥沃的, 华丽的

definitions.en: s displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses
definitions.zh: [医] 过盛的, 过多的

examples.en: The garden has luxuriant green plants.
examples.zh: 花园里有繁茂的绿色植物。

examples.en: Her hair is thick and luxuriant.
examples.zh: 她的头发浓密而华丽。

definitions.en: s. not easily borne; wearing; I only had to greet the guests"
definitions.zh: a. 累赘的, 恼人的, 繁重的
[法] 难于负担的, 压抑的, 累赘的

examples.en: The heavy box felt burdensome to carry.
examples.zh: 沉重的箱子搬起来很累赘。

examples.en: Too many rules can be burdensome.
examples.zh: 太多的规则可能很恼人。

definitions.en: v. wish ill or allow unwillingly
definitions.zh: vt. 嫉妒, 羡慕, 勉强允给, 吝惜

examples.en: I don't begrudge him his success.
examples.zh: 我不嫉妒他的成功。

examples.en: She begrudged every minute spent waiting.
examples.zh: 她吝惜每一分钟等待的时间。

definitions.en: n. a decoration of color or interest that is added to relieve plainness
definitions.zh: n. 装饰, 装饰品

examples.en: She wore a simple adornment on her dress.
examples.zh: 她在裙子上戴了简单的装饰。

examples.en: The room needs some adornment to look nice.
examples.zh: 房间需要一些装饰品才好看。

definitions.en: n. a long whipstitch or overhand stitch overlying an edge to prevent raveling
definitions.zh: a. 阴天的, 阴暗的, 愁闷的

examples.en: The sky is overcast and might rain.
examples.zh: 天空阴天，可能会下雨。

examples.en: He felt overcast after hearing the bad news.
examples.zh: 听到坏消息后他感到愁闷。

definitions.en: n. outer membranous covering of some fruits or seeds
definitions.zh: n. 外壳, 皮, 无价值之物

definitions.en: v. remove the husks from
definitions.zh: vt. 剥...的壳, 削皮

examples.en: Remove the husk from the corn.
examples.zh: 剥去玉米的外壳。

examples.en: The husk of the nut is hard.
examples.zh: 坚果的外壳很硬。

definitions.en: n. a person who has fallen into a decadent state (morally or artistically)
definitions.zh: a. 衰微的, 颓废的

definitions.en: s. marked by excessive self-indulgence and moral decay
definitions.zh: n. 颓废派

examples.en: The decadent cake was full of chocolate.
examples.zh: 这块颓废的蛋糕满是巧克力。

examples.en: He lived a decadent lifestyle in the city.
examples.zh: 他在城市里过着颓废的生活。

definitions.en: n. the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
definitions.zh: vt. 使茫然, 使发昏, 使眼花缭乱

definitions.en: n. confusion characterized by lack of clarity
definitions.zh: n. 迷乱, 眼花缭乱

examples.en: The accident left him in a daze.
examples.zh: 事故让他陷入迷乱。

examples.en: The bright light dazed her for a moment.
examples.zh: 明亮的灯光使她一时眼花缭乱。

definitions.en: n. a light shade of blue
definitions.zh: n. 天蓝色, 碧空

definitions.en: v. color azure
definitions.zh: a. 蔚蓝的

examples.en: The sky is a beautiful azure today.
examples.zh: 今天天空是美丽的蔚蓝色。

examples.en: She painted the wall azure.
examples.zh: 她把墙漆成天蓝色。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or composed of knights
definitions.zh: a. 骑术的, 马的, 骑在马背上的

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or featuring horseback riding
definitions.zh: n. 骑手

examples.zh: 她是骑术冠军。

examples.en: The equestrian event was exciting.
examples.zh: 骑术比赛很激动人心。

definitions.en: n. leather made from alligator's hide

definitions.en: n. either of two amphibious reptiles related to crocodiles but with shorter broader snouts
definitions.zh: [机] 两栖装甲车

examples.en: The alligator swam slowly in the river.
examples.zh: 短吻鳄在河里慢慢游动。

examples.en: She bought a bag made of alligator leather.
examples.zh: 她买了一个短吻鳄皮做的包。

definitions.en: n. the act of giving an account describing incidents or a course of events
definitions.zh: n. 叙述, 故事, 叙述文

definitions.en: n. (rhetoric) the second section of an oration in which the facts are set forth
definitions.zh: [法] 陈诉, 原告陈述者事实

examples.en: The narration of the story was clear.
examples.zh: 故事的叙述很清晰。

examples.en: Her narration brought the tale to life.
examples.zh: 她的叙述让故事生动起来。

definitions.en: a. likely to fail or make errors
definitions.zh: a. 易错的, 可能犯错的

examples.zh: 所有人都会犯错。

examples.en: The system is fallible and needs checks.
examples.zh: 系统可能犯错，需要检查。

definitions.en: n. an arithmetic operation in which the difference between two numbers is calculated
definitions.zh: n. 减少

definitions.en: n. the act of subtracting (removing a part from the whole)
definitions.zh: [计] 减法

examples.en: Subtraction is the opposite of addition.
examples.zh: 减法是加法的相反运算。

examples.en: We learned subtraction in math class.
examples.zh: 我们在数学课上学了减法。

definitions.en: s. withdrawn from society; seeking solitude
definitions.zh: a. 隐遁的, 偏僻的
n. 隐遁者, 遁世者

examples.en: He lives as a recluse in the mountains.
examples.zh: 他作为隐遁者住在山里。

examples.en: The writer became a recluse after fame.
examples.zh: 那位作家成名后成了遁世者。

definitions.en: n. the resemblance of an animal species to another species or to natural objects; provides concealment and protection from predators

[医] 拟态(生物), 模仿, 模拟

examples.en: The insect uses mimicry to avoid predators.
examples.zh: 这种昆虫用拟态躲避捕食者。

examples.en: His mimicry of the teacher was very funny.
examples.zh: 他对老师的模仿非常有趣。

definitions.en: s devoid of intelligence
definitions.zh: a. 发呆的, 愚笨的

examples.zh: 他愚笨的评论惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: She gave a fatuous smile without reason.
examples.zh: 她无缘无故地露出发呆的微笑。

definitions.en: a. characterized by asymmetry in the spatial arrangement or placement of parts or components
definitions.zh: a. 不对称的, 偏位的

definitions.en: s. irregular in shape or outline
definitions.zh: [计] 非对称的, 不对称的

examples.en: The painting has an asymmetrical design.
examples.zh: 这幅画有不对称的设计。

examples.en: Her haircut is intentionally asymmetrical.
examples.zh: 她的发型故意不对称。

examples.zh: 我一点也不在乎他的意见。

examples.en: There is not a whit of truth in it.
examples.zh: 其中没有一点点真相。

definitions.en: n. a member of an ancient Jewish sect in Judea in the first century who fought to the death against the Romans and who killed or persecuted Jews who collaborated with the Romans
definitions.zh: n. 热心者, 狂热者, 犹太教狂热信徒
[法] 狂热分子, 激烈分子

examples.zh: 他是环境保护的狂热者。

examples.en: The zealot argued loudly about his beliefs.
examples.zh: 那个狂热者大声争论他的信仰。

definitions.en: v. speed up the progress of; facilitate
definitions.zh: vt. 加快, 促进, 发出

definitions.en: v. process fast and efficiently
definitions.zh: a. 畅通的, 无阻碍的, 迅速的, 方便的

examples.en: We need to expedite the shipping process.
examples.zh: 我们需要加快运输过程。

examples.en: Please expedite the delivery of this package.
examples.zh: 请加快这个包裹的递送。

definitions.en: v derange mentally, throw out of mental balance; make insane
definitions.zh: vt. 扰乱, 使发狂

examples.zh: 巨大的噪音会扰乱他的思绪。

examples.en: Stress may derange a person's mental health.
examples.zh: 压力可能使人的精神健康紊乱。

definitions.en: a. free from physical or moral spots or stains
definitions.zh: a. 无瑕疵的, 无缺点的, 无污点的, 清白的

examples.zh: 她的皮肤光滑无瑕疵。

examples.en: He has an unblemished reputation at work.
examples.zh: 他在工作中有着清白的名声。

definitions.en: r. by custom; according to common practice
definitions.zh: adv. 照例, 通常, 习惯上

examples.zh: 我们通常七点吃晚饭。

examples.en: They customarily bow when greeting elders.
examples.zh: 他们习惯上向长辈鞠躬问候。

definitions.en: s not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
definitions.zh: a. 不合适的, 不适宜的, 不得体的

examples.zh: 他不得体的行为让派对上的所有人震惊。

examples.en: It is unseemly to laugh at someone's mistake.
examples.zh: 嘲笑别人的错误是不合适的。

definitions.en: v. to feel or express sympathy or compassion
definitions.zh: v. 怜悯, 同情

examples.zh: 我对你的损失表示同情。

examples.zh: 失败后，他们互相怜悯。

definitions.en: n. a crystal of snow
definitions.zh: n. 雪片, 雪花, 雪片莲

examples.zh: 一片雪花轻轻落在她的鼻子上。

examples.en: Each snowflake has a unique shape.
examples.zh: 每片雪花都有独特的形状。

definitions.zh: n. 贸易保护主义者

examples.zh: 贸易保护主义政策提高了进口税。

examples.zh: 他在贸易辩论中是个坚定的保护主义者。

definitions.en: s harmful to living things
definitions.zh: a. 有害的, 不公正的

examples.zh: 吸烟对你的健康有害。

examples.zh: 这种行为对公司声誉有害。

definitions.en: s. marked by violent force
definitions.zh: a. 冲动的, 猛烈的, 轻率的, 狂暴的

examples.zh: 他冲动的决定导致了许多问题。

examples.en: She is known for her impetuous nature.
examples.zh: 她以冲动的性格而闻名。

definitions.en: v. go together
definitions.zh: vi. 协调, 以和声唱

definitions.en: v. write a harmony for
definitions.zh: vt. 使一致, 使和谐

examples.zh: 房间里的颜色协调得很好。

examples.en: They harmonize their voices when singing.
examples.zh: 他们唱歌时使声音和谐。

definitions.en: a. concerned with topography
definitions.zh: a. 地形的, 地形学的, 地形测量的

examples.zh: 这张地图显示了该地区的地形特征。

examples.en: Topographical surveys help in building roads.
examples.zh: 地形测量有助于修建道路。

definitions.en: n. the amount by which something shrinks

examples.zh: 这首音乐有一种舒缓的节奏。

examples.en: She spoke with a gentle cadence in her voice.
examples.zh: 她说话时声音带有一种温柔的抑扬。

definitions.en: n. a beam made usually of steel; a main support in a structure
definitions.zh: n. 大梁, 主梁

examples.zh: 钢制大梁支撑着这座桥。

examples.zh: 工人们把沉重的大梁吊装到位。

definitions.zh: vt. 使慢跑

examples.zh: 马以轻松的慢跑前进。

examples.zh: 她学会了在小马上慢跑。

definitions.en: a. careful and diligent in the use of resources

examples.zh: 她用钱很节俭。

examples.zh: 节俭的人为未来储蓄。

definitions.en: n. a chemical agent that is added to a chemical mixture to counteract the effects of impurities

definitions.en: n. any animal that feeds on refuse and other decaying organic matter
definitions.zh: [计] 清除器

examples.zh: 秃鹫是吃死动物的食腐动物。

examples.en: The scavenger collected trash from the streets.
examples.zh: 清道夫从街道上收集垃圾。

definitions.en: n the articulation of speech regarded from the point of view of its intelligibility to the audience
definitions.zh: n. 措辞, 发音, 用语

examples.zh: 她的发音清晰易懂。

examples.en: Good diction is important for public speaking.
examples.zh: 好的措辞对公开演讲很重要。

definitions.en: v come out better in a competition, race, or conflict
definitions.zh: vt. 打败, 征服, 克服
[法] 征服, 战胜, 击败

examples.en: The army vanquished its enemies in battle.
examples.zh: 军队在战斗中打败了敌人。

examples.en: She vanquished her fears and spoke publicly.
examples.zh: 她克服了恐惧，公开演讲。

definitions.en: s. firm and dependable especially in loyalty
definitions.zh: a. 坚定的, 踏实的, 固定的, 不变的

examples.zh: 她对自己的信念坚定不移。

examples.zh: 在困难时期，他是一个坚定的朋友。

definitions.en: r. in an ingenious manner
definitions.zh: adv. 有才能地, 贤明地

examples.zh: 他巧妙地解决了这个复杂问题。

examples.en: The device was ingeniously designed to save space.
examples.zh: 这个设备被巧妙地设计以节省空间。

definitions.en: r. in an impartial manner
definitions.zh: adv. 公平地, 无私地; 秉公

examples.zh: 法官必须在法庭上公正地裁决。

examples.zh: 她公平地听取了双方的意见。

definitions.en: v. raise in a relief

examples.zh: 艺术家将在金属上压印一个图案。

examples.en: They emboss the leather with gold letters.
examples.zh: 他们在皮革上浮雕金色字母。

definitions.en: v. express a negative opinion of

examples.zh: 不要在公共场合贬低你的同事。

examples.en: He tends to disparage others' achievements.
examples.zh: 他倾向于贬低他人的成就。

definitions.en: r. without a doubt
definitions.zh: adv. 确实地, 无疑地, 确信地

examples.en: He will assuredly finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 他无疑会按时完成项目。

examples.en: She assuredly knows the answer to that question.
examples.zh: 她确实知道那个问题的答案。

definitions.en: s. not inclined to ask questions
definitions.zh: a. 不提出疑问的, 不提出质询的, 不犹豫的

examples.zh: 他对领导表现出不犹豫的忠诚。
