definitions.en: v. remove water from
definitions.zh: [医] 脱水, 去水

examples.en: Drink water to avoid getting dehydrated.
examples.zh: 喝水以避免脱水。

examples.en: The sun can dehydrate your skin quickly.
examples.zh: 太阳会迅速使你的皮肤脱水。

definitions.en: v. make by twisting together or intertwining
definitions.zh: n. 合股线, 麻线, 搓
v. 搓, (使)交织, 编饰, (使)缠绕

examples.en: She used twine to tie the package.
examples.zh: 她用麻线捆扎包裹。

examples.en: The vines twine around the tree.
examples.zh: 藤蔓缠绕在树上。

definitions.en: v. move stealthily
definitions.zh: vi. 偷偷隐躲, 偷懒

examples.en: The cat skulked behind the bushes.
examples.zh: 猫偷偷隐躲在灌木丛后面。

examples.en: He skulked away to avoid work.
examples.zh: 他偷偷溜走以偷懒。

definitions.en: v. preserve by chilling
definitions.zh: vt. 使冷却, 使清凉, 冷藏

definitions.en: v. cool or chill in or as if in a refrigerator
definitions.zh: [机] 冷冻

examples.en: Please refrigerate the milk after opening.
examples.zh: 打开后请冷藏牛奶。

examples.en: You should refrigerate leftovers promptly.
examples.zh: 你应该及时冷藏剩菜。

definitions.en: n. the power or ability to move
definitions.zh: n. 运动, 移动, 旅行

definitions.en: n. self-propelled movement
definitions.zh: [医] 行动, 运动

examples.en: Walking is a basic form of locomotion.
examples.zh: 行走是运动的基本形式。

examples.en: The robot's locomotion was smooth and fast.
examples.zh: 机器人的移动平稳而快速。

definitions.en: a. of or pertaining to Renaissance humanism
definitions.zh: a. 人本主义的, 人道主义的
[法] 人道主义的, 人文主义的, 人本主义的

examples.en: Humanistic values focus on human welfare.
examples.zh: 人本主义价值观关注人类福祉。

examples.en: She studied humanistic philosophy in college.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习了人道主义哲学。

definitions.en: n. fiber of the flax plant that is made into thread and woven into linen fabric
definitions.zh: n. 亚麻, 麻布, 亚麻织品

definitions.en: n. plant of the genus Linum that is cultivated for its seeds and for the fibers of its stem
definitions.zh: [医] 亚麻

examples.en: Flax is used to make linen fabric.
examples.zh: 亚麻用于制作亚麻布。

examples.en: The farmer grows flax in his field.
examples.zh: 农民在他的田里种植亚麻。

definitions.en: v. make formless
definitions.zh: vt. 使残缺, 使变形

definitions.en: v. become misshapen
definitions.zh: vi. 变形

examples.en: Heat can deform plastic materials.
examples.zh: 热量会使塑料材料变形。

examples.en: The accident deformed the car's frame.
examples.zh: 事故使汽车框架变形。

definitions.en: n. echinoderms characterized by five arms extending from a central disk
definitions.zh: n. 海星

examples.en: The starfish has five arms.
examples.zh: 海星有五条手臂。

examples.en: We found a starfish on the beach.
examples.zh: 我们在海滩上发现了一只海星。

definitions.en: n. a cartilaginous structure at the top of the trachea; contains elastic vocal cords that are the source of the vocal tone in speech
definitions.zh: n. 喉头
[医] 喉

examples.en: The larynx is also called the voice box.
examples.zh: 喉头也称为声匣。

examples.en: He injured his larynx while shouting.
examples.zh: 他喊叫时伤了喉头。

definitions.en: v. burn superficially or lightly
definitions.zh: v. 烧焦, 烤焦

examples.en: Be careful not to singe your hair near the candle.
examples.zh: 小心别在蜡烛旁烧焦你的头发。

examples.en: The chef singed the chicken to remove its feathers.
examples.zh: 厨师烧焦了鸡皮以去除羽毛。

definitions.en: n. a sore that has become inflamed and formed pus
definitions.zh: vi. 溃烂, 生脓

definitions.en: v. ripen and generate pus
definitions.zh: vt. 使溃烂
n. 脓疮, 溃烂

examples.en: The wound began to fester without proper care.
examples.zh: 伤口因缺乏适当护理而开始溃烂。

examples.en: Resentment can fester if left unaddressed.
examples.zh: 怨恨如果不去处理会恶化。

definitions.en: v. make familiar or conversant with
definitions.zh: vt. 使熟悉, 使熟知, 使通俗化

examples.en: Familiarize yourself with the new software.
examples.zh: 让自己熟悉新软件。

examples.en: She needs to familiarize the rules first.
examples.zh: 她需要先熟悉规则。

definitions.en: r in a menacing manner
definitions.zh: adv. 威胁地, 胁迫地, 危险地

examples.en: He spoke threateningly to the intruder.
examples.zh: 他威胁地对闯入者说话。

examples.en: The dog growled threateningly at the stranger.
examples.zh: 狗威胁地对陌生人咆哮。

definitions.en: n. a piece of writing that has been copied from someone else and is presented as being your own work
definitions.zh: n. 剽窃, 抄袭, 剽窃物

definitions.en: n. the act of plagiarizing; taking someone's words or ideas as if they were your own
definitions.zh: [法] 抄袭, 剽窃, 剽窃作品

examples.en: Plagiarism is a serious offense in academic writing.
examples.zh: 剽窃在学术写作中是严重的违规行为。

examples.en: He was expelled for plagiarism in his thesis.
examples.zh: 他因论文剽窃被开除。

definitions.en: n. ice resembling a pendent spear, formed by the freezing of dripping water
definitions.zh: n. 垂冰, 冰柱, 冷冰冰的人

examples.en: A long icicle hung from the roof of the house.
examples.zh: 一根长长的冰柱挂在房檐上。

examples.en: The child broke the icicle and played with it.
examples.zh: 孩子打断了冰柱并玩了起来。

definitions.en: v. form or shape by forcing through an opening
definitions.zh: vt. 挤出, 压出, 逐出
vi. 伸出, 突出

examples.en: The machine extrudes plastic into long tubes.
examples.zh: 这台机器将塑料挤压成长管。

examples.en: They extrude metal to create custom shapes.
examples.zh: 他们挤压金属以制造定制形状。

definitions.en: n a farm building for housing poultry
definitions.zh: n. 狭小空间, 鸡笼, 捕鱼篓

definitions.en: n an enclosure made or wire or metal bars in which birds or animals can be kept
definitions.zh: vt. 关进鸡舍, 监禁

examples.en: The chickens are safe inside the coop at night.
examples.zh: 晚上鸡在鸡笼里很安全。

examples.en: He built a new coop for his pet rabbits.
examples.zh: 他为他的宠物兔子建了一个新笼子。

definitions.en: s. given formal standing or endorsement; made official or legitimate by the observance of proper procedures
definitions.zh: v. 使（协议、计划等）成书面文字形式( formalize的过去式和过去分词); 使成为正式, 使具有一定形式

examples.en: The agreement was formalized in writing.
examples.zh: 协议以书面形式正式化。

examples.en: They formalized their partnership last year.
examples.zh: 他们去年使合作关系成为正式。

definitions.en: n. redness of the skin caused by exposure to the rays of the sun
definitions.zh: n. 日炙, 晒斑, 晒焦, 晒黑

definitions.en: v. get a sunburn by overexposure to the sun
definitions.zh: vt.vi. (使)晒黑, (使)晒得退色, (使)晒焦

examples.en: She got a bad sunburn at the beach.
examples.zh: 她在海滩上严重晒伤。

examples.en: Use sunscreen to avoid sunburn.
examples.zh: 使用防晒霜避免晒斑。

definitions.en: v. cast rays of light upon
definitions.zh: vt. 照耀, 启发, 使灿烂, 放射

definitions.en: v. expose to radiation
definitions.zh: vi. 发光, 变灿烂

examples.en: The sun irradiates the earth with light and heat.
examples.zh: 太阳用光和热照耀地球。

examples.en: They irradiate food to kill bacteria and extend shelf life.
examples.zh: 他们用辐射处理食物以杀死细菌并延长保质期。

definitions.en: s. situated at the farthest possible point from a center
definitions.zh: a. 最外面的, 最远离中心的

examples.en: The outermost layer of Earth is the crust.
examples.zh: 地球最外层是地壳。

examples.en: We explored the outermost islands.
examples.zh: 我们探索了最外围的岛屿。

definitions.en: v to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
definitions.zh: vt. 假设, 假定

examples.en: Scientists hypothesize that the planet has water.
examples.zh: 科学家假设这颗行星有水。

examples.en: We can hypothesize about the cause of the disease.
examples.zh: 我们可以假设这种疾病的原因。

definitions.en: n a device (trade name Aqua-Lung) that lets divers breathe under water; scuba is an acronym for self-contained underwater breathing apparatus
definitions.zh: n. 自携式水中呼吸器

examples.en: He uses scuba gear to explore the ocean.
examples.zh: 他用自携式水中呼吸器探索海洋。

examples.en: Scuba diving is a popular hobby in summer.
examples.zh: 自携式水中呼吸器潜水是夏季流行的爱好。

definitions.en: a. relating to or affecting or functioning as a gland
definitions.zh: a. 腺的, 含腺的, 天生的, 固有的, 肉体的
[医] 腺的

examples.en: The glandular system helps regulate body functions.
examples.zh: 腺系统帮助调节身体功能。

examples.en: She has a glandular problem that affects her health.
examples.zh: 她有一个影响健康的腺问题。

definitions.en: s produced or growing in extreme abundance
definitions.zh: a. 很多的, 丰富的, 浪费的, 慷慨的

examples.en: She offered profuse thanks for the generous gift.
examples.zh: 她对这份慷慨的礼物表示了丰富的感谢。

examples.en: The garden had profuse blooms in the spring.
examples.zh: 花园在春天有繁茂的花朵。

definitions.en: v. make legal
definitions.zh: vt. 法律上认为正当, 使合法化
[法] 使合法化, 法律上认可, 使符法律

examples.en: The government plans to legalize the new drug.
examples.zh: 政府计划使这种新药合法化。

examples.en: Many countries want to legalize same-sex marriage.
examples.zh: 许多国家想使同性婚姻合法化。

definitions.en: n. a decrease in size of an organ caused by disease or disuse
definitions.zh: n. 萎缩, 萎缩症

definitions.en: n. any weakening or degeneration (especially through lack of use)
definitions.zh: [医] 萎缩

examples.en: Muscle atrophy can occur from lack of exercise.
examples.zh: 肌肉萎缩可能因缺乏锻炼而发生。

examples.en: The disease caused atrophy of the patient's legs.
examples.zh: 这种疾病导致患者腿部萎缩。

definitions.en: v represent according to a conventional style
definitions.zh: a. 程式化的；按固定格式的

examples.en: The artist uses stylized shapes in her paintings.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在她的画中使用程式化的形状。

examples.en: This stylized font is easy to read and elegant.
examples.zh: 这种程式化的字体易读且优雅。

definitions.en: v. put into dramatic form
definitions.zh: vt. 改编成戏剧, 编写剧本

definitions.en: v. represent something in a dramatic manner
definitions.zh: vi. 戏剧化

examples.en: They want to dramatize the novel for television.
examples.zh: 他们想把这部小说改编成电视剧。

examples.en: She tends to dramatize small problems in her life.
examples.zh: 她倾向于戏剧化生活中的小问题。

definitions.en: n. any of several Old World shrubby broad-leaved willows having large catkins; some are important sources for tanbark and charcoal
definitions.zh: a. 灰黄色的, 土色的, 气色不好的

definitions.en: v. cause to become sallow
definitions.zh: v. (使)成土色

definitions.en: s. unhealthy looking
definitions.zh: n. 黄华柳, 黄华柳细枝

examples.en: His skin looked sallow after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病之后他的皮肤看起来灰黄色。

examples.en: The sallow leaves fell from the tree in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天灰黄色的叶子从树上落下。

definitions.en: s. restricting the scope or freedom of action
definitions.zh: a. 受限的, 限制的；拘束的；狭窄的, 偏狭的

examples.en: The small room felt confining and uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 这个小房间让人感到受限且不舒服。

examples.en: Confining rules can limit creativity in children.
examples.zh: 限制性的规则会限制孩子的创造力。

definitions.en: n. a pernicious and malign influence that is hard to get rid of
definitions.zh: n. 瘟疫, 散布毒害的事物, 罪恶
[医] 疫病, 疫病流行

examples.en: The pestilence spread quickly through the city.
examples.zh: 瘟疫迅速在城市中传播。

examples.en: History records many outbreaks of pestilence.
examples.zh: 历史记录了许多瘟疫的爆发。

definitions.en: v. sleep during winter
definitions.zh: vi. 过冬, 冬眠, 避寒

examples.en: Bears hibernate during the winter.
examples.zh: 熊在冬天冬眠。

examples.en: Some animals hibernate to save energy.
examples.zh: 一些动物冬眠以节省能量。

definitions.en: n. the intellectual productivity of a creative imagination
definitions.zh: n. 多产, 丰饶, 肥沃, 繁殖力
[医] 生殖能, 生殖力

examples.en: The land's fecundity supports many crops.
examples.zh: 土地的丰饶支持了许多作物。

examples.en: Her fecundity as a writer is amazing.
examples.zh: 她作为作家的多产令人惊叹。

definitions.en: n. criminal offense of making false statements under oath
definitions.zh: n. 伪誓, 伪证, 背信弃义
[经] 伪证, 假的证据

examples.en: He was charged with perjury in court.
examples.zh: 他在法庭上被指控伪证。

examples.en: Perjury is a serious crime.
examples.zh: 伪证是一项严重的罪行。

definitions.en: v remove impurities from, increase the concentration of, and separate through the process of distillation
definitions.zh: a. 净化的；精制的

examples.en: The purified water is safe for drinking now.
examples.zh: 净化的水现在可以安全饮用。

examples.en: She uses purified oil for her cooking recipes.
examples.zh: 她用精制的油做她的烹饪食谱。

definitions.en: n. a score in American football; being in possession of the ball across the opponents' goal line
definitions.zh: n. 触地, 触地得分, 着地

examples.en: The team scored a touchdown in the final minute.
examples.zh: 球队在最后一分钟触地得分。

examples.en: He celebrated his touchdown with a happy dance.
examples.zh: 他用快乐的舞蹈庆祝他的触地得分。

definitions.en: a having spines
definitions.zh: a. 多刺的, 尽是尖刺的, 尖刺状的, 麻烦的, 棘手的

examples.en: The cactus is very spiny.
examples.zh: 仙人掌非常多刺。

examples.en: A spiny fish lives in the reef.
examples.zh: 一条多刺的鱼生活在礁石中。

definitions.en: v. compose a sequence of dance steps, often to music
definitions.zh: v. 设计舞蹈动作

examples.en: She will choreograph the dance for the show.
examples.zh: 她将为这场演出设计舞蹈动作。

examples.en: They need to choreograph a new ballet piece.
examples.zh: 他们需要设计一个新的芭蕾舞片段。

definitions.en: n. disagreeable sounds
definitions.zh: n. 不和谐音, 不一致, 不调和, 刺耳的声音
[医] 不谐和

examples.en: The dissonance in the music made it sound harsh.
examples.zh: 音乐中的不和谐音使它听起来刺耳。

examples.en: There is dissonance between their opinions on this.
examples.zh: 他们在这件事上的意见不一致。

definitions.en: n. natural or artificial channel through which water flows
definitions.zh: n. 水道, 河道

definitions.en: n. a conduit through which water flows
definitions.zh: [法] 水流权, 河流, 水路

examples.en: The watercourse runs through the entire valley.
examples.zh: 水道贯穿整个山谷。

examples.en: They built a new watercourse for irrigation.
examples.zh: 他们建了一条新的水道用于灌溉。

definitions.en: n. a bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder
definitions.zh: n. 远足用的背包；双肩背包, 背包

examples.en: She carries her books in a blue backpack.
examples.zh: 她把书放在一个蓝色双肩背包里。

examples.en: We plan to backpack through Europe next summer.
examples.zh: 我们计划明年夏天背包旅行欧洲。

definitions.en: a. providing carefully for the future
definitions.zh: a. 有先见之明的, 有远虑的, 节俭的

examples.en: A provident person saves money for later.
examples.zh: 一个有远虑的人会为以后存钱。

examples.en: She is provident with her resources.
examples.zh: 她对资源很节俭。

definitions.en: v. strip the skin off
definitions.zh: vt. 剥皮, 去皮, 抢夺
[医] 剥皮, 剥兽皮

examples.en: The hunter flayed the animal's skin.
examples.zh: 猎人剥了动物的皮。

examples.en: Critics flayed the movie for its flaws.
examples.zh: 评论家因电影的缺陷而猛烈批评它。

definitions.en: s. casually thoughtless or inconsiderate
definitions.zh: a. 即时的, 即席的, 无准备的, 随便的, 简慢的, 不友好的

definitions.en: r. without previous thought or preparation
definitions.zh: adv. 即时地, 即席地, 随便地

examples.en: He gave an offhand reply to the question.
examples.zh: 他随口回答了这个问题。

examples.en: She made an offhand remark about the weather.
examples.zh: 她随口评论了一下天气。

definitions.en: n. a stingy hoarder of money and possessions (often living miserably)
definitions.zh: n. 守财奴, 吝啬鬼, (石油工程上用的)锥钻头

examples.en: The miser never spends money on others.
examples.zh: 守财奴从不为别人花钱。

examples.en: He lived like a miser in a small house.
examples.zh: 他像守财奴一样住在小房子里。

definitions.en: a. marked by or paying little heed or attention; we know now that it is bad economics"--Franklin D. Roosevelt
definitions.zh: a. 不注意的, 不留心的, 不谨慎的

examples.en: He was heedless of the warnings about the storm.
examples.zh: 他对风暴的警告不注意。

examples.en: Her heedless driving caused a small accident.
examples.zh: 她不留心的驾驶导致了一场小事故。

definitions.en: n. the first beard of an adolescent boy
definitions.zh: n. 细毛, 绒毛, 警察
vi. 作绒毛状飞散, 变成绒毛状
vt. 起毛, 使模糊

examples.en: The peach has a soft fuzz on its skin.
examples.zh: 桃子皮上有柔软的细毛。

examples.en: He noticed fuzz on his chin after not shaving.
examples.zh: 他没刮胡子后注意到下巴上有绒毛。

definitions.en: v. influence or urge by gentle urging, caressing, or flattering
definitions.zh: vt. 以甜言蜜语诱惑, 用甜言蜜语骗
vi. 用甜言蜜语哄骗

examples.en: He tried to wheedle money from his parents.
examples.zh: 他试图用甜言蜜语从父母那里骗钱。

examples.en: She wheedled her friend into lending her the car.
examples.zh: 她用甜言蜜语哄朋友把车借给她。

definitions.en: n. a dog with heavy water-resistant coat that can be trained to retrieve game
definitions.zh: n. 取回的人

examples.en: The retriever fetched the ball from the lake.
examples.zh: 取回的人从湖中取回了球。

examples.en: Our golden retriever loves to play in the park.
examples.zh: 我们的金毛取回的人喜欢在公园玩。

definitions.en: v make or form a layer
definitions.zh: [计] 分层
[医] 分层

examples.en: Layering clothes helps keep you warm in winter.
examples.zh: 分层穿衣有助于冬天保暖。

examples.en: The artist uses layering to create depth in art.
examples.zh: 艺术家使用分层在艺术中创造深度。

definitions.en: n. a six-sided polygon
definitions.zh: n. 六角形, 六边形
[机] 六角, 六角形, 六角边

examples.en: A stop sign is not a hexagon; it's an octagon.
examples.zh: 停车标志不是六边形，而是八边形。

examples.en: The honeycomb is made of many hexagon shapes.
examples.zh: 蜂巢由许多六边形组成。

definitions.en: s of a color similar to that of wood or earth
definitions.zh: a. 呈褐色的

examples.en: The leaves turned a brownish color in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天叶子变成了呈褐色。

examples.en: She painted the wall a soft brownish shade.
examples.zh: 她把墙漆成了柔和的呈褐色色调。

definitions.en: a. having teeth especially of a certain number or type; often used in combination
definitions.zh: a. 有齿的, 锯齿的, 锯齿状的

examples.en: The toothed blade cuts through wood easily.
examples.zh: 有齿的刀刃轻松切过木头。

examples.en: A toothed whale uses its teeth to catch fish.
examples.zh: 有齿的鲸鱼用它的牙齿抓鱼。

definitions.en: n. the change in direction of a propagating wave (light or sound) when passing from one medium to another
definitions.zh: n. 折光, 折射

definitions.zh: v. 浪涌；冲击（surge的ing形式）

examples.en: The surging waves crashed against the rocks.
examples.zh: 汹涌的波浪拍打着岩石。

examples.en: Surging electricity can damage electronic devices.
examples.zh: 浪涌电流可能损坏电子设备。

definitions.en: s. excessively greedy and grasping
definitions.zh: a. 强夺的, 贪欲的, 贪婪的

examples.en: The rapacious businessman took all the profits.
examples.zh: 贪婪的商人拿走了所有利润。

examples.en: Rapacious wolves hunted in the forest at night.
examples.zh: 贪婪的狼在夜间森林中捕猎。

definitions.en: r. to a phenomenal degree
definitions.zh: adv. 现象, 从感官认识到, 非凡, 出众

examples.en: The team performed phenomenally well this season.
examples.zh: 这个团队本赛季表现非凡地好。

examples.en: She is phenomenally talented at playing piano.
examples.zh: 她在弹钢琴方面天赋非凡。

definitions.en: v. make children
definitions.zh: vt. 为某人之生父, 招致, 产生, 引起

examples.en: Hard work can beget success in life.
examples.zh: 努力工作可以带来生活中的成功。

examples.en: Violence often begets more violence in conflicts.
examples.zh: 暴力常常在冲突中招致更多暴力。

definitions.en: n indecision in speech or action
definitions.zh: n. 游移不定, 踌躇, 不果断

examples.en: His vacillation made it hard to trust his decisions.
examples.zh: 他的游移不定让人难以信任他的决定。

examples.en: Vacillation often leads to missed opportunities.
examples.zh: 踌躇不决常常导致错失机会。

definitions.en: s repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
definitions.zh: a. 使用过于频繁的, 常见的, 陈腐的

examples.en: That phrase is too hackneyed to use now.
examples.zh: 那个短语现在用太陈腐了。

examples.en: His speech was full of hackneyed expressions.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了陈腐的表达。

definitions.en: s. relevant and appropriate
definitions.zh: a. 关系密切的, 有关的, 同样的, 恰当的, 贴切的
[机] 锗烷

examples.en: Your comment is not germane to our discussion.
examples.zh: 你的评论与我们的讨论无关。

examples.en: Please keep your questions germane to the topic.
examples.zh: 请让你的问题与主题相关。

definitions.en: v cause to lose one's composure
definitions.zh: vt. 打乱, 挫败, 使破灭

examples.en: The unexpected question discomfited the speaker.
examples.zh: 这个意外的问题让演讲者感到挫败。

examples.en: She tried not to discomfit her guests with bad news.
examples.zh: 她尽量不用坏消息打乱客人的心情。

definitions.en: n a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people
definitions.zh: n. 谚语, 俗话, 笑柄

examples.en: His name became a byword for honesty.
examples.zh: 他的名字成了诚实的代名词。

examples.en: That company is a byword for quality products.
examples.zh: 那家公司是优质产品的代名词。

definitions.en: r by good fortune
definitions.zh: 偶然地, 意外地

examples.en: We fortuitously met an old friend at the park.
examples.zh: 我们偶然在公园遇到了一位老朋友。

examples.en: She fortuitously found the lost keys under the sofa.
examples.zh: 她偶然在沙发下找到了丢失的钥匙。

definitions.en: n. a rough loosely woven fabric originally made with yarn that was spun at home
definitions.zh: a. 家里纺的, 家里做的, 简朴的, 不做作的, 平凡的, 朴素的, 朴实的, 粗陋的

definitions.en: s. of textiles; having a rough surface
definitions.zh: n. 土布

examples.en: She wore a simple homespun dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件简朴的土布裙子去派对。

examples.en: His homespun advice was full of wisdom.
examples.zh: 他朴实的建议充满了智慧。

definitions.en: v. express strong disapproval of; deplore
definitions.zh: vt. 声明不赞成, 抗议, 反对

definitions.en: v. belittle
definitions.zh: [法] 对...表示不赞成, 反对

examples.en: Many people deprecate the use of violence.
examples.zh: 许多人反对使用暴力。

examples.en: She deprecates his rude behavior in public.
examples.zh: 她反对他在公共场合的粗鲁行为。

definitions.en: s. (of tumors, e.g.) slow to heal or develop and usually painless
definitions.zh: a. 懒惰的, 无痛的
[医] 无痛的

examples.en: The indolent student never finished his homework.
examples.zh: 懒惰的学生从不完成作业。

examples.en: She was too indolent to get out of bed early.
examples.zh: 她太懒惰了，不愿早起。

definitions.en: s. eminent beyond or above comparison
definitions.zh: a. 无敌的, 无比的

examples.en: Her matchless beauty captivated everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她无比的美丽迷住了房间里的每个人。

examples.en: The athlete showed matchless skill during the game.
examples.zh: 这位运动员在比赛中展现了无比的技巧。

definitions.en: s full of trivial conversation
definitions.zh: a. 饶舌的, 多嘴的, 喋喋不休的

examples.en: The garrulous old man talked for hours.
examples.zh: 饶舌的老人聊了几个小时。

examples.en: She is too garrulous to keep a secret.
examples.zh: 她太多嘴了，守不住秘密。

definitions.en: n the termination or disintegration of a relationship (between persons or nations)
definitions.zh: n. 分裂, 崩溃, 解散, 解体

definitions.en: n coming apart
definitions.zh: [电] 停止

examples.en: Their breakup was very sad for both of them.
examples.zh: 他们的分手对双方都很伤心。

examples.en: The breakup of the ice sheet was dramatic.
examples.zh: 冰盖的崩解非常壮观。

definitions.en: s. exhibiting self-importance
definitions.zh: a. 自夸的, 自负的, 喜夸耀的

examples.en: His boastful attitude annoyed his classmates.
examples.zh: 他自夸的态度惹恼了同学。

examples.en: She tried not to sound boastful about her success.
examples.zh: 她尽量不让自己的成功听起来自夸。

definitions.en: v look on as or consider
definitions.zh: a. 名誉好的, 被称为...的, 有...名气的
[法] 好名誉的, 驰名的, 号称的

examples.en: He is reputed to be a very generous person.
examples.zh: 他被认为是一个非常慷慨的人。

examples.en: This restaurant is reputed for its delicious seafood.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以美味的海鲜闻名。

definitions.en: v excrete perspiration through the pores in the skin
definitions.zh: v. 出汗, 流汗, 分泌, 渗出

examples.en: People perspire when they exercise heavily.
examples.zh: 人们剧烈运动时会出汗。

examples.en: She began to perspire in the hot sun.
examples.zh: 她在炎热的太阳下开始流汗。

definitions.en: n. a male servant (especially a footman)
definitions.zh: n. 仆人, 侍从, 马屁精
vt. 服侍, 侍候, 奉承

examples.en: The rich man had a lackey to do his chores.
examples.zh: 那个富人有个仆人做杂务。

examples.en: He acted like a lackey to gain favor.
examples.zh: 他表现得像个马屁精以获取好感。

definitions.en: n. agreement on a secret plot
definitions.zh: n. 默许, 纵容

definitions.en: n. (law) tacit approval of someone's wrongdoing
definitions.zh: [法] 纵容, 默许

examples.en: The crime happened with the connivance of the guard.
examples.zh: 这起犯罪是在守卫的纵容下发生的。

examples.en: Connivance in illegal activities is unacceptable.
examples.zh: 纵容非法活动是不可接受的。

definitions.en: s. blindly imitative
definitions.zh: a. 奴隶的, 奴性的, 盲从的

examples.en: His slavish imitation of the artist was obvious.
examples.zh: 他对那位艺术家的盲从模仿很明显。

examples.en: She rejected a slavish adherence to tradition.
examples.zh: 她拒绝盲从传统。

definitions.en: n. a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo
definitions.zh: n. 海港, 港口城市

examples.en: The ship arrived at the seaport.
examples.zh: 船抵达了海港。

examples.en: This city is a major seaport.
examples.zh: 这座城市是一个主要海港。

definitions.en: s. drooping without elasticity; wanting in stiffness
definitions.zh: a. 软弱的, 没气力的, 无活力的
[医] 弛缓的

examples.en: The flaccid balloon lay on the floor.
examples.zh: 软塌塌的气球躺在地板上。

examples.en: His muscles became flaccid after the illness.
examples.zh: 生病后他的肌肉变得松弛无力。

definitions.en: a. serenely self-possessed and free from agitation especially in times of stress
definitions.zh: a. 镇静的, 沉着的

examples.en: She remained composed during the crisis.
examples.zh: 她在危机中保持镇静。

examples.en: He was composed and ready to answer questions.
examples.zh: 他沉着冷静，准备好回答问题。

definitions.en: s. immoderately desirous of acquiring e.g. wealth
definitions.zh: a. 贪婪的

examples.en: The avaricious man wanted more money.
examples.zh: 那个贪婪的人想要更多钱。

examples.en: Her avaricious nature made her unpopular.
examples.zh: 她贪婪的本性让她不受欢迎。

definitions.en: s (used of persons or behavior) characterized by or indicative of lack of generosity
definitions.zh: a. 吝啬的, 贪婪的

examples.en: The miserly man never shared his food.
examples.zh: 那个吝啬的人从不分享食物。

examples.en: Her miserly habits annoyed her friends.
examples.zh: 她吝啬的习惯惹恼了朋友。

definitions.en: v separate the limbs from the body
definitions.zh: v. 分割…的肢体, 肢解( dismember的过去式和过去分词); 身首异处

examples.en: The dismembered body was found in the forest.
examples.zh: 被肢解的尸体在森林中被发现。

examples.en: The toy was dismembered after the dog played with it.
examples.zh: 玩具被狗玩过后肢解了。

definitions.en: a. having or expressing desire for something
definitions.zh: a. 想要的, 想望的, 渴望的

examples.en: She is desirous of a new job.
examples.zh: 她渴望一份新工作。

examples.en: He felt desirous of her attention.
examples.zh: 他渴望得到她的注意。

definitions.en: s. self-consciously timid; lowering my head, I looked at the wall"- Ezra Pound
definitions.zh: a. 害羞的

examples.en: The bashful child hid behind his mother.
examples.zh: 害羞的孩子躲在他妈妈身后。

examples.en: She gave a bashful smile when praised.
examples.zh: 被表扬时她害羞地笑了笑。

definitions.en: n a state of extreme poverty or destitution
definitions.zh: n. 贫困, 贫穷, 拮据, 馈乏
[法] 赤贫, 缺乏

examples.en: They lived in penury after losing their jobs.
examples.zh: 失业后他们生活在贫困中。

examples.en: Penury forced him to beg on the streets.
examples.zh: 贫困迫使他上街乞讨。

definitions.en: v. hide under a false appearance
definitions.zh: v. 掩饰, 假装不知道

examples.en: He tried to dissemble his true feelings.
examples.zh: 他试图掩饰真实感受。

examples.en: She dissembled her anger with a smile.
examples.zh: 她用微笑掩饰愤怒。

definitions.en: v. cause to agonize
definitions.zh: vt. 使极度痛苦, 折磨

definitions.en: v. suffer agony or anguish
definitions.zh: vi. 感到痛苦

examples.en: She would agonize over every small decision.
examples.zh: 她会为每个小决定感到痛苦。

examples.en: Don't agonize too much about the test results.
examples.zh: 不要太为考试结果感到痛苦。

definitions.en: s. heavy and starchy and hard to digest
definitions.zh: a. 易吃饱的, 塞满的, 平凡的, 庸俗的, 步履艰难的

examples.en: The stodgy pudding was hard to digest.
examples.zh: 那油腻的布丁很难消化。

examples.en: He disliked the stodgy food at the party.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢派对上油腻的食物。

definitions.en: a. helpful in bringing about a harmonious adaptation
definitions.zh: a. 与人方便的, 肯通融的

examples.en: The accommodating host offered us a room.
examples.zh: 好客的主人给了我们一个房间。

examples.en: She was very accommodating to our needs.
examples.zh: 她非常通融地满足我们的需求。

definitions.en: s. reciprocally connected
definitions.zh: v. 互相连接, 互相联系( interconnect的过去式和过去分词)

examples.en: All the systems in the building are interconnected.
examples.zh: 大楼里所有系统都是互相连接的。

examples.en: Our lives are interconnected in many ways.
examples.zh: 我们的生活以多种方式互相联系。

definitions.en: n. a sharp sound made by small birds or insects
definitions.zh: n. 喳喳声, 唧唧声
v. 吱喳而鸣

examples.en: The birds chirp happily in the morning.
examples.zh: 鸟儿在早晨快乐地吱喳叫。

examples.en: I heard a chirp from the small bird.
examples.zh: 我听到小鸟的唧唧声。

definitions.en: a. quick or skillful or adept in action or thought
definitions.zh: a. 灵巧的, 敏捷的, 聪明的

examples.en: She is adroit at solving complex problems.
examples.zh: 她善于解决复杂问题。

examples.en: His adroit handling of the situation impressed us.
examples.zh: 他灵巧处理情况的方式让我们印象深刻。

definitions.en: a. not bridgeable
definitions.zh: a. 不能架桥的, 不能逾越的

examples.en: There was an unbridgeable gap between their opinions.
examples.zh: 他们的意见之间存在无法逾越的鸿沟。

examples.en: The cultural differences seemed unbridgeable at first.
examples.zh: 起初文化差异似乎无法逾越。

definitions.en: s. suited to or suggestive of a grave or burial
definitions.zh: a. 送葬的, 适合葬礼的, 悲哀的

examples.en: The funereal atmosphere made everyone sad.
examples.zh: 葬礼般的气氛让每个人都悲伤。

examples.en: She wore a funereal black dress to the event.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件葬礼般的黑色连衣裙参加活动。

definitions.en: s. difficult to penetrate; incomprehensible to one of ordinary understanding or knowledge
definitions.zh: a. 难解的, 深奥的

examples.en: The abstruse theory confused the students.
examples.zh: 深奥的理论让学生困惑。

examples.en: He wrote an abstruse article on philosophy.
examples.zh: 他写了一篇关于哲学的深奥文章。

definitions.en: a. easily managed (controlled or taught or molded)
definitions.zh: a. 驯服的, 易于管教的
[经] 易加工的, 易处理的

examples.en: The tractable horse obeyed every command.
examples.zh: 驯服的马服从每个命令。

examples.en: She found the child tractable and easy to teach.
examples.zh: 她发现孩子听话且容易教。

definitions.en: v. grow weak and thin or waste away physically
definitions.zh: vt. 使消瘦, 使憔悴
vi. 消瘦

examples.en: The illness caused him to emaciate quickly.
examples.zh: 疾病使他迅速消瘦。

examples.en: Without food, the animal began to emaciate.
examples.zh: 没有食物，动物开始消瘦。

definitions.en: n. a humorist who uses ridicule and irony and sarcasm
definitions.zh: n. 讽刺作者, 爱挖苦的人

examples.en: The satirist made fun of political leaders.
examples.zh: 讽刺作家取笑政治领袖。

examples.en: A good satirist uses humor to criticize society.
examples.zh: 好的讽刺作家用幽默批评社会。

definitions.en: s. marked by casual disrespect
definitions.zh: a. 鲁莽的, 卑鄙的, 厚颜无耻的

examples.en: The impudent child talked back to his teacher.
examples.zh: 那个鲁莽的孩子顶撞老师。

examples.en: Her impudent remark made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 她厚颜无耻的评论让所有人不舒服。

definitions.en: n the first light of day
definitions.zh: n. 拂晓, 黎明

examples.en: The dawning sun painted the sky orange.
examples.zh: 初升的太阳把天空染成橙色。

examples.en: At dawning, the birds began to sing.
examples.zh: 拂晓时，鸟儿开始歌唱。

definitions.en: a. containing or constituting or characterized by pleasing melody
definitions.zh: a. 旋律美妙的, 旋律优美的, 有乐曲的

examples.en: The bird has a melodious song.
examples.zh: 这只鸟有旋律优美的歌声。

examples.en: Her voice is soft and melodious.
examples.zh: 她的声音柔和而悦耳。

definitions.en: a. preventing especially liquids to pass or diffuse through
definitions.zh: a. 不能渗透的, 不能通过的
[医] 不[渗]透性

examples.en: This jacket is impermeable to water.
examples.zh: 这件夹克防水。

examples.en: The rock is impermeable to liquids.
examples.zh: 这块岩石不透液体。

definitions.en: s not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
definitions.zh: a. 不适合的, 不合体的, 不相配的

examples.en: Such behavior is unbecoming of a leader.
examples.zh: 这种行为不适合一个领导者。

examples.en: Her dress was unbecoming for the formal event.
examples.zh: 她的裙子不适合这个正式场合。

definitions.en: r. in a perennial manner; repeatedly
definitions.zh: adv. 永久地

examples.en: This plant blooms perennially in the garden.
examples.zh: 这种植物在花园里常年开花。

examples.en: He is perennially optimistic about the future.
examples.zh: 他对未来永远乐观。

definitions.en: n. a brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone; has a narrow tube and a flared bell and is played by means of valves
definitions.zh: n. 圆锥形纸袋, 短号
[医] 小助听筒

examples.en: He played the cornet in the band.
examples.zh: 他在乐队里吹短号。

examples.en: The cornet has a bright, clear sound.
examples.zh: 短号有明亮清晰的声音。

definitions.en: n. characterized by high spirits and animation
definitions.zh: n. 快活, 活泼, 精神充沛

examples.en: Her vivacity made her the life of the party.
examples.zh: 她的活泼使她成为派对的核心。

examples.en: The child's vivacity was contagious to everyone.
examples.zh: 孩子的活泼感染了每个人。

definitions.en: a. lacking spiny processes
definitions.zh: a. 无脊椎的, 没有骨气的, 懦弱的

examples.en: The spineless manager never defended his team.
examples.zh: 懦弱的经理从不维护他的团队。

examples.en: She called him spineless for giving in so easily.
examples.zh: 她骂他懦弱，因为他轻易屈服。

definitions.en: s excessively or hypocritically pious
definitions.zh: a. 假装圣洁的, 假装虔诚的, 假装诚实的

examples.en: His sanctimonious tone annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他假装虔诚的语气惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: She gave a sanctimonious speech about honesty.
examples.zh: 她发表了一篇关于诚实的伪善演讲。

definitions.en: a. completely lacking nobility in character or quality or purpose
definitions.zh: a. 卑贱的, 卑鄙的, 低级的

examples.en: His ignoble actions brought shame to the family.
examples.zh: 他卑鄙的行为给家族带来了耻辱。

examples.en: Stealing is an ignoble act.
examples.zh: 偷窃是卑鄙的行为。

definitions.en: v dig up for reburial or for medical investigation; of dead bodies
definitions.zh: vt. 掘出, 发掘

examples.en: The police decided to exhume the body.
examples.zh: 警方决定掘出尸体。

examples.en: They will exhume the remains for testing.
examples.zh: 他们将发掘遗骸进行检测。

definitions.en: v decorate
definitions.zh: vt. 装饰, 修饰

examples.en: They bedeck the hall with flowers.
examples.zh: 他们用鲜花装饰大厅。

examples.en: The bride was bedecked in jewels.
examples.zh: 新娘佩戴着珠宝装饰。

definitions.en: v regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
definitions.zh: vt. 尊敬, 崇敬, 崇拜

examples.en: Many cultures venerate their ancestors.
examples.zh: 许多文化崇敬祖先。

examples.en: They venerate the old temple as sacred.
examples.zh: 他们崇敬这座古庙为圣地。

definitions.en: v. hold as reserve or withdraw from circulation; of capital
definitions.zh: vt. 使不动, 使固定, 使不能移动

definitions.en: v. make defenseless
definitions.zh: [医] 制动, 固定

examples.en: The doctor had to immobilize the broken arm.
examples.zh: 医生必须固定住骨折的手臂。

examples.en: Heavy snow can immobilize a city's traffic.
examples.zh: 大雪能使城市交通瘫痪。

definitions.en: s. concealing crafty designs for advancing your own interest
definitions.zh: a. 阴谋的, 诡诈的
n. 设计(工作), 计谋

examples.en: Her designing nature made others distrust her.
examples.zh: 她诡诈的本性使别人不信任她。

examples.en: He was known for his designing schemes.
examples.zh: 他以诡诈的计谋著称。

definitions.en: a. unwilling to spend
definitions.zh: a. 小气的, 吝啬的, 缺乏的, 有刺的

examples.en: He is too stingy to buy his friends gifts.
examples.zh: 他太小气，不给朋友买礼物。

examples.en: The stingy man never tips the waiter.
examples.zh: 那个吝啬的人从不给服务员小费。

definitions.en: s. displaying superhuman strength or power
definitions.zh: a. 魁梧有力的

examples.en: It was a herculean task to finish on time.
examples.zh: 按时完成是一项艰巨的任务。

examples.en: He made a herculean effort to lift the heavy box.
examples.zh: 他用了巨大的力气抬起沉重的箱子。

definitions.en: v steal goods; take as spoils
definitions.zh: vt. 夺取, 掠夺

examples.en: The invaders despoiled the village of its treasures.
examples.zh: 入侵者掠夺了村庄的财宝。

examples.en: They despoiled the forest for valuable timber.
examples.zh: 他们为了珍贵木材掠夺了森林。

definitions.en: v harass with persistent criticism or carping
definitions.zh: vt. 逗弄, 使干着急

examples.en: The smell of food tantalized the hungry children.
examples.zh: 食物的香味逗弄着饥饿的孩子们。

examples.en: She tantalized him with a promise she never kept.
examples.zh: 她用从未兑现的承诺逗弄他。

definitions.en: v be a signal for or a symptom of
definitions.zh: vt. 预示

examples.en: Dark clouds betoken a coming storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: His smile betokens a good mood today.
examples.zh: 他的微笑预示着今天心情不错。

definitions.en: n. the action of people mingling and coming into contact
definitions.zh: v. 混合, 混入( mingle的现在分词 ); 混进, 与…交往[联系]

examples.en: The mingling of colors created a beautiful painting.
examples.zh: 颜色的混合创造了一幅美丽的画。

examples.en: Guests were mingling and chatting at the party.
examples.zh: 客人们在派对上交往聊天。

definitions.en: v. make or shape as with an axe
definitions.zh: vt. 砍, 砍倒, 砍成

definitions.en: v. strike with an axe; cut down, strike
definitions.zh: vi. 砍, 劈, 坚持

examples.en: He used an axe to hew the wood.
examples.zh: 他用斧头砍木头。

examples.en: They hew the stone to build a wall.
examples.zh: 他们劈开石头来建墙。

definitions.en: v foreshadow or presage
definitions.zh: vt. 预言, 预告, 预示

examples.en: No one can foretell the future with certainty.
examples.zh: 没有人能确切预言未来。

examples.en: Dark clouds often foretell a coming storm.
examples.zh: 乌云常常预示暴风雨来临。

definitions.en: v. cause to be bitter or resentful
definitions.zh: vt. 使受苦, 使(更)恶化, 使怨恨, 加苦味于

examples.en: Failure can embitter a person over time.
examples.zh: 失败会逐渐使一个人怨恨。

examples.en: His harsh words embittered her for years.
examples.zh: 他严厉的话语让她怨恨多年。

definitions.en: n. a person who escapes into a world of fantasy
definitions.zh: a. 逃避现实的
n. 逃避现实者

examples.en: He is an escapist who reads fantasy novels all day.
examples.zh: 他是个整天读奇幻小说的逃避现实者。

examples.en: Escapist movies help people forget their problems.
examples.zh: 逃避现实的电影帮助人们忘记问题。

definitions.en: n. reprehensible acquisitiveness; insatiable desire for wealth (personified as one of the deadly sins)
definitions.zh: n. 贪婪

examples.en: His avarice for money knew no bounds.
examples.zh: 他对金钱的贪婪无止境。

examples.en: Avarice drove him to cheat his friends.
examples.zh: 贪婪驱使他欺骗朋友。

definitions.en: n a rate (usually rapid) at which something happens
definitions.zh: n. 迅速, 快

examples.en: The swiftness of the cheetah amazed the tourists.
examples.zh: 猎豹的迅速令游客惊叹。

examples.en: He completed the task with remarkable swiftness.
examples.zh: 他以惊人的迅速完成了任务。

definitions.en: s. blowing in puffs or short intermittent blasts
definitions.zh: a. 刮风的, 阵阵猛急的, 突发的, 津津有味的

examples.en: Gusty winds made it hard to walk outside.
examples.zh: 阵阵强风使外面行走困难。

examples.en: The gusty weather forced the picnic to be canceled.
examples.zh: 刮风的天气迫使野餐取消。

definitions.en: n a cruel and oppressive dictator
definitions.zh: n. 独裁者

examples.en: The autocrat ruled the country with an iron fist.
examples.zh: 独裁者用铁腕统治国家。

examples.en: People rebelled against the cruel autocrat.
examples.zh: 人民反抗残酷的独裁者。

definitions.en: n. the condition of having been made smooth or slippery by the application of a lubricant
definitions.zh: n. 润滑, 注油, 润滑作用

definitions.en: n. an application of a lubricant to something
definitions.zh: [计] 润滑

examples.en: Proper lubrication keeps the engine running smoothly.
examples.zh: 适当的润滑使发动机平稳运行。

examples.en: The mechanic checked the lubrication of all parts.
examples.zh: 机械师检查了所有部件的润滑情况。

definitions.en: v. deprive through death
definitions.zh: vt. 使孤寂, 使丧失, 使失去

examples.en: The accident bereaved her of her husband.
examples.zh: 事故使她失去了丈夫。

examples.en: War bereaves many families of their loved ones.
examples.zh: 战争使许多家庭失去亲人。

definitions.en: v. keep away from others
definitions.zh: vt. 使隔离, 使孤立, 隔开

examples.en: She decided to seclude herself in the mountains.
examples.zh: 她决定隐居在山区。

examples.en: He wanted to seclude from the noisy city.
examples.zh: 他想远离喧嚣的城市。

definitions.en: v. be preoccupied with something
definitions.zh: vt. 迷住, 使困扰

examples.en: She tends to obsess over small details.
examples.zh: 她容易在小细节上纠结。

examples.en: Don't let fear obsess your mind.
examples.zh: 别让恐惧占据你的思绪。

definitions.en: n a crystalline rock that can be cut and polished for jewelry
definitions.zh: n. 经雕琢的宝石

examples.en: She wore a beautiful gemstone on her finger.
examples.zh: 她手指上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

examples.en: This gemstone is very rare and valuable.
examples.zh: 这颗宝石非常稀有且珍贵。

definitions.en: n a disposition free from stress or emotion
definitions.zh: n. 宁静

examples.en: I love the tranquility of the forest.
examples.zh: 我喜欢森林的宁静。

examples.en: She meditated for inner tranquility.
examples.zh: 她冥想以求内心宁静。

definitions.en: v. make less active or intense
definitions.zh: vt. 消除, 使清凉, 熄灭
[医] 消, 灭; 消和(石灰); 松, 缓和

examples.en: Water will slake your thirst.
examples.zh: 水能解你的渴。

examples.en: He tried to slake his curiosity.
examples.zh: 他试图满足自己的好奇心。

definitions.en: n. a substance that can be burned to provide heat or power
definitions.zh: a. 易燃的, 燃烧性的, 易动激情的

definitions.en: a. capable of igniting and burning
definitions.zh: n. 易燃物, 可燃物

examples.en: Gasoline is a highly combustible liquid.
examples.zh: 汽油是高度易燃的液体。

examples.en: Keep combustible materials away from fire.
examples.zh: 让易燃物远离火源。

definitions.en: n. a transparent variety of beryl that is blue green in color
definitions.zh: n. 海蓝宝石, 浅绿色
[化] 海蓝宝石

examples.en: The sea looked aquamarine in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 大海在阳光下呈现海蓝色。

examples.en: She chose an aquamarine dress for the party.
examples.zh: 她为派对选了一件海蓝色的裙子。

definitions.en: v. cause to expand as it by internal pressure
definitions.zh: v. (使)膨胀, (使)扩张

examples.en: The balloon began to distend with air.
examples.zh: 气球开始因充气而膨胀。

examples.en: His stomach distended after the big meal.
examples.zh: 他大餐后胃部膨胀了。

definitions.en: n. a clique (often secret) that seeks power usually through intrigue
definitions.zh: n. 秘密结社, (尤指政治上的)阴谋
vi. 策划阴谋

examples.en: A secret cabal plotted against the king.
examples.zh: 一个秘密小集团密谋反对国王。

examples.en: The cabal controlled the company from behind.
examples.zh: 这个阴谋集团在幕后控制着公司。

definitions.en: v. grow and flourish
definitions.zh: n. 芽, 嫩枝
v. 萌芽, 发芽

examples.en: The city's population began to burgeon.
examples.zh: 这个城市的人口开始迅速增长。

examples.en: New businesses burgeon in the spring.
examples.zh: 新企业在春天蓬勃发展。

definitions.en: n. a salt or ester of fulminic acid
definitions.zh: vt. 使爆发, 以严词谴责

definitions.en: v. criticize severely
definitions.zh: vi. 爆炸, 怒喝, 电闪

definitions.en: v. come on suddenly and intensely
definitions.zh: n. 雷酸盐, 烈性炸药

examples.en: He fulminated against the new policy.
examples.zh: 他严词谴责新政策。

examples.en: The chemical can fulminate if heated.
examples.zh: 这种化学物质加热会爆炸。

definitions.en: n. the state (usually of a woman) of having no children or being unable to have children
definitions.zh: n. 贫瘠, 不妊, 不孕, 不生育, 不毛, 荒芜, 思想贫乏, 空洞, 无用, 无聊
[医] 不育症, 不孕症

examples.en: The barrenness of the desert surprised us.
examples.zh: 沙漠的贫瘠让我们惊讶。

examples.en: Barrenness can be a difficult condition to treat.
examples.zh: 不孕症可能是一种难以治疗的状况。

definitions.en: s playful like a lively kitten
definitions.zh: a. 乱跳的, 欢闹的

examples.en: The puppy was very frisky today.
examples.zh: 小狗今天非常欢闹。

examples.en: Children are often frisky after a nap.
examples.zh: 孩子们午睡后常常欢闹。

definitions.en: v. picture to oneself; imagine possible
definitions.zh: vt. 想象, 预想

examples.en: I envision a bright future for us.
examples.zh: 我预想我们有一个光明的未来。

examples.en: Can you envision living in space?
examples.zh: 你能想象住在太空吗？

definitions.en: n (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
definitions.zh: n. 尘埃, 微粒

examples.en: A mote of dust floated in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 一粒尘埃在阳光中漂浮。

examples.en: He saw a mote in her eye.
examples.zh: 他看到她眼里有一粒微粒。

definitions.en: n. a person who is discontented or disgusted
definitions.zh: a. 抱不平的, 不满的, 不服的
n. 不满现状的人

examples.en: The malcontent complained about everything.
examples.zh: 不满的人抱怨一切。

examples.en: He is a malcontent who never smiles.
examples.zh: 他是一个从不微笑的不满者。

definitions.en: v. remove the organization from
definitions.zh: vt. 破坏组织, 使混乱, 瓦解

examples.en: The sudden change will disorganize our plans.
examples.zh: 突然的变化会打乱我们的计划。

examples.en: Don't disorganize the files on my desk.
examples.zh: 别弄乱我桌上的文件。

definitions.en: n. (baseball) playing the position of catcher on a baseball team
definitions.zh: a. 易传染的, 有魅力的, 吸引人的

examples.en: Her laughter is very catching.
examples.zh: 她的笑声很有感染力。

examples.en: He is catching for the team.
examples.zh: 他在队里担任接球手。

definitions.en: v. make an incision into by carving or cutting
definitions.zh: vt. 切割, 雕刻
[医] 切

examples.en: The surgeon incised the skin carefully.
examples.zh: 外科医生小心地切割皮肤。

examples.en: He incised his name on the stone.
examples.zh: 他把名字雕刻在石头上。

definitions.en: s used of persons or their behavior
definitions.zh: a. 不可忍受的, 忍耐不住的

examples.en: His insufferable attitude made everyone angry.
examples.zh: 他难以忍受的态度让每个人都生气。

examples.en: The heat in the room was insufferable.
examples.zh: 房间里的热让人无法忍受。

definitions.en: s capable of being influenced or formed
definitions.zh: a. 易弯的, 柔韧的, 柔顺的

examples.en: The pliant branch bent easily in the wind.
examples.zh: 柔韧的树枝在风中容易弯曲。

examples.en: She has a pliant personality and adapts well.
examples.zh: 她性格柔顺，适应能力强。

definitions.en: v use cautiously and frugally
definitions.zh: v. 节约, 节省, 有效地利用

examples.en: We need to economize on water during summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我们需要节约用水。

examples.en: She tries to economize by buying in bulk.
examples.zh: 她试图通过批量购买来节省开支。

definitions.en: n. a small rectangular free-reed instrument having a row of free reeds set back in air holes and played by blowing into the desired hole
definitions.zh: n. 口琴, 玻璃钟琴
[医] 氢气发音管

examples.en: He played a beautiful tune on the harmonica.
examples.zh: 他用口琴吹奏了一首优美的曲子。

examples.en: The child learned to play the harmonica quickly.
examples.zh: 那个孩子很快学会了吹口琴。

definitions.en: v. fill to satisfaction
definitions.zh: vt. 使饱足, 使厌腻, 充分满足

definitions.en: a. supplied (especially fed) to satisfaction
definitions.zh: a. 饱足的, 厌腻的

examples.en: The large meal did not satiate his hunger.
examples.zh: 那顿大餐并没有满足他的饥饿。

examples.en: She felt satiate after eating the whole cake.
examples.zh: 吃完整个蛋糕后，她感到饱足了。

definitions.en: n. American silversmith remembered for his midnight ride (celebrated in a poem by Longfellow) to warn the colonists in Lexington and Concord that British troops were coming (1735-1818)
definitions.zh: vt. 崇敬, 敬畏, 尊敬

examples.en: Many people revere their elders.
examples.zh: 许多人尊敬长辈。

examples.en: They revere the ancient traditions.
examples.zh: 他们崇敬古老的传统。

definitions.en: r in an unproductive manner
definitions.zh: adv. 不结果实的, 徒劳的, 无益的, 无效的, 无结果的

examples.en: He searched fruitlessly for his lost keys.
examples.zh: 他徒劳地寻找丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: They argued fruitlessly about the problem.
examples.zh: 他们无益地争论这个问题。

definitions.en: v. make long or longer by pulling and stretching
definitions.zh: v. 延长, (使)伸延

definitions.en: s. having notably more length than width; being long and slender
definitions.zh: a. 伸长的

examples.en: The artist tried to elongate the figure in the painting.
examples.zh: 画家试图在画中拉长人物形象。

examples.en: Stretching can help elongate your muscles.
examples.zh: 拉伸有助于延长肌肉。

definitions.en: n. a United States coin worth one tenth of a dollar
definitions.zh: n. 10分硬币(美、加)

examples.en: I found a dime on the sidewalk today.
examples.zh: 我今天在人行道上找到了一枚10分硬币。

examples.en: A dime is worth ten cents in the US.
examples.zh: 在美国，一枚10分硬币值十美分。

definitions.en: v. cause to be confused emotionally
definitions.zh: vt. 使迷惑, 使不知所措

examples.en: The complex instructions bewilder the students.
examples.zh: 复杂的说明使学生们困惑。

examples.en: His sudden change of plan bewildered everyone.
examples.zh: 他突然改变计划使每个人都困惑。

definitions.en: s. softly bright or radiant
definitions.zh: a. 发光的, 通红的
adv. 发光地

examples.en: Her face was aglow with happiness.
examples.zh: 她的脸因幸福而发光。

examples.en: The sky was aglow with the setting sun.
examples.zh: 天空因落日而通红。

definitions.en: n a bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder
definitions.zh: n. 背包

examples.en: He carried his lunch in a small knapsack.
examples.zh: 他把午餐装在一个小背包里。

examples.en: The hiker packed his knapsack for the trip.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者为旅行打包了背包。

definitions.en: n. the act of rotating in a circle or spiral
definitions.zh: n. 旋回, 回转, 旋转
[医] 回旋, 环旋

examples.en: The dancer's gyration amazed the audience.
examples.zh: 舞者的旋转让观众惊叹。

examples.en: The gyration of the wheel was smooth.
examples.zh: 轮子的旋转很平稳。

definitions.en: s. guided by whim and fancy
definitions.zh: a. 轻浮的, 轻狂的, 心情浮动的

examples.en: She is too flighty to focus on one job.
examples.zh: 她太轻浮了，无法专注于一份工作。

examples.en: His flighty behavior annoyed his friends.
examples.zh: 他轻狂的行为惹恼了朋友们。

definitions.en: v put in motion or move to act
definitions.zh: vt. 开动, 驱使, 激励

examples.en: The machine is actuated by a simple lever.
examples.zh: 这台机器由一个简单的杠杆开动。

examples.en: His speech actuated the crowd to take action.
examples.zh: 他的演讲激励人群采取行动。

definitions.en: n. (music) an electronic instrument (usually played with a keyboard) that generates and modifies sounds electronically and can imitate a variety of other musical instruments
definitions.zh: n. 合成器, 综合者
[计] 合成器

examples.en: The musician used a synthesizer for the song.
examples.zh: 音乐家为这首歌使用了合成器。

examples.en: A synthesizer can create many different sounds.
examples.zh: 合成器可以创造许多不同的声音。

definitions.en: n. an instance of oratory
definitions.zh: n. 演说, 致辞, 引语

examples.en: The president gave a moving oration at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 总统在典礼上发表了感人的演说。

examples.en: Her oration inspired the entire audience.
examples.zh: 她的致辞激励了全体观众。

definitions.en: s. (used of armor) having overlapping metal plates attached to a leather backing
definitions.zh: a. 有鳞(斑)的, 瓦片迭盖的, 栉比鳞次的

examples.en: The scaled armor protected the knight well.
examples.zh: 鳞甲很好地保护了骑士。

examples.en: The fish had a beautifully scaled body.
examples.zh: 那条鱼有着美丽的鳞片身体。

definitions.en: v. impart gradually
definitions.zh: vt. 滴注, 慢慢地灌输

examples.en: Teachers instill knowledge in their students.
examples.zh: 老师向学生灌输知识。

examples.en: Parents instill good values in their children.
examples.zh: 父母向孩子慢慢灌输良好的价值观。

definitions.en: s eminent beyond or above comparison
definitions.zh: a. 无比的, 出类的, 无双的

examples.en: Her peerless beauty amazed everyone at the event.
examples.zh: 她无比的美貌惊艳了活动中的每个人。

examples.en: The athlete's skill is peerless in the world.
examples.zh: 这位运动员的技能在世界上无双。

definitions.en: v take exception to
definitions.zh: vt. 否定, 反驳
n. 否认, 反驳, 反对

examples.en: No one can gainsay the truth of his statement.
examples.zh: 没有人能否认他陈述的真实性。

examples.en: She dared to gainsay the popular opinion.
examples.zh: 她敢于反驳流行的观点。

definitions.en: v. requisition forcibly, as of enemy property
definitions.zh: vt. 使隐退, 使隔绝, 扣押, 没收

definitions.en: v. undergo sequestration by forming a stable compound with an ion
definitions.zh: [化] 螯合剂; 多价螯合剂

examples.en: The judge decided to sequester the jury.
examples.zh: 法官决定隔离陪审团。

examples.en: They sequester the witness for safety.
examples.zh: 他们为安全隔离证人。

definitions.en: n. feeling an inappropriate lack of seriousness
definitions.zh: n. 轻率, 轻浮, 不稳定

examples.en: His levity during the meeting annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他在会议上的轻浮惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: We need seriousness, not levity, right now.
examples.zh: 我们现在需要严肃，而不是轻率。

definitions.en: a. large and roomy (`convenient' is archaic in this sense)
definitions.zh: a. 宽敞的, 方便的

examples.en: The new house has a commodious living room.
examples.zh: 新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。

examples.en: This closet is commodious enough for all clothes.
examples.zh: 这个壁橱足够宽敞，能放所有衣服。

definitions.en: v. tear or be torn violently
definitions.zh: vt. 分裂, 劈开, 强夺, 撕碎, 划破
vi. 撕开, 裂开

examples.en: The loud noise rent the silence of the night.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音划破了夜晚的寂静。

examples.en: The storm rent the old tree in two.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把老树劈成了两半。

definitions.en: n. a stupid person; these words are used to express a low opinion of someone's intelligence
definitions.zh: n. 智力迟钝的学生, 傻瓜

examples.en: The teacher called him a dunce for failing.
examples.zh: 老师因他不及格而叫他傻瓜。

examples.en: Don't be a dunce; study for the test.
examples.zh: 别当傻瓜；为考试学习。

definitions.en: v. admit openly and bluntly; make no bones about
definitions.zh: vt. 坦率承认, 断言
[法] 公开宣称, 声明, 供认

examples.en: He avowed his love for her publicly.
examples.zh: 他公开承认了对她的爱。

examples.en: She avowed that she had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 她坦率承认自己犯了错误。

definitions.en: s. long and thin and often limp
definitions.zh: a. 瘦的, 细长的, 长而柔软的

examples.en: Her hair was lank and lifeless after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后她的头发又细又无生气。

examples.en: The lank grass lay flat on the ground.
examples.zh: 细长的草平躺在地上。

definitions.en: s. feeling or caused to feel uneasy and self-conscious
definitions.zh: a. 不安的, 窘迫的

examples.en: He felt abashed after making a mistake.
examples.zh: 犯错后他感到窘迫。

examples.en: She was abashed by the unexpected compliment.
examples.zh: 她因意外的赞美而局促不安。

definitions.en: n. (biology) a taxonomic group that is a division of a species; usually arises as a consequence of geographical isolation within a species
definitions.zh: n. 亚种

examples.en: This bird is a subspecies of the common sparrow.
examples.zh: 这种鸟是普通麻雀的一个亚种。

examples.en: Scientists discovered a new subspecies of frog.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了一种新的青蛙亚种。

definitions.en: n. music with a syncopated melody (usually for the piano)
definitions.zh: n. 雷格泰姆旋律, 散拍乐
a. 滑稽的

examples.en: Ragtime music was popular in the early 1900s.
examples.zh: 雷格泰姆音乐在20世纪初很流行。

examples.en: He played a lively ragtime tune on the piano.
examples.zh: 他在钢琴上弹奏了一首活泼的雷格泰姆曲调。

definitions.en: v. cause to form a united, orderly, and aesthetically consistent whole
definitions.zh: vi. 附着, 粘着, 凝聚, 一致

definitions.en: v. have internal elements or parts logically connected so that aesthetic consistency results
definitions.zh: [建] 粘合

examples.en: The team's ideas cohere into a strong plan.
examples.zh: 团队的想法凝聚成一个强有力的计划。

examples.en: These two parts do not cohere well together.
examples.zh: 这两个部分不能很好地粘合在一起。

definitions.en: n. hand tool for boring holes
definitions.zh: n. 螺旋钻, 木螺钻
[机] 木螺钻

examples.en: He used an auger to drill a hole in the wood.
examples.zh: 他用螺旋钻在木头上钻孔。

examples.en: The auger made clean holes for the fence posts.
examples.zh: 螺旋钻为栅栏桩钻出了干净的洞。

definitions.en: n. a person who owns or operates a ranch
definitions.zh: n. 大农场经营者, 牧场工人

examples.en: The rancher raised cattle on the open land.
examples.zh: 牧场主在开阔的土地上养牛。

examples.en: A rancher must care for many animals daily.
examples.zh: 牧场主每天必须照顾许多动物。

definitions.en: v be interwoven or interconnected
definitions.zh: [计] 转接的, 转换的

examples.en: The interconnecting roads make travel easy.
examples.zh: 相互连接的道路使旅行变得容易。

examples.en: These interconnecting pipes carry water to the house.
examples.zh: 这些相互连接的管道把水输送到房子。

definitions.en: v make off with belongings of others
definitions.zh: vt. 偷窃, 窃取

examples.en: He tried to filch a cookie from the jar.
examples.zh: 他试图从罐子里偷一块饼干。

examples.en: Someone filched my pen from the desk.
examples.zh: 有人从桌上偷了我的笔。

definitions.en: n. a musician who plays the trumpet or cornet
definitions.zh: n. 小号吹奏者, 号兵, 吹鼓手

examples.en: The trumpeter played a loud and clear note.
examples.zh: 小号手吹奏了一个响亮而清晰的音符。

examples.en: A skilled trumpeter led the marching band.
examples.zh: 一位熟练的小号手带领着行进乐队。

definitions.en: s. ostentatiously lofty in style
definitions.zh: a. 夸大的, 夸夸其谈的

examples.en: His bombastic speech bored the audience.
examples.zh: 他夸夸其谈的演讲让观众厌烦。

examples.en: Avoid bombastic language in simple writing.
examples.zh: 在简单的写作中避免夸大的语言。

definitions.en: n. an irreverent mental attitude
definitions.zh: n. 不敬, 非礼, 不敬行为

examples.en: His irreverence towards tradition shocked many.
examples.zh: 他对传统的不敬让许多人震惊。

examples.en: The comedian's irreverence made the audience laugh.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员的不敬让观众大笑。

definitions.en: n the feeling of being bored by something tedious
definitions.zh: n. 倦怠, 厌倦
[医] 厌倦

examples.en: He felt a deep ennui during the long meeting.
examples.zh: 在漫长的会议中他感到深深的倦怠。

examples.en: Ennui set in after weeks of doing nothing.
examples.zh: 几周无所事事之后，厌倦感袭来。

definitions.en: v. raise the status of
definitions.zh: vt. 增威严, 使高贵, 故作显贵

examples.en: We should dignify our work with pride.
examples.zh: 我们应该以自豪来使工作高贵。

examples.en: The ceremony will dignify the occasion.
examples.zh: 这个仪式将使场合增威严。

definitions.en: n. the ritual washing of a priest's hands or of sacred vessels
definitions.zh: n. 洗澡, 洗礼, 斋戒沐浴
[化] 洗净; 洗净液

examples.en: The priest performed the ritual ablution before prayer.
examples.zh: 牧师在祈祷前进行了仪式性的沐浴。

examples.en: Ablution is part of many religious traditions.
examples.zh: 沐浴是许多宗教传统的一部分。

definitions.en: s after the expected or usual time; delayed
definitions.zh: a. 慢的, 迟到的, 勉强的, 拖拉的, 迟的

examples.en: She was tardy for the morning class again.
examples.zh: 她早上上课又迟到了。

examples.en: A tardy response can cause problems.
examples.zh: 迟到的回复可能会引发问题。

definitions.en: n audacious (even arrogant) behavior that you have no right to
definitions.zh: n. 厚颜无耻

examples.en: He had the effrontery to ask for a raise.
examples.zh: 他厚颜无耻地要求加薪。

examples.en: Her effrontery shocked everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的厚颜无耻震惊了房间里的每个人。

definitions.en: a. disposed to believe on little evidence
definitions.zh: a. 轻信的, 易受骗的

examples.en: Credulous people often fall for scams.
examples.zh: 轻信的人常常上当受骗。

examples.en: She is too credulous to question his story.
examples.zh: 她太轻信了，不会质疑他的说法。

definitions.en: n. the most important spring in a mechanical device (especially a clock or watch); as it uncoils it drives the mechanism
definitions.zh: n. 主发条, 主要动机, 主要原因, 主要动力
[法] 主要动机, 主要原因, 主要动力

examples.en: The mainspring of the watch broke yesterday.
examples.zh: 手表的主发条昨天断了。

examples.en: Curiosity is the mainspring of scientific discovery.
examples.zh: 好奇心是科学发现的主要动力。

definitions.en: s. especially tense; especially in some dialects
definitions.zh: v. 压缩, 压紧, 使收缩( constrict的过去式和过去分词)

examples.en: The snake's body constricted around its prey.
examples.zh: 蛇的身体压缩在猎物周围。

examples.en: He felt constricted in the small room.
examples.zh: 他在小房间里感到压抑。

definitions.en: s. incapable of being morally corrupted
definitions.zh: a. 不腐败的, 不能收买的, 清廉的

examples.en: The judge was known to be incorruptible.
examples.zh: 那位法官以清廉著称。

examples.en: An incorruptible leader earns the people's trust.
examples.zh: 一个清廉的领导者赢得人民的信任。

definitions.en: v cause to be alert and energetic
definitions.zh: vt. 使活跃, 激励, 供给...能量

definitions.en: v raise to a higher energy level
definitions.zh: [电] 激励

examples.en: A good breakfast will energize you.
examples.zh: 一顿好早餐会让你充满活力。

examples.en: The coach's speech energized the whole team.
examples.zh: 教练的讲话激励了整个团队。

definitions.en: v. arrange according to a system or reduce to a system
definitions.zh: vt. 使组织化, 使系统化, 把...分类
[医] 系统化, 分类

examples.en: We need to systematize our filing system.
examples.zh: 我们需要使归档系统化。

examples.en: The manager wants to systematize all processes.
examples.zh: 经理想把所有流程系统化。

definitions.en: n. pit viper with horny segments at the end of the tail that rattle when shaken
definitions.zh: n. 响尾蛇
[医] 响尾蛇

examples.en: A rattlesnake can be very dangerous.
examples.zh: 响尾蛇可能非常危险。

examples.en: We heard a rattlesnake in the desert.
examples.zh: 我们在沙漠里听到了一条响尾蛇。

definitions.en: s (of soil) soft and watery
definitions.zh: a. 沼泽的, 沼泽多的, 湿地的, 松软的

examples.en: The swampy ground made walking difficult.
examples.zh: 沼泽的地面使行走困难。

examples.en: They built a house in a swampy area.
examples.zh: 他们在沼泽地区建了一所房子。

definitions.en: a. capable of being dispensed with or done without
definitions.zh: a. 不是必要的, 可有可无的

examples.en: This old chair is dispensable now.
examples.zh: 这把旧椅子现在可有可无。

examples.en: Some items in the kit are dispensable.
examples.zh: 工具箱里有些物品不是必需的。

definitions.en: n. someone who plays a violoncello
definitions.zh: n. 大提琴演奏家

examples.en: The cellist played a beautiful melody.
examples.zh: 大提琴演奏家演奏了一首优美的旋律。

examples.en: A famous cellist performed at the concert.
examples.zh: 一位著名的大提琴家在音乐会上表演。

definitions.en: n. use of the same consonant at the beginning of each stressed syllable in a line of verse
definitions.zh: n. 头韵
[医] 同音韵错误症

examples.en: The poem uses alliteration for effect.
examples.zh: 这首诗使用头韵来增强效果。

examples.en: Alliteration repeats the same starting sound.
examples.zh: 头韵重复相同的起始音。

definitions.en: a. deserving of respect or high regard
definitions.zh: a. 可尊敬的, 可估计的

examples.en: She is an estimable teacher in our school.
examples.zh: 她是我们学校一位可敬的老师。

examples.en: His estimable work earned him respect.
examples.zh: 他可敬的工作赢得了尊重。

definitions.en: v. make inconspicuous
definitions.zh: vt. 抹去, 消除, 忘却

examples.en: Time will efface the painful memories.
examples.zh: 时间会抹去痛苦的记忆。

examples.en: She tried to efface herself from the group.
examples.zh: 她试图在群体中不引人注目。

definitions.en: v indicate by signs
definitions.zh: vt. 成为...的前兆, 预知, 给与...的警告

examples.en: Dark clouds portend a coming storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: This event may portend future trouble.
examples.zh: 这个事件可能预示着未来的麻烦。

definitions.en: s. marked by speed and efficiency
definitions.zh: a. 迅速的, 敏捷的

examples.en: We need an expeditious solution to this.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个迅速的解决方案。

examples.en: The expeditious delivery pleased the customer.
examples.zh: 迅速的送货让顾客满意。

definitions.en: n a sudden violent change in the earth's surface
definitions.zh: n. 大洪水, 地震, (社会政治的)大变动

definitions.en: n an event resulting in great loss and misfortune
definitions.zh: [医] 渗出, 渗液, 猝变, 聚变

examples.en: The earthquake was a terrible cataclysm.
examples.zh: 地震是一场可怕的灾难。

examples.en: War can cause a social cataclysm.
examples.zh: 战争可能导致社会大变动。

definitions.en: n. the product of vaporization of a solid
definitions.zh: vt. 使升华, 使高尚

definitions.en: v. direct energy or urges into useful activities
definitions.zh: vi. 升华, 纯化

definitions.en: s. made pure
definitions.zh: a. 纯净化的, 高尚的, 理想化的

examples.en: Art can sublimate strong emotions.
examples.zh: 艺术可以升华强烈的情感。

examples.en: He sublimated his anger into creative work.
examples.zh: 他把愤怒升华为创造性工作。

definitions.en: v. make peace with
definitions.zh: vt. 慰抚, 安抚, 和解, 谋求...的好感

examples.en: They offered gifts to propitiate the gods.
examples.zh: 他们献上礼物以安抚神灵。

examples.en: He tried to propitiate his angry boss.
examples.zh: 他试图安抚生气的老板。

definitions.en: a. free from impediment or obstruction or hindrance
definitions.zh: a. 没有障碍的, 没有阻挡的

examples.en: The view from the hill was unobstructed.
examples.zh: 从山丘上看到的景色没有阻挡。

examples.en: We need an unobstructed path to the door.
examples.zh: 我们需要一条没有障碍的通往门的路。

definitions.en: v. cause to be off balance
definitions.zh: vt. 使倾覆, (重量、价值)超过, 使失去均衡, 跌倒
vi. 失去平衡
n. 超重, 超量, 失去平衡

examples.en: The heavy load caused the cart to overbalance.
examples.zh: 重物导致手推车倾覆。

examples.en: He overbalanced and fell off the ladder.
examples.zh: 他失去平衡从梯子上摔了下来。

definitions.en: n. a gear with a small number of teeth designed to mesh with a larger wheel or rack
definitions.zh: n. 鸟翼, 翅膀, 翅前翼, 羽毛, 小齿轮

definitions.en: v. bind the arms of
definitions.zh: vt. 剪断翼尖, 绑住...两臂

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the broken pinion gear.
examples.zh: 机械师更换了损坏的小齿轮。

examples.en: They had to pinion the prisoner's arms.
examples.zh: 他们不得不绑住囚犯的两臂。

definitions.en: n. a person who writes the words for songs
definitions.zh: n. 抒情诗人, 歌曲作者

examples.en: The lyricist wrote beautiful words for the song.
examples.zh: 歌词作者为这首歌写了优美的词。

examples.en: A good lyricist can tell a story with words.
examples.zh: 一个好的歌词作者可以用词讲故事。

definitions.en: n. the state of having rejected your religious beliefs or your political party or a cause (often in favor of opposing beliefs or causes)
definitions.zh: n. 叛教, 变节, 脱党

definitions.en: n. the act of abandoning a party for cause
definitions.zh: [法] 叛教, 背教, 脱党

examples.en: His apostasy shocked the entire community.
examples.zh: 他的叛教震惊了整个社区。

examples.en: Apostasy is rare in that strict religion.
examples.zh: 在那个严格的宗教中，背教很少见。

definitions.en: s slow and apathetic
definitions.zh: a. 麻痹的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 蛰伏的

definitions.en: s in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation
definitions.zh: [医] 迟钝的, 不活泼的, 缓慢的

examples.en: The bear was torpid during winter hibernation.
examples.zh: 熊在冬眠期间是迟钝的。

examples.en: He felt torpid after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病之后他感到迟缓无力。

definitions.en: v. be uncomfortably hot
definitions.zh: vi. 闷热, 被暑气所苦, 汗流浃背

definitions.en: v. suffer from intense heat
definitions.zh: vt. 使闷热, 使热得出汗
n. 闷热

examples.en: We swelter in the heat of summer.
examples.zh: 我们在夏天的炎热中汗流浃背。

examples.en: The workers swelter under the hot sun.
examples.zh: 工人们在烈日下闷热难耐。

definitions.en: n adult male chicken
definitions.zh: n. 公鸡, 栖息的鸟
[机] 炉篦

examples.en: The rooster crows every morning at dawn.
examples.zh: 公鸡每天黎明时打鸣。

examples.en: A rooster has a red comb on its head.
examples.zh: 公鸡头上有一个红色的鸡冠。

definitions.en: v push to thrust outward
definitions.zh: vt. 逼使, 强迫, 伸出

definitions.en: v thrust oneself in as if by force
definitions.zh: vi. 打扰, 强行闯入

examples.en: He tends to obtrude his opinions on others.
examples.zh: 他倾向于把自己的意见强加给别人。

examples.en: Don't obtrude into their private conversation.
examples.zh: 不要强行闯入他们的私人谈话。

definitions.en: v. treat with fumes, expose to fumes, especially with the aim of disinfecting or eradicating pests
definitions.zh: vt. 熏制
[医] 熏烟

examples.en: They fumigate the house to kill pests.
examples.zh: 他们熏制房子以杀死害虫。

examples.en: The doctor will fumigate the hospital room.
examples.zh: 医生将熏蒸医院房间。

definitions.en: n. the highest level or degree attainable; the highest stage of development
definitions.zh: n. 顶点, 极度, 最高点
[医] 极期

examples.en: She reached the acme of her career at forty.
examples.zh: 她在四十岁达到了事业的顶点。

examples.en: The acme of his success was winning the award.
examples.zh: 他成功的顶点是赢得奖项。

definitions.en: s. excessively fat
definitions.zh: a. 肥大的, 肥胖的
[医] 肥胖的

examples.en: The corpulent man struggled to climb the stairs.
examples.zh: 那个肥胖的男人爬楼梯很吃力。

examples.en: A corpulent cat sat lazily on the sofa.
examples.zh: 一只肥猫懒洋洋地坐在沙发上。

definitions.en: n. any distracting or deceptive maneuver (as a mock attack)
definitions.zh: n. 伪装, 假装, 假托, 佯攻

definitions.en: v. deceive by a mock action
definitions.zh: vi. 装作, 假装, 佯攻
a. 假的, 虚饰的

examples.en: The boxer made a feint to the left.
examples.zh: 拳击手向左做了一个假动作。

examples.en: She feinted a pass and then shot the ball.
examples.zh: 她佯装传球，然后射门。

definitions.en: r. in a lyrical manner
definitions.zh: adv. 抒情地；诗意地；狂热地

examples.en: She sang lyrically and moved the audience.
examples.zh: 她抒情地歌唱，感动了观众。

examples.en: The poem was written lyrically with emotion.
examples.zh: 这首诗写得充满情感和诗意。

definitions.en: n. any substance that propels
definitions.zh: n. 推进剂, 发射火药, 推进者

definitions.en: s. tending to or capable of propelling
definitions.zh: [化] 火药

examples.en: The rocket uses liquid propellant for power.
examples.zh: 火箭使用液体推进剂提供动力。

examples.en: This spray can contains a safe propellant.
examples.zh: 这个喷雾罐含有安全的推进剂。

definitions.en: a. having come into contact
definitions.zh: a. 精神不太正常的, 受感动的

examples.en: She was deeply touched by his kindness.
examples.zh: 她被他的善良深深感动了。

examples.en: He touched the soft fabric gently.
examples.zh: 他轻轻地触摸了柔软的布料。

definitions.en: v lengthen in time; cause to be or last longer
definitions.zh: vt. 延长, 拖延, 伸出, 绘制
[法] 延迟, 拖延, 延长

examples.en: They tried not to protract the meeting.
examples.zh: 他们尽量不延长会议。

examples.en: The illness protract his recovery time.
examples.zh: 疾病拖延了他的康复时间。

definitions.en: v express criticism towards
definitions.zh: vt. 谴责, 责骂, 申斥

examples.en: The teacher upbraid the student for cheating.
examples.zh: 老师因作弊而责骂学生。

examples.en: She upbraid him for his rude behavior.
examples.zh: 她因他的粗鲁行为而谴责他。

definitions.en: n. a disparaging remark
definitions.zh: n. 诽谤, 中伤, 洒水

definitions.en: n. an abusive attack on a person's character or good name
definitions.zh: [医] 喷洒[法]

examples.en: He cast an aspersion on her reputation.
examples.zh: 他对她的名誉进行了诽谤。

examples.en: The aspersion hurt her deeply.
examples.zh: 这种中伤深深地伤害了她。

definitions.en: v formally reject or disavow a formerly held belief, usually under pressure
definitions.zh: vt. 放弃
vi. 放弃信仰, 撤回声明, 公开认错

examples.en: The politician recant his earlier statement.
examples.zh: 那位政治家撤回了他先前的声明。

examples.en: She recant her false testimony in court.
examples.zh: 她在法庭上撤回虚假证词。

definitions.en: n. someone who demands exact conformity to rules and forms
definitions.zh: n. 严格执行纪律的人

examples.en: The teacher is a strict martinet about rules.
examples.zh: 这位老师对规则是个严格的纪律执行者。

examples.en: A martinet demands perfect order in the classroom.
examples.zh: 一个严格执行纪律的人要求教室完美有序。
