examples.en: Covetous desires can lead to unhappiness.
examples.zh: 贪婪的欲望可能导致不快乐。

definitions.en: s greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement
definitions.zh: a. 优秀的, 超群的, 卓越的

examples.en: She is a preeminent scientist in her field.
examples.zh: 她是她领域内卓越的科学家。

examples.en: This museum has a preeminent art collection.
examples.zh: 这个博物馆拥有超群的艺术收藏。

definitions.en: v mix together different elements
definitions.zh: a. 熔化的, 熔凝的

examples.en: The metals fused together under high heat.
examples.zh: 金属在高温下熔合在一起。

examples.en: The two companies fused into one large firm.
examples.zh: 两家公司合并成一家大公司。

definitions.en: n. quantity that can be carried by a train
definitions.zh: n. 装载量, 列车载重

examples.en: A trainload of coal arrived at the station.
examples.zh: 一列车的煤到达了车站。

examples.en: The factory received a trainload of supplies.
examples.zh: 工厂收到了一列车的补给。

definitions.en: s exposing human folly to ridicule
definitions.zh: a. 讽刺的, 挖苦的

examples.en: His satiric comments made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 他讽刺的评论让所有人都笑了。

examples.en: The satiric cartoon criticized the politician.
examples.zh: 这幅讽刺漫画批评了那位政客。

definitions.en: n. someone elected to honorary membership in an academy
definitions.zh: n. 学会会员, 院士, 学究, 大学生, 学者

examples.en: The academician gave a lecture on physics.
examples.zh: 院士做了一场关于物理的讲座。

examples.en: She was elected as an academician last year.
examples.zh: 她去年被选为学会会员。

definitions.en: s. easily influenced
definitions.zh: a. 易延展的, 韧性的, 易教导的

definitions.en: s. capable of being shaped or bent or drawn out
definitions.zh: [医] 延伸性的

examples.en: Gold is a very ductile metal.
examples.zh: 金是一种非常易延展的金属。

examples.en: The ductile wire can be bent easily.
examples.zh: 这种韧性的电线容易弯曲。

definitions.en: n. the person who operates the projector in a movie house
definitions.zh: n. 放映员, 电视技师, 地图制作者

examples.en: The projectionist started the movie on time.
examples.zh: 放映员准时开始了电影。

examples.en: A good projectionist ensures clear images.
examples.zh: 好的放映员确保画面清晰。

definitions.en: a. having become fixed and definite in form
definitions.zh: a. [医]结晶的, 使晶状的

definitions.en: s. having both internal structure and external form of a crystal
definitions.zh: v. 使结晶( crystallize的过去式和过去分词); 计划成型, 具体化

examples.en: The sugar crystallized into small crystals.
examples.zh: 糖结晶成了小晶体。

examples.en: Her plan crystallized after much thought.
examples.zh: 她的计划经过深思熟虑后成型了。

definitions.en: r. not in accordance with the season
definitions.zh: adv. 反季节地；不合季节地

examples.en: The weather is unseasonably warm today.
examples.zh: 今天天气反常地暖和。

examples.en: It snowed unseasonably in early autumn.
examples.zh: 初秋时下了一场不合季节的雪。

definitions.en: v. insulate against noise
definitions.zh: a. 隔音的

examples.en: The room is completely soundproof.
examples.zh: 这个房间完全隔音。

examples.en: They soundproofed the recording studio.
examples.zh: 他们给录音室做了隔音处理。

definitions.en: n the amount of cargo that can be held by a boat or ship or a freight car
definitions.zh: n. 船货, 大量
[经] 船货, 船双运载量, 大量

examples.en: A shipload of goods arrived at the port.
examples.zh: 一船货物抵达了港口。

examples.en: They ordered a shipload of new books.
examples.zh: 他们订购了大量新书。

definitions.en: n. concerned with theoretical possibilities rather than actual use
definitions.zh: n. 不切实际, 办不到

examples.en: The plan's impracticality was soon obvious.
examples.zh: 这个计划的不切实际很快就显而易见了。

examples.en: He ignored the impracticality of his idea.
examples.zh: 他忽略了自己想法的不切实际。

definitions.en: n. a building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented
definitions.zh: n. 戏院, 电影院, 剧场, 全体观众, 戏剧, 戏剧效果, 阶梯式讲堂, 场所

examples.en: We went to the theater to see a play.
examples.zh: 我们去剧院看了一场戏。

examples.en: The theater was full of excited people.
examples.zh: 剧院里挤满了兴奋的人。

definitions.en: n. one of two (approximately) equal parts
definitions.zh: n. 一半, 一部分, 应得之份

definitions.en: n. one of two basic subdivisions of a tribe
definitions.zh: [医] 等分, 一半, 一部分

examples.en: She received a moiety of the inheritance.
examples.zh: 她得到了遗产的一半。

examples.en: The tribe was divided into two moieties.
examples.zh: 这个部落分为两个半族。

definitions.en: n. a place where eggs are hatched under artificial conditions (especially fish eggs)
definitions.zh: n. 孵卵处

examples.en: The hatchery raises thousands of fish each year.
examples.zh: 这个孵卵所每年培育数千条鱼。

examples.en: Workers at the hatchery care for the eggs.
examples.zh: 孵卵所的工作人员照料这些蛋。

definitions.en: s. set in a rigidly conventional pattern of behavior, habits, or beliefs
definitions.zh: v. 使成化石( fossilize的过去式和过去分词); 使陈腐; 变成化石; 变陈腐

examples.en: His fossilized ideas are hard to change.
examples.zh: 他那些陈腐的想法很难改变。

examples.en: The fossilized remains were found in the rock.
examples.zh: 化石残骸在岩石中被发现。

definitions.en: a. inhabiting or frequenting trees
definitions.zh: a. 树的, 栖于树木的

definitions.en: s. resembling a tree in form and branching structure
definitions.zh: [医] 树的, 树上生活的

examples.en: Monkeys are arboreal animals living in trees.
examples.zh: 猴子是生活在树上的树栖动物。

examples.en: The arboreal habitat is rich in biodiversity.
examples.zh: 树栖栖息地生物多样性丰富。

definitions.en: n. a doctrine of reform
definitions.zh: n. 改良主义

examples.en: Reformism seeks gradual change in society.
examples.zh: 改良主义寻求社会的渐进变革。

examples.en: Many politicians support reformism over revolution.
examples.zh: 许多政治家支持改良主义而非革命。

definitions.en: v move or cause to move with a sudden jerky motion
definitions.zh: n. 震压造型；震动

examples.en: The jolting bus made me feel sick.
examples.zh: 颠簸的公交车让我感到恶心。

examples.en: He woke up to a jolting noise outside.
examples.zh: 他被外面一声震动惊醒。

definitions.en: s having many aspects
definitions.zh: a. 多层面的

examples.en: She has a multifaceted talent in music.
examples.zh: 她在音乐方面有多方面的才能。

examples.en: The problem is multifaceted and needs careful study.
examples.zh: 这个问题是多层面的，需要仔细研究。

definitions.en: v. cook in nearly boiling water
definitions.zh: vt. 娇养, 溺爱, 用文火煮(蛋)

examples.en: Parents should not coddle their children too much.
examples.zh: 父母不应过分溺爱孩子。

examples.en: She likes to coddle eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她喜欢用文火煮鸡蛋当早餐。

definitions.en: n. a mass of snow heaped up by the wind
definitions.zh: n. (被风刮在一起的)雪堆, 随风飘飞的雪

examples.en: The car got stuck in a snowdrift.
examples.zh: 汽车陷在雪堆里了。

examples.en: Children played in the large snowdrift.
examples.zh: 孩子们在大雪堆里玩耍。

definitions.zh: n. 工匠；手艺人；工艺师

examples.en: The craftspeople made beautiful pottery by hand.
examples.zh: 工匠们手工制作了精美的陶器。

examples.en: Local craftspeople sell their work at the market.
examples.zh: 当地手工艺人在市场上出售他们的作品。

definitions.en: v be earlier in time; go back further
definitions.zh: vt. 先于, 前于

definitions.en: v establish something as being earlier relative to something else
definitions.zh: [经] 提前日期(比实际毋早的日期)

examples.en: This artifact antedates the Roman era.
examples.zh: 这件人工制品先于罗马时代。

examples.en: The document antedates the contract by a week.
examples.zh: 这份文件比合同早一周。

definitions.en: n. ribbonlike flatworms that are parasitic in the intestines of humans and other vertebrates
definitions.zh: n. 绦虫
[医] 绦虫

examples.en: The dog had a tapeworm and needed treatment.
examples.zh: 这只狗有绦虫，需要治疗。

examples.en: Tapeworms can live in the human intestine.
examples.zh: 绦虫可以寄生在人体肠道内。

definitions.en: a. Of or pertaining to iconography.
definitions.zh: a. 图像材料的；肖像学的；肖像的；图示法的象征

examples.en: The iconographic analysis revealed hidden symbols.
examples.zh: 图像材料分析揭示了隐藏的符号。

examples.en: She studied iconographic traditions in ancient art.
examples.zh: 她研究了古代艺术中的肖像学传统。

definitions.en: n. a loud low warning signal that can be heard by fogbound ships
definitions.zh: n. 雾号, 响而尖的声音

examples.en: The foghorn sounded loudly in the harbor.
examples.zh: 雾号在港口发出响亮的声音。

examples.en: Sailors rely on the foghorn during thick fog.
examples.zh: 水手们在浓雾中依赖雾号。

definitions.en: n. the removal of salt (especially from sea water)
definitions.zh: [化] 脱盐
[医] 脱盐[作用], 去盐[作用]

examples.en: Desalination turns seawater into fresh water.
examples.zh: 脱盐将海水转化为淡水。

examples.en: The city built a new desalination plant.
examples.zh: 这座城市建了一座新的脱盐厂。

definitions.en: s. without profit or reward
definitions.zh: a. 无利的, 无益的

examples.en: The business was profitless and had to close.
examples.zh: 这家生意无利可图，不得不关闭。

examples.en: He considered the task profitless and boring.
examples.zh: 他认为这项任务无益且无聊。

definitions.en: a. compulsively or physiologically dependent on something habit-forming
definitions.zh: a. 沉溺于...的, 无法摆脱(某种嗜好)的
[法] 嗜, 好, 惯于

examples.en: He is addicted to playing video games.
examples.zh: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。

examples.en: She became addicted to coffee.
examples.zh: 她变得对咖啡上瘾。

definitions.en: n. the quality or habit of not adhering to a correct or usual or expected time
definitions.zh: n. 慢, 缓慢, 迟延

examples.en: His tardiness made the teacher angry.
examples.zh: 他的迟到让老师生气了。

examples.en: Tardiness is not acceptable in this company.
examples.zh: 在这家公司，迟到是不可接受的。

definitions.en: n. a lack of sophistication
definitions.zh: n. 乡下习气, 方言, 地方风俗

examples.en: His provincialism made him dislike new ideas.
examples.zh: 他的乡下习气让他不喜欢新想法。

examples.en: The city's culture was free from provincialism.
examples.zh: 这座城市的文化没有地方偏见。

definitions.en: s free of guilt; not subject to blame
definitions.zh: a. 不可非难的, 无缺点的, 无过失的

examples.en: Her behavior was irreproachable and honest.
examples.zh: 她的行为无可指责且诚实。

examples.en: He has an irreproachable reputation at work.
examples.zh: 他在工作中有着无可挑剔的声誉。

definitions.en: v beat thoroughly and conclusively in a competition or fight
definitions.zh: vt. 用棒打, 殴打, 硬灌(观念等)
vi. 敲击

examples.en: Our team will drub the opponents today.
examples.zh: 我们队今天会痛击对手。

examples.en: He drubbed the rug to remove dust.
examples.zh: 他用力敲打地毯以去除灰尘。

definitions.en: s skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands
definitions.zh: a. 灵巧的, 惯用右手的

examples.en: The artist is dexterous with her hands.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家双手灵巧。

examples.en: He made a dexterous move to catch the ball.
examples.zh: 他灵巧地移动接住了球。

definitions.zh: n. 城市居民的生活方式, 城市化

examples.en: Urbanism studies how cities and people interact.
examples.zh: 城市化研究城市与人如何互动。

examples.en: Modern urbanism focuses on sustainable living.
examples.zh: 现代城市化关注可持续生活。

definitions.en: n an attendant employed at a beach or pool to protect swimmers from accidents
definitions.zh: n. 救命者, 救生员, 济急的人

examples.en: The lifesaver rescued the drowning child.
examples.zh: 救生员救起了溺水的孩子。

examples.en: A cup of coffee was a real lifesaver.
examples.zh: 一杯咖啡真是救急之物。

definitions.en: s. associated by chance and not an integral part
definitions.zh: a. 偶然的, 外来的
[医] 偶生的, 偶发的; 异位的

examples.en: The discovery was adventitious, not planned.
examples.zh: 这个发现是偶然的，不是计划好的。

examples.en: Adventitious roots grow from the stem.
examples.zh: 不定根从茎上生长出来。

definitions.en: n. range of what one can know or understand
definitions.zh: n. 认识, 察知, 审理

examples.en: He took cognizance of the new rules.
examples.zh: 他注意到了新规则。

examples.en: The court has cognizance of this case.
examples.zh: 法院对此案有审理权。

definitions.en: v. lessen the density or solidity of
definitions.zh: vt. 使稀少, 使稀薄, 使纯化, 精炼

definitions.en: v. make more subtle or refined
definitions.zh: vi. 变稀少, 变稀薄

examples.en: The air begins to rarefy at high altitudes.
examples.zh: 在高海拔地区，空气开始变得稀薄。

examples.en: Heat can rarefy the gas in the container.
examples.zh: 热量可以使容器中的气体变稀薄。

definitions.en: s. consisting of many cells
definitions.zh: a. 多细胞的
[医] 多细胞的; 多空隙的

examples.en: Humans are multicellular organisms with many cells.
examples.zh: 人类是多细胞生物，拥有许多细胞。

examples.en: Multicellular life evolved from simple ancestors.
examples.zh: 多细胞生命从简单的祖先进化而来。

definitions.en: v. convert to a fossil
definitions.zh: vt. 使成化石, 使陈腐

definitions.en: v. become mentally inflexible
definitions.zh: vi. 变成化石, 变陈腐

examples.en: The bones began to fossilize over time.
examples.zh: 骨头随着时间的推移开始变成化石。

examples.en: His ideas fossilize and never change.
examples.zh: 他的想法变得陈腐，从不改变。

definitions.en: n. being mixed with extraneous material; the product of adulterating
definitions.zh: n. 掺杂, 掺假的东西

definitions.en: n. the act of adulterating (especially the illicit substitution of one substance for another)
definitions.zh: [化] 掺杂; 掺加

examples.en: Adulteration of food is illegal in many countries.
examples.zh: 在许多国家，食品掺假是非法的。

examples.en: The company was fined for adulteration of milk.
examples.zh: 这家公司因牛奶掺假被罚款。

definitions.en: s. spanning or crossing or on the farther side of a continent
definitions.zh: a. 横贯大陆的, 大陆那边的

examples.en: The transcontinental railroad connected both coasts.
examples.zh: 横贯大陆的铁路连接了两岸。

examples.en: They took a transcontinental flight to New York.
examples.zh: 他们乘坐横贯大陆的航班去了纽约。

definitions.en: v. release from military service or remove from the active list of military service
definitions.zh: vt. 使复员, 使退伍, 遣散

examples.en: The army will demobilize soldiers after the war.
examples.zh: 军队将在战后遣散士兵。

examples.en: The government plans to demobilize the troops.
examples.zh: 政府计划让部队复员。

definitions.en: n. a cassette for videotape
definitions.zh: n. 盒式录像带

examples.en: He found an old videocassette in the attic.
examples.zh: 他在阁楼里找到了一盒旧录像带。

examples.en: The videocassette contained a recording of the wedding.
examples.zh: 这盒录像带里有婚礼的录像。

definitions.en: n. state of disgrace resulting from public abuse
definitions.zh: n. 辱骂, 毁谤, 耻辱

examples.en: He faced public obloquy for his actions.
examples.zh: 他的行为招致了公众辱骂。

examples.en: The politician endured much obloquy.
examples.zh: 那位政客忍受了许多毁谤。

definitions.en: s. preoccupied with the pursuit of pleasure and especially games of chance
definitions.zh: a. 沉迷于酒色的, 闲游浪荡的, 消失的

examples.en: He led a dissipated life full of parties.
examples.zh: 他过着沉迷酒色的生活，派对不断。

examples.en: The dissipated young man wasted all his money.
examples.zh: 那个放荡的年轻人挥霍了所有钱。

definitions.en: s. skillful in statecraft or management
definitions.zh: a. 睿智的, 聪明的, 贤明的, 伶俐的

examples.en: The sagacious leader made wise decisions.
examples.zh: 睿智的领导者做出了明智的决定。

examples.en: She is a sagacious businesswoman.
examples.zh: 她是一位聪明的女商人。

definitions.en: v. lessen or to try to lessen the seriousness or extent of
definitions.zh: vt. 减轻, 为...找借口
[法] 减轻, 低估, 藐视

examples.en: Nothing can extenuate his crime.
examples.zh: 没有什么能减轻他的罪行。

examples.en: She tried to extenuate her mistake.
examples.zh: 她试图为自己的错误找借口。

definitions.en: v. cause to become stonelike or stiff or dazed and stunned
definitions.zh: vt. (非正式)使惊呆, 使吓得要死, 使发呆
vt.vi. 使石化, 使成为化石, 使变僵, 变僵硬, 使消失活力, 使僵化

examples.en: The loud noise petrified the child.
examples.zh: 巨大的声响把孩子吓呆了。

examples.en: Wood can petrify over millions of years.
examples.zh: 木头经过数百万年可以石化。

definitions.en: n. a resident of a suburb
definitions.zh: n. 郊区居民

examples.en: The suburbanite commutes to the city every day.
examples.zh: 这位郊区居民每天通勤到城市。

examples.en: Many suburbanites enjoy quiet neighborhoods and gardens.
examples.zh: 许多郊区居民喜欢安静的社区和花园。

definitions.en: v. tire excessively
definitions.zh: vt.使过度疲劳

examples.en: Don't overtire yourself before the big race.
examples.zh: 在大赛前不要让自己过度疲劳。

examples.en: Working too hard can overtire your body.
examples.zh: 工作太辛苦会使身体过度疲劳。

definitions.en: n. One who improvises.
definitions.zh: n. 即兴创作者

examples.en: The jazz musician is a skilled improviser.
examples.zh: 这位爵士音乐家是熟练的即兴创作者。

examples.en: As an improviser, she creates songs on the spot.
examples.zh: 作为即兴创作者，她当场创作歌曲。

definitions.en: v. be a signal for or a symptom of
definitions.zh: vt. 预约, 订, 表示
n. 预约

examples.en: His calm voice bespeaks confidence.
examples.zh: 他平静的声音表示自信。

examples.en: The luxury car bespeaks wealth.
examples.zh: 这辆豪车表示财富。

definitions.en: n a coating of gold or of something that looks like gold
definitions.zh: n. 镀金, 镀金材料, 涂金, 虚饰的外观, 假象

definitions.en: v decorate with, or as if with, gold leaf or liquid gold
definitions.zh: [计] 镀金, 装金

examples.en: The gilding on the frame was very shiny.
examples.zh: 画框上的镀金非常闪亮。

examples.en: They used gold leaf for the gilding process.
examples.zh: 他们用金箔进行镀金工艺。

definitions.en: n. the 100th anniversary (or the celebration of it)
definitions.zh: n. 百年纪念

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or completing a period of 100 years
definitions.zh: a. 一百年的

examples.en: The town celebrated its centennial with a parade.
examples.zh: 小镇用游行庆祝了百年纪念。

examples.en: The centennial event honored the city's history.
examples.zh: 百年纪念活动致敬了这座城市的历史。

definitions.en: n. a person who has received a degree from a school (high school or college or university)
definitions.zh: n. 男毕业生, 男校友

examples.en: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
examples.zh: 他是哈佛大学的校友。

examples.en: The alumnus donated money to his old school.
examples.zh: 这位校友向他的母校捐了钱。

definitions.en: s having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
definitions.zh: a. 熟练的, 巧妙的

definitions.en: s done with delicacy and skill
definitions.zh: [机] 熟练的

examples.en: He is a skillful painter.
examples.zh: 他是一位熟练的画家。

examples.en: The skillful worker fixed the car quickly.
examples.zh: 那位熟练的工人很快修好了车。

definitions.en: n. German philosopher who advocated intuition over reason (1744-1803)
definitions.zh: n. 牧人, (美)(非正式)监狱看守

definitions.en: n. someone who drives a herd
definitions.zh: [计] 首部, 首标, 标题, 头标, 报头, 管座, 端板

examples.en: The herder led the sheep across the field.
examples.zh: 牧人领着羊群穿过田野。

examples.en: A herder watches over cattle in the mountains.
examples.zh: 牧人在山上照看牛群。

definitions.en: n. someone who argues noisily or angrily
definitions.zh: n. 口角者, 争论者, 牧人

examples.en: The wrangler argued loudly about the rules.
examples.zh: 那个争论者大声争论规则。

examples.en: He is a wrangler who never backs down.
examples.zh: 他是一个从不退缩的争论者。

definitions.en: n. robust hairy social bee of temperate regions
definitions.zh: n. [动]大黄蜂

examples.en: A bumblebee buzzed around the garden flowers.
examples.zh: 一只大黄蜂在花园的花丛中嗡嗡飞。

examples.en: The bumblebee landed on a bright yellow rose.
examples.zh: 大黄蜂落在一朵亮黄色的玫瑰上。

definitions.en: s. enjoying or affording comforting warmth and shelter especially in a small space
definitions.zh: a. 舒适的, 安逸的, 惬意的

definitions.en: s. having or fostering a warm or friendly and informal atmosphere
definitions.zh: n. (茶壶等的)保暖罩, 舒适的座位

definitions.en: s. suggesting connivance
definitions.zh: vt. 以假话使安心

examples.en: The small room felt warm and cozy.
examples.zh: 这个小房间感觉温暖又舒适。

examples.en: We had a cozy dinner by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 我们在壁炉旁吃了一顿舒适的晚餐。

definitions.en: n. a painter or drawer of portraits
definitions.zh: n. 肖像画家, 人像摄影师

examples.en: The portraitist painted a beautiful picture of her.
examples.zh: 这位肖像画家为她画了一幅美丽的画。

examples.en: A skilled portraitist captures the subject's personality.
examples.zh: 一位熟练的人像摄影师捕捉到被摄者的个性。

definitions.en: n. a deposit of valuable ore occurring within definite boundaries separating it from surrounding rocks
definitions.zh: n. 矿脉, 水路, 排水沟

examples.en: Miners discovered a rich lode of gold.
examples.zh: 矿工发现了一条丰富的金矿脉。

examples.en: The lode contained valuable silver ore.
examples.zh: 这条矿脉含有珍贵的银矿石。

definitions.en: n a source of oil; used for forage and soil improvement and as food
definitions.zh: n. 大豆

definitions.en: n erect bushy hairy annual herb having trifoliate leaves and purple to pink flowers; extensively cultivated for food and forage and soil improvement but especially for its nutritious oil-rich seeds; native to Asia
definitions.zh: [化] 大豆

examples.en: Soybean is a major source of protein.
examples.zh: 大豆是蛋白质的主要来源。

examples.en: Farmers grow soybean for food and oil.
examples.zh: 农民种植大豆用于食品和油。

definitions.en: v speak unfavorably about
definitions.zh: vt. 诽谤, 中伤, 背叛
[法] 诽谤, 中伤, 诋毁

examples.en: He tried to traduce his rival's reputation.
examples.zh: 他试图诽谤对手的名誉。

examples.en: The article traduced the politician unfairly.
examples.zh: 那篇文章不公正地中伤了那位政治家。

definitions.en: a. Multiplied by a thousand.
definitions.zh: a. 千倍的
adv. 千倍地, 成千倍

examples.en: The value increased a thousandfold over time.
examples.zh: 价值随时间增长了千倍。

examples.en: Her efforts paid off a thousandfold.
examples.zh: 她的努力得到了千倍的回报。

definitions.en: n. language or humor that is down-to-earth
definitions.zh: n. 咸性

examples.en: The saltiness of the soup was perfect.
examples.zh: 汤的咸度恰到好处。

examples.en: He enjoyed the saltiness of the sea air.
examples.zh: 他喜欢海风的咸味。

definitions.en: n something hard to endure
definitions.zh: n. 严格, 严厉, 苛刻, 严酷, 严密, 精确

definitions.en: n the quality of being valid and rigorous
definitions.zh: [医] 寒战, 强直, 僵硬

examples.en: The scientific rigor of the study was impressive.
examples.zh: 这项研究的科学严谨性令人印象深刻。

examples.en: He endured the rigor of the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 他忍受了严酷冬天的苛刻。

definitions.en: n. any substance used to provide cooling (as in a refrigerator)
definitions.zh: a. 冷冻的, 冷却的, 清凉的

definitions.en: s. causing cooling or freezing
definitions.zh: n. 清凉剂, 冷却剂, 冷冻剂
[计] 致冷剂

examples.en: The refrigerator uses a special refrigerant.
examples.zh: 冰箱使用一种特殊的冷却剂。

examples.en: Refrigerant helps keep food cold.
examples.zh: 冷却剂帮助保持食物低温。

definitions.en: v. grind and knead
definitions.zh: v. 咀嚼

examples.en: You should masticate your food thoroughly.
examples.zh: 你应该彻底咀嚼食物。

examples.en: The cow masticates grass slowly in the field.
examples.zh: 牛在田里慢慢咀嚼草。

definitions.en: v. remove the contents of
definitions.zh: vt. 取出内脏, 除去精华, 切除(病人)器官

definitions.en: v. take away a vital or essential part of
definitions.zh: vi. (因手术不良)内脏凸出

examples.en: The chef eviscerated the fish before cooking.
examples.zh: 厨师在烹饪前取出了鱼的内脏。

examples.en: The new law eviscerated the old regulations.
examples.zh: 新法律废除了旧规定中的精华。

definitions.en: v behave well or properly
definitions.zh: vt. 举动, 表现

definitions.en: v behave in a certain manner
definitions.zh: vi. 相称, 适合

examples.en: She comports herself with dignity at all times.
examples.zh: 她始终举止端庄。

examples.en: His actions do not comport with his words.
examples.zh: 他的行为与言语不相称。

definitions.en: v. exploit for maximal profit, usually by sacrificing quality
definitions.zh: vt. 使商业化, 使商品化, 使能营利, 在...发展商业

definitions.en: v. make commercial
definitions.zh: [经] 使商业化, 使商品化, 在...发展商业

examples.en: They want to commercialize their new invention.
examples.zh: 他们想将新发明商业化。

examples.en: The company plans to commercialize the product soon.
examples.zh: 公司计划很快将产品商品化。

definitions.en: s. rigidly formal or bound by convention
definitions.zh: a. 讲究仪式的, 隆重的

examples.en: The wedding was a ceremonious event with many rituals.
examples.zh: 婚礼是一个隆重的活动，有许多仪式。

examples.en: He gave a ceremonious bow to the queen.
examples.zh: 他向女王隆重地鞠躬。

definitions.en: n persistent petty and unjustified criticism
definitions.zh: a. 吹毛求疵的, 挑毛病的

examples.en: His constant carping annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他不断的吹毛求疵惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: Stop carping and offer a solution.
examples.zh: 别挑剔了，提出一个解决方案。

definitions.en: n the branch of mechanics that deals with the motion of gases (especially air) and their effects on bodies in the flow
definitions.zh: n. 空气动力学
[化] 空气动力学

examples.en: Aerodynamics helps design faster cars.
examples.zh: 空气动力学有助于设计更快的汽车。

examples.en: The plane's shape improves aerodynamics.
examples.zh: 飞机的形状改善了空气动力学性能。

definitions.en: v kill with or as if with a burst of gunfire or electric current or as if by shooting
definitions.zh: v. (使)蒸发

examples.en: The sun will vaporize the water in the puddle.
examples.zh: 太阳会使水坑里的水蒸发。

examples.en: The heat vaporized the liquid quickly.
examples.zh: 热量迅速蒸发了液体。

definitions.en: v. weaken mentally or morally
definitions.zh: vt. 使衰弱
a. 衰弱的, 无力的

examples.en: The long illness began to enervate him.
examples.zh: 漫长的疾病开始使他衰弱。

examples.en: Heat can enervate even the strongest person.
examples.zh: 炎热甚至能使最强壮的人衰弱。

definitions.en: n liveliness and eagerness
definitions.zh: n. 轻快, 活泼

examples.en: The briskness of the morning air woke her up.
examples.zh: 早晨空气的轻快让她清醒。

examples.en: He walked with briskness and energy.
examples.zh: 他轻快而有活力地走着。

definitions.en: n. a carpenter who helps build and launch wooden vessels
definitions.zh: n. 造船木匠

examples.en: The shipwright built a strong wooden boat.
examples.zh: 造船木匠造了一艘坚固的木船。

examples.en: A skilled shipwright worked on the vessel.
examples.zh: 一位熟练的造船木匠在船上工作。

definitions.en: v. cause to become equal or homogeneous as by mixing
definitions.zh: vi. 变均匀

definitions.en: v. break up the fat globules of
definitions.zh: vt. 使均匀

examples.en: The machine helps homogenize the milk.
examples.zh: 这台机器帮助使牛奶均匀。

examples.en: They homogenize the mixture for a smooth texture.
examples.zh: 他们使混合物均匀以获得光滑的质地。

definitions.en: n any agreeable (pleasing and harmonious) sounds
definitions.zh: n. 悦耳之音

examples.en: The euphony of the music relaxed everyone.
examples.zh: 音乐的悦耳之音让每个人放松。

examples.en: She loved the euphony of the birds singing.
examples.zh: 她喜欢鸟儿歌唱的悦耳之音。

definitions.en: v pronounce not guilty of criminal charges
definitions.zh: vt. 使无罪, 开脱
[法] 使无罪, 申辩无罪, 辩解

examples.en: The evidence helped exculpate the suspect.
examples.zh: 证据帮助开脱了嫌疑人的罪名。

examples.en: He tried to exculpate himself from blame.
examples.zh: 他试图为自己开脱责任。

definitions.en: n. a four-sided polygon
definitions.zh: a. 四边形的

definitions.en: s. having four sides
definitions.zh: [医] 四边形的, 四边形

examples.en: A square is a type of quadrilateral.
examples.zh: 正方形是一种四边形。

examples.en: The shape has four sides, so it is quadrilateral.
examples.zh: 这个形状有四条边，所以是四边形的。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to monochromatism
definitions.zh: a. 单色的, 单频的

definitions.en: a. (of light or other electromagnetic radiation) having only one wavelength
definitions.zh: [化] 单色的

examples.en: The room was decorated in monochromatic colors.
examples.zh: 房间用单色装饰。

examples.en: He prefers monochromatic light for photography.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢单色光用于摄影。

definitions.en: n. a member of any of about two dozen Native American peoples called `Pueblos' by the Spanish because they live in pueblos (villages built of adobe and rock)
definitions.zh: n. 普韦布洛印第安人, 印第安人村庄

examples.en: The pueblo was built with adobe bricks.
examples.zh: 这个印第安人村庄是用土坯砖建造的。

examples.en: They visited an ancient pueblo in New Mexico.
examples.zh: 他们参观了新墨西哥州的一个古老村庄。

definitions.en: n. the branch of geology studying the folding and faulting of the earth's crust
definitions.zh: n. 构造学, 构造地质学

examples.en: Tectonics studies the movement of Earth's crust.
examples.zh: 构造学研究地壳的运动。

examples.en: Plate tectonics explains earthquakes and volcanoes.
examples.zh: 板块构造学解释了地震和火山。

definitions.en: n. a primate of the family Hominidae
definitions.zh: n. 人科的动物

examples.en: The hominid walked upright on two legs.
examples.zh: 这种人科动物用两条腿直立行走。

examples.en: Scientists found a fossil of an ancient hominid.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了一种古代人科动物的化石。

definitions.en: a having or covered with hair
definitions.zh: a. 多毛的, 有粗毛的
[医] 多毛的

examples.en: The hirsute man had a thick beard.
examples.zh: 那个多毛的男人留着浓密的胡子。

examples.en: Her hirsute arms were covered in hair.
examples.zh: 她多毛的手臂上长满了汗毛。

definitions.en: v make something by hand
definitions.zh: v. 手工, 手艺( handcraft的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: She bought a handcrafted wooden bowl.
examples.zh: 她买了一个手工制作的木碗。

examples.en: The handcrafted jewelry is very beautiful.
examples.zh: 这件手工制作的珠宝非常漂亮。

definitions.en: v be deliberately ambiguous or unclear in order to mislead or withhold information
definitions.zh: vi. 说模棱两可的话, 支吾

examples.en: Politicians often equivocate to avoid answering.
examples.zh: 政客们常常支吾其词以避免回答。

examples.en: Don't equivocate; just tell me the truth.
examples.zh: 别含糊其辞，直接告诉我真相。

definitions.en: n. the leader of a dance band
definitions.zh: n. 伴舞乐队的指挥

examples.en: The bandleader directed the musicians on stage.
examples.zh: 乐队指挥在舞台上指导乐手。

examples.en: A good bandleader keeps the music lively.
examples.zh: 一个好的乐队指挥让音乐保持活泼。

definitions.en: v work in an administrative capacity; supervise or be in charge of
definitions.zh: vt. 管理, 支配

examples.en: She will administrate the new project.
examples.zh: 她将管理这个新项目。

examples.en: He helps administrate the school's budget.
examples.zh: 他帮助管理学校的预算。

definitions.en: v. mix up or confuse
definitions.zh: vt. 使昏乱, 使腐坏

definitions.en: v. become rotten
definitions.zh: vi. 变质
a. 昏乱的, 腐坏的

examples.en: The heat will addle the eggs if left out.
examples.zh: 如果放在外面，热量会使鸡蛋腐坏。

examples.en: His confusing speech seemed to addle my mind.
examples.zh: 他令人困惑的演讲似乎使我的头脑昏乱。

definitions.en: s very generous
definitions.zh: a. 丰厚的, 慷慨的

examples.en: The munificent donor gave a large sum of money.
examples.zh: 这位慷慨的捐赠者捐了一大笔钱。

examples.en: Her munificent gift helped build the library.
examples.zh: 她丰厚的礼物帮助建造了图书馆。

definitions.en: n. the property of being physically malleable; the property of something that can be worked or hammered or shaped without breaking
definitions.zh: n. 可展性, 可锻性, 顺从
[医] 展性

examples.en: Gold's malleability makes it easy to shape.
examples.zh: 金的可展性使其易于塑形。

examples.en: The metal's malleability is useful for jewelry.
examples.zh: 这种金属的可锻性对珠宝制作很有用。

definitions.en: s dissenting (especially dissenting with the majority opinion)
definitions.zh: a. 好搞派系的, 好结党营私的

examples.en: The factious group disagreed with the majority.
examples.zh: 这个好搞派系的团体不同意多数人的意见。

examples.en: Factious arguments delayed the decision.
examples.zh: 好搞派系的争论推迟了决定。

definitions.en: n a wild gathering involving excessive drinking and promiscuity
definitions.zh: vt. 使堕落

definitions.en: v corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality
definitions.zh: vi. 放荡
n. 放荡

examples.en: The party was a debauch of drinking and dancing.
examples.zh: 派对是一场饮酒和跳舞的放荡聚会。

examples.en: He tried to debauch his friend with bad habits.
examples.zh: 他试图用坏习惯使他的朋友堕落。

definitions.en: n. terseness and economy in writing and speaking achieved by expressing a great deal in just a few words
definitions.zh: [计] 简明性, 简洁性
[经] 简洁性

examples.en: Conciseness is important in good writing.
examples.zh: 简洁性在好写作中很重要。

examples.en: She valued conciseness in her speeches.
examples.zh: 她重视演讲中的简洁性。

definitions.en: n. the act of ceding
definitions.zh: n. 割让, 转让
[经] 财产权利等的转让, 再保险

examples.en: The cession of land ended the long dispute.
examples.zh: 土地的割让结束了长期的争端。

examples.en: They agreed to the cession of their rights.
examples.zh: 他们同意转让他们的权利。

definitions.en: a. Of or pertaining to embryology.
definitions.zh: [医]胚胎学的

examples.en: Embryological studies focus on early development.
examples.zh: 胚胎学研究关注早期发育。

examples.en: The embryological process is fascinating.
examples.zh: 胚胎学的过程很迷人。

definitions.en: n a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
definitions.zh: n. 出租车

examples.en: She hailed a taxicab to go to the airport.
examples.zh: 她叫了一辆出租车去机场。

examples.en: The taxicab driver knew the city well.
examples.zh: 出租车司机很熟悉这座城市。

definitions.en: n. someone who flies a balloon
definitions.zh: n. 驾驶/操纵气球的人

examples.en: The balloonist soared high above the clouds.
examples.zh: 气球驾驶员在云层之上翱翔。

examples.en: A skilled balloonist navigates the wind carefully.
examples.zh: 熟练的气球驾驶员小心地驾驭风向。

definitions.en: n. a deep fissure
definitions.zh: n. 裂缝, (堤、坝等的)决口, 崩溃处
vt. 使有裂缝

examples.en: The climber fell into a deep crevasse.
examples.zh: 登山者掉进了一个深裂缝。

examples.en: A crevasse in the glacier was dangerous.
examples.zh: 冰川上的裂缝很危险。

definitions.en: n a thin sheet of metal (iron or steel) coated with tin to prevent rusting; used especially for cans, pots, and tins
definitions.zh: n. 镀锡铁皮, 马口铁
[化] 镀锡薄钢板

examples.en: Tinplate is used to make food cans.
examples.zh: 马口铁用于制作食品罐。

examples.en: The factory produces tinplate for packaging.
examples.zh: 工厂生产用于包装的镀锡铁皮。

definitions.en: a. of or concerned with choreography
definitions.zh: a. 舞蹈艺术的, 舞台舞蹈的

examples.en: The choreographic design was very creative.
examples.zh: 舞蹈艺术的设计非常有创意。

examples.en: She studied choreographic techniques in college.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习了舞蹈艺术技巧。

definitions.en: n. idle or foolish and irrelevant talk
definitions.zh: vi. 唠叨, 空谈
vt. 瞎扯
n. 唠叨, 空谈, 瞎扯

examples.en: Stop your prate and listen to me.
examples.zh: 别唠叨了，听我说。

examples.en: His prate about nothing bored everyone.
examples.zh: 他关于无聊事的空谈让所有人厌烦。

definitions.en: s likely to spread and cause an epidemic disease
definitions.zh: a. 瘟疫的, 有害的, 传播疾病的, 讨厌的, 恼人的
[医] 疫病的

examples.en: The pestilential disease spread quickly.
examples.zh: 这种瘟疫疾病迅速传播。

examples.en: Pestilential rats carried the plague.
examples.zh: 传播疾病的老鼠携带了瘟疫。

definitions.en: s marked by excessive confidence
definitions.zh: a. 过于自信的, 自负的
[法] 过于自信的, 过于自恃的

examples.en: He was overconfident and failed the test.
examples.zh: 他过于自信，考试没通过。

examples.en: Being overconfident can lead to mistakes.
examples.zh: 过于自信会导致错误。

definitions.en: s. not produced by natural forces
definitions.zh: a. 人为的, 人工的, 不自然的
[医] 人工的, 人造的, 假的

examples.en: The smile on his face seemed factitious.
examples.zh: 他脸上的微笑似乎不自然。

examples.en: They created a factitious demand for the product.
examples.zh: 他们为产品制造了人为的需求。

definitions.en: v. make stupid with alcohol
definitions.zh: vt. 使昏沉, 使迷惑, 使糊涂

examples.en: The loud noise seemed to befuddle the old man.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音似乎让老人昏沉。

examples.en: Too much information can befuddle a student.
examples.zh: 太多信息会让学生迷惑。

definitions.en: v. be later in time
definitions.zh: vt. 填迟...的日期

definitions.en: v. establish something as being later relative to something else
definitions.zh: n. 事后日期

examples.en: Please postdate the check to next week.
examples.zh: 请把支票的日期填到下周。

examples.en: The event will postdate the previous one.
examples.zh: 这个事件将发生在之前的事件之后。

definitions.en: n. the head of a pin
definitions.zh: n. 针头, 小东西, 微不足道的东西

examples.en: The pinhead is very small and sharp.
examples.zh: 针头非常小且尖锐。

examples.en: He compared the problem to a pinhead.
examples.zh: 他把这个问题比作针头一样微不足道。

definitions.en: n. a woodworker who specializes in making furniture
definitions.zh: n. 家具师, 细工木匠

examples.en: The cabinetmaker built a beautiful wooden table.
examples.zh: 家具师制作了一张漂亮的木桌。

examples.en: A skilled cabinetmaker uses fine tools.
examples.zh: 熟练的细工木匠使用精细工具。

definitions.en: n. a relatively flat highland
definitions.zh: n. 高地

examples.en: The tableland offered a wide view of the valley.
examples.zh: 高地提供了山谷的广阔视野。

examples.en: Complacence can prevent improvement.
examples.zh: 自满会阻碍进步。

examples.zh: 音乐柔和而悦耳。

definitions.en: n the act of calling down a curse that invokes evil (and usually serves as an insult)

examples.zh: 她在小型立式钢琴上弹奏了一首优美的旋律。

examples.zh: 那架旧的小型拨弦古钢琴代代相传。

definitions.en: n. a decorative pin that is worn in a necktie

definitions.en: n someone who takes spoils or plunder (as in war)

definitions.en: a. not provident; not providing for the future

examples.en: An improvident person does not save money.

examples.zh: 你可以轻松地使金属棒带磁力。

examples.zh: 演讲者的话吸引了观众。

definitions.en: n. the outer region of the Earth's atmosphere; contains a high concentration of free electrons

examples.zh: 电离层将无线电波反射回地球。

examples.zh: 卫星在电离层上方轨道运行。

definitions.en: n a person who is devoted to eating and drinking to excess
definitions.zh: n. 美食家

examples.zh: 那位美食家在餐厅享用了一顿大餐。

examples.en: A gourmand loves fine food and drink.
examples.zh: 美食家热爱美食和饮品。

definitions.en: v. make more industrial or city-like
definitions.zh: vt. 使都市化, 使成都市式, 使文雅

examples.zh: 城市计划使农村地区都市化。

examples.zh: 他们想快速使该地区城市化。

definitions.en: v to bear a reciprocal or mutual relation
definitions.zh: a. 有相互关系的

examples.zh: 这两组数据是相关的。

examples.en: Their results correlated with the theory.
examples.zh: 他们的结果与理论相关。

definitions.zh: n. 市郊化, 郊区化；近郊化

examples.zh: 郊区化改变了许多小镇。

examples.en: The city experienced rapid suburbanization.
examples.zh: 这座城市经历了快速的郊区化。

definitions.en: v. read for errors

examples.zh: 请发送前校对这份文件。

examples.zh: 她校对文章以修正错误。

examples.zh: 他们通过更好的储存减少了损耗。

definitions.en: n. the intensely luminous surface of a star (especially the sun)

examples.zh: 太阳的光球非常明亮。

definitions.zh: n. (大学)研究生助教奖学金

examples.en: His assistantship helped pay for tuition.
examples.zh: 他的助教奖学金帮助支付了学费。

definitions.zh: 残存性, 生存性, 耐受性

examples.zh: 该物种的生存性很高。

examples.en: They tested the vehicle's survivability.
examples.zh: 他们测试了车辆的耐受性。

definitions.en: n. a state or atmosphere of harmony or mutual civility and respect

examples.zh: 国家间的礼让促进和平。

definitions.en: n. untanned hide especially of cattle; cut in strips it is used for whips and ropes

examples.zh: 她学会了用符号记录舞步。

examples.zh: 她的副业是画风景画。

definitions.en: a of or relating to the science of acoustics

definitions.en: a. having no odor

definitions.en: n. a person skilled in testing for defects of vision in order to prescribe corrective glasses

examples.en: The per capita income has increased this year.
examples.zh: 今年人均收入增加了。

examples.en: We calculated the per capita water usage.
examples.zh: 我们计算了人均用水量。

definitions.en: n. the process of turning some plant material into stone by infiltration with water carrying mineral particles without changing the original shape
definitions.zh: n. 使变成石头, 石化, 化石, 僵化, 吓呆

definitions.en: n. a rock created by petrifaction; an organic object infiltrated with mineral matter and preserved in its original form
definitions.zh: [医] 石化

examples.en: Petrifaction turns wood into stone over time.
examples.zh: 石化过程随时间将木头变成石头。

examples.en: The petrifaction of the tree amazed the scientists.
examples.zh: 那棵树的石化让科学家们惊叹。

definitions.en: n any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning
definitions.zh: pl. 现象

examples.en: Natural phenomena like rain are common.
examples.zh: 像雨这样的自然现象很常见。

examples.en: Scientists study many strange phenomena.
examples.zh: 科学家研究许多奇怪的现象。

definitions.en: n. the act of stealing small amounts or small articles
definitions.zh: n. 小偷小摸, 偷窃, 赃物
[经] 偷窃险, 脏物

examples.en: The store suffered from pilferage of small items.
examples.zh: 这家商店遭受了小件物品的偷窃。

examples.en: Pilferage is a problem in many workplaces.
examples.zh: 小偷小摸是许多工作场所的问题。

definitions.en: s. using simple and direct language
definitions.zh: a. 老实说的, 直言无隐的, 言辞率直的

examples.en: She is a plainspoken person who tells the truth.
examples.zh: 她是个直言无隐的人，总是说实话。

examples.en: His plainspoken advice helped me a lot.
examples.zh: 他直言不讳的建议帮了我很多。

definitions.en: n the sound like water splashing
definitions.zh: n. 浅池, 积水坑, 击水声, (水的)飞溅

definitions.en: v interlace the shoots of
definitions.zh: v. (水)溅泼

examples.en: We heard the plash of water in the pond.
examples.zh: 我们听到池塘里水的溅泼声。

examples.en: The plash of rain was soothing to hear.
examples.zh: 雨水的溅泼声听起来很舒缓。

definitions.en: s as the hard flattened scales of e.g. sharks
definitions.zh: 板状的, 层状的

examples.en: The fish has platelike scales on its body.
examples.zh: 这条鱼身上有板状的鳞片。

examples.en: Platelike structures protect the animal's skin.
examples.zh: 板状结构保护了动物的皮肤。

definitions.en: v. adjourn by royal prerogative; without dissolving the legislative body
definitions.zh: vt.vi. (使)闭会, (使)休会
[法] 使休会, 使闭会

examples.en: The king decided to prorogue the parliament.
examples.zh: 国王决定使议会休会。

examples.en: They voted to prorogue the session early.
examples.zh: 他们投票使会议提前休会。

definitions.en: v. t. To compose again; to form anew; to put together again
definitions.zh: vt. 重组, 修改, 使镇定

examples.en: She tried to recompose herself after the shock.
examples.zh: 震惊之后她试图让自己镇定下来。

examples.en: The artist will recompose the painting's layout.
examples.zh: 艺术家将重新构图这幅画的布局。

definitions.en: a. that is able or fit be rented
definitions.zh: a. 可租的, 可收租金的
[法] 可租的, 可收租金的

examples.en: This apartment is rentable at a low price.
examples.zh: 这套公寓以低价可租。

examples.en: The property is rentable for the summer season.
examples.zh: 这处房产夏季可租。

definitions.en: v. cause to turn
definitions.zh: vt. 使适应, 再调整

examples.en: We need to reorient our business strategy.
examples.zh: 我们需要重新调整商业策略。

examples.en: She will reorient the map to face north.
examples.zh: 她会把地图调整方向朝北。

definitions.en: n. an act of requiting; returning in kind
definitions.zh: n. 酬答, 还礼
[法] 报答, 回报, 报复

examples.en: He received requital for his hard work.
examples.zh: 他因努力工作得到了回报。

examples.en: Requital for kindness is not always expected.
examples.zh: 善意的回报并不总是被期待。

definitions.en: n an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction
definitions.zh: n. 虚墟, 遗迹

examples.en: The ancient ruins attract many tourists every year.
examples.zh: 古老的遗迹每年吸引许多游客。

examples.en: The earthquake left the city in ruins.
examples.zh: 地震使这座城市变成废墟。

definitions.en: n ability to apply knowledge or experience or understanding or common sense and insight
definitions.zh: n. 象有学识, 装聪明, 智慧

examples.en: The old man's sapience was respected by all.
examples.zh: 老人的智慧受到所有人的尊敬。

examples.en: Sapience comes from experience and learning.
examples.zh: 智慧来自经验和学习。

definitions.en: n. a fund of money put by as a reserve
definitions.zh: n. 储蓄, 存款
[经] 储金, 储蓄

examples.en: She keeps her savings in a bank account.
examples.zh: 她把储蓄存在银行账户里。

examples.en: We used our savings to buy a house.
examples.zh: 我们用存款买了房子。

definitions.en: n the act of damaging something or someone
definitions.zh: n. 危害, 损伤, 损害
vt. 损伤, 伤害, 痛斥

examples.en: The storm caused scathe to the crops.
examples.zh: 暴风雨对庄稼造成了损害。

examples.en: He escaped without scathe from the accident.
examples.zh: 他毫发无损地从事故中逃脱。

definitions.en: n a man who serves as a sailor
definitions.zh: 水兵, 海员, 水手

examples.en: The seamen worked hard on the ship.
examples.zh: 海员们在船上努力工作。

examples.en: Many seamen enjoy life at sea.
examples.zh: 许多海员喜欢海上生活。

definitions.en: n. a gastrointestinal hormone that stimulates the secretion of water and bicarbonate from the pancreas and bile ducts whenever the stomach empties too much acid into the small intestine
definitions.zh: n. 促胰液素
[化] 肠促胰液肽; 胰泌素

examples.en: Secretin helps the pancreas release digestive juices.
examples.zh: 促胰液素帮助胰腺释放消化液。

examples.en: The body produces secretin in the small intestine.
examples.zh: 身体在小肠中产生促胰液素。

definitions.en: s. able to provide for your own needs without help from others
definitions.zh: a. 自给自足的, 极为自负的

examples.en: The village is self-sufficient in food.
examples.zh: 这个村庄在食物上自给自足。

examples.en: She wants to be self-sufficient and independent.
examples.zh: 她想要自给自足且独立。

definitions.en: s. somewhat arid
definitions.zh: a. 雨量非常少的, 半干旱的

examples.en: The semiarid region receives little rainfall.
examples.zh: 半干旱地区降雨量很少。

examples.en: Plants in semiarid areas are drought-resistant.
examples.zh: 半干旱地区的植物耐旱。

definitions.en: s. literate but poorly informed
definitions.zh: n. 半文盲

examples.en: He is semiliterate and struggles with reading.
examples.zh: 他是半文盲，阅读有困难。

examples.en: Semiliterate people often need help with forms.
examples.zh: 半文盲的人经常需要帮忙填表。

definitions.zh: 半熔化的

examples.en: The semimolten rock flowed slowly down the volcano.
examples.zh: 半熔化的岩石缓慢地流下火山。

examples.en: Semimolten glass can be shaped into bottles.
examples.zh: 半熔化的玻璃可以塑形为瓶子。

definitions.en: s. relating to the near future
definitions.zh: a. 短射程的

definitions.en: s. limited to short distances
definitions.zh: [经] 短射程的

examples.en: We made a short-range plan for the week.
examples.zh: 我们为这周制定了一个短期计划。

examples.en: The missile has a short-range target.
examples.zh: 这枚导弹有一个短射程的目标。

definitions.zh: 航天飞机

examples.en: The space shuttle launched into orbit successfully.
examples.zh: 航天飞机成功发射进入轨道。

examples.en: Astronauts traveled to space on the space shuttle.
examples.zh: 宇航员乘坐航天飞机前往太空。

definitions.en: n an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave
definitions.zh: 系列, 范围, 谱, 光谱, 波谱, 射频频谱, 无线电信号频谱, 余象

definitions.en: n a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities
definitions.zh: [计] , 光谱, 频谱

examples.en: The spectra of light show different colors.
examples.zh: 光谱显示不同的颜色。

examples.en: Scientists analyze spectra to study stars.
examples.zh: 科学家分析光谱来研究恒星。

definitions.en: v revolve quickly and repeatedly around one's own axis
definitions.zh: a. 有背骨的, 有脊柱的, 有刺的

examples.en: The spined cactus is dangerous to touch.
examples.zh: 有刺的仙人掌触摸起来很危险。

examples.en: Some animals have spined bodies for protection.
examples.zh: 有些动物有带刺的身体用于保护。

definitions.zh: 立体照片, 立体照相, 立体照像

examples.en: A stereophotograph gives a three-dimensional view.
examples.zh: 立体照片提供三维视角。

examples.en: He took a stereophotograph of the mountain scene.
examples.zh: 他拍了一张山景的立体照片。

definitions.en: n any stimulating information or event; acts to arouse action
definitions.zh: 剌激, 剌激物, 促进因素, 动因
[医] 刺激特, 刺激

examples.en: External stimuli can affect our behavior.
examples.zh: 外部刺激会影响我们的行为。

examples.en: The brain responds to various stimuli quickly.
examples.zh: 大脑对各种刺激反应迅速。

definitions.en: n one of several parallel layers of material arranged one on top of another (such as a layer of tissue or cells in an organism or a layer of sedimentary rock)
definitions.zh: pl. 层, 地层, 阶层

definitions.en: n people having the same social, economic, or educational status
definitions.zh: [医] 层

examples.en: Different social strata have different lifestyles.
examples.zh: 不同的社会阶层有不同的生活方式。

examples.en: Geologists study rock strata to learn history.
examples.zh: 地质学家研究岩层来了解历史。

definitions.en: n the section of an orchestra that plays stringed instruments
definitions.zh: n. 附带条件, 弦乐部分, 弦乐器

examples.en: The strings section played beautifully in the concert.
examples.zh: 弦乐部分在音乐会上演奏得很美。

examples.en: He learned to play the violin in strings.
examples.zh: 他在弦乐器中学拉小提琴。

definitions.zh: n. 学科的分支

examples.en: Biochemistry is a subdiscipline of biology.
examples.zh: 生物化学是生物学的一个分支学科。

examples.en: Each subdiscipline focuses on a specific area.
examples.zh: 每个分支学科专注于一个特定领域。

definitions.en: v. t. To withdraw; to take away.
definitions.zh: vt. 减去, 拿掉

definitions.en: v. t. To subtract by arithmetical operation; to deduct.
definitions.zh: [医] 下转

examples.en: One tectonic plate can subduct under another.
examples.zh: 一个构造板块可以俯冲到另一个之下。

examples.en: The accountant will subduct the expenses from total.
examples.zh: 会计将从总额中减去开支。

definitions.en: v cause to experience or suffer or make liable or vulnerable to
definitions.zh: v. 使从属；受…影响；使遭受（subject的过去分词形式）

examples.en: The workers were subjected to long hours.
examples.zh: 工人们遭受了长时间的工作。

examples.en: She was subjected to unfair treatment at work.
examples.zh: 她在工作中遭受了不公平待遇。

definitions.en: v. t. To heat too much, to overheat; as, to superheat an
definitions.zh: vt. 使过热

definitions.en: oven.
definitions.zh: n. 过热

examples.en: The engine can superheat the steam for power.
examples.zh: 发动机可以过热蒸汽以产生动力。

examples.en: Do not superheat the metal or it will melt.
examples.zh: 不要过热金属，否则它会熔化。

definitions.en: n elastic straps that hold trousers up (usually used in the plural)
definitions.zh: n. 悬挂者(物), 袜吊, 吊裤带
[医] 悬吊带, 悬吊器

examples.en: He wore suspenders to keep his pants up.
examples.zh: 他穿吊裤带以保持裤子不掉。

examples.en: The suspender broke and his trousers fell down.
examples.zh: 吊裤带断了，他的裤子掉了下来。

definitions.en: n. the branch of military science dealing with detailed maneuvers to achieve objectives set by strategy
definitions.zh: n. 用兵学, 战术, 兵法
[经] 战术, 策略

examples.en: The coach changed the team's tactics.
examples.zh: 教练改变了球队的战术。

examples.en: Good tactics can win the game.
examples.zh: 好的战术可以赢得比赛。

definitions.en: n. the time of life between the ages of 12 and 20
definitions.zh: n. 十三岁到十九岁

examples.en: Many teens enjoy playing video games.
examples.zh: 许多青少年喜欢玩电子游戏。

examples.en: She is in her teens and loves music.
examples.zh: 她十几岁，热爱音乐。

definitions.zh: 远程工作者

examples.en: A telecommuter works from home using a computer.
examples.zh: 远程工作者在家用电脑工作。

examples.en: The company hired many telecommuters for efficiency.
examples.zh: 公司为了效率雇用了许多远程工作者。

definitions.en: r. by three orders of magnitude
definitions.zh: adv. 千倍, 千重
a. 千倍, 千重

examples.en: The population grew thousand-fold over the century.
examples.zh: 人口在一个世纪里增长了千倍。

examples.en: His wealth increased thousand-fold after the investment.
examples.zh: 投资后他的财富增加了千倍。

definitions.en: s thin in diameter; resembling a thread
definitions.zh: a. 丝状的, 像丝的, 细长的

examples.en: The threadlike roots spread through the soil.
examples.zh: 丝状的根在土壤中蔓延。

examples.en: She noticed threadlike veins on the leaf.
examples.zh: 她注意到叶子上丝状的叶脉。

definitions.en: s. involving or relating to three dimensions or aspects; giving the illusion of depth
definitions.zh: a. 三维的, 立体的, 真实的

examples.en: The movie was shown in three-dimensional format.
examples.zh: 这部电影以三维格式放映。

examples.en: A three-dimensional model helps visualize the design.
examples.zh: 三维模型有助于可视化设计。

definitions.en: s. of a task that takes time and patience
definitions.zh: a. 耗时的

examples.en: This task is very time-consuming.
examples.zh: 这项任务非常耗时。

examples.en: Cleaning the house is time-consuming.
examples.zh: 打扫房子很耗时。

definitions.en: a. having a toe or toes of a specified kind; often used in combination
definitions.zh: a. 有趾的, 斜着钉进去的

examples.en: The bird is long-toed.
examples.zh: 这只鸟有长趾。

examples.en: He toed the nail carefully.
examples.zh: 他小心地把钉子斜着钉进去。

definitions.en: s. of sexual organs; stiff and rigid
definitions.zh: a. 肿胀的, 肿大的
[医] 肿胀的

examples.en: The tumid wound needed medical attention.
examples.zh: 肿胀的伤口需要医疗处理。

examples.en: His tumid ankle made walking difficult.
examples.zh: 他肿胀的脚踝使行走困难。

definitions.zh: n. 超声学
[医] 超声学

examples.en: Ultrasonics is used in medicine.
examples.zh: 超声学用于医学。

examples.en: He studies ultrasonics at university.
examples.zh: 他在大学学习超声学。

definitions.en: r. without scruples
definitions.zh: adv. 不客气地, 无道德原则地

examples.en: He acted unscrupulously to win.
examples.zh: 他为了赢不择手段。

examples.en: She unscrupulously took the money.
examples.zh: 她毫无道德地拿走了钱。

definitions.en: s being in such a position that top and bottom are reversed
definitions.zh: a. 颠倒的, 乱七八糟的

examples.en: The picture is hanging upside-down.
examples.zh: 这幅画挂倒了。

examples.en: He turned the box upside-down.
examples.zh: 他把盒子颠倒过来。

definitions.en: v make a veinlike pattern
definitions.zh: n. 脉纹的形成, 脉纹的排列
[机] 铸模龟裂

examples.en: The leaf has beautiful veining.
examples.zh: 这片叶子有美丽的脉纹。

examples.en: Veining appears on the metal surface.
examples.zh: 金属表面出现了脉纹。

definitions.en: n. one who believes in vitalism
definitions.zh: n. 生机论者, 活力论者
[医] 生机论者, 生活力说者

examples.en: The vitalist believes in life force.
examples.zh: 生机论者相信生命力。

examples.en: A vitalist studies living organisms.
examples.zh: 活力论者研究生物体。

definitions.en: a. Authorized by commission, precept, or right;
definitions.zh: a. 可保证的, 可担保的, 可证明为正当的

definitions.en: justifiable; defensible; as, the seizure of a thief is always
definitions.zh: [法] 可保证的, 可承认的, 正当的

examples.en: His action is warrantable.
examples.zh: 他的行为是正当的。

examples.en: This claim is warrantable by law.
examples.zh: 这个主张在法律上是可保证的。

definitions.en: n finch-like African and Asian colonial birds noted for their elaborately woven nests
definitions.zh: n. 织布鸟

examples.en: The weaverbird builds a nest.
examples.zh: 织布鸟筑巢。

examples.en: We saw a weaverbird in Africa.
examples.zh: 我们在非洲看到了一只织布鸟。

definitions.en: a. shaped like a wedge
definitions.zh: a. 楔形的
[化] 楔形

examples.en: The wedge-shaped piece fits here.
examples.zh: 楔形的那块适合这里。

examples.en: A wedge-shaped stone is useful.
examples.zh: 楔形石头很有用。

definitions.en: n a contented state of being happy and healthy and prosperous
definitions.zh: a. 安宁的, 康乐的

examples.en: Exercise improves your well-being.
examples.zh: 锻炼改善你的康乐。

examples.en: She cares about her well-being.
examples.zh: 她关心自己的安宁。
